verses.textZh: 尊敬的提阿非罗先生，因为有许多人，已经把在我们中间成就了的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 尊敬的提阿非罗先生，因为有许多人，已经把在我们中间成就了的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事我既从起头都详细考察了，就定意要按着次序写给你，
verses.textEnNiv: Many have undertaken to draw up an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us,
verses.textEnEsv: Inasmuch as many have undertaken to compile a narrative of the things that have been accomplished among us,
verses.textEnNkjv: Inasmuch as many have taken in hand to set in order a narrative of those things which have been fulfilled among us,
verses.textEnNlt: Many people have set out to write accounts about the events that have been fulfilled among us.
verses.textEnNasb: Since many have undertaken to compile an account of the things accomplished among us,
verses.textEn: Many have undertaken to draw up an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us,

verses.textZh: 按照起初亲眼看见的传道人所传给我们的，编着成书；
verses.textZhCnvs: 按照起初亲眼看见的传道人所传给我们的，编着成书；
verses.textZhCuv: 使你知道所学之道都是确实的。
verses.textEnNiv: just as they were handed down to us by those who from the first were eyewitnesses and servants of the word.
verses.textEnEsv: just as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and ministers of the word have delivered them to us,
verses.textEnNkjv: just as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and ministers of the word delivered them to us,
verses.textEnNlt: They used the eyewitness reports circulating among us from the early disciples.
verses.textEnNasb: just as they were handed down to us by those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word,
verses.textEn: just as they were handed down to us by those who from the first were eyewitnesses and servants of the word.

verses.textZh: 我已经把这些事从头考查过，认为也应该按着次序写给你，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我已经把这些事从头考查过，认为也应该按着次序写给你，
verses.textZhCuv: 当犹太王希律的时候，亚比雅班里有一个祭司，名叫撒迦利亚；他妻子是亚伦的后人，名叫伊利莎白。
verses.textEnNiv: With this in mind, since I myself have carefully investigated everything from the beginning, I too decided to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,
verses.textEnEsv: it seemed good to me also, having followed all things closely for some time past, to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,
verses.textEnNkjv: it seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write to you an orderly account, most excellent Theophilus,
verses.textEnNlt: Having carefully investigated everything from the beginning, I also have decided to write an accurate account for you, most honorable Theophilus,
verses.textEnNasb: it seemed fitting to me as well, having investigated everything carefully from the beginning, to write it out for you in an orderly sequence, most excellent Theophilus;
verses.textEn: With this in mind, since I myself have carefully investigated everything from the beginning, I too decided to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,

verses.textZh: 让你晓得所学到的道理，都是确实的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 让你晓得所学到的道理，都是确实的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们二人在神面前都是义人，遵行主的一切诫命礼仪，没有可指摘的，
verses.textEnNiv: so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught.
verses.textEnEsv: that you may have certainty concerning the things you have been taught.
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may know the certainty of those things in which you were instructed.
verses.textEnNlt: so you can be certain of the truth of everything you were taught.
verses.textEnNasb: so that you may know the exact truth about the things you have been taught.
verses.textEn: so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught.

verses.textZh: 犹太王希律在位的日子，亚比雅班里有一个祭司，名叫撒迦利亚，他妻子是亚伦的后代，名叫以利沙伯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太王希律在位的日子，亚比雅班里有一个祭司，名叫撒迦利亚，他妻子是亚伦的后代，名叫以利沙伯。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是没有孩子；因为伊利莎白不生育，两个人又年纪老迈了。
verses.textEnNiv: In the time of Herod king of Judea there was a priest named Zechariah, who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah; his wife Elizabeth was also a descendant of Aaron.
verses.textEnEsv: In the days of Herod, king of Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah, of the division of Abijah. And he had a wife from the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
verses.textEnNkjv: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the division of Abijah. His wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
verses.textEnNlt: When Herod was king of Judea, there was a Jewish priest named Zechariah. He was a member of the priestly order of Abijah, and his wife, Elizabeth, was also from the priestly line of Aaron.
verses.textEnNasb: In the days of Herod, king of Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah, of the division of Abijah; and he had a wife from the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
verses.textEn: In the time of Herod king of Judea there was a priest named Zechariah, who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah; his wife Elizabeth was also a descendant of Aaron.

verses.textZh: 他们在神面前都是义人，遵行主的一切诫命规条，无可指摘，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在神面前都是义人，遵行主的一切诫命规条，无可指摘，
verses.textZhCuv: 撒迦利亚按班次在神面前供祭司的职分，
verses.textEnNiv: Both of them were righteous in the sight of God, observing all the Lord’s commands and decrees blamelessly.
verses.textEnEsv: And they were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and statutes of the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
verses.textEnNlt: Zechariah and Elizabeth were righteous in God’s eyes, careful to obey all of the Lord’s commandments and regulations.
verses.textEnNasb: They were both righteous in the sight of God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and requirements of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Both of them were righteous in the sight of God, observing all the Lord’s commands and decrees blamelessly.

verses.textZh: 只是没有孩子，因为以利沙伯不生育，二人又都上了年纪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是没有孩子，因为以利沙伯不生育，二人又都上了年纪。
verses.textZhCuv: 照祭司的规矩掣签，得进主殿烧香。
verses.textEnNiv: But they were childless because Elizabeth was not able to conceive, and they were both very old.
verses.textEnEsv: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and both were advanced in years.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they were both well advanced in years.
verses.textEnNlt: They had no children because Elizabeth was unable to conceive, and they were both very old.
verses.textEnNasb: And yet they had no child, because Elizabeth was infertile, and they were both advanced in years.
verses.textEn: But they were childless because Elizabeth was not able to conceive, and they were both very old.

verses.textZh: 有一次，撒迦利亚在神面前按着班次执行祭司的职务，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一次，撒迦利亚在神面前按着班次执行祭司的职务，
verses.textZhCuv: 烧香的时候，众百姓在外面祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: Once when Zechariah’s division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God,
verses.textEnEsv: Now while he was serving as priest before God when his division was on duty,
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, that while he was serving as priest before God in the order of his division,
verses.textEnNlt: One day Zechariah was serving God in the Temple, for his order was on duty that week.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened that while he was performing his priestly service before God in the appointed order of his division,
verses.textEn: Once when Zechariah’s division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God,

verses.textZh: 照祭司的惯例抽中了签，进入主的圣殿烧香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照祭司的惯例抽中了签，进入主的圣殿烧香。
verses.textZhCuv: 有主的使者站在香坛的右边，向他显现。
verses.textEnNiv: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to go into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
verses.textEnEsv: according to the custom of the priesthood, he was chosen by lot to enter the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
verses.textEnNkjv: according to the custom of the priesthood, his lot fell to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: As was the custom of the priests, he was chosen by lot to enter the sanctuary of the Lord and burn incense.
verses.textEnNasb: according to the custom of the priestly office, he was chosen by lot to enter the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
verses.textEn: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to go into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

verses.textZh: 烧香的时候，众人都在外面祈祷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 烧香的时候，众人都在外面祈祷。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒迦利亚看见，就惊慌害怕。
verses.textEnNiv: And when the time for the burning of incense came, all the assembled worshipers were praying outside.
verses.textEnEsv: And the whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the whole multitude of the people was praying outside at the hour of incense.
verses.textEnNlt: While the incense was being burned, a great crowd stood outside, praying.
verses.textEnNasb: And the whole multitude of the people were in prayer outside at the hour of the incense offering.
verses.textEn: And when the time for the burning of incense came, all the assembled worshipers were praying outside.

verses.textZh: 有主的使者站在香坛右边，向他显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有主的使者站在香坛右边，向他显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 天使对他说：「撒迦利亚，不要害怕，因为你的祈祷已经被听见了。你的妻子伊利莎白要给你生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫约翰。
verses.textEnNiv: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.
verses.textEnEsv: And there appeared to him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
verses.textEnNlt: While Zechariah was in the sanctuary, an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing to the right of the incense altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Now an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing to the right of the altar of incense.
verses.textEn: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.

verses.textZh: 撒迦利亚一见就惊慌起来，十分害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒迦利亚一见就惊慌起来，十分害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必欢喜快乐；有许多人因他出世，也必喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: When Zechariah saw him, he was startled and was gripped with fear.
verses.textEnEsv: And Zechariah was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
verses.textEnNlt: Zechariah was shaken and overwhelmed with fear when he saw him.
verses.textEnNasb: Zechariah was troubled when he saw the angel, and fear gripped him.
verses.textEn: When Zechariah saw him, he was startled and was gripped with fear.

verses.textZh: 天使说："撒迦利亚，不要怕，因为你的祈求已蒙垂听，你妻子以利沙伯要给你生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫约翰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天使说："撒迦利亚，不要怕，因为你的祈求已蒙垂听，你妻子以利沙伯要给你生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫约翰。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在主面前将要为大，淡酒浓酒都不喝，从母腹里就被圣灵充满了。
verses.textEnNiv: But the angel said to him: "Do not be afraid, Zechariah; your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to call him John.
verses.textEnEsv: But the angel said to him, "Do not be afraid, Zechariah, for your prayer has been heard, and your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the angel said to him, "Do not be afraid, Zacharias, for your prayer is heard; and your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.
verses.textEnNlt: But the angel said, "Don’t be afraid, Zechariah! God has heard your prayer. Your wife, Elizabeth, will give you a son, and you are to name him John.
verses.textEnNasb: But the angel said to him, "Do not be afraid, Zechariah, for your prayer has been heard, and your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you shall name him John.
verses.textEn: But the angel said to him: "Do not be afraid, Zechariah; your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to call him John.

verses.textZh: 你必欢喜快乐，许多人因他出生，也必喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必欢喜快乐，许多人因他出生，也必喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要使许多以色列人回转，归于主－他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice because of his birth,
verses.textEnEsv: And you will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth,
verses.textEnNkjv: And you will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.
verses.textEnNlt: You will have great joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth,
verses.textEnNasb: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice over his birth.
verses.textEn: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice because of his birth,

verses.textZh: 他在主面前要被尊为大，淡酒浓酒都不喝，未出母腹就被圣灵充满。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在主面前要被尊为大，淡酒浓酒都不喝，未出母腹就被圣灵充满。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必有以利亚的心志能力，行在主的前面，叫为父的心转向儿女，叫悖逆的人转从义人的智慧，又为主预备合用的百姓。」
verses.textEnNiv: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He is never to take wine or other fermented drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even before he is born.
verses.textEnEsv: for he will be great before the Lord. And he must not drink wine or strong drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink. He will also be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.
verses.textEnNlt: for he will be great in the eyes of the Lord. He must never touch wine or other alcoholic drinks. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even before his birth.
verses.textEnNasb: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord; and he will drink no wine or liquor, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit while still in his mother’s womb.
verses.textEn: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He is never to take wine or other fermented drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even before he is born.

verses.textZh: 他要使许多以色列人转向主他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要使许多以色列人转向主他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒迦利亚对天使说：「我凭着什么可知道这事呢？我已经老了，我的妻子也年纪老迈了。」
verses.textEnNiv: He will bring back many of the people of Israel to the Lord their God.
verses.textEnEsv: And he will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNlt: And he will turn many Israelites to the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNasb: And he will turn many of the sons of Israel back to the Lord their God.
verses.textEn: He will bring back many of the people of Israel to the Lord their God.

verses.textZh: 他必有以利亚的灵和能力，行在主的前面，叫父亲的心转向儿女，叫悖逆的转向义人的意念，为主安排那预备好了的人民。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必有以利亚的灵和能力，行在主的前面，叫父亲的心转向儿女，叫悖逆的转向义人的意念，为主安排那预备好了的人民。"
verses.textZhCuv: 天使回答说：「我是站在神面前的加百列，奉差而来对你说话，将这好信息报给你。
verses.textEnNiv: And he will go on before the Lord, in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the parents to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous—to make ready a people prepared for the Lord."
verses.textEnEsv: and he will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just, to make ready for the Lord a people prepared."
verses.textEnNkjv: He will also go before Him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just, to make ready a people prepared for the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: He will be a man with the spirit and power of Elijah. He will prepare the people for the coming of the Lord. He will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children, and he will cause those who are rebellious to accept the wisdom of the godly."
verses.textEnNasb: And it is he who will go as a forerunner before Him in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of fathers back to their children, and the disobedient to the attitude of the righteous, to make ready a people prepared for the Lord."
verses.textEn: And he will go on before the Lord, in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the parents to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous—to make ready a people prepared for the Lord."

verses.textZh: 撒迦利亚对天使说："我怎么能知道这事呢？我已经老了，我妻子也上了年纪。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒迦利亚对天使说："我怎么能知道这事呢？我已经老了，我妻子也上了年纪。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到了时候，这话必然应验；只因你不信，你必哑巴，不能说话，直到这事成就的日子。」
verses.textEnNiv: Zechariah asked the angel, "How can I be sure of this? I am an old man and my wife is well along in years."
verses.textEnEsv: And Zechariah said to the angel, "How shall I know this? For I am an old man, and my wife is advanced in years."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Zacharias said to the angel, "How shall I know this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years."
verses.textEnNlt: Zechariah said to the angel, "How can I be sure this will happen? I’m an old man now, and my wife is also well along in years."
verses.textEnNasb: Zechariah said to the angel, "How will I know this? For I am an old man, and my wife is advanced in her years."
verses.textEn: Zechariah asked the angel, "How can I be sure of this? I am an old man and my wife is well along in years."

verses.textZh: 天使回答："我是站在神面前的加百列，奉差遣向你说话，报给你这好消息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天使回答："我是站在神面前的加百列，奉差遣向你说话，报给你这好消息。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓等候撒迦利亚，诧异他许久在殿里。
verses.textEnNiv: The angel said to him, "I am Gabriel. I stand in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to tell you this good news.
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel answered him, "I am Gabriel. I stand in the presence of God, and I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the angel answered and said to him, "I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God, and was sent to speak to you and bring you these glad tidings.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel said, "I am Gabriel! I stand in the very presence of God. It was he who sent me to bring you this good news!
verses.textEnNasb: The angel answered and said to him, "I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God, and I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
verses.textEn: The angel said to him, "I am Gabriel. I stand in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to tell you this good news.

verses.textZh: 看吧！到了时候我的话必要应验；因为你不信我的话，你必成为哑巴，直到这些事成就的那一天，才能说话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看吧！到了时候我的话必要应验；因为你不信我的话，你必成为哑巴，直到这些事成就的那一天，才能说话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 及至他出来，不能和他们说话，他们就知道他在殿里见了异象；因为他直向他们打手式，竟成了哑巴。
verses.textEnNiv: And now you will be silent and not able to speak until the day this happens, because you did not believe my words, which will come true at their appointed time."
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, you will be silent and unable to speak until the day that these things take place, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their time."
verses.textEnNkjv: But behold, you will be mute and not able to speak until the day these things take place, because you did not believe my words which will be fulfilled in their own time."
verses.textEnNlt: But now, since you didn’t believe what I said, you will be silent and unable to speak until the child is born. For my words will certainly be fulfilled at the proper time."
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, you will be silent and unable to speak until the day when these things take place, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled at their proper time."
verses.textEn: And now you will be silent and not able to speak until the day this happens, because you did not believe my words, which will come true at their appointed time."

verses.textZh: 众人等候撒迦利亚；因他在圣殿里迟迟不出来，觉得奇怪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人等候撒迦利亚；因他在圣殿里迟迟不出来，觉得奇怪。
verses.textZhCuv: 他供职的日子已满，就回家去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he stayed so long in the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people were waiting for Zechariah, and they were wondering at his delay in the temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marveled that he lingered so long in the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah to come out of the sanctuary, wondering why he was taking so long.
verses.textEnNasb: And meanwhile the people were waiting for Zechariah, and were wondering at his delay in the temple.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he stayed so long in the temple.

verses.textZh: 等到他出来，却不能讲话，竟成了哑巴，不断地向他们打手式，他们就知道他在圣殿里见了异象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 等到他出来，却不能讲话，竟成了哑巴，不断地向他们打手式，他们就知道他在圣殿里见了异象。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些日子以后，他的妻子伊利莎白怀了孕，就隐藏了五个月，
verses.textEnNiv: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They realized he had seen a vision in the temple, for he kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak.

verses.textEnNkjv: So when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus’ parents had fulfilled all the requirements of the law of the Lord, they returned home to Nazareth in Galilee.
verses.textEnNasb: And when His parents had completed everything in accordance with the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own city of Nazareth.
verses.textEn: When Joseph and Mary had done everything required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee to their own town of Nazareth.

verses.textZh: 孩子渐渐长大，强壮起来，充满智慧，有神的恩典在他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子渐渐长大，强壮起来，充满智慧，有神的恩典在他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 当他十二岁的时候，他们按着节期的规矩上去。
verses.textEnNiv: And the child grew and became strong; he was filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was on him.
verses.textEnEsv: And the child grew and became strong, filled with wisdom. And the favor of God was upon him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Child grew and became strong in spirit, filled with wisdom; and the grace of God was upon Him.
verses.textEnNlt: There the child grew up healthy and strong. He was filled with wisdom, and God’s favor was on him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Child continued to grow and to become strong, increasing in wisdom; and the favor of God was upon Him.
verses.textEn: And the child grew and became strong; he was filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was on him.

verses.textZh: 每年逾越节，他父母都上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每年逾越节，他父母都上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textZhCuv: 守满了节期，他们回去，孩童耶稣仍旧在耶路撒冷。他的父母并不知道，
verses.textEnNiv: Every year Jesus’ parents went to Jerusalem for the Festival of the Passover.
verses.textEnEsv: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the Feast of the Passover.
verses.textEnNkjv: His parents went to Jerusalem every year at the Feast of the Passover.
verses.textEnNlt: Every year Jesus’ parents went to Jerusalem for the Passover festival.
verses.textEnNasb: His parents went to Jerusalem every year at the Feast of the Passover.
verses.textEn: Every year Jesus’ parents went to Jerusalem for the Festival of the Passover.

verses.textZh: 当他十二岁时，他们按着节期的惯例，照常上去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当他十二岁时，他们按着节期的惯例，照常上去。
verses.textZhCuv: 以为他在同行的人中间，走了一天的路程，就在亲族和熟识的人中找他，
verses.textEnNiv: When he was twelve years old, they went up to the festival, according to the custom.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he was twelve years old, they went up according to custom.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus was twelve years old, they attended the festival as usual.
verses.textEnNasb: And when He was twelve years old, they went up there according to the custom of the feast;
verses.textEn: When he was twelve years old, they went up to the festival, according to the custom.

verses.textZh: 过完了节，他们回去的时候，孩童耶稣仍留在耶路撒冷，他父母却不知道，
verses.textZhCnvs: 过完了节，他们回去的时候，孩童耶稣仍留在耶路撒冷，他父母却不知道，
verses.textZhCuv: 既找不着，就回耶路撒冷去找他。
verses.textEnNiv: After the festival was over, while his parents were returning home, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, but they were unaware of it.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the feast was ended, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. His parents did not know it,
verses.textEnNkjv: When they had finished the days, as they returned, the Boy Jesus lingered behind in Jerusalem. And Joseph and His mother did not know it;
verses.textEnNlt: After the celebration was over, they started home to Nazareth, but Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. His parents didn’t miss him at first,
verses.textEnNasb: and as they were returning, after spending the full number of days required, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, but His parents were unaware of it.
verses.textEn: After the festival was over, while his parents were returning home, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, but they were unaware of it.

verses.textZh: 还以为他在同行的人中间。走了一天，就在亲戚和熟人中找他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 还以为他在同行的人中间。走了一天，就在亲戚和熟人中找他，
verses.textZhCuv: 过了三天，就遇见他在殿里，坐在教师中间，一面听，一面问。
verses.textEnNiv: Thinking he was in their company, they traveled on for a day. Then they began looking for him among their relatives and friends.
verses.textEnEsv: but supposing him to be in the group they went a day’s journey, but then they began to search for him among their relatives and acquaintances,
verses.textEnNkjv: but supposing Him to have been in the company, they went a day’s journey, and sought Him among their relatives and acquaintances.
verses.textEnNlt: because they assumed he was among the other travelers. But when he didn’t show up that evening, they started looking for him among their relatives and friends.
verses.textEnNasb: Instead, they thought that He was somewhere in the caravan, and they went a day’s journey; and then they began looking for Him among their relatives and acquaintances.
verses.textEn: Thinking he was in their company, they traveled on for a day. Then they began looking for him among their relatives and friends.

verses.textZh: 没有找到，就转回耶路撒冷找他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有找到，就转回耶路撒冷找他。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡听见他的，都希奇他的聪明和他的应对。
verses.textEnNiv: When they did not find him, they went back to Jerusalem to look for him.
verses.textEnEsv: and when they did not find him, they returned to Jerusalem, searching for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when they did not find Him, they returned to Jerusalem, seeking Him.
verses.textEnNlt: When they couldn’t find him, they went back to Jerusalem to search for him there.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they did not find Him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for Him.
verses.textEn: When they did not find him, they went back to Jerusalem to look for him.

verses.textZh: 过了三天，才发现他在圣殿里，坐在教师中间，一面听，一面问。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了三天，才发现他在圣殿里，坐在教师中间，一面听，一面问。
verses.textZhCuv: 他父母看见就很希奇。他母亲对他说：「我儿！为什么向我们这样行呢？看哪，你父亲和我伤心来找你！」
verses.textEnNiv: After three days they found him in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.
verses.textEnEsv: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now so it was that after three days they found Him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.
verses.textEnNlt: Three days later they finally discovered him in the Temple, sitting among the religious teachers, listening to them and asking questions.
verses.textEnNasb: Then, after three days they found Him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.
verses.textEn: After three days they found him in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.

verses.textZh: 所有听见他的人，都希奇他的聪明和应对。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有听见他的人，都希奇他的聪明和应对。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「为什么找我呢？岂不知我应当以我父的事为念吗 ？」
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone who heard him was amazed at his understanding and his answers.
verses.textEnEsv: And all who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all who heard Him were astonished at His understanding and answers.
verses.textEnNlt: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
verses.textEnNasb: And all who heard Him were amazed at His understanding and His answers.
verses.textEn: Everyone who heard him was amazed at his understanding and his answers.

verses.textZh: 他父母见了，非常惊奇，他母亲说："孩子，为甚么这样对待我们呢？你看，你父亲和我都很担心地在找你呢！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他父母见了，非常惊奇，他母亲说："孩子，为甚么这样对待我们呢？你看，你父亲和我都很担心地在找你呢！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他所说的这话，他们不明白。
verses.textEnNiv: When his parents saw him, they were astonished. His mother said to him, "Son, why have you treated us like this? Your father and I have been anxiously searching for you."
verses.textEnEsv: And when his parents saw him, they were astonished. And his mother said to him, "Son, why have you treated us so? Behold, your father and I have been searching for you in great distress."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when they saw Him, they were amazed; and His mother said to Him, "Son, why have You done this to us? Look, Your father and I have sought You anxiously."
verses.textEnNlt: His parents didn’t know what to think. "Son," his mother said to him, "why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been frantic, searching for you everywhere."
verses.textEnNasb: When Joseph and Mary saw Him, they were bewildered; and His mother said to Him, "Son, why have You treated us this way? Behold, Your father and I have been anxiously looking for You!"
verses.textEn: When his parents saw him, they were astonished. His mother said to him, "Son, why have you treated us like this? Your father and I have been anxiously searching for you."

verses.textZh: <red>他说："为甚么找我呢？你们不知道我必须在我父的家里吗？ "</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他说："为甚么找我呢？你们不知道我必须在我父的家里吗？ "</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他就同他们下去，回到拿撒勒，并且顺从他们。他母亲把这一切的事都存在心里。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whyp were you searching for me?”</red> he asked. <red>“Didn’t you know I had to be in my Father’s house?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Why were you looking for me? Did you not know that I must be in my Father’s house?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Why did you seek Me? Did you not know that I must be about My Father’s business?"
verses.textEnNlt: "But why did you need to search?" he asked. "Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?"
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "Why is it that you were looking for Me? Did you not know that I had to be in My Father’s house?"
verses.textEn: <red>“Whyp were you searching for me?”</red> he asked. <red>“Didn’t you know I had to be in my Father’s house?”</red>

verses.textZh: 但他们不明白他所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们不明白他所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣的智慧和身量 ，并神和人喜爱他的心，都一齐增长。
verses.textEnNiv: But they did not understand what he was saying to them.
verses.textEnEsv: And they did not understand the saying that he spoke to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they did not understand the statement which He spoke to them.
verses.textEnNlt: But they didn’t understand what he meant.
verses.textEnNasb: And yet they on their part did not understand the statement which He had made to them.
verses.textEn: But they did not understand what he was saying to them.

verses.textZh: 他就同他们下去，回到拿撒勒，并且顺从他们。他母亲把这一切事，都存在心里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就同他们下去，回到拿撒勒，并且顺从他们。他母亲把这一切事，都存在心里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就同他们下去，回到拿撒勒，并且顺从他们。他母亲把这一切事，都存在心里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But his mother treasured all these things in her heart.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth and was submissive to them. And his mother treasured up all these things in her heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He went down with them and came to Nazareth, and was subject to them, but His mother kept all these things in her heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he returned to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. And his mother stored all these things in her heart.
verses.textEnNasb: And He went down with them and came to Nazareth, and He continued to be subject to them; and His mother treasured all these things in her heart.
verses.textEn: Then he went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But his mother treasured all these things in her heart.

verses.textZh: 耶稣的智慧和身量，以及神和人对他的喜爱，都不断增长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣的智慧和身量，以及神和人对他的喜爱，都不断增长。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣的智慧和身量，以及神和人对他的喜爱，都不断增长。
verses.textEnNiv: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus increased in wisdom and in stature and in favor with God and man.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus grew in wisdom and in stature and in favor with God and all the people.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus kept increasing in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and people.
verses.textEn: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.

verses.textZh: 凯撒提庇留执政第十五年，本丢．彼拉多作犹太总督，希律作加利利的分封王，他兄弟腓力作以土利亚和特拉可尼地区的分封王，吕撒尼亚作亚比利尼的分封王，
verses.textZhCnvs: 凯撒提庇留执政第十五年，本丢．彼拉多作犹太总督，希律作加利利的分封王，他兄弟腓力作以土利亚和特拉可尼地区的分封王，吕撒尼亚作亚比利尼的分封王，
verses.textZhCuv: 凯撒提庇留在位第十五年，本丢‧彼拉多作犹太巡抚，希律作加利利分封的王，他兄弟腓力作以土利亚和特拉可尼地方分封的王，吕撒聂作亚比利尼分封的王，
verses.textEnNiv: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar—when Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and Traconitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene—
verses.textEnEsv: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
verses.textEnNlt: It was now the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius, the Roman emperor. Pontius Pilate was governor over Judea; Herod Antipas was ruler over Galilee; his brother Philip was ruler over Iturea and Traconitis; Lysanias was ruler over Abilene.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, when Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, and Herod was tetrarch of Galilee and his brother Philip was tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias was tetrarch of Abilene,
verses.textEn: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar—when Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and Traconitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene—

verses.textZh: 亚那和该亚法作大祭司的时候，神的话临到撒迦利亚的儿子，在旷野的约翰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚那和该亚法作大祭司的时候，神的话临到撒迦利亚的儿子，在旷野的约翰。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚那和该亚法作大祭司。那时，撒迦利亚的儿子约翰在旷野里，神的话临到他。
verses.textEnNiv: during the high-priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John the son of Zechariah in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: while Annas and Caiaphas were high priests, the word of God came to John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: Annas and Caiaphas were the high priests. At this time a message from God came to John son of Zechariah, who was living in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: in the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zechariah, in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: during the high-priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness.

verses.textZh: 他就来到约旦河一带地方，宣讲悔改的洗礼，使罪得赦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就来到约旦河一带地方，宣讲悔改的洗礼，使罪得赦。

verses.textEnNiv: He went into all the country around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went into all the region around the Jordan, proclaiming a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he went into all the region around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the remission of sins,
verses.textEnNlt: Then John went from place to place on both sides of the Jordan River, preaching that people should be baptized to show that they had repented of their sins and turned to God to be forgiven.
verses.textEnNasb: And he came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins;
verses.textEn: He went into all the country around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.

verses.textZh: 正如以赛亚先知的书上写着： "在旷野有呼喊者的声音： ‘预备主的道， 修直他的路！
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如以赛亚先知的书上写着： "在旷野有呼喊者的声音： ‘预备主的道， 修直他的路！
verses.textZhCuv: 正如先知以赛亚书上所记的话，说： 在旷野有人声喊着说： 预备主的道， 修直他的路！
verses.textEnNiv: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: "A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.
verses.textEnEsv: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, "The voice of one crying in the wilderness: ‘Prepare the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.textEnNkjv: as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, saying: "The voice of one crying in the wilderness: ‘Prepare the way of the Lord; Make His paths straight.
verses.textEnNlt: Isaiah had spoken of John when he said, "He is a voice shouting in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord ’s coming! Clear the road for him!
verses.textEnNasb: as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: "The voice of one calling out in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way of the Lord, Make His paths straight!
verses.textEn: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: "A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.

verses.textZh: 一切洼谷都当填满， 大小山冈都要削平！ 弯弯曲曲的改为正直， 高高低低的修成平坦！
verses.textZhCnvs: 一切洼谷都当填满， 大小山冈都要削平！ 弯弯曲曲的改为正直， 高高低低的修成平坦！
verses.textZhCuv: 一切山洼都要填满； 大小山冈都要削平！ 弯弯曲曲的地方要改为正直； 高高低低的道路要改为平坦！
verses.textEnNiv: Every valley shall be filled in, every mountain and hill made low. The crooked roads shall become straight, the rough ways smooth.
verses.textEnEsv: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be made low, and the crooked shall become straight, and the rough places shall become level ways,
verses.textEnNkjv: Every valley shall be filled And every mountain and hill brought low; The crooked places shall be made straight And the rough ways smooth;
verses.textEnNlt: The valleys will be filled, and the mountains and hills made level. The curves will be straightened, and the rough places made smooth.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Every ravine will be filled, And every mountain and hill will be lowered; The crooked will become straight, And the rough roads smooth;
verses.textEn: Every valley shall be filled in, every mountain and hill made low. The crooked roads shall become straight, the rough ways smooth.

verses.textZh: 所有的人都要看见神的救恩。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的人都要看见神的救恩。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有血气的，都要见神的救恩！
verses.textEnNiv: And all people will see God’s salvation.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: and all flesh shall see the salvation of God.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And then all people will see the salvation sent from God.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And all flesh will see the salvation of God!’ "
verses.textEn: And all people will see God’s salvation.’ "

verses.textZh: 约翰对那出来要受他洗礼的群众说："毒蛇所生的啊，谁指示你们逃避那将要来的忿怒呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰对那出来要受他洗礼的群众说："毒蛇所生的啊，谁指示你们逃避那将要来的忿怒呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰对那出来要受他洗的众人说：「毒蛇的种类！谁指示你们逃避将来的忿怒呢？
verses.textEnNiv: John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, "You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
verses.textEnEsv: He said therefore to the crowds that came out to be baptized by him, "You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to the multitudes that came out to be baptized by him, "Brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.textEnNlt: When the crowds came to John for baptism, he said, "You brood of snakes! Who warned you to flee the coming wrath?
verses.textEnNasb: So he was saying to the crowds who were going out to be baptized by him, "You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.textEn: John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, "You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

verses.textZh: 应当结出果子来，与悔改的心相称；你们心里不要说：‘我们有亚伯拉罕作我们的祖宗。’我告诉你们，神能从这些石头中给亚伯拉罕兴起后裔来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 应当结出果子来，与悔改的心相称；你们心里不要说：‘我们有亚伯拉罕作我们的祖宗。’我告诉你们，神能从这些石头中给亚伯拉罕兴起后裔来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要结出果子来，与悔改的心相称。不要自己心里说：『有亚伯拉罕为我们的祖宗。』我告诉你们，神能从这些石头中，给亚伯拉罕兴起子孙来。
verses.textEnNiv: Produce fruit in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
verses.textEnEsv: Bear fruits in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you, God is able from these stones to raise up children for Abraham.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore bear fruits worthy of repentance, and do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I say to you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.
verses.textEnNlt: Prove by the way you live that you have repented of your sins and turned to God. Don’t just say to each other, ‘We’re safe, for we are descendants of Abraham.’ That means nothing, for I tell you, God can create children of Abraham from these very stones.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore produce fruits that are consistent with repentance, and do not start saying to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father,’ for I say to you that from these stones God is able to raise up children for Abraham.
verses.textEn: Produce fruit in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.

verses.textZh: 现在斧头已经放在树根上，所有不结好果子的树，就砍下来，丢在火里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在斧头已经放在树根上，所有不结好果子的树，就砍下来，丢在火里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在斧子已经放在树根上，凡不结好果子的树就砍下来，丢在火里。」
verses.textEnNiv: The ax is already at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire."
verses.textEnEsv: Even now the axe is laid to the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire."
verses.textEnNkjv: And even now the ax is laid to the root of the trees. Therefore every tree which does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire."
verses.textEnNlt: Even now the ax of God’s judgment is poised, ready to sever the roots of the trees. Yes, every tree that does not produce good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into the fire."
verses.textEnNasb: But indeed the axe is already being laid at the root of the trees; so every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire."
verses.textEn: The ax is already at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire."

verses.textZh: 群众问他："那么，我们该作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众问他："那么，我们该作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人问他说：「这样，我们当做什么呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "What should we do then?" the crowd asked.
verses.textEnEsv: And the crowds asked him, "What then shall we do?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So the people asked him, saying, "What shall we do then?"
verses.textEnNlt: The crowds asked, "What should we do?"
verses.textEnNasb: And the crowds were questioning him, saying, "Then what are we to do?"
verses.textEn: "What should we do then?" the crowd asked.

verses.textZh: 他回答："有两件衣服的，当分给那没有的，有食物的也当照样作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答："有两件衣服的，当分给那没有的，有食物的也当照样作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰回答说：「有两件衣裳的，就分给那没有的；有食物的，也当这样行。」
verses.textEnNiv: John answered, "Anyone who has two shirts should share with the one who has none, and anyone who has food should do the same."
verses.textEnEsv: And he answered them, "Whoever has two tunics is to share with him who has none, and whoever has food is to do likewise."
verses.textEnNkjv: He answered and said to them, "He who has two tunics, let him give to him who has none; and he who has food, let him do likewise."
verses.textEnNlt: John replied, "If you have two shirts, give one to the poor. If you have food, share it with those who are hungry."
verses.textEnNasb: And he would answer and say to them, "The one who has two tunics is to share with the one who has none; and the one who has food is to do likewise."
verses.textEn: John answered, "Anyone who has two shirts should share with the one who has none, and anyone who has food should do the same."

verses.textZh: 又有税吏来要受洗，问他："老师，我们当作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有税吏来要受洗，问他："老师，我们当作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 又有税吏来要受洗，问他说：「夫子，我们当做什么呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Even tax collectors came to be baptized. "Teacher," they asked, "what should we do?"
verses.textEnEsv: Tax collectors also came to be baptized and said to him, "Teacher, what shall we do?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then tax collectors also came to be baptized, and said to him, "Teacher, what shall we do?"
verses.textEnNlt: Even corrupt tax collectors came to be baptized and asked, "Teacher, what should we do?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now even tax collectors came to be baptized, and they said to him, "Teacher, what are we to do?"
verses.textEn: Even tax collectors came to be baptized. "Teacher," they asked, "what should we do?"

verses.textZh: 他说："除了规定的以外，不可多收。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："除了规定的以外，不可多收。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰说：「除了例定的数目，不要多取。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Don’t collect any more than you are required to," he told them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Collect no more than you are authorized to do."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to them, "Collect no more than what is appointed for you."
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "Collect no more taxes than the government requires."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to them, " Collect no more than what you have been ordered to."
verses.textEn: "Don’t collect any more than you are required to," he told them.

verses.textZh: 兵丁也问他："至于我们，我们又应当作甚么呢？"他说："不要恐吓，不要敲诈，当以自己的粮饷为满足。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 兵丁也问他："至于我们，我们又应当作甚么呢？"他说："不要恐吓，不要敲诈，当以自己的粮饷为满足。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又有兵丁问他说：「我们当做什么呢？」约翰说：「不要以强暴待人，也不要讹诈人，自己有钱粮就当知足。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then some soldiers asked him, "And what should we do?" He replied, "Don’t extort money and don’t accuse people falsely—be content with your pay."
verses.textEnEsv: Soldiers also asked him, "And we, what shall we do?" And he said to them, "Do not extort money from anyone by threats or by false accusation, and be content with your wages."
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise the soldiers asked him, saying, "And what shall we do?" So he said to them, "Do not intimidate anyone or accuse falsely, and be content with your wages."
verses.textEnNlt: "What should we do?" asked some soldiers. John replied, "Don’t extort money or make false accusations. And be content with your pay."
verses.textEnNasb: And soldiers also were questioning him, saying, "What are we to do, we as well?" And he said to them, "Do not extort money from anyone, nor harass anyone, and be content with your wages."
verses.textEn: Then some soldiers asked him, "And what should we do?" He replied, "Don’t extort money and don’t accuse people falsely—be content with your pay."

verses.textZh: 那时众人正在期待，人人心里都在猜想会不会约翰就是基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时众人正在期待，人人心里都在猜想会不会约翰就是基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓指望基督来的时候，人都心里猜疑，或者约翰是基督。
verses.textEnNiv: The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts if John might possibly be the Messiah.
verses.textEnEsv: As the people were in expectation, and all were questioning in their hearts concerning John, whether he might be the Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as the people were in expectation, and all reasoned in their hearts about John, whether he was the Christ or not,
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone was expecting the Messiah to come soon, and they were eager to know whether John might be the Messiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now while the people were in a state of expectation and they all were thinking carefully in their hearts about John, whether he himself perhaps was the Christ,
verses.textEn: The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts if John might possibly be the Messiah.

verses.textZh: 约翰对众人说："我用水给你们施洗，但那能力比我更大的要来，我就是给他解鞋带都没有资格。他要用圣灵与火给你们施洗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰对众人说："我用水给你们施洗，但那能力比我更大的要来，我就是给他解鞋带都没有资格。他要用圣灵与火给你们施洗。
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰说：「我是用水给你们施洗，但有一位能力比我更大的要来，我就是给他解鞋带也不配。他要用圣灵与火给你们施洗。
verses.textEnNiv: John answered them all, "I baptize you with water. But one who is more powerful than I will come, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
verses.textEnEsv: John answered them all, saying, "I baptize you with water, but he who is mightier than I is coming, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: John answered, saying to all, "I indeed baptize you with water; but One mightier than I is coming, whose sandal strap I am not worthy to loose. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
verses.textEnNlt: John answered their questions by saying, "I baptize you with water; but someone is coming soon who is greater than I am—so much greater that I’m not even worthy to be his slave and untie the straps of his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
verses.textEnNasb: John responded to them all, saying, "As for me, I baptize you with water; but He is coming who is mightier than I, and I am not fit to untie the straps of His sandals; He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
verses.textEn: John answered them all, "I baptize you with water. But one who is more powerful than I will come, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.

verses.textZh: 他手里拿着簸箕，要扬净麦场，把麦子收进仓里，却用不灭的火把糠秕烧尽。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他手里拿着簸箕，要扬净麦场，把麦子收进仓里，却用不灭的火把糠秕烧尽。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他手里拿着簸箕，要扬净他的场，把麦子收在仓里，把糠用不灭的火烧尽了。」
verses.textEnNiv: His winnowing fork is in his hand to clear his threshing floor and to gather the wheat into his barn, but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire."
verses.textEnEsv: His winnowing fork is in his hand, to clear his threshing floor and to gather the wheat into his barn, but the chaff he will burn with unquenchable fire."
verses.textEnNkjv: His winnowing fan is in His hand, and He will thoroughly clean out His threshing floor, and gather the wheat into His barn; but the chaff He will burn with unquenchable fire."
verses.textEnNlt: He is ready to separate the chaff from the wheat with his winnowing fork. Then he will clean up the threshing area, gathering the wheat into his barn but burning the chaff with never-ending fire."
verses.textEnNasb: His winnowing fork is in His hand to thoroughly clear His threshing floor, and to gather the wheat into His barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire."
verses.textEn: His winnowing fork is in his hand to clear his threshing floor and to gather the wheat into his barn, but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire."

verses.textZh: 他还用许多别的话劝勉众人，向他们传福音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他还用许多别的话劝勉众人，向他们传福音。
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰又用许多别的话劝百姓，向他们传福音。
verses.textEnNiv: And with many other words John exhorted the people and proclaimed the good news to them.
verses.textEnEsv: So with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And with many other exhortations he preached to the people.
verses.textEnNlt: John used many such warnings as he announced the Good News to the people.
verses.textEnNasb: So with many other exhortations he preached the gospel to the people.
verses.textEn: And with many other words John exhorted the people and proclaimed the good news to them.

verses.textZh: 分封王希律，因他弟弟的妻子希罗底，并因他自己所行的一切恶事，受到约翰的责备。
verses.textZhCnvs: 分封王希律，因他弟弟的妻子希罗底，并因他自己所行的一切恶事，受到约翰的责备。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是分封的王希律，因他兄弟之妻希罗底的缘故，并因他所行的一切恶事，受了约翰的责备；
verses.textEnNiv: But when John rebuked Herod the tetrarch because of his marriage to Herodias, his brother’s wife, and all the other evil things he had done,
verses.textEnEsv: But Herod the tetrarch, who had been reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things that Herod had done,
verses.textEnNkjv: But Herod the tetrarch, being rebuked by him concerning Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
verses.textEnNlt: John also publicly criticized Herod Antipas, the ruler of Galilee, for marrying Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for many other wrongs he had done.
verses.textEnNasb: But when Herod the tetrarch was reprimanded by him regarding Herodias, his brother’s wife, and regarding all the evil things which Herod had done,
verses.textEn: But when John rebuked Herod the tetrarch because of his marriage to Herodias, his brother’s wife, and all the other evil things he had done,

verses.textZh: 他在这一切事以外，再加上一件，就是把约翰关在监里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在这一切事以外，再加上一件，就是把约翰关在监里。
verses.textZhCuv: 又另外添了一件，就是把约翰收在监里。
verses.textEnNiv: Herod added this to them all: He locked John up in prison.
verses.textEnEsv: added this to them all, that he locked up John in prison.
verses.textEnNkjv: also added this, above all, that he shut John up in prison.
verses.textEnNlt: So Herod put John in prison, adding this sin to his many others.
verses.textEnNasb: Herod also added this to them all: he locked John up in prison.
verses.textEn: Herod added this to them all: He locked John up in prison.

verses.textZh: 众人受了洗，耶稣也受了洗。他正在祷告，天就开了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人受了洗，耶稣也受了洗。他正在祷告，天就开了，
verses.textZhCuv: 众百姓都受了洗，耶稣也受了洗。正祷告的时候，天就开了，
verses.textEnNiv: When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as he was praying, heaven was opened
verses.textEnEsv: Now when all the people were baptized, and when Jesus also had been baptized and was praying, the heavens were opened,
verses.textEnNkjv: When all the people were baptized, it came to pass that Jesus also was baptized; and while He prayed, the heaven was opened.
verses.textEnNlt: One day when the crowds were being baptized, Jesus himself was baptized. As he was praying, the heavens opened,
verses.textEnNasb: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also was baptized, and while He was praying, heaven was opened,
verses.textEn: When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as he was praying, heaven was opened

verses.textZh: 圣灵仿佛鸽子，有形体地降在他身上；有声音从天上来，说："你是我的爱子，我喜悦你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣灵仿佛鸽子，有形体地降在他身上；有声音从天上来，说："你是我的爱子，我喜悦你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 圣灵降临在他身上，形状仿佛鸽子；又有声音从天上来，说：「你是我的爱子，我喜悦你。」
verses.textEnNiv: and the Holy Spirit descended on him in bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven: "You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased."
verses.textEnEsv: and the Holy Spirit descended on him in bodily form, like a dove; and a voice came from heaven, "You are my beloved Son; with you I am well pleased."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Holy Spirit descended in bodily form like a dove upon Him, and a voice came from heaven which said, "You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased."
verses.textEnNlt: and the Holy Spirit, in bodily form, descended on him like a dove. And a voice from heaven said, "You are my dearly loved Son, and you bring me great joy. "
verses.textEnNasb: and the Holy Spirit descended upon Him in bodily form like a dove, and a voice came from heaven: "You are My beloved Son, in You I am well pleased."
verses.textEn: and the Holy Spirit descended on him in bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven: "You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased."

verses.textZh: 耶稣开始传道，年约三十岁，人以为他是约瑟的儿子，约瑟是希里的儿子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣开始传道，年约三十岁，人以为他是约瑟的儿子，约瑟是希里的儿子，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣开头传道，年纪约有三十岁。依人看来，他是约瑟的儿子；约瑟是希里的儿子；
verses.textEnNiv: Now Jesus himself was about thirty years old when he began his ministry. He was the son, so it was thought, of Joseph, the son of Heli,
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus, when he began his ministry, was about thirty years of age, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jesus Himself began Hisministryat about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, theson of Heli,
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus was about thirty years old when he began his public ministry. Jesus was known as the son of Joseph. Joseph was the son of Heli.
verses.textEnNasb: When He began His ministry, Jesus Himself was about thirty years old, being, as was commonly held, the son of Joseph, the son of Eli,
verses.textEn: Now Jesus himself was about thirty years old when he began his ministry. He was the son, so it was thought, of Joseph, the son of Heli,

verses.textZh: 依次往上推，是玛塔、利未、麦基、雅拿、约瑟、
verses.textZhCnvs: 依次往上推，是玛塔、利未、麦基、雅拿、约瑟、

verses.textEn: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melki, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

verses.textZh: 玛他提亚、亚摩斯、拿鸿、以斯利、拿该、
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛他提亚、亚摩斯、拿鸿、以斯利、拿该、

verses.textEnNkjv: theson of Mattathiah, theson of Amos, theson of Nahum, theson of Esli, theson of Naggai,
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph was the son of Mattathias. Mattathias was the son of Amos. Amos was the son of Nahum. Nahum was the son of Esli. Esli was the son of Naggai.
verses.textEnNasb: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Hesli, the son of Naggai,
verses.textEn: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

verses.textZh: 玛押、玛他提亚、西美、约瑟、约大、
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛押、玛他提亚、西美、约瑟、约大、

verses.textEnNiv: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josek, the son of Joda,
verses.textEnEsv: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josech, the son of Joda,
verses.textEnNkjv: theson of Maath, theson of Mattathiah, theson of Semei, theson of Joseph, theson of Judah,

verses.textEnNasb: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josech, the son of Joda,
verses.textEn: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josek, the son of Joda,

verses.textEn: All spoke well of him and were amazed at the gracious words that came from his lips. "Isn’t this Joseph’s son?" they asked.

verses.textZh: 他说："<red>你们必向我说这俗语：‘医生，治好你自己吧！’也必说：‘我们听见你在迦百农所行的一切事，也该在你本乡这里行啊！’</red>"

verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to them, <red>“Surely you will quote this proverb to me: ‘Physician, heal yourself!’ And you will tell me, ‘Do here in your hometown what we have heard that you did in Capernaum.’ ”</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: He said to them, "You will surely say this proverb to Me, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in Your country.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "You will undoubtedly quote me this proverb: ‘Physician, heal yourself’—meaning, ‘Do miracles here in your hometown like those you did in Capernaum.’
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "No doubt you will quote this proverb to Me: ‘Physician, heal yourself! All the miracles that we heard were done in Capernaum, do here in Your hometown as well.’ "

verses.textZhCuv: 就起来撵他出城（他们的城造在山上）；他们带他到山崖，要把他推下去。
verses.textEnNiv: They got up, drove him out of the town, and took him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw him off the cliff.
verses.textEnEsv: And they rose up and drove him out of the town and brought him to the brow of the hill on which their town was built, so that they could throw him down the cliff.
verses.textEnNkjv: and rose up and thrust Him out of the city; and they led Him to the brow of the hill on which their city was built, that they might throw Him down over the cliff.
verses.textEnNlt: Jumping up, they mobbed him and forced him to the edge of the hill on which the town was built. They intended to push him over the cliff,
verses.textEnNasb: and they got up and drove Him out of the city, and brought Him to the crest of the hill on which their city had been built, so that they could throw Him down from the cliff.
verses.textEn: They got up, drove him out of the town, and took him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw him off the cliff.

verses.textZh: 耶稣却从他们中间走过，就离去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣却从他们中间走过，就离去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他却从他们中间直行，过去了。
verses.textEnNiv: But he walked right through the crowd and went on his way.
verses.textEnEsv: But passing through their midst, he went away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then passing through the midst of them, He went His way.
verses.textEnNlt: but he passed right through the crowd and went on his way.
verses.textEnNasb: But He passed through their midst and went on His way.
verses.textEn: But he walked right through the crowd and went on his way.

verses.textZh: 耶稣下到加利利的迦百农城，在安息日教导人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣下到加利利的迦百农城，在安息日教导人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣下到迦百农，就是加利利的一座城，在安息日教训众人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and on the Sabbath he taught the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. And he was teaching them on the Sabbath,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He went down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and was teaching them on the Sabbaths.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus went to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and taught there in the synagogue every Sabbath day.
verses.textEnNasb: And He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee; and He was teaching them on the Sabbath;
verses.textEn: Then he went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and on the Sabbath he taught the people.

verses.textZh: 他们对他的教训都很惊奇，因为他的话带着权柄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对他的教训都很惊奇，因为他的话带着权柄。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们很希奇他的教训，因为他的话里有权柄。
verses.textEnNiv: They were amazed at his teaching, because his words had authority.
verses.textEnEsv: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word possessed authority.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were astonished at His teaching, for His word was with authority.
verses.textEnNlt: There, too, the people were amazed at his teaching, for he spoke with authority.
verses.textEnNasb: and they were amazed at His teaching, because His message was delivered with authority.
verses.textEn: They were amazed at his teaching, because his words had authority.

verses.textZh: 会堂里有一个被污鬼附着的人，大声喊叫：
verses.textZhCnvs: 会堂里有一个被污鬼附着的人，大声喊叫：
verses.textZhCuv: 在会堂里有一个人，被污鬼的精气附着，大声喊叫说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by a demon, an impure spirit. He cried out at the top of his voice,
verses.textEnEsv: And in the synagogue there was a man who had the spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon. And he cried out with a loud voice,
verses.textEnNlt: Once when he was in the synagogue, a man possessed by a demon—an evil spirit—cried out, shouting,
verses.textEnNasb: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by the spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice,
verses.textEn: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by a demon, an impure spirit. He cried out at the top of his voice,

verses.textZh: "哎！拿撒勒人耶稣，我们跟你有甚么关系呢？你来毁灭我们吗？我知道你是谁，你是神的圣者。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "哎！拿撒勒人耶稣，我们跟你有甚么关系呢？你来毁灭我们吗？我知道你是谁，你是神的圣者。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「唉！拿撒勒的耶稣，我们与你有什么相干？你来灭我们吗？我知道你是谁，乃是神的圣者。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go away! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!"
verses.textEnEsv: "Ha! What have you to do with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are— the Holy One of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "Let us alone! What have we to do with You, Jesus of Nazareth? Did You come to destroy us? I know who You are— the Holy One of God!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Go away! Why are you interfering with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Leave us alone! What business do You have with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!"
verses.textEn: "Go away! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣斥责他说："住口！从他身上出来！"鬼把那人摔倒在众人中间，就从他身上出来了，没有伤害他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣斥责他说："住口！从他身上出来！"鬼把那人摔倒在众人中间，就从他身上出来了，没有伤害他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣责备他说：「<red>不要作声，从这人身上出来吧！</red>」鬼把那人摔倒在众人中间，就出来了，却也没有害他。
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Bep quiet!”</red> Jesus said sternly. <red>“Come out of him!”</red> Then the demon threw the man down before them all and came out without injuring him.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus rebuked him, saying, "Be silent and come out of him!" And when the demon had thrown him down in their midst, he came out of him, having done him no harm.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus rebuked him, saying, "Be quiet, and come out of him!" And when the demon had thrown him in their midst, it came out of him and did not hurt him.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus reprimanded him. "Be quiet! Come out of the man," he ordered. At that, the demon threw the man to the floor as the crowd watched; then it came out of him without hurting him further.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus rebuked him, saying, "Be quiet and come out of him!" And when the demon had thrown him down in the midst of the people, it came out of him without doing him any harm.
verses.textEn: <red>“Bep quiet!”</red> Jesus said sternly. <red>“Come out of him!”</red> Then the demon threw the man down before them all and came out without injuring him.

verses.textZh: 众人都惊骇，彼此谈论说："这是怎么回事？他用权柄能力吩咐污灵，污灵竟出来了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人都惊骇，彼此谈论说："这是怎么回事？他用权柄能力吩咐污灵，污灵竟出来了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人都惊讶，彼此对问说：「这是什么道理呢？因为他用权柄能力吩咐污鬼，污鬼就出来。」
verses.textEnNiv: All the people were amazed and said to each other, "What words these are! With authority and power he gives orders to impure spirits and they come out!"
verses.textEnEsv: And they were all amazed and said to one another, "What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they were all amazed and spoke among themselves, saying, "What a word this is! For with authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out."
verses.textEnNlt: Amazed, the people exclaimed, "What authority and power this man’s words possess! Even evil spirits obey him, and they flee at his command!"
verses.textEnNasb: And amazement came upon them all, and they began talking with one another, saying, "What is this message? For with authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!"
verses.textEn: All the people were amazed and said to each other, "What words these are! With authority and power he gives orders to impure spirits and they come out!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣的名声，传遍了周围各地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣的名声，传遍了周围各地。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶稣的名声传遍了周围地方。
verses.textEnNiv: And the news about him spread throughout the surrounding area.
verses.textEnEsv: And reports about him went out into every place in the surrounding region.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the report about Him went out into every place in the surrounding region.
verses.textEnNlt: The news about Jesus spread through every village in the entire region.
verses.textEnNasb: And the news about Him was spreading into every locality of the surrounding region.
verses.textEn: And the news about him spread throughout the surrounding area.

verses.textZh: 他起身离开会堂，进入西门的家。西门的岳母正在发高热，他们为她求耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他起身离开会堂，进入西门的家。西门的岳母正在发高热，他们为她求耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣出了会堂，进了西门的家。西门的岳母害热病甚重，有人为她求耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus left the synagogue and went to the home of Simon. Now Simon’s mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they asked Jesus to help her.
verses.textEnEsv: And he arose and left the synagogue and entered Simon’s house. Now Simon’s mother-in-law was ill with a high fever, and they appealed to him on her behalf.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now He arose from the synagogue and entered Simon’s house. But Simon’s wife’s mother was sick with a high fever, and they made request of Him concerning her.
verses.textEnNlt: After leaving the synagogue that day, Jesus went to Simon’s home, where he found Simon’s mother-in-law very sick with a high fever. "Please heal her," everyone begged.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He got up and left the synagogue, and entered Simon’s home. Now Simon’s mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they asked Him to help her.
verses.textEn: Jesus left the synagogue and went to the home of Simon. Now Simon’s mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they asked Jesus to help her.

verses.textZh: 耶稣站在她旁边，斥责那热病，热就退了；她立刻起身服事他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣站在她旁边，斥责那热病，热就退了；她立刻起身服事他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣站在她旁边，斥责那热病，热就退了。她立刻起来服事他们。
verses.textEnNiv: So he bent over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. She got up at once and began to wait on them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her, and immediately she rose and began to serve them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. And immediately she arose and served them.
verses.textEnNlt: Standing at her bedside, he rebuked the fever, and it left her. And she got up at once and prepared a meal for them.
verses.textEnNasb: And standing over her, He rebuked the fever, and it left her; and she immediately got up and served them.
verses.textEn: So he bent over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. She got up at once and began to wait on them.

verses.textZh: 日落的时候，不论害甚么病的人，都被带到耶稣那里；他一一为他们按手，医好他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 日落的时候，不论害甚么病的人，都被带到耶稣那里；他一一为他们按手，医好他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 日落的时候，凡有病人的，不论害什么病，都带到耶稣那里。耶稣按手在他们各人身上，医好他们。
verses.textEnNiv: At sunset, the people brought to Jesus all who had various kinds of sickness, and laying his hands on each one, he healed them.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the sun was setting, all those who had any who were sick with various diseases brought them to him, and he laid his hands on every one of them and healed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the sun was setting, all those who had any that were sick with various diseases brought them to Him; and He laid His hands on every one of them and healed them.
verses.textEnNlt: As the sun went down that evening, people throughout the village brought sick family members to Jesus. No matter what their diseases were, the touch of his hand healed every one.
verses.textEnNasb: Now while the sun was setting, all those who had any who were sick with various diseases brought them to Him; and He was laying His hands on each one of them and healing them.
verses.textEn: At sunset, the people brought to Jesus all who had various kinds of sickness, and laying his hands on each one, he healed them.

verses.textZh: 又有鬼从好些人身上出来，喊着说："你是神的儿子。"耶稣斥责他们，不许他们说话，因为他们知道他是基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有鬼从好些人身上出来，喊着说："你是神的儿子。"耶稣斥责他们，不许他们说话，因为他们知道他是基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有鬼从好些人身上出来，喊着说：「你是神的儿子。」耶稣斥责他们，不许他们说话，因为他们知道他是基督。
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, demons came out of many people, shouting, "You are the Son of God!" But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew he was the Messiah.
verses.textEnEsv: And demons also came out of many, crying, "You are the Son of God!" But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: And demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, "You are the Christ, the Son of God!" And He, rebuking them, did not allow them to speak, for they knew that He was the Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Many were possessed by demons; and the demons came out at his command, shouting, "You are the Son of God!" But because they knew he was the Messiah, he rebuked them and refused to let them speak.
verses.textEnNasb: Demons also were coming out of many, shouting, "You are the Son of God!" And yet He was rebuking them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew that He was the Christ.
verses.textEn: Moreover, demons came out of many people, shouting, "You are the Son of God!" But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew he was the Messiah.

verses.textZh: 天一亮，耶稣出来，到旷野地方去。众人寻找他，一直找到他那里，要留住他，不要他离开他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天一亮，耶稣出来，到旷野地方去。众人寻找他，一直找到他那里，要留住他，不要他离开他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 天亮的时候，耶稣出来，走到旷野地方。众人去找他，到了他那里，要留住他，不要他离开他们。
verses.textEnNiv: At daybreak, Jesus went out to a solitary place. The people were looking for him and when they came to where he was, they tried to keep him from leaving them.
verses.textEnEsv: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desolate place. And the people sought him and came to him, and would have kept him from leaving them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when it was day, He departed and went into a deserted place. And the crowd sought Him and came to Him, and tried to keep Him from leaving them;
verses.textEnNlt: Early the next morning Jesus went out to an isolated place. The crowds searched everywhere for him, and when they finally found him, they begged him not to leave them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when day came, Jesus left and went to a secluded place; and the crowds were searching for Him, and they came to Him and tried to keep Him from leaving them.
verses.textEn: At daybreak, Jesus went out to a solitary place. The people were looking for him and when they came to where he was, they tried to keep him from leaving them.

verses.textZh: 他却说："<red>我也必须到别的城去传神国的福音，因为我是为了这缘故奉差遣的。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他却说："<red>我也必须到别的城去传神国的福音，因为我是为了这缘故奉差遣的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶稣对他们说：「<red>我也必须在别城传神国的福音，因我奉差原是为此。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: But he said, <red>“I must proclaim the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns also, because that is why I was sent.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but he said to them, "I must preach the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns as well; for I was sent for this purpose."
verses.textEnNkjv: but He said to them, "I must preach the kingdom of God to the other cities also, because for this purpose I have been sent."
verses.textEnNlt: But he replied, "I must preach the Good News of the Kingdom of God in other towns, too, because that is why I was sent."
verses.textEnNasb: But He said to them, "I must also preach the kingdom of God to the other cities, because I was sent for this purpose."
verses.textEn: But he said, <red>“I must proclaim the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns also, because that is why I was sent.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是他往犹太的各会堂去传道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他往犹太的各会堂去传道。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶稣在加利利的各会堂传道。
verses.textEnNiv: And he kept on preaching in the synagogues of Judea.
verses.textEnEsv: And he was preaching in the synagogues of Judea.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
verses.textEnNlt: So he continued to travel around, preaching in synagogues throughout Judea.
verses.textEnNasb: So He kept on preaching in the synagogues of Judea.
verses.textEn: And he kept on preaching in the synagogues of Judea.

verses.textZh: 耶稣站在革尼撒勒湖边，众人拥挤他，要听神的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣站在革尼撒勒湖边，众人拥挤他，要听神的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣站在革尼撒勒湖边，众人拥挤他，要听神的道。
verses.textEnNiv: One day as Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret, the people were crowding around him and listening to the word of God.
verses.textEnEsv: On one occasion, while the crowd was pressing in on him to hear the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret,
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, as the multitude pressed about Him to hear the word of God, that He stood by the Lake of Gennesaret,
verses.textEnNlt: One day as Jesus was preaching on the shore of the Sea of Galilee, great crowds pressed in on him to listen to the word of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened that while the crowd was pressing around Him and listening to the word of God, He was standing by the lake of Gennesaret;
verses.textEn: One day as Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret, the people were crowding around him and listening to the word of God.

verses.textZh: 他看见两只船停在湖边，渔夫离开船洗网去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他看见两只船停在湖边，渔夫离开船洗网去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他见有两只船湾在湖边；打鱼的人却离开船洗网去了。
verses.textEnNiv: He saw at the water’s edge two boats, left there by the fishermen, who were washing their nets.
verses.textEnEsv: and he saw two boats by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.
verses.textEnNkjv: and saw two boats standing by the lake; but the fishermen had gone from them and were washing their nets.
verses.textEnNlt: He noticed two empty boats at the water’s edge, for the fishermen had left them and were washing their nets.
verses.textEnNasb: and He saw two boats lying at the edge of the lake; but the fishermen had gotten out of them and were washing their nets.
verses.textEn: He saw at the water’s edge two boats, left there by the fishermen, who were washing their nets.

verses.textZh: 他上了西门的那一只船，请他撑开，离岸不远，就坐下，从船上教导众人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他上了西门的那一只船，请他撑开，离岸不远，就坐下，从船上教导众人。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一只船是西门的，耶稣就上去，请他把船撑开，稍微离岸，就坐下，从船上教训众人。
verses.textEnNiv: He got into one of the boats, the one belonging to Simon, and asked him to put out a little from shore. Then he sat down and taught the people from the boat.
verses.textEnEsv: Getting into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, he asked him to put out a little from the land. And he sat down and taught the people from the boat.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He got into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. And He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.
verses.textEnNlt: Stepping into one of the boats, Jesus asked Simon, its owner, to push it out into the water. So he sat in the boat and taught the crowds from there.
verses.textEnNasb: And He got into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little distance from the land. And He sat down and continued teaching the crowds from the boat.
verses.textEn: He got into one of the boats, the one belonging to Simon, and asked him to put out a little from shore. Then he sat down and taught the people from the boat.

verses.textZh: 讲完了，就对西门说："<red>把船开到水深的地方，下网打鱼！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 讲完了，就对西门说："<red>把船开到水深的地方，下网打鱼！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 讲完了，对西门说：「<red>把船开到水深之处，下网打鱼。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, <red>“Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, "Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch."
verses.textEnNkjv: When He had stopped speaking, He said to Simon, "Launch out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch."
verses.textEnNlt: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, "Now go out where it is deeper, and let down your nets to catch some fish."
verses.textEnNasb: Now when He had finished speaking, He said to Simon, "Put out into the deep water and let down your nets for a catch."
verses.textEn: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, <red>“Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch.”</red>

verses.textZh: 西门说："主啊，我们整夜劳苦，毫无所得，不过，我愿照你的话下网。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门说："主啊，我们整夜劳苦，毫无所得，不过，我愿照你的话下网。"
verses.textZhCuv: 西门说：「夫子，我们整夜劳力，并没有打着什么。但依从你的话，我就下网。」
verses.textEnNiv: Simon answered, "Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets."
verses.textEnEsv: And Simon answered, "Master, we toiled all night and took nothing! But at your word I will let down the nets."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Simon answered and said to Him, "Master, we have toiled all night and caught nothing; nevertheless at Your word I will let down the net."
verses.textEnNlt: "Master," Simon replied, "we worked hard all last night and didn’t catch a thing. But if you say so, I’ll let the nets down again."
verses.textEnNasb: Simon responded and said, "Master, we worked hard all night and caught nothing, but I will do as You say and let down the nets."
