verses.textEn: Simon answered, "Master, we’ve worked hard all night and haven’t caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets."

verses.textZh: 他们下了网，就圈住很多鱼，网几乎裂开，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们下了网，就圈住很多鱼，网几乎裂开，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们下了网，就圈住许多鱼，网险些裂开，
verses.textEnNiv: When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to break.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had done this, they enclosed a large number of fish, and their nets were breaking.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had done this, they caught a great number of fish, and their net was breaking.
verses.textEnNlt: And this time their nets were so full of fish they began to tear!
verses.textEnNasb: And when they had done this, they caught a great quantity of fish, and their nets began to tear;
verses.textEn: When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to break.

verses.textZh: 就招呼另外那只船上的同伴来帮助，他们就来把两只船装满，甚至船要下沉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就招呼另外那只船上的同伴来帮助，他们就来把两只船装满，甚至船要下沉。
verses.textZhCuv: 便招呼那只船上的同伴来帮助。他们就来，把鱼装满了两只船，甚至船要沉下去。
verses.textEnNiv: So they signaled their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.
verses.textEnEsv: They signaled to their partners in the other boat to come and help them. And they came and filled both the boats, so that they began to sink.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they signaled to their partners in the other boat to come and help them. And they came and filled both the boats, so that they began to sink.
verses.textEnNlt: A shout for help brought their partners in the other boat, and soon both boats were filled with fish and on the verge of sinking.
verses.textEnNasb: so they signaled to their partners in the other boat to come and help them. And they came and filled both of the boats, to the point that they were sinking.
verses.textEn: So they signaled their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.

verses.textZh: 西门．彼得看见这种情景，就俯伏在耶稣膝前，说："主啊，离开我，因为我是个罪人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门．彼得看见这种情景，就俯伏在耶稣膝前，说："主啊，离开我，因为我是个罪人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 西门‧彼得看见，就俯伏在耶稣膝前，说：「主啊，离开我，我是个罪人！」
verses.textEnNiv: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees and said, "Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!"
verses.textEnEsv: But when Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, "Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, O Lord."
verses.textEnNkjv: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, "Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, O Lord!"
verses.textEnNlt: When Simon Peter realized what had happened, he fell to his knees before Jesus and said, "Oh, Lord, please leave me—I’m such a sinful man."
verses.textEnNasb: But when Simon Peter saw this, he fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, "Go away from me, Lord, for I am a sinful man!"
verses.textEn: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees and said, "Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!"

verses.textZh: 他和跟他在一起的人，因这网所打的鱼，都十分惊骇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他和跟他在一起的人，因这网所打的鱼，都十分惊骇。
verses.textZhCuv: 他和一切同在的人都惊讶这一网所打的鱼。
verses.textEnNiv: For he and all his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,
verses.textEnEsv: For he and all who were with him were astonished at the catch of fish that they had taken,
verses.textEnNkjv: For he and all who were with him were astonished at the catch of fish which they had taken;
verses.textEnNlt: For he was awestruck by the number of fish they had caught, as were the others with him.
verses.textEnNasb: For amazement had seized him and all his companions because of the catch of fish which they had taken;
verses.textEn: For he and all his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,

verses.textZh: 西门的伙伴，西庇太的儿子雅各、约翰也是这样。耶稣对西门说："<red>不要怕！从今以后，你要作得人的渔夫了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门的伙伴，西庇太的儿子雅各、约翰也是这样。耶稣对西门说："<red>不要怕！从今以后，你要作得人的渔夫了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他的伙伴西庇太的儿子雅各、约翰，也是这样。耶稣对西门说：「<red>不要怕！从今以后，你要得人了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: and so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, Simon’s partners. Then Jesus said to Simon, <red>“Don’t be afraid; from now on you will fish for people.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, "Do not be afraid; from now on you will be catching men."
verses.textEnNkjv: and so also were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, "Do not be afraid. From now on you will catch men."
verses.textEnNlt: His partners, James and John, the sons of Zebedee, were also amazed. Jesus replied to Simon, "Don’t be afraid! From now on you’ll be fishing for people!"
verses.textEnNasb: and likewise also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, "Do not fear; from now on you will be catching people."
verses.textEn: and so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, Simon’s partners. Then Jesus said to Simon, <red>“Don’t be afraid; from now on you will fish for people.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们把两只船拢了岸，撇下一切，跟从了耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把两只船拢了岸，撇下一切，跟从了耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们把两只船拢了岸，就撇下所有的，跟从了耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: So they pulled their boats up on shore, left everything and followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had brought their boats to land, they left everything and followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when they had brought their boats to land, they forsook all and followed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: And as soon as they landed, they left everything and followed Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything and followed Him.
verses.textEn: So they pulled their boats up on shore, left everything and followed him.

verses.textZh: 有一次，耶稣在一个城里，突然有一个满身痲风的人看见他，就把脸伏在地上，求他说："主啊！如果你肯，必能使我洁净。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一次，耶稣在一个城里，突然有一个满身痲风的人看见他，就把脸伏在地上，求他说："主啊！如果你肯，必能使我洁净。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一回，耶稣在一个城里，有人满身长了大麻风，看见他，就俯伏在地，求他说：「主若肯，必能叫我洁净了。」
verses.textEnNiv: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell with his face to the ground and begged him, "Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean."
verses.textEnEsv: While he was in one of the cities, there came a man full of leprosy. And when he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, "Lord, if you will, you can make me clean."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened when He was in a certain city, that behold, a man who was full of leprosy saw Jesus; and he fell on his face and implored Him, saying, "Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean."
verses.textEnNlt: In one of the villages, Jesus met a man with an advanced case of leprosy. When the man saw Jesus, he bowed with his face to the ground, begging to be healed. "Lord," he said, "if you are willing, you can heal me and make me clean."
verses.textEnNasb: While He was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man covered with leprosy; and when he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged Him, saying, "Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean."
verses.textEn: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell with his face to the ground and begged him, "Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean."

verses.textZh: 耶稣伸手摸他，说："<red>我肯，你洁净了吧！</red>"痲风立刻离开了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣伸手摸他，说："<red>我肯，你洁净了吧！</red>"痲风立刻离开了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣伸手摸他，说：「<red>我肯，你洁净了吧！</red>」大麻风立刻就离了他的身。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. <red>“I am willing,”</red> he said. <red>“Be clean!”</red> And immediately the leprosy left him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, "I will; be clean." And immediately the leprosy left him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He put out His hand and touched him, saying, "I am willing; be cleansed." Immediately the leprosy left him.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus reached out and touched him. "I am willing," he said. "Be healed!" And instantly the leprosy disappeared.
verses.textEnNasb: And He reached out with His hand and touched him, saying, "I am willing; be cleansed." And immediately the leprosy left him.
verses.textEn: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. <red>“I am willing,”</red> he said. <red>“Be clean!”</red> And immediately the leprosy left him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣嘱咐他不可告诉任何人，"<red>你只要去给祭司检查，并且照着摩西所规定的，为你得洁净献祭，好向大家作证。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣嘱咐他不可告诉任何人，"<red>你只要去给祭司检查，并且照着摩西所规定的，为你得洁净献祭，好向大家作证。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣嘱咐他：「<red>你切不可告诉人，只要去把身体给祭司察看，又要为你得了洁净，照摩西所吩咐的献上礼物，对众人作证据。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus ordered him, <red>“Don’t tell anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he charged him to tell no one, but "go and show yourself to the priest, and make an offering for your cleansing, as Moses commanded, for a proof to them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He charged him to tell no one, "But go and show yourself to the priest, and make an offering for your cleansing, as a testimony to them, just as Moses commanded."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus instructed him not to tell anyone what had happened. He said, "Go to the priest and let him examine you. Take along the offering required in the law of Moses for those who have been healed of leprosy. This will be a public testimony that you have been cleansed."
verses.textEnNasb: And He ordered him to tell no one, saying,"But go and show yourself to the priest, and make an offering for your cleansing, just as Moses commanded, as a testimony to them."
verses.textEn: Then Jesus ordered him, <red>“Don’t tell anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”</red>

verses.textZh: 但他的名声却越发传扬出去，成群的人来聚集，要听道，并且要使他们的疾病痊愈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他的名声却越发传扬出去，成群的人来聚集，要听道，并且要使他们的疾病痊愈。
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶稣的名声越发传扬出去。有极多的人聚集来听道，也指望医治他们的病。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet the news about him spread all the more, so that crowds of people came to hear him and to be healed of their sicknesses.
verses.textEnEsv: But now even more the report about him went abroad, and great crowds gathered to hear him and to be healed of their infirmities.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, the report went around concerning Him all the more; and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by Him of their infirmities.
verses.textEnNlt: But despite Jesus’ instructions, the report of his power spread even faster, and vast crowds came to hear him preach and to be healed of their diseases.
verses.textEnNasb: But the news about Him was spreading even farther, and large crowds were gathering to hear Him and to be healed of their sicknesses.
verses.textEn: Yet the news about him spread all the more, so that crowds of people came to hear him and to be healed of their sicknesses.

verses.textZh: 耶稣却退到旷野去祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣却退到旷野去祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣却退到旷野去祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.
verses.textEnEsv: But he would withdraw to desolate places and pray.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He Himself often withdrew into the wilderness and prayed.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus often withdrew to the wilderness for prayer.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus Himself would often slip away to the wilderness and pray.
verses.textEn: But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.

verses.textZh: 有一天，耶稣正在教导人，法利赛人和律法教师也坐在那里，他们是从加利利和犹太各乡村，并耶路撒冷来的；主的能力与他同在，叫他能医病。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，耶稣正在教导人，法利赛人和律法教师也坐在那里，他们是从加利利和犹太各乡村，并耶路撒冷来的；主的能力与他同在，叫他能医病。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一天，耶稣教训人，有法利赛人和教法师在旁边坐着；他们是从加利利各乡村和犹太并耶路撒冷来的。主的能力与耶稣同在，使他能医治病人。
verses.textEnNiv: One day Jesus was teaching, and Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there. They had come from every village of Galilee and from Judea and Jerusalem. And the power of the Lord was with Jesus to heal the sick.
verses.textEnEsv: On one of those days, as he was teaching, Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there, who had come from every village of Galilee and Judea and from Jerusalem. And the power of the Lord was with him to heal.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened on a certain day, as He was teaching, that there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by, who had come out of every town of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. And the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
verses.textEnNlt: One day while Jesus was teaching, some Pharisees and teachers of religious law were sitting nearby. (It seemed that these men showed up from every village in all Galilee and Judea, as well as from Jerusalem.) And the Lord’s healing power was strongly with Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: One day He was teaching, and there were some Pharisees and teachers of the Law sitting there who had come from every village of Galilee and Judea, and from Jerusalem; and the power of the Lord was present for Him to perform healing.
verses.textEn: One day Jesus was teaching, and Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there. They had come from every village of Galilee and from Judea and Jerusalem. And the power of the Lord was with Jesus to heal the sick.

verses.textZh: 有人用床抬着一个瘫子，想送进去，放在耶稣跟前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人用床抬着一个瘫子，想送进去，放在耶稣跟前。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人用褥子抬着一个瘫子，要抬进去放在耶稣面前，
verses.textEnNiv: Some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a mat and tried to take him into the house to lay him before Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, some men were bringing on a bed a man who was paralyzed, and they were seeking to bring him in and lay him before Jesus,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then behold, men brought on a bed a man who was paralyzed, whom they sought to bring in and lay before Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a sleeping mat. They tried to take him inside to Jesus,
verses.textEnNasb: And some men were carrying a man on a stretcher who was paralyzed; and they were trying to bring him in and to set him down in front of Him.
verses.textEn: Some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a mat and tried to take him into the house to lay him before Jesus.

verses.textZh: 因为人多，没有办法进去，就上了房顶，从瓦间把瘫子和床往当中缒下去，正在耶稣跟前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为人多，没有办法进去，就上了房顶，从瓦间把瘫子和床往当中缒下去，正在耶稣跟前。
verses.textZhCuv: 却因人多，寻不出法子抬进去，就上了房顶，从瓦间把他连褥子缒到当中，正在耶稣面前。
verses.textEnNiv: When they could not find a way to do this because of the crowd, they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd, right in front of Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: but finding no way to bring him in, because of the crowd, they went up on the roof and let him down with his bed through the tiles into the midst before Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they could not find how they might bring him in, because of the crowd, they went up on the housetop and let him down with his bed through the tiling into the midst before Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: but they couldn’t reach him because of the crowd. So they went up to the roof and took off some tiles. Then they lowered the sick man on his mat down into the crowd, right in front of Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: But when they did not find any way to bring him in because of the crowd, they went up on the roof and let him down through the tiles with his stretcher, into the middle of the crowd, in front of Jesus.
verses.textEn: When they could not find a way to do this because of the crowd, they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd, right in front of Jesus.

verses.textZh: 他看见他们的信心，就说："<red>朋友 ，你的罪赦了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他看见他们的信心，就说："<red>朋友 ，你的罪赦了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣见他们的信心，就对瘫子说：「<red>你的罪赦了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus saw their faith, he said, <red>“Friend, your sins are forgiven.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when he saw their faith, he said, "Man, your sins are forgiven you."
verses.textEnNkjv: When He saw their faith, He said to him, "Man, your sins are forgiven you."
verses.textEnNlt: Seeing their faith, Jesus said to the man, "Young man, your sins are forgiven."
verses.textEnNasb: And seeing their faith, He said, " Friend, your sins are forgiven you."
verses.textEn: When Jesus saw their faith, he said, <red>“Friend, your sins are forgiven.”</red>

verses.textZh: 经学家和法利赛人就议论起来，说："这人是谁，竟然说僭妄的话？除神一位以外，谁能赦罪呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 经学家和法利赛人就议论起来，说："这人是谁，竟然说僭妄的话？除神一位以外，谁能赦罪呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 文士和法利赛人就议论说：「这说僭妄话的是谁？除了神以外，谁能赦罪呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law began thinking to themselves, "Who is this fellow who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to question, saying, "Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, "Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
verses.textEnNlt: But the Pharisees and teachers of religious law said to themselves, "Who does he think he is? That’s blasphemy! Only God can forgive sins!"
verses.textEnNasb: The scribes and the Pharisees began thinking of the implications, saying, "Who is this man who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, except God alone?"
verses.textEn: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law began thinking to themselves, "Who is this fellow who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but God alone?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣知道他们的议论，就对他们说："<red>你们心里为甚么议论呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣知道他们的议论，就对他们说："<red>你们心里为甚么议论呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣知道他们所议论的，就说：「你们心里议论的是什么呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked, <red>“Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answered them, "Why do you question in your hearts?
verses.textEnNkjv: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, He answered and said to them, "Why are you reasoning in your hearts?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he asked them, "Why do you question this in your hearts?
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus, aware of their thoughts, responded and said to them, "Why are you thinking this way in your hearts?
verses.textEn: Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked, <red>“Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>说：‘你的罪赦了’，或说：‘起来行走’，哪一样容易呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>说：‘你的罪赦了’，或说：‘起来行走’，哪一样容易呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>或说『你的罪赦了』，或说『你起来行走』，哪一样容易呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Rise and walk’?
verses.textEnNkjv: Which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Rise up and walk’?
verses.textEnNlt: Is it easier to say ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or ‘Stand up and walk’?
verses.textEnNasb: Which is easier, to say: ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?
verses.textEn: <red>Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而为了要你们知道，人子在地上有赦罪的权柄， 我吩咐你，起来，拿起你的床，回家去吧。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而为了要你们知道，人子在地上有赦罪的权柄， 我吩咐你，起来，拿起你的床，回家去吧。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 但要叫你们知道，人子在地上有赦罪的权柄。」就对瘫子说：「<red>我吩咐你，起来，拿你的褥子回家去吧！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.”</red> So he said to the paralyzed man, <red>“I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins"—he said to the man who was paralyzed—"I say to you, rise, pick up your bed and go home."
verses.textEnNkjv: But that you may know that the Son of Man has power on earth to forgive sins"—He said to the man who was paralyzed, "I say to you, arise, take up your bed, and go to your house."
verses.textEnNlt: So I will prove to you that the Son of Man has the authority on earth to forgive sins." Then Jesus turned to the paralyzed man and said, "Stand up, pick up your mat, and go home!"
verses.textEnNasb: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins," He said to the man who was paralyzed, "I say to you, get up, and pick up your stretcher, and go home."
verses.textEn: <red>But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.”</red> So he said to the paralyzed man, <red>“I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那人立刻当众起来，拿着他躺过的床，颂赞神，回家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人立刻当众起来，拿着他躺过的床，颂赞神，回家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人当众人面前立刻起来，拿着他所躺卧的褥子回家去，归荣耀与神。
verses.textEnNiv: Immediately he stood up in front of them, took what he had been lying on and went home praising God.
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately he rose up before them and picked up what he had been lying on and went home, glorifying God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately he rose up before them, took up what he had been lying on, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
verses.textEnNlt: And immediately, as everyone watched, the man jumped up, picked up his mat, and went home praising God.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately he got up before them, and picked up what he had been lying on, and went home glorifying God.
verses.textEn: Immediately he stood up in front of them, took what he had been lying on and went home praising God.

verses.textZh: 众人都惊奇，颂赞神，并且十分惧怕，说："我们今天看见了不平常的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人都惊奇，颂赞神，并且十分惧怕，说："我们今天看见了不平常的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人都惊奇，也归荣耀与神，并且满心惧怕，说：「我们今日看见非常的事了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone was amazed and gave praise to God. They were filled with awe and said, "We have seen remarkable things today."
verses.textEnEsv: And amazement seized them all, and they glorified God and were filled with awe, saying, "We have seen extraordinary things today."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God and were filled with fear, saying, "We have seen strange things today!"
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone was gripped with great wonder and awe, and they praised God, exclaiming, "We have seen amazing things today!"
verses.textEnNasb: And they were all struck with astonishment and began glorifying God. They were also filled with fear, saying, "We have seen remarkable things today!"
verses.textEn: Everyone was amazed and gave praise to God. They were filled with awe and said, "We have seen remarkable things today."

verses.textZh: 事后，耶稣出去，看见一个税吏，名叫利未，坐在税关那里，就对他说："<red>来跟从我！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 事后，耶稣出去，看见一个税吏，名叫利未，坐在税关那里，就对他说："<red>来跟从我！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，耶稣出去，看见一个税吏，名叫利未，坐在税关上，就对他说：「<red>你跟从我来。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: After this, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector by the name of Levi sitting at his tax booth. <red>“Follow me,”</red> Jesus said to him,
verses.textEnEsv: After this he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi, sitting at the tax booth. And he said to him, "Follow me."
verses.textEnNkjv: After these things He went out and saw a tax collector named Levi, sitting at the tax office. And He said to him, "Follow Me."
verses.textEnNlt: Later, as Jesus left the town, he saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at his tax collector’s booth. "Follow me and be my disciple," Jesus said to him.
verses.textEnNasb: After that He went out and looked at a tax collector named Levi sitting in the tax office, and He said to him, "Follow Me."
verses.textEn: After this, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector by the name of Levi sitting at his tax booth. <red>“Follow me,”</red> Jesus said to him,

verses.textZh: 他就撇下一切，起来跟从了耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就撇下一切，起来跟从了耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就撇下所有的，起来，跟从了耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: and Levi got up, left everything and followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And leaving everything, he rose and followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he left all, rose up, and followed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Levi got up, left everything, and followed him.
verses.textEnNasb: And he left everything behind, and got up and began following Him.
verses.textEn: and Levi got up, left everything and followed him.

verses.textZh: 利未在自己家里，为他大摆筵席，有许多税吏和别的人一起吃饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未在自己家里，为他大摆筵席，有许多税吏和别的人一起吃饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未在自己家里为耶稣大摆筵席，有许多税吏和别人与他们一同坐席。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Levi held a great banquet for Jesus at his house, and a large crowd of tax collectors and others were eating with them.
verses.textEnEsv: And Levi made him a great feast in his house, and there was a large company of tax collectors and others reclining at table with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Levi gave Him a great feast in his own house. And there were a great number of tax collectors and others who sat down with them.
verses.textEnNlt: Later, Levi held a banquet in his home with Jesus as the guest of honor. Many of Levi’s fellow tax collectors and other guests also ate with them.
verses.textEnNasb: And Levi gave a big reception for Him in his house; and there was a large crowd of tax collectors and other people who were reclining at the table with them.
verses.textEn: Then Levi held a great banquet for Jesus at his house, and a large crowd of tax collectors and others were eating with them.

verses.textZh: 法利赛人和经学家埋怨他的门徒，说："你们为甚么跟税吏和罪人一起吃喝呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人和经学家埋怨他的门徒，说："你们为甚么跟税吏和罪人一起吃喝呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人和文士就向耶稣的门徒发怨言说：「你们为什么和税吏并罪人一同吃喝呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law who belonged to their sect complained to his disciples, "Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the Pharisees and their scribes grumbled at his disciples, saying, "Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And their scribes and the Pharisees complained against His disciples, saying, "Why do You eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?"
verses.textEnNlt: But the Pharisees and their teachers of religious law complained bitterly to Jesus’ disciples, "Why do you eat and drink with such scum? "
verses.textEnNasb: The Pharisees and their scribes began grumbling to His disciples, saying, "Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?"
verses.textEn: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law who belonged to their sect complained to his disciples, "Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："健康的人不需要医生，有病的人才需要。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："健康的人不需要医生，有病的人才需要。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「无病的人用不着医生；有病的人才用得着。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered them, <red>“It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus answered them, "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus answered them, "Healthy people don’t need a doctor—sick people do.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus answered and said to them, "It is not those who are healthy who need a physician, but those who are sick.
verses.textEn: Jesus answered them, <red>“It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我来不是要召义人，而是要召罪人悔改。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我来不是要召义人，而是要召罪人悔改。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我来本不是召义人悔改，乃是召罪人悔改。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I have not come to call the righteous but sinners to repentance."
verses.textEnNkjv: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance."
verses.textEnNlt: I have come to call not those who think they are righteous, but those who know they are sinners and need to repent."
verses.textEnNasb: I have not come to call the righteous to repentance, but sinners."
verses.textEn: <red>I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们说："约翰的门徒常常禁食、祈祷，法利赛人的门徒也是这样，而你的门徒却又吃又喝。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："约翰的门徒常常禁食、祈祷，法利赛人的门徒也是这样，而你的门徒却又吃又喝。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「约翰的门徒屡次禁食祈祷，法利赛人的门徒也是这样；惟独你的门徒又吃又喝。」
verses.textEnNiv: They said to him, "John’s disciples often fast and pray, and so do the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours go on eating and drinking."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to him, "The disciples of John fast often and offer prayers, and so do the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to Him, "Why do the disciples of John fast often and make prayers, and likewise those of the Pharisees, but Yours eat and drink?"
verses.textEnNlt: One day some people said to Jesus, "John the Baptist’s disciples fast and pray regularly, and so do the disciples of the Pharisees. Why are your disciples always eating and drinking?"
verses.textEnNasb: And they said to Him, "The disciples of John often fast and offer prayers, the disciples of the Pharisees also do the same, but Yours eat and drink."
verses.textEn: They said to him, "John’s disciples often fast and pray, and so do the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours go on eating and drinking."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>新郎跟宾客在一起的时候，你们怎么可以叫宾客禁食呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>新郎跟宾客在一起的时候，你们怎么可以叫宾客禁食呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「新郎和陪伴之人同在的时候，岂能叫陪伴之人禁食呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while he is with them?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to them, "Can you make wedding guests fast while the bridegroom is with them?
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus responded, "Do wedding guests fast while celebrating with the groom? Of course not.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to them, "You cannot make the attendants of the groom fast while the groom is with them, can you?
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while he is with them?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但日子到了，新郎要被取去，离开他们，那一天他们就要禁食了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但日子到了，新郎要被取去，离开他们，那一天他们就要禁食了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但日子将到，新郎要离开他们，那日他们就要禁食了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; in those days they will fast.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The days will come when the bridegroom is taken away from them, and then they will fast in those days."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them; then they will fast in those days."
verses.textEnNlt: But someday the groom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast."
verses.textEnNasb: But the days will come; and when the groom is taken away from them, then they will fast in those days."
verses.textEn: <red>But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; in those days they will fast.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他又对他们设个比喻说："<red>没有人会从新衣服撕下一块布，补在旧衣服上，如果这样，不但新衣服撕破了，而且新撕下的布，也和旧的不调和。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对他们设个比喻说："<red>没有人会从新衣服撕下一块布，补在旧衣服上，如果这样，不但新衣服撕破了，而且新撕下的布，也和旧的不调和。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣又设一个比喻，对他们说：「没有人把新衣服撕下一块来补在旧衣服上；若是这样，就把新的撕破了，并且所撕下来的那块新的和旧的也不相称。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He told them this parable: <red>“No one tears a piece out of a new garment to patch an old one. Otherwise, they will have torn the new garment, and the patch from the new will not match the old.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He also told them a parable: "No one tears a piece from a new garment and puts it on an old garment. If he does, he will tear the new, and the piece from the new will not match the old.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He spoke a parable to them: "No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old one; otherwise the new makes a tear, and also the piece that was taken out of the new does not match the old.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus gave them this illustration: "No one tears a piece of cloth from a new garment and uses it to patch an old garment. For then the new garment would be ruined, and the new patch wouldn’t even match the old garment.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was also telling them a parable: "No one tears a piece of cloth from a new garment and puts it on an old garment; otherwise he will both tear the new, and the patch from the new garment will not match the old.
verses.textEn: He told them this parable: <red>“No one tears a piece out of a new garment to patch an old one. Otherwise, they will have torn the new garment, and the patch from the new will not match the old.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>也没有人会把新酒装在旧皮袋里；如果这样，新酒就会把皮袋胀破，不但酒漏掉，皮袋也损坏了；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>也没有人会把新酒装在旧皮袋里；如果这样，新酒就会把皮袋胀破，不但酒漏掉，皮袋也损坏了；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>也没有人把新酒装在旧皮袋里；若是这样，新酒必将皮袋裂开，酒便漏出来，皮袋也就坏了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the new wine will burst the skins; the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the new wine will burst the skins and it will be spilled, and the skins will be destroyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the wineskins and be spilled, and the wineskins will be ruined.
verses.textEnNlt: "And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. For the new wine would burst the wineskins, spilling the wine and ruining the skins.
verses.textEnNasb: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins; otherwise the new wine will burst the skins and it will be spilled out, and the skins will be ruined.
verses.textEn: <red>And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the new wine will burst the skins; the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人总是把新酒装在新皮袋里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人总是把新酒装在新皮袋里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但新酒必须装在新皮袋里。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>No, new wine must be poured into new wineskins.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins.
verses.textEnNkjv: But new wine must be put into new wineskins, and both are preserved.
verses.textEnNlt: New wine must be stored in new wineskins.
verses.textEnNasb: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins.
verses.textEn: <red>No, new wine must be poured into new wineskins.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>喝惯陈酒的人，就不想喝新酒，他总说陈的好。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>喝惯陈酒的人，就不想喝新酒，他总说陈的好。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>没有人喝了陈酒又想喝新的；他总说陈的好。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And no one after drinking old wine wants the new, for they say, ‘The old is better.’ ”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And no one after drinking old wine desires new, for he says, ‘The old is good.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And no one, having drunk old wine,immediately desires new; for he says, ‘The old is better.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But no one who drinks the old wine seems to want the new wine. ‘The old is just fine,’ they say."
verses.textEnNasb: And no one, after drinking old wine wants new; for he says, ‘The old is fine.’ "
verses.textEn: <red>And no one after drinking old wine wants the new, for they say, ‘The old is better.’ ”</red>

verses.textZh: 有一个安息日，耶稣从麦田经过，他的门徒摘了麦穗，用手搓着吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个安息日，耶稣从麦田经过，他的门徒摘了麦穗，用手搓着吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个安息日，耶稣从麦地经过。他的门徒掐了麦穗，用手搓着吃。
verses.textEnNiv: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels.
verses.textEnEsv: On a Sabbath, while he was going through the grainfields, his disciples plucked and ate some heads of grain, rubbing them in their hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened on the second Sabbath after the first that He went through the grainfields. And His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate them, rubbing them in their hands.
verses.textEnNlt: One Sabbath day as Jesus was walking through some grainfields, his disciples broke off heads of grain, rubbed off the husks in their hands, and ate the grain.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened that Jesus was passing through some grainfields on a Sabbath, and His disciples were picking the heads of grain, rubbing them in their hands, and eating them.
verses.textEn: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels.

verses.textZh: 有几个法利赛人说："你们为甚么作安息日不可作的事呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有几个法利赛人说："你们为甚么作安息日不可作的事呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 有几个法利赛人说：「你们为什么做安息日不可做的事呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the Pharisees asked, "Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?"
verses.textEnEsv: But some of the Pharisees said, "Why are you doing what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And some of the Pharisees said to them, "Why are you doing what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath?"
verses.textEnNlt: But some Pharisees said, "Why are you breaking the law by harvesting grain on the Sabbath?"
verses.textEnNasb: But some of the Pharisees said, "Why are you doing what is not lawful on the Sabbath?"
verses.textEn: Some of the Pharisees asked, "Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："大卫和跟他在一起的人，在饥饿的时候所作的，你们没有念过吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："大卫和跟他在一起的人，在饥饿的时候所作的，你们没有念过吗？
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「经上记着大卫和跟从他的人饥饿之时所做的事，连这个你们也没有念过吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered them, <red>“Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus answered them, "Have you not read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him:
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus answering them said, "Have you not even read this, what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him:
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "Haven’t you read in the Scriptures what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus, answering them, said, "Have you not even read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,
verses.textEn: Jesus answered them, <red>“Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他不是进了神的殿，吃了陈设饼，也给跟他在一起的人吃吗？这饼除了祭司以外，别的人是不可以吃的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他不是进了神的殿，吃了陈设饼，也给跟他在一起的人吃吗？这饼除了祭司以外，别的人是不可以吃的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他怎么进了神的殿，拿陈设饼吃，又给跟从的人吃？这饼除了祭司以外，别人都不可吃。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He entered the house of God, and taking the consecrated bread, he ate what is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: how he entered the house of God and took and ate the bread of the Presence, which is not lawful for any but the priests to eat, and also gave it to those with him?"
verses.textEnNkjv: how he went into the house of God, took and ate the showbread, and also gave some to those with him, which is not lawful for any but the priests to eat?"
verses.textEnNlt: He went into the house of God and broke the law by eating the sacred loaves of bread that only the priests can eat. He also gave some to his companions."
verses.textEnNasb: how he entered the house of God, and took and ate the consecrated bread, which is not lawful for anyone to eat except the priests alone, and gave it to his companions?"
verses.textEn: <red>He entered the house of God, and taking the consecrated bread, he ate what is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他又对他们说："<red>人子是安息日的主。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对他们说："<red>人子是安息日的主。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 又对他们说：「<red>人子是安息日的主。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to them, <red>“The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "The Son of Man is also Lord of the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNlt: And Jesus added, "The Son of Man is Lord, even over the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNasb: And He was saying to them, "The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to them, <red>“The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”</red>

verses.textZh: 另一个安息日，耶稣进入会堂教导人，在那里有一个人，右手枯干，
verses.textZhCnvs: 另一个安息日，耶稣进入会堂教导人，在那里有一个人，右手枯干，
verses.textZhCuv: 又有一个安息日，耶稣进了会堂教训人，在那里有一个人右手枯干了。
verses.textEnNiv: On another Sabbath he went into the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was shriveled.
verses.textEnEsv: On another Sabbath, he entered the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was withered.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened on another Sabbath, also, that He entered the synagogue and taught. And a man was there whose right hand was withered.
verses.textEnNlt: On another Sabbath day, a man with a deformed right hand was in the synagogue while Jesus was teaching.
verses.textEnNasb: On another Sabbath He entered the synagogue and taught; and a man was there whose right hand was withered.
verses.textEn: On another Sabbath he went into the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was shriveled.

verses.textZh: 经学家和法利赛人要看他会不会在安息日治病，好找把柄控告他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 经学家和法利赛人要看他会不会在安息日治病，好找把柄控告他。
verses.textZhCuv: 文士和法利赛人窥探耶稣，在安息日治病不治病，要得把柄去告他。
verses.textEnNiv: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal on the Sabbath.
verses.textEnEsv: And the scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, so that they might find a reason to accuse him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the scribes and Pharisees watched Him closely, whether He would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against Him.
verses.textEnNlt: The teachers of religious law and the Pharisees watched Jesus closely. If he healed the man’s hand, they planned to accuse him of working on the Sabbath.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the scribes and the Pharisees were watching Him closely to see if He healed on the Sabbath, so that they might find a reason to accuse Him.
verses.textEn: The Pharisees and the teachers of the law were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal on the Sabbath.

verses.textZh: 耶稣知道他们的意念，就对那一只手枯干了的人说："<red>起来，站在当中！</red>"那人就起来站着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣知道他们的意念，就对那一只手枯干了的人说："<red>起来，站在当中！</red>"那人就起来站着。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣却知道他们的意念，就对那枯干一只手的人说：「<red>起来！站在当中。</red>」那人就起来，站着。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said to the man with the shriveled hand, <red>“Get up and stand in front of everyone.”</red> So he got up and stood there.
verses.textEnEsv: But he knew their thoughts, and he said to the man with the withered hand, "Come and stand here." And he rose and stood there.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He knew their thoughts, and said to the man who had the withered hand, "Arise and stand here." And he arose and stood.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus knew their thoughts. He said to the man with the deformed hand, "Come and stand in front of everyone." So the man came forward.
verses.textEnNasb: But He knew what they were thinking, and He said to the man with the withered hand, "Get up and come forward!" And he got up and came forward.
verses.textEn: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said to the man with the shriveled hand, <red>“Get up and stand in front of everyone.”</red> So he got up and stood there.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>我问你们：在安息日哪一样是可以作的呢：作好事还是坏事？救命还是害命？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>我问你们：在安息日哪一样是可以作的呢：作好事还是坏事？救命还是害命？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他们说：「<red>我问你们，在安息日行善行恶，救命害命，哪样是可以的呢？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to them, <red>“I ask you, which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to them, "I ask you, is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do harm, to save life or to destroy it?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to them, "I will ask you one thing: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said to his critics, "I have a question for you. Does the law permit good deeds on the Sabbath, or is it a day for doing evil? Is this a day to save life or to destroy it?"
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to them, "I ask you whether it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath or to do harm, to save a life or to destroy it?"
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to them, <red>“I ask you, which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他环视周围所有的人，就对那人说："<red>伸出你的手来！</red>"他把手一伸，手就复原了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他环视周围所有的人，就对那人说："<red>伸出你的手来！</red>"他把手一伸，手就复原了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就周围看着他们众人，对那人说：「<red>伸出手来！</red>」他把手一伸，手就复了原。
verses.textEnNiv: He looked around at them all, and then said to the man, <red>“Stretch out your hand.”</red> He did so, and his hand was completely restored.
verses.textEnEsv: And after looking around at them all he said to him, "Stretch out your hand." And he did so, and his hand was restored.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He had looked around at them all, He said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." And he did so, and his hand was restored as whole as the other.
verses.textEnNlt: He looked around at them one by one and then said to the man, "Hold out your hand." So the man held out his hand, and it was restored!
verses.textEnNasb: And after looking around at them all, He said to him, "Stretch out your hand!" And he did so; and his hand was restored.
verses.textEn: He looked around at them all, and then said to the man, <red>“Stretch out your hand.”</red> He did so, and his hand was completely restored.

verses.textZh: 他们却大怒，彼此商议怎样对付耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们却大怒，彼此商议怎样对付耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就满心大怒，彼此商议怎样处治耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were furious and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: But they were filled with fury and discussed with one another what they might do to Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they were filled with rage, and discussed with one another what they might do to Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: At this, the enemies of Jesus were wild with rage and began to discuss what to do with him.
verses.textEnNasb: But they themselves were filled with senseless rage, and began discussing together what they might do to Jesus.
verses.textEn: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were furious and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus.

verses.textZh: 在那些日子，有一次耶稣出去到山上祷告，整夜祷告神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些日子，有一次耶稣出去到山上祷告，整夜祷告神。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，耶稣出去，上山祷告，整夜祷告神；
verses.textEnNiv: One of those days Jesus went out to a mountainside to pray, and spent the night praying to God.
verses.textEnEsv: In these days he went out to the mountain to pray, and all night he continued in prayer to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in those days that He went out to the mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
verses.textEnNlt: One day soon afterward Jesus went up on a mountain to pray, and he prayed to God all night.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it was at this time that He went off to the mountain to pray, and He spent the whole night in prayer with God.
verses.textEn: One of those days Jesus went out to a mountainside to pray, and spent the night praying to God.

verses.textZh: 天亮以后，他把门徒叫来，从他们中间挑选了十二个人，称他们为使徒，
verses.textZhCnvs: 天亮以后，他把门徒叫来，从他们中间挑选了十二个人，称他们为使徒，
verses.textZhCuv: 到了天亮，叫他的门徒来，就从他们中间挑选十二个人，称他们为使徒。
verses.textEnNiv: When morning came, he called his disciples to him and chose twelve of them, whom he also designated apostles:
verses.textEnEsv: And when day came, he called his disciples and chose from them twelve, whom he named apostles:
verses.textEnNkjv: And when it was day, He called His disciples to Himself; and from them He chose twelve whom He also named apostles:
verses.textEnNlt: At daybreak he called together all of his disciples and chose twelve of them to be apostles. Here are their names:
verses.textEnNasb: And when day came, He called His disciples to Him and chose twelve of them, whom He also named as apostles:
verses.textEn: When morning came, he called his disciples to him and chose twelve of them, whom he also designated apostles:

verses.textZh: 就是西门 ，和他弟弟安得烈，以及雅各、约翰、腓力、巴多罗迈、
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是西门 ，和他弟弟安得烈，以及雅各、约翰、腓力、巴多罗迈、
verses.textZhCuv: 这十二个人有西门（耶稣又给他起名叫彼得），还有他兄弟安得烈，又有雅各和约翰，腓力和巴多罗买，
verses.textEnNiv: Simon (whom he named Peter), his brother Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew,
verses.textEnEsv: Simon, whom he named Peter, and Andrew his brother, and James and John, and Philip, and Bartholomew,
verses.textEnNkjv: Simon, whom He also named Peter, and Andrew his brother; James and John; Philip and Bartholomew;
verses.textEnNlt: Simon (whom he named Peter), Andrew (Peter’s brother), James, John, Philip, Bartholomew,
verses.textEnNasb: Simon, whom He also named Peter, and his brother Andrew; and James and John; and Philip and Bartholomew;
verses.textEn: Simon (whom he named Peter), his brother Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew,

verses.textZh: 马太、多马、亚勒腓的儿子雅各、称为激进派的西门、
verses.textZhCnvs: 马太、多马、亚勒腓的儿子雅各、称为激进派的西门、
verses.textZhCuv: 马太和多马，亚勒腓的儿子雅各和奋锐党的西门，
verses.textEnNiv: Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Simon who was called the Zealot,
verses.textEnEsv: and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon who was called the Zealot,
verses.textEnNkjv: Matthew and Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called the Zealot;
verses.textEnNlt: Matthew, Thomas, James (son of Alphaeus), Simon (who was called the zealot),
verses.textEnNasb: and Matthew and Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon who was called the Zealot;
verses.textEn: Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Simon who was called the Zealot,

verses.textZh: 雅各的儿子犹大，和出卖主的加略人犹大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各的儿子犹大，和出卖主的加略人犹大。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各的儿子 犹大，和卖主的加略人犹大。
verses.textEnNiv: Judas son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.
verses.textEnEsv: and Judas the son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Judas theson of James, and Judas Iscariot who also became a traitor.
verses.textEnNlt: Judas (son of James), Judas Iscariot (who later betrayed him).
verses.textEnNasb: Judas the son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.
verses.textEn: Judas son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.

verses.textZh: 耶稣和他们下了山，站在平地上，有一大群门徒同他在一起，又有一大批从犹太全地、耶路撒冷和推罗、西顿海边来的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣和他们下了山，站在平地上，有一大群门徒同他在一起，又有一大批从犹太全地、耶路撒冷和推罗、西顿海边来的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣和他们下了山，站在一块平地上；同站的有许多门徒，又有许多百姓，从犹太全地和耶路撒冷，并泰尔、西顿的海边来，都要听他讲道，又指望医治他们的病；
verses.textEnNiv: He went down with them and stood on a level place. A large crowd of his disciples was there and a great number of people from all over Judea, from Jerusalem, and from the coastal region around Tyre and Sidon,
verses.textEnEsv: And he came down with them and stood on a level place, with a great crowd of his disciples and a great multitude of people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the seacoast of Tyre and Sidon,
verses.textEnNkjv: And He came down with them and stood on a level place with a crowd of His disciples and a great multitude of people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and from the seacoast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear Him and be healed of their diseases,
verses.textEnNlt: When they came down from the mountain, the disciples stood with Jesus on a large, level area, surrounded by many of his followers and by the crowds. There were people from all over Judea and from Jerusalem and from as far north as the seacoasts of Tyre and Sidon.
verses.textEnNasb: And then Jesus came down with them and stood on a level place; and there was a large crowd of His disciples, and a great multitude of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and the coastal region of Tyre and Sidon,
verses.textEn: He went down with them and stood on a level place. A large crowd of his disciples was there and a great number of people from all over Judea, from Jerusalem, and from the coastal region around Tyre and Sidon,

verses.textZh: 他们要听他讲道，也要他们的疾病得医好。还有一些被污灵缠扰的也痊愈了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要听他讲道，也要他们的疾病得医好。还有一些被污灵缠扰的也痊愈了。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有被污鬼缠磨的，也得了医治。
verses.textEnNiv: who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases. Those troubled by impure spirits were cured,
verses.textEnEsv: who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases. And those who were troubled with unclean spirits were cured.
verses.textEnNkjv: as well as those who were tormented with unclean spirits. And they were healed.
verses.textEnNlt: They had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases; and those troubled by evil spirits were healed.
verses.textEnNasb: who had come to hear Him and to be healed of their diseases; and those who were troubled by unclean spirits were being cured.
verses.textEn: who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases. Those troubled by impure spirits were cured,

verses.textZh: 群众都设法摸他，因为有能 力从他身上出来，治好众人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众都设法摸他，因为有能 力从他身上出来，治好众人。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人都想要摸他；因为有能力从他身上发出来，医好了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: and the people all tried to touch him, because power was coming from him and healing them all.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the crowd sought to touch him, for power came out from him and healed them all.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the whole multitude sought to touch Him, for power went out from Him and healed them all.
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone tried to touch him, because healing power went out from him, and he healed everyone.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the people were trying to touch Him, because power was coming from Him and healing them all.
verses.textEn: and the people all tried to touch him, because power was coming from him and healing them all.

verses.textZh: 耶稣抬头看着门徒，说： "贫穷的人有福了， 因为神的国是你们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣抬头看着门徒，说： "贫穷的人有福了， 因为神的国是你们的。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣举目看着门徒，说： 你们贫穷的人有福了！ 因为神的国是你们的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Looking at his disciples, he said: <red>“Blessedpn are you who are poor, forld yours is the kingdom of God.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said: "Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He lifted up His eyes toward His disciples, and said: "Blessed are you poor, For yours is the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus turned to his disciples and said, "God blesses you who are poor, for the Kingdom of God is yours.
verses.textEnNasb: And He raised His eyes toward His disciples and began saying, "Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.
verses.textEn: Looking at his disciples, he said: <red>“Blessedpn are you who are poor, forld yours is the kingdom of God.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>饥饿的人有福了， 因为你们要得饱足。 哀哭的人有福了， 因为你们将要喜乐。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>饥饿的人有福了， 因为你们要得饱足。 哀哭的人有福了， 因为你们将要喜乐。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们饥饿的人有福了！ 因为你们将要饱足。 你们哀哭的人有福了！ 因为你们将要喜笑。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Blessedln are you who hunger now, forld you will be satisfied. Blessedln are you who weep now, forld you will laugh.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Blessed are you who are hungry now, for you shall be satisfied. "Blessed are you who weep now, for you shall laugh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are you who hunger now, For you shall be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, For you shall laugh.
verses.textEnNlt: God blesses you who are hungry now, for you will be satisfied. God blesses you who weep now, for in due time you will laugh.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed are you who are hungry now, for you will be satisfied. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
verses.textEn: <red>Blessedln are you who hunger now, forld you will be satisfied. Blessedln are you who weep now, forld you will laugh.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>世人为人子的缘故憎恨你们、排斥你们、辱骂你们，弃绝你们的名好象弃绝恶物，你们就有福了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>世人为人子的缘故憎恨你们、排斥你们、辱骂你们，弃绝你们的名好象弃绝恶物，你们就有福了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「人为人子恨恶你们，拒绝你们，辱骂你们，弃掉你们的名，以为是恶，你们就有福了！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Blessedln are you when people hate you, whenld they exclude you and insult you andld reject your name as evil, becauseld of the Son of Man.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Blessed are you when people hate you and when they exclude you and revile you and spurn your name as evil, on account of the Son of Man!
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are you when men hate you, And when they exclude you, And revile you, and cast out your name as evil, For the Son of Man’s sake.
verses.textEnNlt: What blessings await you when people hate you and exclude you and mock you and curse you as evil because you follow the Son of Man.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed are you when the people hate you, and when they exclude you, and insult you, and scorn your name as evil, on account of the Son of Man.
verses.textEn: <red>Blessedln are you when people hate you, whenld they exclude you and insult you andld reject your name as evil, becauseld of the Son of Man.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那时你们应该欢喜跳跃，因为你们在天上的赏赐是大的，他们的祖先对待先知也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那时你们应该欢喜跳跃，因为你们在天上的赏赐是大的，他们的祖先对待先知也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>当那日，你们要欢喜跳跃，因为你们在天上的赏赐是大的。他们的祖宗待先知也是这样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Rejoicep in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven. For that is how their ancestors treated the prophets.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Rejoice in that day, and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven; for so their fathers did to the prophets.
verses.textEnNkjv: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy! For indeed your reward is great in heaven, For in like manner their fathers did to the prophets.
verses.textEnNlt: When that happens, be happy! Yes, leap for joy! For a great reward awaits you in heaven. And remember, their ancestors treated the ancient prophets that same way.
verses.textEnNasb: Rejoice on that day and jump for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven. For their fathers used to treat the prophets the same way.
verses.textEn: <red>“Rejoicep in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven. For that is how their ancestors treated the prophets.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"然而你们富有的人有祸了， 因为你们已经得了你们的安慰。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"然而你们富有的人有祸了， 因为你们已经得了你们的安慰。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但你们富足的人有祸了！ 因为你们受过你们的安慰。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butpn woe to you who are rich, forld you have already received your comfort.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "But woe to you who are rich, for you have received your consolation.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But woe to you who are rich, For you have received your consolation.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you who are rich, for you have your only happiness now.
verses.textEnNasb: But woe to you who are rich, for you are receiving your comfort in full.
verses.textEn: <red>“Butpn woe to you who are rich, forld you have already received your comfort.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们饱足的人有祸了， 因为你们将要饥饿。 你们喜乐的人有祸了， 因为你们将要痛哭。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们饱足的人有祸了， 因为你们将要饥饿。 你们喜乐的人有祸了， 因为你们将要痛哭。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们饱足的人有祸了！ 因为你们将要饥饿。 你们喜笑的人有祸了！ 因为你们将要哀恸哭泣。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Woeln to you who are well fed now, forld you will go hungry. Woeln to you who laugh now, forld you will mourn and weep.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to you who are full now, for you shall be hungry. "Woe to you who laugh now, for you shall mourn and weep.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to you who are full, For you shall hunger. Woe to you who laugh now, For you shall mourn and weep.
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits you who are fat and prosperous now, for a time of awful hunger awaits you. What sorrow awaits you who laugh now, for your laughing will turn to mourning and sorrow.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to you who are well-fed now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
verses.textEn: <red>Woeln to you who are well fed now, forld you will go hungry. Woeln to you who laugh now, forld you will mourn and weep.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人都说你们好的时候，你们就有祸了，因为你们的祖先对待假先知也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人都说你们好的时候，你们就有祸了，因为你们的祖先对待假先知也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 「<red>人都说你们好的时候，你们就有祸了！因为他们的祖宗待假先知也是这样。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Woeln to you when everyone speaks well of you, forld that is how their ancestors treated the false prophets.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to you, when all people speak well of you, for so their fathers did to the false prophets.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to you when all men speak well of you, For so did their fathers to the false prophets.
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits you who are praised by the crowds, for their ancestors also praised false prophets.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to you when all the people speak well of you; for their fathers used to treat the false prophets the same way.
verses.textEn: <red>Woeln to you when everyone speaks well of you, forld that is how their ancestors treated the false prophets.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"只是我告诉你们听道的人：当爱你们的仇敌，善待恨你们的人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"只是我告诉你们听道的人：当爱你们的仇敌，善待恨你们的人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「只是我告诉你们这听道的人，你们的仇敌，要爱他！恨你们的，要待他好！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp to you who are listening I say: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "But I say to you who hear, Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
verses.textEnNkjv: "But I say to you who hear: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
verses.textEnNlt: "But to you who are willing to listen, I say, love your enemies! Do good to those who hate you.
verses.textEnNasb: "But I say to you who hear, love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp to you who are listening I say: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>咒诅你们的，要为他们祝福，凌辱你们的，要为他们祷告。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>咒诅你们的，要为他们祝福，凌辱你们的，要为他们祷告。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>咒诅你们的，要为他祝福！凌辱你们的，要为他祷告！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: bless those who curse you, pray for those who abuse you.
verses.textEnNkjv: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who spitefully use you.
verses.textEnNlt: Bless those who curse you. Pray for those who hurt you.
verses.textEnNasb: bless those who curse you, pray for those who are abusive to you.
verses.textEn: <red>bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有人打你一边的脸，把另一边也转给他打；有人拿你的外衣，连内衣也让他拿去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有人打你一边的脸，把另一边也转给他打；有人拿你的外衣，连内衣也让他拿去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>有人打你这边的脸，连那边的脸也由他打。有人夺你的外衣，连里衣也由他拿去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If someone slaps you on one cheek, turn to them the other also. If someone takes your coat, do not withhold your shirt from them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: To one who strikes you on the cheek, offer the other also, and from one who takes away your cloak do not withhold your tunic either.
verses.textEnNkjv: To him who strikes you on the one cheek, offer the other also. And from him who takes away your cloak, do not withhold your tunic either.
verses.textEnNlt: If someone slaps you on one cheek, offer the other cheek also. If someone demands your coat, offer your shirt also.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever hits you on the cheek, offer him the other also; and whoever takes away your cloak, do not withhold your tunic from him either.
verses.textEn: <red>If someone slaps you on one cheek, turn to them the other also. If someone takes your coat, do not withhold your shirt from them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>向你求的，就给他；有人拿去你的东西，不用再要回来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>向你求的，就给他；有人拿去你的东西，不用再要回来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡求你的，就给他。有人夺你的东西去，不用再要回来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Give to everyone who asks you, and if anyone takes what belongs to you, do not demand it back.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Give to everyone who begs from you, and from one who takes away your goods do not demand them back.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give to everyone who asks of you. And from him who takes away your goods do not ask them back.
verses.textEnNlt: Give to anyone who asks; and when things are taken away from you, don’t try to get them back.
verses.textEnNasb: Give to everyone who asks of you, and whoever takes away what is yours, do not demand it back.
verses.textEn: <red>Give to everyone who asks you, and if anyone takes what belongs to you, do not demand it back.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们愿意人怎样待你们，你们就应当怎样待人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们愿意人怎样待你们，你们就应当怎样待人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们愿意人怎样待你们，你们也要怎样待人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Do to others as you would have them do to you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And as you wish that others would do to you, do so to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And just as you want men to do to you, you also do to them likewise.
verses.textEnNlt: Do to others as you would like them to do to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Treat people the same way you want them to treat you.
verses.textEn: <red>Do to others as you would have them do to you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果单爱那些爱你们的人，那有甚么好处呢？罪人也爱那些爱他们的人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果单爱那些爱你们的人，那有甚么好处呢？罪人也爱那些爱他们的人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们若单爱那爱你们的人，有什么可酬谢的呢？就是罪人也爱那爱他们的人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Ifp you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners love those who love them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "If you love those who love you, what benefit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But if you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you love only those who love you, why should you get credit for that? Even sinners love those who love them!
verses.textEnNasb: If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.
verses.textEn: <red>“Ifp you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners love those who love them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果只善待那些善待你们的人，那有甚么好处呢？罪人也会这样行。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果只善待那些善待你们的人，那有甚么好处呢？罪人也会这样行。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们若善待那善待你们的人，有什么可酬谢的呢？就是罪人也是这样行。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And if you do good to those who are good to you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners do that.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if you do good to those who do good to you, what benefit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.
verses.textEnNlt: And if you do good only to those who do good to you, why should you get credit? Even sinners do that much!
verses.textEnNasb: And if you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.
verses.textEn: <red>And if you do good to those who are good to you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners do that.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果借给人，又指望向人收回，那有甚么好处呢？罪人也借给罪人，要如数收回。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果借给人，又指望向人收回，那有甚么好处呢？罪人也借给罪人，要如数收回。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们若借给人，指望从他收回，有什么可酬谢的呢？就是罪人也借给罪人，要如数收回。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, expecting to be repaid in full.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if you lend to those from whom you expect to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to get back the same amount.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if you lend to those from whom you hope to receive back, what credit is that to you? For even sinners lend to sinners to receive as much back.
verses.textEnNlt: And if you lend money only to those who can repay you, why should you get credit? Even sinners will lend to other sinners for a full return.
verses.textEnNasb: And if you lend to those from whom you expect to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners in order to receive back the same amount.
verses.textEn: <red>And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, expecting to be repaid in full.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们要爱仇敌，善待他们；借出去，不要指望偿还；这样你们的赏赐就大了，你们也必作至高者的儿子，因为神自己也宽待忘恩的和恶人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们要爱仇敌，善待他们；借出去，不要指望偿还；这样你们的赏赐就大了，你们也必作至高者的儿子，因为神自己也宽待忘恩的和恶人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们倒要爱仇敌，也要善待他们，并要借给人不指望偿还，你们的赏赐就必大了，你们也必作至高者的儿子，因为他恩待那忘恩的和作恶的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them without expecting to get anything back. Then your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High, because he is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing in return, and your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High, for he is kind to the ungrateful and the evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: But love your enemies, do good, and lend, hoping for nothing in return; and your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High. For He is kind to the unthankful and evil.
verses.textEnNlt: "Love your enemies! Do good to them. Lend to them without expecting to be repaid. Then your reward from heaven will be very great, and you will truly be acting as children of the Most High, for he is kind to those who are unthankful and wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: But love your enemies and do good, and lend, expecting nothing in return; and your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High; for He Himself is kind to ungrateful and evil people.
verses.textEn: <red>But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them without expecting to get anything back. Then your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High, because he is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们要仁慈像你们的父仁慈一样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们要仁慈像你们的父仁慈一样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要慈悲，像你们的父慈悲一样。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Be merciful, even as your Father is merciful.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore be merciful, just as your Father also is merciful.
verses.textEnNlt: You must be compassionate, just as your Father is compassionate.
verses.textEnNasb: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.
verses.textEn: <red>Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们不要判断人，就必不受判断；不要定人的罪，就必不被定罪；要饶恕人，就必蒙饶恕；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们不要判断人，就必不受判断；不要定人的罪，就必不被定罪；要饶恕人，就必蒙饶恕；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们不要论断人，就不被论断；你们不要定人的罪，就不被定罪；你们要饶恕人，就必蒙饶恕 ；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Dop not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Judge not, and you will not be judged; condemn not, and you will not be condemned; forgive, and you will be forgiven;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Judge not, and you shall not be judged. Condemn not, and you shall not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not judge others, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn others, or it will all come back against you. Forgive others, and you will be forgiven.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not judge, and you will not be judged; and do not condemn, and you will not be condemned; pardon, and you will be pardoned.
verses.textEn: <red>“Dop not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>要给人，就必有给你们的；并且要用十足的升斗，连按带摇，上尖下流地倒在你们怀里；因为你们用甚么升斗量给人，就必用甚么升斗量给你们。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>要给人，就必有给你们的；并且要用十足的升斗，连按带摇，上尖下流地倒在你们怀里；因为你们用甚么升斗量给人，就必用甚么升斗量给你们。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要给人，就必有给你们的，并且用十足的升斗，连摇带按，上尖下流地倒在你们怀里；因为你们用什么量器量给人，也必用什么量器量给你们。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: give, and it will be given to you. Good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over, will be put into your lap. For with the measure you use it will be measured back to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over will be put into your bosom. For with the same measure that you use, it will be measured back to you."
verses.textEnNlt: Give, and you will receive. Your gift will return to you in full—pressed down, shaken together to make room for more, running over, and poured into your lap. The amount you give will determine the amount you get back. "
verses.textEnNasb: Give, and it will be given to you. They will pour into your lap a good measure—pressed down, shaken together, and running over. For by your standard of measure it will be measured to you in return."
verses.textEn: <red>Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又用比喻对他们说："<red>瞎子怎能给瞎子领路呢？两个人不都要掉在坑里吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又用比喻对他们说："<red>瞎子怎能给瞎子领路呢？两个人不都要掉在坑里吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣又用比喻对他们说：「瞎子岂能领瞎子，两个人不是都要掉在坑里吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He also told them this parable: <red>“Can the blind lead the blind? Will they not both fall into a pit?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He also told them a parable: "Can a blind man lead a blind man? Will they not both fall into a pit?
verses.textEnNkjv: And He spoke a parable to them: "Can the blind lead the blind? Will they not both fall into the ditch?
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus gave the following illustration: "Can one blind person lead another? Won’t they both fall into a ditch?
verses.textEnNasb: Now He also spoke a parable to them: "A person who is blind cannot guide another who is blind, can he? Will they not both fall into a pit?
verses.textEn: He also told them this parable: <red>“Can the blind lead the blind? Will they not both fall into a pit?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>学生不能胜过老师，所有学成的，不过和老师一样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>学生不能胜过老师，所有学成的，不过和老师一样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>学生不能高过先生；凡学成了的不过和先生一样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The student is not above the teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like their teacher.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.
verses.textEnNkjv: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone who is perfectly trained will be like his teacher.
verses.textEnNlt: Students are not greater than their teacher. But the student who is fully trained will become like the teacher.
verses.textEnNasb: A student is not above the teacher; but everyone, when he has been fully trained, will be like his teacher.
verses.textEn: <red>The student is not above the teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like their teacher.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>为甚么看得见你弟兄眼中的木屑，却想不到自己眼中的梁木呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>为甚么看得见你弟兄眼中的木屑，却想不到自己眼中的梁木呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>为什么看见你弟兄眼中有刺，却不想自己眼中有梁木呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whyp do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother’s eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but do not notice the log that is in your own eye?
verses.textEnNkjv: And why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye, but do not perceive the plank in your own eye?
verses.textEnNlt: "And why worry about a speck in your friend’s eye when you have a log in your own?
verses.textEnNasb: Why do you look at the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but do not notice the log that is in your own eye?
verses.textEn: <red>“Whyp do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother’s eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你不看见自己眼中的梁木，怎能对你弟兄说：‘弟兄，容我除去你眼中的木屑’呢？伪君子啊！先去掉自己眼中的梁木，才能看得清楚，好去掉弟兄眼中的木屑。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你不看见自己眼中的梁木，怎能对你弟兄说：‘弟兄，容我除去你眼中的木屑’呢？伪君子啊！先去掉自己眼中的梁木，才能看得清楚，好去掉弟兄眼中的木屑。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你不见自己眼中有梁木，怎能对你弟兄说：『容我去掉你眼中的刺』呢？你这假冒为善的人！先去掉自己眼中的梁木，然后才能看得清楚，去掉你弟兄眼中的刺。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>How can you say to your brother, ‘Brother, let me take the speck out of your eye,’ when you yourself fail to see the plank in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: How can you say to your brother, ‘Brother, let me take out the speck that is in your eye,’ when you yourself do not see the log that is in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the log out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take out the speck that is in your brother’s eye.
verses.textEnNkjv: Or how can you say to your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck that is in your eye,’ when you yourself do not see the plank that is in your own eye? Hypocrite! First remove the plank from your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck that is in your brother’s eye.
verses.textEnNlt: How can you think of saying, ‘Friend, let me help you get rid of that speck in your eye,’ when you can’t see past the log in your own eye? Hypocrite! First get rid of the log in your own eye; then you will see well enough to deal with the speck in your friend’s eye.
verses.textEnNasb: How can you say to your brother, ‘Brother, let me take out the speck that is in your eye,’ when you yourself do not see the log that is in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the log out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take out the speck that is in your brother’s eye.
verses.textEn: <red>How can you say to your brother, ‘Brother, let me take the speck out of your eye,’ when you yourself fail to see the plank in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"因为好树不能结坏果子，坏树不能结好果子。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"因为好树不能结坏果子，坏树不能结好果子。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「因为，没有好树结坏果子，也没有坏树结好果子。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Nop good tree bears bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "For no good tree bears bad fruit, nor again does a bad tree bear good fruit,
verses.textEnNkjv: "For a good tree does not bear bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: "A good tree can’t produce bad fruit, and a bad tree can’t produce good fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: For there is no good tree that bears bad fruit, nor, on the other hand, a bad tree that bears good fruit.
verses.textEn: <red>“Nop good tree bears bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凭着果子就可以认出树来。人不能从荆棘上采无花果，也不能从蒺藜里摘葡萄。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凭着果子就可以认出树来。人不能从荆棘上采无花果，也不能从蒺藜里摘葡萄。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡树木看果子，就可以认出它来。人不是从荆棘上摘无花果，也不是从蒺藜里摘葡萄。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Each tree is recognized by its own fruit. People do not pick figs from thornbushes, or grapes from briers.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: for each tree is known by its own fruit. For figs are not gathered from thornbushes, nor are grapes picked from a bramble bush.
verses.textEnNkjv: For every tree is known by its own fruit. For men do not gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.
verses.textEnNlt: A tree is identified by its fruit. Figs are never gathered from thornbushes, and grapes are not picked from bramble bushes.
verses.textEnNasb: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people do not gather figs from thorns, nor do they pick grapes from a briar bush.
verses.textEn: <red>Each tree is recognized by its own fruit. People do not pick figs from thornbushes, or grapes from briers.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>良善的人从心中所存的良善发出良善，邪恶的人从心中所存的邪恶发出邪恶；因为心中所充满的，口里就说出来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>良善的人从心中所存的良善发出良善，邪恶的人从心中所存的邪恶发出邪恶；因为心中所充满的，口里就说出来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>善人从他心里所存的善就发出善来；恶人从他心里所存的恶就发出恶来；因为心里所充满的，口里就说出来。」</red>
