verses.textEnNiv: <red>A good man brings good things out of the good stored up in his heart, and an evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in his heart. For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The good person out of the good treasure of his heart produces good, and the evil person out of his evil treasure produces evil, for out of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaks.
verses.textEnNkjv: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings forth evil. For out of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaks.
verses.textEnNlt: A good person produces good things from the treasury of a good heart, and an evil person produces evil things from the treasury of an evil heart. What you say flows from what is in your heart.
verses.textEnNasb: The good person out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth what is good; and the evil person out of the evil treasure brings forth what is evil; for his mouth speaks from that which fills his heart.
verses.textEn: <red>A good man brings good things out of the good stored up in his heart, and an evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in his heart. For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们为甚么称呼我‘主啊！主啊！’却不遵行我的吩咐呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们为甚么称呼我‘主啊！主啊！’却不遵行我的吩咐呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们为什么称呼我『主啊，主啊』却不遵我的话行呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whyp do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and do not do what I say?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Why do you call me ‘Lord, Lord,’ and not do what I tell you?
verses.textEnNkjv: "But why do you call Me ‘Lord, Lord,’ and not do the things which I say?
verses.textEnNlt: "So why do you keep calling me ‘Lord, Lord!’ when you don’t do what I say?
verses.textEnNasb: "Now why do you call Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and do not do what I say?
verses.textEn: <red>“Whyp do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and do not do what I say?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>每一个到我跟前，听我的话并且去行的，我要指示你们他像甚么人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>每一个到我跟前，听我的话并且去行的，我要指示你们他像甚么人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡到我这里来，听见我的话就去行的，我要告诉你们他像什么人：</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>As for everyone who comes to me and hears my words and puts them into practice, I will show you what they are like.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Everyone who comes to me and hears my words and does them, I will show you what he is like:
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever comes to Me, and hears My sayings and does them, I will show you whom he is like:
verses.textEnNlt: I will show you what it’s like when someone comes to me, listens to my teaching, and then follows it.
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone who comes to Me and hears My words and acts on them, I will show you whom he is like:
verses.textEn: <red>As for everyone who comes to me and hears my words and puts them into practice, I will show you what they are like.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他像一个人建造房屋，挖深了地，把根基建在盘石上。大水泛滥的时候，急流冲击那房屋，不能使它动摇，因为它建造得好。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他像一个人建造房屋，挖深了地，把根基建在盘石上。大水泛滥的时候，急流冲击那房屋，不能使它动摇，因为它建造得好。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他像一个人盖房子，深深地挖地，把根基安在磐石上；到发大水的时候，水冲那房子，房子总不能摇动，因为根基立在磐石上 。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>They are like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid the foundation on rock. When a flood came, the torrent struck that house but could not shake it, because it was well built.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: he is like a man building a house, who dug deep and laid the foundation on the rock. And when a flood arose, the stream broke against that house and could not shake it, because it had been well built.
verses.textEnNkjv: He is like a man building a house, who dug deep and laid the foundation on the rock. And when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently against that house, and could not shake it, for it was founded on the rock.
verses.textEnNlt: It is like a person building a house who digs deep and lays the foundation on solid rock. When the floodwaters rise and break against that house, it stands firm because it is well built.
verses.textEnNasb: he is like a man building a house, who dug deep and laid a foundation on the rock; and when there was a flood, the river burst against that house and yet it could not shake it, because it had been well built.
verses.textEn: <red>They are like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid the foundation on rock. When a flood came, the torrent struck that house but could not shake it, because it was well built.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但那听见而不遵行的，就像人在地上建屋，没有根基，急流一冲，就立刻倒塌，毁坏得很厉害。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但那听见而不遵行的，就像人在地上建屋，没有根基，急流一冲，就立刻倒塌，毁坏得很厉害。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>惟有听见不去行的，就像一个人在土地上盖房子，没有根基；水一冲，随即倒塌了，并且那房子坏的很大。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But the one who hears my words and does not put them into practice is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation. The moment the torrent struck that house, it collapsed and its destruction was complete.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But the one who hears and does not do them is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation. When the stream broke against it, immediately it fell, and the ruin of that house was great."
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who heard and did nothing is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream beat vehemently; and immediately it fell. And the ruin of that house was great."
verses.textEnNlt: But anyone who hears and doesn’t obey is like a person who builds a house right on the ground, without a foundation. When the floods sweep down against that house, it will collapse into a heap of ruins."
verses.textEnNasb: But the one who has heard and has not acted accordingly is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation; and the river burst against it and it immediately collapsed, and the ruin of that house was great."
verses.textEn: <red>But the one who hears my words and does not put them into practice is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation. The moment the torrent struck that house, it collapsed and its destruction was complete.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣向群众讲完这一切话，就进了迦百农。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣向群众讲完这一切话，就进了迦百农。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对百姓讲完了这一切的话，就进了迦百农。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus had finished saying all this to the people who were listening, he entered Capernaum.
verses.textEnEsv: After he had finished all his sayings in the hearing of the people, he entered Capernaum.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when He concluded all His sayings in the hearing of the people, He entered Capernaum.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus had finished saying all this to the people, he returned to Capernaum.
verses.textEnNasb: When He had completed all His teaching in the hearing of the people, He went to Capernaum.
verses.textEn: When Jesus had finished saying all this to the people who were listening, he entered Capernaum.

verses.textZh: 有百夫长所重用的一个奴仆，病得快要死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有百夫长所重用的一个奴仆，病得快要死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个百夫长所宝贵的仆人害病，快要死了。
verses.textEnNiv: There a centurion’s servant, whom his master valued highly, was sick and about to die.
verses.textEnEsv: Now a centurion had a servant who was sick and at the point of death, who was highly valued by him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and ready to die.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time the highly valued slave of a Roman officer was sick and near death.
verses.textEnNasb: Now a centurion’s slave, who was highly regarded by him, was sick and about to die.
verses.textEn: There a centurion’s servant, whom his master valued highly, was sick and about to die.

verses.textZh: 百夫长听见耶稣的事，就打发犹太人中几个长老到他那里，求他去医治他的奴仆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 百夫长听见耶稣的事，就打发犹太人中几个长老到他那里，求他去医治他的奴仆。
verses.textZhCuv: 百夫长风闻耶稣的事，就托犹太人的几个长老去求耶稣来救他的仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: The centurion heard of Jesus and sent some elders of the Jews to him, asking him to come and heal his servant.
verses.textEnEsv: When the centurion heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and heal his servant.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when he heard about Jesus, he sent elders of the Jews to Him, pleading with Him to come and heal his servant.
verses.textEnNlt: When the officer heard about Jesus, he sent some respected Jewish elders to ask him to come and heal his slave.
verses.textEnNasb: When he heard about Jesus, he sent some Jewish elders to Him, asking Him to come and save the life of his slave.
verses.textEn: The centurion heard of Jesus and sent some elders of the Jews to him, asking him to come and heal his servant.

verses.textZh: 长老们就来见耶稣，恳切地求他说："你给他行这事，是他配得的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 长老们就来见耶稣，恳切地求他说："你给他行这事，是他配得的，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们到了耶稣那里，就切切地求他说：「你给他行这事是他所配得的；
verses.textEnNiv: When they came to Jesus, they pleaded earnestly with him, "This man deserves to have you do this,
verses.textEnEsv: And when they came to Jesus, they pleaded with him earnestly, saying, "He is worthy to have you do this for him,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they came to Jesus, they begged Him earnestly, saying that the one for whom He should do this was deserving,
verses.textEnNlt: So they earnestly begged Jesus to help the man. "If anyone deserves your help, he does," they said,
verses.textEnNasb: When they came to Jesus, they strongly urged Him, saying, "He is worthy for You to grant this to him;
verses.textEn: When they came to Jesus, they pleaded earnestly with him, "This man deserves to have you do this,

verses.textZh: 因为他爱我们的人民，给我们建造会堂。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他爱我们的人民，给我们建造会堂。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他爱我们的百姓，给我们建造会堂。」
verses.textEnNiv: because he loves our nation and has built our synagogue."
verses.textEnEsv: for he loves our nation, and he is the one who built us our synagogue."
verses.textEnNkjv: "for he loves our nation, and has built us a synagogue."
verses.textEnNlt: "for he loves the Jewish people and even built a synagogue for us."
verses.textEnNasb: for he loves our nation, and it was he who built us our synagogue."
verses.textEn: because he loves our nation and has built our synagogue."

verses.textZh: 耶稣就和他们同去。离那家不远的时候，百夫长派几个朋友来说："主啊，不必劳驾，因为你到舍下来，我实在不敢当，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣就和他们同去。离那家不远的时候，百夫长派几个朋友来说："主啊，不必劳驾，因为你到舍下来，我实在不敢当，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣就和他们同去。离那家不远，百夫长托几个朋友去见耶稣，对他说：「主啊！不要劳动；因你到我舍下，我不敢当。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jesus went with them. He was not far from the house when the centurion sent friends to say to him: "Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I do not deserve to have you come under my roof.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus went with them. When he was not far from the house, the centurion sent friends, saying to him, "Lord, do not trouble yourself, for I am not worthy to have you come under my roof.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus went with them. And when He was already not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to Him, saying to Him, "Lord, do not trouble Yourself, for I am not worthy that You should enter under my roof.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jesus went with them. But just before they arrived at the house, the officer sent some friends to say, "Lord, don’t trouble yourself by coming to my home, for I am not worthy of such an honor.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jesus started on His way with them; but already, when He was not yet far from the house, the centurion sent friends, saying to Him, " Lord, do not trouble Yourself further, for I am not worthy for You to enter under my roof;
verses.textEn: So Jesus went with them. He was not far from the house when the centurion sent friends to say to him: "Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I do not deserve to have you come under my roof.

verses.textZh: 我也觉得没有资格去见你；只要你说一句话，我的仆人就必好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也觉得没有资格去见你；只要你说一句话，我的仆人就必好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也自以为不配去见你，只要你说一句话，我的仆人就必好了。
verses.textEnNiv: That is why I did not even consider myself worthy to come to you. But say the word, and my servant will be healed.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I did not presume to come to you. But say the word, and let my servant be healed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I did not even think myself worthy to come to You. But say the word, and my servant will be healed.
verses.textEnNlt: I am not even worthy to come and meet you. Just say the word from where you are, and my servant will be healed.
verses.textEnNasb: for that reason I did not even consider myself worthy to come to You; but just say the word, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.textEn: That is why I did not even consider myself worthy to come to you. But say the word, and my servant will be healed.

verses.textZh: 因为我自己是在别人的权下，也有兵在我以下；我对这个说：‘去！’他就去；对另一个说：‘来！’他就来；对我的仆人说：‘作这个！’他就作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我自己是在别人的权下，也有兵在我以下；我对这个说：‘去！’他就去；对另一个说：‘来！’他就来；对我的仆人说：‘作这个！’他就作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我在人的权下，也有兵在我以下，对这个说：『去！』他就去；对那个说：『来！』他就来；对我的仆人说：『你做这事！』他就去做。」
verses.textEnNiv: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and that one, ‘Come,’ and he comes. I say to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it."
verses.textEnEsv: For I too am a man set under authority, with soldiers under me: and I say to one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I also am a man placed under authority, having soldiers under me. And I say to one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it."
verses.textEnNlt: I know this because I am under the authority of my superior officers, and I have authority over my soldiers. I only need to say, ‘Go,’ and they go, or ‘Come,’ and they come. And if I say to my slaves, ‘Do this,’ they do it."
verses.textEnNasb: For I also am a man placed under authority, with soldiers under myself; and I say to this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes, and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes, and to my slave, ‘Do this!’ and he does it."
verses.textEn: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and that one, ‘Come,’ and he comes. I say to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it."

verses.textZh: 耶稣听见这些话，就很惊奇，转身对跟随的众人说："<red>我告诉你们，这样的信心，我在以色列中从来没有见过。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣听见这些话，就很惊奇，转身对跟随的众人说："<red>我告诉你们，这样的信心，我在以色列中从来没有见过。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣听见这话，就希奇他，转身对跟随的众人说：「<red>我告诉你们，这么大的信心，就是在以色列中，我也没有遇见过。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed at him, and turning to the crowd following him, he said, <red>“I tell you, I have not found such great faith even in Israel.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turning to the crowd that followed him, said, "I tell you, not even in Israel have I found such faith."
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jesus heard these things, He marveled at him, and turned around and said to the crowd that followed Him, "I say to you, I have not found such great faith, not even in Israel!"
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed. Turning to the crowd that was following him, he said, "I tell you, I haven’t seen faith like this in all Israel!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Jesus heard this, He was amazed at him, and turned and said to the crowd that was following Him, "I say to you, not even in Israel have I found such great faith."
verses.textEn: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed at him, and turning to the crowd following him, he said, <red>“I tell you, I have not found such great faith even in Israel.”</red>

verses.textZh: 奉派的人回到家里，见那奴仆已经好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 奉派的人回到家里，见那奴仆已经好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那托来的人回到百夫长家里，看见仆人已经好了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the men who had been sent returned to the house and found the servant well.
verses.textEnEsv: And when those who had been sent returned to the house, they found the servant well.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those who were sent, returning to the house, found the servant well who had been sick.
verses.textEnNlt: And when the officer’s friends returned to his house, they found the slave completely healed.
verses.textEnNasb: And when those who had been sent returned to the house, they found the slave in good health.
verses.textEn: Then the men who had been sent returned to the house and found the servant well.

verses.textZh: 后来耶稣往拿因城去，与他同去的有门徒和一大群人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来耶稣往拿因城去，与他同去的有门徒和一大群人。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了不多时 ，耶稣往一座城去，这城名叫拿因，他的门徒和极多的人与他同行。
verses.textEnNiv: Soon afterward, Jesus went to a town called Nain, and his disciples and a large crowd went along with him.
verses.textEnEsv: Soon afterward he went to a town called Nain, and his disciples and a great crowd went with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, the day after, that He went into a city called Nain; and many of His disciples went with Him, and a large crowd.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon afterward Jesus went with his disciples to the village of Nain, and a large crowd followed him.
verses.textEnNasb: Soon afterward Jesus went to a city called Nain; and His disciples were going along with Him, accompanied by a large crowd.
verses.textEn: Soon afterward, Jesus went to a town called Nain, and his disciples and a large crowd went along with him.

verses.textZh: 他走近城门的时候，有人把一个死人抬出来，是个独生子，他母亲又是个寡妇。城里有一大群人陪着她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他走近城门的时候，有人把一个死人抬出来，是个独生子，他母亲又是个寡妇。城里有一大群人陪着她。
verses.textZhCuv: 将近城门，有一个死人被抬出来。这人是他母亲独生的儿子；他母亲又是寡妇。有城里的许多人同着寡妇送殡。
verses.textEnNiv: As he approached the town gate, a dead person was being carried out—the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. And a large crowd from the town was with her.
verses.textEnEsv: As he drew near to the gate of the town, behold, a man who had died was being carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow, and a considerable crowd from the town was with her.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He came near the gate of the city, behold, a dead man was being carried out, the only son of his mother; and she was a widow. And a large crowd from the city was with her.
verses.textEnNlt: A funeral procession was coming out as he approached the village gate. The young man who had died was a widow’s only son, and a large crowd from the village was with her.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as He approached the gate of the city, a dead man was being carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow; and a sizeable crowd from the city was with her.

verses.textEnNasb: "To what then shall I compare the people of this generation, and what are they like?
verses.textEn: Jesus went on to say, <red>“To what, then, can I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们好象小孩子坐在巿中心，彼此呼叫，说： ‘我们给你们吹笛子，你们却不跳舞； 我们唱哀歌，你们也不啼哭。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们好象小孩子坐在巿中心，彼此呼叫，说： ‘我们给你们吹笛子，你们却不跳舞； 我们唱哀歌，你们也不啼哭。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>好像孩童坐在街市上，彼此呼叫说： 我们向你们吹笛， 你们不跳舞； 我们向你们举哀， 你们不啼哭。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling out to each other: “ ‘Wepn played the pipe for you, andld you did not dance; weln sang a dirge, andld you did not cry.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling to one another, "‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not weep.’
verses.textEnNkjv: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling to one another, saying: ‘We played the flute for you, And you did not dance; We mourned to you, And you did not weep.’
verses.textEnNlt: They are like children playing a game in the public square. They complain to their friends, ‘We played wedding songs, and you didn’t dance, so we played funeral songs, and you didn’t weep.’
verses.textEnNasb: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a song of mourning, and you did not weep.’
verses.textEn: <red>They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling out to each other: “ ‘Wepn played the pipe for you, andld you did not dance; weln sang a dirge, andld you did not cry.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为施洗的约翰来了，不吃饭，不喝酒，你们说他是鬼附的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为施洗的约翰来了，不吃饭，不喝酒，你们说他是鬼附的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>施洗的约翰来，不吃饼，不喝酒，你们说他是被鬼附着的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Forp John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For John the Baptist has come eating no bread and drinking no wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’
verses.textEnNlt: For John the Baptist didn’t spend his time eating bread or drinking wine, and you say, ‘He’s possessed by a demon.’
verses.textEnNasb: For John the Baptist has come neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon!’
verses.textEn: <red>Forp John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人子来了，又吃又喝，你们说：‘你看，这人贪食好酒，与税吏和罪人为友。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人子来了，又吃又喝，你们说：‘你看，这人贪食好酒，与税吏和罪人为友。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人子来，也吃也喝，你们说他是贪食好酒的人，是税吏和罪人的朋友。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Here is a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Look at him! A glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
verses.textEnNkjv: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Look, a glutton and a winebibber, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
verses.textEnNlt: The Son of Man, on the other hand, feasts and drinks, and you say, ‘He’s a glutton and a drunkard, and a friend of tax collectors and other sinners!’
verses.textEnNasb: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a heavy drinker, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
verses.textEn: <red>The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Here is a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但神的智慧，借着他的儿女就证实是公义的了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但神的智慧，借着他的儿女就证实是公义的了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但智慧之子都以智慧为是。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But wisdom is proved right by all her children.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Yet wisdom is justified by all her children."
verses.textEnNkjv: But wisdom is justified by all her children."
verses.textEnNlt: But wisdom is shown to be right by the lives of those who follow it. "
verses.textEnNasb: And yet wisdom is vindicated by all her children."
verses.textEn: <red>But wisdom is proved right by all her children.”</red>

verses.textZh: 有一个法利赛人，请耶稣同他吃饭，他就到法利赛人家去赴席。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个法利赛人，请耶稣同他吃饭，他就到法利赛人家去赴席。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个法利赛人请耶稣和他吃饭；耶稣就到法利赛人家里去坐席。
verses.textEnNiv: When one of the Pharisees invited Jesus to have dinner with him, he went to the Pharisee’s house and reclined at the table.
verses.textEnEsv: One of the Pharisees asked him to eat with him, and he went into the Pharisee’s house and reclined at table.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one of the Pharisees asked Him to eat with him. And He went to the Pharisee’s house, and sat down to eat.
verses.textEnNlt: One of the Pharisees asked Jesus to have dinner with him, so Jesus went to his home and sat down to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: Now one of the Pharisees was requesting Him to eat with him, and He entered the Pharisee’s house and reclined at the table.
verses.textEn: When one of the Pharisees invited Jesus to have dinner with him, he went to the Pharisee’s house and reclined at the table.

verses.textZh: 那城里有一个女人，是个罪人，知道他在法利赛人家里吃饭，就拿着一瓶香膏，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那城里有一个女人，是个罪人，知道他在法利赛人家里吃饭，就拿着一瓶香膏，
verses.textZhCuv: 那城里有一个女人，是个罪人，知道耶稣在法利赛人家里坐席，就拿着盛香膏的玉瓶，
verses.textEnNiv: A woman in that town who lived a sinful life learned that Jesus was eating at the Pharisee’s house, so she came there with an alabaster jar of perfume.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, a woman of the city, who was a sinner, when she learned that he was reclining at table in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster flask of ointment,
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at the table in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster flask of fragrant oil,
verses.textEnNlt: When a certain immoral woman from that city heard he was eating there, she brought a beautiful alabaster jar filled with expensive perfume.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was a woman in the city who was a sinner; and when she learned that He was reclining at the table in the Pharisee’s house, she brought an alabaster vial of perfume,
verses.textEn: A woman in that town who lived a sinful life learned that Jesus was eating at the Pharisee’s house, so she came there with an alabaster jar of perfume.

verses.textZh: 站在耶稣背后，挨近他的脚哭，眼泪滴湿他的脚，又用自己的头发擦干，不住地吻他的脚，并且抹上香膏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 站在耶稣背后，挨近他的脚哭，眼泪滴湿他的脚，又用自己的头发擦干，不住地吻他的脚，并且抹上香膏。
verses.textZhCuv: 站在耶稣背后，挨着他的脚哭，眼泪湿了耶稣的脚，就用自己的头发擦干，又用嘴连连亲他的脚，把香膏抹上。
verses.textEnNiv: As she stood behind him at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears. Then she wiped them with her hair, kissed them and poured perfume on them.
verses.textEnEsv: and standing behind him at his feet, weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears and wiped them with the hair of her head and kissed his feet and anointed them with the ointment.
verses.textEnNkjv: and stood at His feet behind Him weeping; and she began to wash His feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head; and she kissed His feet and anointed them with the fragrant oil.
verses.textEnNlt: Then she knelt behind him at his feet, weeping. Her tears fell on his feet, and she wiped them off with her hair. Then she kept kissing his feet and putting perfume on them.
verses.textEnNasb: and standing behind Him at His feet, weeping, she began to wet His feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, and began kissing His feet and anointing them with the perfume.
verses.textEn: As she stood behind him at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears. Then she wiped them with her hair, kissed them and poured perfume on them.

verses.textZh: 请他的法利赛人看见了，心里说："这人若是先知，必定知道摸他的是谁，是怎样的女人，因为她是个罪人！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 请他的法利赛人看见了，心里说："这人若是先知，必定知道摸他的是谁，是怎样的女人，因为她是个罪人！"
verses.textZhCuv: 请耶稣的法利赛人看见这事，心里说：「这人若是先知，必知道摸他的是谁，是个怎样的女人；乃是个罪人。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the Pharisee who had invited him saw this, he said to himself, "If this man were a prophet, he would know who is touching him and what kind of woman she is—that she is a sinner."
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw this, he said to himself, "If this man were a prophet, he would have known who and what sort of woman this is who is touching him, for she is a sinner."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the Pharisee who had invited Him saw this, he spoke to himself, saying, "This Man, if He were a prophet, would know who and what manner of woman thisis who is touching Him, for she is a sinner."
verses.textEnNlt: When the Pharisee who had invited him saw this, he said to himself, "If this man were a prophet, he would know what kind of woman is touching him. She’s a sinner!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the Pharisee who had invited Him saw this, he said to himself, "If this Man were a prophet He would know who and what sort of person this woman is who is touching Him, that she is a sinner!"
verses.textEn: When the Pharisee who had invited him saw this, he said to himself, "If this man were a prophet, he would know who is touching him and what kind of woman she is—that she is a sinner."

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他说："<red>西门，我有句话要对你说。</red>"他说："<red>老师，请说。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他说："<red>西门，我有句话要对你说。</red>"他说："<red>老师，请说。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他说：「<red>西门！我有句话要对你说。</red>」西门说：「<red>夫子，请说。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered him, <red>“Simon, I have something to tell you.”</red> “Tell me, teacher,” he said.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus answering said to him, "Simon, I have something to say to you." And he answered, "Say it, Teacher."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus answered and said to him, "Simon, I have something to say to you." So he said, "Teacher, say it."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus answered his thoughts. "Simon," he said to the Pharisee, "I have something to say to you." "Go ahead, Teacher," Simon replied.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus responded and said to him, "Simon, I have something to say to you." And he replied, "Say it, Teacher."
verses.textEn: Jesus answered him, <red>“Simon, I have something to tell you.”</red> “Tell me, teacher,” he said.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："一个债主有两个债户，一个欠五百银币，一个欠五十。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："一个债主有两个债户，一个欠五百银币，一个欠五十。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「一个债主有两个人欠他的债；一个欠五十两银子，一个欠五两银子；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Twop people owed money to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "A certain moneylender had two debtors. One owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
verses.textEnNkjv: "There was a certain creditor who had two debtors. One owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus told him this story: "A man loaned money to two people—500 pieces of silver to one and 50 pieces to the other.
verses.textEnNasb: "A moneylender had two debtors: the one owed five hundred denarii, and the other, fifty.
verses.textEn: <red>“Twop people owed money to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们都无力偿还，债主就把两人豁免了。他们之中哪一个更爱他呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们都无力偿还，债主就把两人豁免了。他们之中哪一个更爱他呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为他们无力偿还，债主就开恩免了他们两个人的债。这两个人哪一个更爱他呢？」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Neither of them had the money to pay him back, so he forgave the debts of both. Now which of them will love him more?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When they could not pay, he cancelled the debt of both. Now which of them will love him more?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had nothing with which to repay, he freely forgave them both. Tell Me, therefore, which of them will love him more?"
verses.textEnNlt: But neither of them could repay him, so he kindly forgave them both, canceling their debts. Who do you suppose loved him more after that?"
verses.textEnNasb: When they were unable to repay, he canceled the debts of both. So which of them will love him more?"
verses.textEn: <red>Neither of them had the money to pay him back, so he forgave the debts of both. Now which of them will love him more?”</red>

verses.textZh: 西门回答："我想是那个多得恩免的。"耶稣说："<red>你判断对了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门回答："我想是那个多得恩免的。"耶稣说："<red>你判断对了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 西门回答说：「<red>我想是那多得恩免的人。</red>」耶稣说：「<red>你断的不错。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Simon replied, “I suppose the one who had the bigger debt forgiven.” <red>“Youp have judged correctly,”</red> Jesus said.
verses.textEnEsv: Simon answered, "The one, I suppose, for whom he cancelled the larger debt." And he said to him, "You have judged rightly."
verses.textEnNkjv: Simon answered and said, "I suppose the one whom he forgave more." And He said to him, "You have rightly judged."
verses.textEnNlt: Simon answered, "I suppose the one for whom he canceled the larger debt." "That’s right," Jesus said.
verses.textEnNasb: Simon answered and said, "I assume the one for whom he canceled the greater debt." And He said to him, "You have judged correctly."
verses.textEn: Simon replied, “I suppose the one who had the bigger debt forgiven.” <red>“Youp have judged correctly,”</red> Jesus said.

verses.textZh: 于是转身向着那女人，对西门说："<red>你看见这女人吗？我进了你的家，你没有给我水洗脚，但这女人用眼泪湿了我的脚，用头发擦干。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是转身向着那女人，对西门说："<red>你看见这女人吗？我进了你的家，你没有给我水洗脚，但这女人用眼泪湿了我的脚，用头发擦干。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>于是转过来向着那女人，便对西门说：「你看见这女人吗？我进了你的家，你没有给我水洗脚；但这女人用眼泪湿了我的脚，用头发擦干。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then he turned toward the woman and said to Simon, <red>“Do you see this woman? I came into your house. You did not give me any water for my feet, but she wet my feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then turning toward the woman he said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I entered your house; you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He turned to the woman and said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I entered your house; you gave Me no water for My feet, but she has washed My feet with her tears and wiped them with the hair of her head.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he turned to the woman and said to Simon, "Look at this woman kneeling here. When I entered your home, you didn’t offer me water to wash the dust from my feet, but she has washed them with her tears and wiped them with her hair.
verses.textEnNasb: And turning toward the woman, He said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I entered your house; you gave Me no water for My feet, but she has wet My feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.
verses.textEn: Then he turned toward the woman and said to Simon, <red>“Do you see this woman? I came into your house. You did not give me any water for my feet, but she wet my feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你没有和我亲吻；但这女人，自从我进来，就不住地亲我的脚。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你没有和我亲吻；但这女人，自从我进来，就不住地亲我的脚。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你没有与我亲嘴；但这女人从我进来的时候就不住地用嘴亲我的脚。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You did not give me a kiss, but this woman, from the time I entered, has not stopped kissing my feet.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You gave me no kiss, but from the time I came in she has not ceased to kiss my feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: You gave Me no kiss, but this woman has not ceased to kiss My feet since the time I came in.
verses.textEnNlt: You didn’t greet me with a kiss, but from the time I first came in, she has not stopped kissing my feet.
verses.textEnNasb: You gave Me no kiss; but she has not stopped kissing My feet since the time I came in.
verses.textEn: <red>You did not give me a kiss, but this woman, from the time I entered, has not stopped kissing my feet.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你没有用油抹我的头；但这女人用香膏抹我的脚。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你没有用油抹我的头；但这女人用香膏抹我的脚。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你没有用油抹我的头；但这女人用香膏抹我的脚。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You did not put oil on my head, but she has poured perfume on my feet.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You did not anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.
verses.textEnNkjv: You did not anoint My head with oil, but this woman has anointed My feet with fragrant oil.
verses.textEnNlt: You neglected the courtesy of olive oil to anoint my head, but she has anointed my feet with rare perfume.
verses.textEnNasb: You did not anoint My head with oil, but she anointed My feet with perfume.
verses.textEn: <red>You did not put oil on my head, but she has poured perfume on my feet.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以我告诉你，她许多罪都蒙赦免了，因为她的爱多；那赦免少的，爱就少。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以我告诉你，她许多罪都蒙赦免了，因为她的爱多；那赦免少的，爱就少。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以我告诉你，她许多的罪都赦免了，因为她的爱多；但那赦免少的，他的爱就少。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Therefore, I tell you, her many sins have been forgiven—as her great love has shown. But whoever has been forgiven little loves little.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven—for she loved much. But he who is forgiven little, loves little."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I say to you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little."
verses.textEnNlt: "I tell you, her sins—and they are many—have been forgiven, so she has shown me much love. But a person who is forgiven little shows only little love."
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason I say to you, her sins, which are many, have been forgiven, for she loved much; but the one who is forgiven little, loves little."
verses.textEn: <red>Therefore, I tell you, her many sins have been forgiven—as her great love has shown. But whoever has been forgiven little loves little.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣就对她说："<red>你的罪赦免了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣就对她说："<red>你的罪赦免了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是对那女人说：「<red>你的罪赦免了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to her, <red>“Your sins are forgiven.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to her, "Your sins are forgiven."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to her, "Your sins are forgiven."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said to the woman, "Your sins are forgiven."
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to her, "Your sins have been forgiven."
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to her, <red>“Your sins are forgiven.”</red>

verses.textZh: 跟他一起吃饭的人心里说："这是谁，竟然赦罪呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 跟他一起吃饭的人心里说："这是谁，竟然赦罪呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 同席的人心里说：「这是什么人，竟赦免人的罪呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The other guests began to say among themselves, "Who is this who even forgives sins?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then those who were at table with him began to say among themselves, "Who is this, who even forgives sins?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And those who sat at the table with Him began to say to themselves, "Who is this who even forgives sins?"
verses.textEnNlt: The men at the table said among themselves, "Who is this man, that he goes around forgiving sins?"
verses.textEnNasb: And then those who were reclining at the table with Him began saying to themselves, "Who is this Man who even forgives sins?"
verses.textEn: The other guests began to say among themselves, "Who is this who even forgives sins?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣对那女人说："<red>你的信救了你，平安地去吧！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对那女人说："<red>你的信救了你，平安地去吧！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对那女人说：「<red>你的信救了你；平平安安回去吧！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to the woman, <red>“Your faith has saved you; go in peace.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you; go in peace."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you. Go in peace."
verses.textEnNlt: And Jesus said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you; go in peace."
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you; go in peace."
verses.textEn: Jesus said to the woman, <red>“Your faith has saved you; go in peace.”</red>

verses.textZh: 不久，耶稣周游各城各村讲道，宣扬神的国的福音，和他在一起的有十二个门徒，
verses.textZhCnvs: 不久，耶稣周游各城各村讲道，宣扬神的国的福音，和他在一起的有十二个门徒，
verses.textZhCuv: 过了不多日，耶稣周游各城各乡传道，宣讲神国的福音。和他同去的有十二个门徒，
verses.textEnNiv: After this, Jesus traveled about from one town and village to another, proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God. The Twelve were with him,
verses.textEnEsv: Soon afterward he went on through cities and villages, proclaiming and bringing the good news of the kingdom of God. And the twelve were with him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, afterward, that He went through every city and village, preaching and bringing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God. And the twelve were with Him,
verses.textEnNlt: Soon afterward Jesus began a tour of the nearby towns and villages, preaching and announcing the Good News about the Kingdom of God. He took his twelve disciples with him,
verses.textEnNasb: Soon afterward, Jesus began going around from one city and village to another, proclaiming and preaching the kingdom of God. The twelve were with Him,
verses.textEn: After this, Jesus traveled about from one town and village to another, proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God. The Twelve were with him,

verses.textZh: 还有几个蒙了医治、脱离污鬼与疾病的妇女，其中有称为抹大拉的马利亚，曾有七个鬼从她身上赶出来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有几个蒙了医治、脱离污鬼与疾病的妇女，其中有称为抹大拉的马利亚，曾有七个鬼从她身上赶出来；
verses.textZhCuv: 还有被恶鬼所附、被疾病所累、已经治好的几个妇女，内中有称为抹大拉的马利亚（曾有七个鬼从她身上赶出来），
verses.textEnNiv: and also some women who had been cured of evil spirits and diseases: Mary (called Magdalene) from whom seven demons had come out;
verses.textEnEsv: and also some women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary, called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,
verses.textEnNkjv: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities—Mary called Magdalene, out of whom had come seven demons,
verses.textEnNlt: along with some women who had been cured of evil spirits and diseases. Among them were Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons;
verses.textEnNasb: and also some women who had been healed of evil spirits and sicknesses: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,
verses.textEn: and also some women who had been cured of evil spirits and diseases: Mary (called Magdalene) from whom seven demons had come out;

verses.textZh: 有希律的管家古撒的妻子约亚拿，又有苏珊娜，和许多别的妇女，她们都用自己的财物供给耶稣和门徒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有希律的管家古撒的妻子约亚拿，又有苏珊娜，和许多别的妇女，她们都用自己的财物供给耶稣和门徒。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有希律的家宰苦撒的妻子约亚拿，并苏撒拿，和好些别的妇女，都是用自己的财物供给耶稣和门徒。
verses.textEnNiv: Joanna the wife of Chuza, the manager of Herod’s household; Susanna; and many others. These women were helping to support them out of their own means.
verses.textEnEsv: and Joanna, the wife of Chuza, Herod’s household manager, and Susanna, and many others, who provided for them out of their means.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Joanna the wife of Chuza, Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others who provided for Him from their substance.
verses.textEnNlt: Joanna, the wife of Chuza, Herod’s business manager; Susanna; and many others who were contributing from their own resources to support Jesus and his disciples.
verses.textEnNasb: and Joanna the wife of Chuza, Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others who were contributing to their support out of their private means.
verses.textEn: Joanna the wife of Chuza, the manager of Herod’s household; Susanna; and many others. These women were helping to support them out of their own means.

verses.textZh: 当时有许多人聚在一起，还有人从各城来到耶稣那里，他就用比喻说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时有许多人聚在一起，还有人从各城来到耶稣那里，他就用比喻说：
verses.textZhCuv: 当许多人聚集、又有人从各城里出来见耶稣的时候，耶稣就用比喻说：
verses.textEnNiv: While a large crowd was gathering and people were coming to Jesus from town after town, he told this parable:
verses.textEnEsv: And when a great crowd was gathering and people from town after town came to him, he said in a parable,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when a great multitude had gathered, and they had come to Him from every city, He spoke by a parable:
verses.textEnNlt: One day Jesus told a story in the form of a parable to a large crowd that had gathered from many towns to hear him:
verses.textEnNasb: Now when a large crowd was coming together, and those from the various cities were journeying to Him, He spoke by way of a parable:
verses.textEn: While a large crowd was gathering and people were coming to Jesus from town after town, he told this parable:

verses.textZh: <red>"有一个撒种的出去撒种，撒的时候，有的落在路旁，被人践踏，或给空中的小鸟吃掉。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"有一个撒种的出去撒种，撒的时候，有的落在路旁，被人践踏，或给空中的小鸟吃掉。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「有一个撒种的出去撒种。撒的时候，有落在路旁的，被人践踏，天上的飞鸟又来吃尽了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“A farmer went out to sow his seed. As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path; it was trampled on, and the birds ate it up.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "A sower went out to sow his seed. And as he sowed, some fell along the path and was trampled underfoot, and the birds of the air devoured it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "A sower went out to sow his seed. And as he sowed, some fell by the wayside; and it was trampled down, and the birds of the air devoured it.
verses.textEnNlt: "A farmer went out to plant his seed. As he scattered it across his field, some seed fell on a footpath, where it was stepped on, and the birds ate it.
verses.textEnNasb: "The sower went out to sow his seed; and as he sowed, some fell beside the road, and it was trampled underfoot, and the birds of the sky ate it up.
verses.textEn: <red>“A farmer went out to sow his seed. As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path; it was trampled on, and the birds ate it up.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有的落在石头地上，一长出来就枯萎了，因为得不着滋润。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有的落在石头地上，一长出来就枯萎了，因为得不着滋润。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>有落在磐石上的，一出来就枯干了，因为得不着滋润。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Some fell on rocky ground, and when it came up, the plants withered because they had no moisture.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And some fell on the rock, and as it grew up, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
verses.textEnNkjv: Some fell on rock; and as soon as it sprang up, it withered away because it lacked moisture.
verses.textEnNlt: Other seed fell among rocks. It began to grow, but the plant soon wilted and died for lack of moisture.
verses.textEnNasb: Other seed fell on rocky soil, and when it came up, it withered away because it had no moisture.
verses.textEn: <red>Some fell on rocky ground, and when it came up, the plants withered because they had no moisture.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有的落在荆棘丛中，荆棘也一齐生长，把它挤住了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有的落在荆棘丛中，荆棘也一齐生长，把它挤住了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>有落在荆棘里的，荆棘一同生长，把它挤住了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up with it and choked the plants.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up with it and choked it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns sprang up with it and choked it.
verses.textEnNlt: Other seed fell among thorns that grew up with it and choked out the tender plants.
verses.textEnNasb: Other seed fell among the thorns; and the thorns grew up with it and choked it out.
verses.textEn: <red>Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up with it and choked the plants.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有的落在好土里，就生长起来，结出百倍的果实。"他说了这些话，就大声说："有耳可听的，就应当听！"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有的落在好土里，就生长起来，结出百倍的果实。"他说了这些话，就大声说："有耳可听的，就应当听！"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 又有落在好土里的，生长起来，结实百倍。」耶稣说了这些话，就大声说：「<red>有耳可听的，就应当听！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Still other seed fell on good soil. It came up and yielded a crop, a hundred times more than was sown.”</red> When he said this, he called out, <red>“Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And some fell into good soil and grew and yielded a hundredfold." As he said these things, he called out, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear."
verses.textEnNkjv: But others fell on good ground, sprang up, and yielded a crop a hundredfold." When He had said these things He cried, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear!"
verses.textEnNlt: Still other seed fell on fertile soil. This seed grew and produced a crop that was a hundred times as much as had been planted!" When he had said this, he called out, "Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand."
verses.textEnNasb: And yet other seed fell into the good soil, and grew up, and produced a crop a hundred times as much." As He said these things, He would call out, "The one who has ears to hear, let him hear."
verses.textEn: <red>Still other seed fell on good soil. It came up and yielded a crop, a hundred times more than was sown.”</red> When he said this, he called out, <red>“Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒问他这比喻是甚么意思。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒问他这比喻是甚么意思。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒问耶稣说：「这比喻是什么意思呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: His disciples asked him what this parable meant.
verses.textEnEsv: And when his disciples asked him what this parable meant,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then His disciples asked Him, saying, "What does this parable mean?"
verses.textEnNlt: His disciples asked him what this parable meant.
verses.textEnNasb: Now His disciples began asking Him what this parable meant.
verses.textEn: His disciples asked him what this parable meant.

verses.textZh: 他说："<red>神的国的奥秘，只给你们知道，对别人就用比喻，叫他们看却看不见，听却听不明白。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："<red>神的国的奥秘，只给你们知道，对别人就用比喻，叫他们看却看不见，听却听不明白。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「<red>神国的奥秘只叫你们知道；至于别人，就用比喻，叫他们看也看不见，听也听不明。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He said, <red>“The knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to others I speak in parables, so that, “ ‘thoughpn seeing, they may not see; thoughld hearing, they may not understand.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: he said, "To you it has been given to know the secrets of the kingdom of God, but for others they are in parables, so that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "To you it has been given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘Seeing they may not see, And hearing they may not understand.’
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "You are permitted to understand the secrets of the Kingdom of God. But I use parables to teach the others so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled: ‘When they look, they won’t really see. When they hear, they won’t understand.’
verses.textEnNasb: And He said, "To you it has been granted to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God, but to the rest they are told in parables, so that while seeing they may not see, and while hearing they may not understand.
verses.textEn: He said, <red>“The knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to others I speak in parables, so that, “ ‘thoughpn seeing, they may not see; thoughld hearing, they may not understand.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"这比喻是说，种子是神的道，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"这比喻是说，种子是神的道，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「这比喻乃是这样：种子就是神的道。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thisp is the meaning of the parable: The seed is the word of God.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is the meaning of the parable: The seed is God’s word.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now this is the parable: the seed is the word of God.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thisp is the meaning of the parable: The seed is the word of God.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那落在路旁的，就是人听了，魔鬼随即来到，从他们心里把道夺去，恐怕他们相信就得救了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那落在路旁的，就是人听了，魔鬼随即来到，从他们心里把道夺去，恐怕他们相信就得救了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那些在路旁的，就是人听了道，随后魔鬼来，从他们心里把道夺去，恐怕他们信了得救。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Those along the path are the ones who hear, and then the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The ones along the path are those who have heard; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those by the wayside are the ones who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
verses.textEnNlt: The seeds that fell on the footpath represent those who hear the message, only to have the devil come and take it away from their hearts and prevent them from believing and being saved.
verses.textEnNasb: And those beside the road are the ones who have heard, then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, so that they will not believe and be saved.
verses.textEn: <red>Those along the path are the ones who hear, and then the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那落在石头地上的，就是人听了，欢欢喜喜地接受，但是没有根，不过是暂时相信，一旦遭遇试炼，就倒退了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那落在石头地上的，就是人听了，欢欢喜喜地接受，但是没有根，不过是暂时相信，一旦遭遇试炼，就倒退了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那些在磐石上的，就是人听道，欢喜领受，但心中没有根，不过暂时相信，及至遇见试炼就退后了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Those on the rocky ground are the ones who receive the word with joy when they hear it, but they have no root. They believe for a while, but in the time of testing they fall away.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the ones on the rock are those who, when they hear the word, receive it with joy. But these have no root; they believe for a while, and in time of testing fall away.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the ones on the rock are those who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, who believe for a while and in time of temptation fall away.
verses.textEnNlt: The seeds on the rocky soil represent those who hear the message and receive it with joy. But since they don’t have deep roots, they believe for a while, then they fall away when they face temptation.
verses.textEnNasb: Those on the rocky soil are the ones who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and yet these do not have a firm root; they believe for a while, and in a time of temptation they fall away.
verses.textEn: <red>Those on the rocky ground are the ones who receive the word with joy when they hear it, but they have no root. They believe for a while, but in the time of testing they fall away.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那落在荆棘里的，就是人听了，走开以后，被今世的忧虑、财富和宴乐挤住了，结不出成熟的子粒来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那落在荆棘里的，就是人听了，走开以后，被今世的忧虑、财富和宴乐挤住了，结不出成熟的子粒来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那落在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，走开以后，被今生的思虑、钱财、宴乐挤住了，便结不出成熟的子粒来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The seed that fell among thorns stands for those who hear, but as they go on their way they are choked by life’s worries, riches and pleasures, and they do not mature.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And as for what fell among the thorns, they are those who hear, but as they go on their way they are choked by the cares and riches and pleasures of life, and their fruit does not mature.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the ones that fell among thorns are those who, when they have heard, go out and are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life, and bring no fruit to maturity.
verses.textEnNlt: The seeds that fell among the thorns represent those who hear the message, but all too quickly the message is crowded out by the cares and riches and pleasures of this life. And so they never grow into maturity.
verses.textEnNasb: And the seed which fell among the thorns, these are the ones who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked by worries, riches, and pleasures of this life, and they bring no fruit to maturity.
verses.textEn: <red>The seed that fell among thorns stands for those who hear, but as they go on their way they are choked by life’s worries, riches and pleasures, and they do not mature.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但那落在好土里的，就是人用诚实良善的心来听，把道持守住，忍耐着结出果实。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但那落在好土里的，就是人用诚实良善的心来听，把道持守住，忍耐着结出果实。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那落在好土里的，就是人听了道，持守在诚实善良的心里，并且忍耐着结实。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But the seed on good soil stands for those with a noble and good heart, who hear the word, retain it, and by persevering produce a crop.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: As for that in the good soil, they are those who, hearing the word, hold it fast in an honest and good heart, and bear fruit with patience.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the ones that fell on the good ground are those who, having heard the word with a noble and good heart, keep it and bear fruit with patience.
verses.textEnNlt: And the seeds that fell on the good soil represent honest, good-hearted people who hear God’s word, cling to it, and patiently produce a huge harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: But the seed in the good soil, these are the ones who have heard the word with a good and virtuous heart, and hold it firmly, and produce fruit with perseverance.
verses.textEn: <red>But the seed on good soil stands for those with a noble and good heart, who hear the word, retain it, and by persevering produce a crop.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"没有人点灯用器皿盖上，或放在床底下，而是放在灯台上，叫进来的人都看得见光。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"没有人点灯用器皿盖上，或放在床底下，而是放在灯台上，叫进来的人都看得见光。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「没有人点灯用器皿盖上，或放在床底下，乃是放在灯台上，叫进来的人看见亮光。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Nop one lights a lamp and hides it in a clay jar or puts it under a bed. Instead, they put it on a stand, so that those who come in can see the light.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "No one after lighting a lamp covers it with a jar or puts it under a bed, but puts it on a stand, so that those who enter may see the light.
verses.textEnNkjv: "No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a vessel or puts it under a bed, but sets it on a lampstand, that those who enter may see the light.
verses.textEnNlt: "No one lights a lamp and then covers it with a bowl or hides it under a bed. A lamp is placed on a stand, where its light can be seen by all who enter the house.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now no one lights a lamp and covers it over with a container, or puts it under a bed; but he puts it on a lampstand so that those who come in may see the light.
verses.textEn: <red>“Nop one lights a lamp and hides it in a clay jar or puts it under a bed. Instead, they put it on a stand, so that those who come in can see the light.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为没有甚么隐藏的事不被显明，也没有甚么掩盖的事不被人知道而暴露出来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为没有甚么隐藏的事不被显明，也没有甚么掩盖的事不被人知道而暴露出来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为掩藏的事没有不显出来的；隐瞒的事没有不露出来被人知道的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be known or brought out into the open.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For nothing is hidden that will not be made manifest, nor is anything secret that will not be known and come to light.
verses.textEnNkjv: For nothing is secret that will not be revealed, nor anything hidden that will not be known and come to light.
verses.textEnNlt: For all that is secret will eventually be brought into the open, and everything that is concealed will be brought to light and made known to all.
verses.textEnNasb: For nothing is concealed that will not become evident, nor anything hidden that will not be known and come to light.
verses.textEn: <red>For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be known or brought out into the open.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以你们应当留心怎样听，因为凡是有的，还要给他；凡是没有的，连他自以为有的，也要拿去。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以你们应当留心怎样听，因为凡是有的，还要给他；凡是没有的，连他自以为有的，也要拿去。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，你们应当小心怎样听；因为凡有的，还要加给他；凡没有的，连他自以为有的，也要夺去。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Therefore consider carefully how you listen. Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what they think they have will be taken from them.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Take care then how you hear, for to the one who has, more will be given, and from the one who has not, even what he thinks that he has will be taken away."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore take heed how you hear. For whoever has, to him more will be given; and whoever does not have, even what he seems to have will be taken from him."
verses.textEnNlt: "So pay attention to how you hear. To those who listen to my teaching, more understanding will be given. But for those who are not listening, even what they think they understand will be taken away from them."
verses.textEnNasb: So take care how you listen; for whoever has, to him more will be given; and whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has will be taken away from him."
verses.textEn: <red>Therefore consider carefully how you listen. Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what they think they have will be taken from them.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣的母亲和弟弟来到他那里，因为人多，不能到他跟前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣的母亲和弟弟来到他那里，因为人多，不能到他跟前。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣的母亲和他弟兄来了，因为人多，不得到他跟前。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Jesus’ mother and brothers came to see him, but they were not able to get near him because of the crowd.
verses.textEnEsv: Then his mother and his brothers came to him, but they could not reach him because of the crowd.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then His mother and brothers came to Him, and could not approach Him because of the crowd.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers came to see him, but they couldn’t get to him because of the crowd.
verses.textEnNasb: Now His mother and brothers came to Him, and they were unable to get to Him because of the crowd.
verses.textEn: Now Jesus’ mother and brothers came to see him, but they were not able to get near him because of the crowd.

verses.textZh: 有人转告耶稣："你母亲和弟弟站在外面要见你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人转告耶稣："你母亲和弟弟站在外面要见你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉他说：「你母亲和你弟兄站在外边，要见你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Someone told him, "Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to see you."
verses.textEnEsv: And he was told, "Your mother and your brothers are standing outside, desiring to see you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it was told Him bysome, who said, "Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, desiring to see You."
verses.textEnNlt: Someone told Jesus, "Your mother and your brothers are standing outside, and they want to see you."
verses.textEnNasb: And it was reported to Him, "Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside, wishing to see You."
verses.textEn: Someone told him, "Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to see you."

verses.textZh: 他回答他们："<red>听了神的道而遵行的人，才是我的母亲，我的弟兄。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答他们："<red>听了神的道而遵行的人，才是我的母亲，我的弟兄。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回答说：「<red>听了神之道而遵行的人就是我的母亲，我的弟兄了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, <red>“My mother and brothers are those who hear God’s word and put it into practice.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he answered them, "My mother and my brothers are those who hear the word of God and do it."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He answered and said to them, "My mother and My brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "My mother and my brothers are all those who hear God’s word and obey it."
verses.textEnNasb: But He answered and said to them, "My mother and My brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it."
verses.textEn: He replied, <red>“My mother and brothers are those who hear God’s word and put it into practice.”</red>

verses.textZh: 有一天，耶稣和门徒上了船，他对他们说："<red>我们渡到海那边去吧。</red>"他们就开了船。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，耶稣和门徒上了船，他对他们说："<red>我们渡到海那边去吧。</red>"他们就开了船。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一天，耶稣和门徒上了船，对门徒说：「<red>我们可以渡到湖那边去。</red>」他们就开了船。
verses.textEnNiv: One day Jesus said to his disciples, <red>“Let us go over to the other side of the lake.”</red> So they got into a boat and set out.
verses.textEnEsv: One day he got into a boat with his disciples, and he said to them, "Let us go across to the other side of the lake." So they set out,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, on a certain day, that He got into a boat with His disciples. And He said to them, "Let us cross over to the other side of the lake." And they launched out.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Jesus said to his disciples, "Let’s cross to the other side of the lake." So they got into a boat and started out.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on one of those days Jesus and His disciples got into a boat, and He said to them, "Let’s cross over to the other side of the lake." So they launched out.
verses.textEn: One day Jesus said to his disciples, <red>“Let us go over to the other side of the lake.”</red> So they got into a boat and set out.

verses.textZh: 船行的时候，他睡着了。海上忽然起了狂风，他们全身湿透，非常危险。
verses.textZhCnvs: 船行的时候，他睡着了。海上忽然起了狂风，他们全身湿透，非常危险。
verses.textZhCuv: 正行的时候，耶稣睡着了。湖上忽然起了暴风，船将满了水，甚是危险。
verses.textEnNiv: As they sailed, he fell asleep. A squall came down on the lake, so that the boat was being swamped, and they were in great danger.
verses.textEnEsv: and as they sailed he fell asleep. And a windstorm came down on the lake, and they were filling with water and were in danger.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as they sailed He fell asleep. And a windstorm came down on the lake, and they were filling withwater, and were in jeopardy.
verses.textEnNlt: As they sailed across, Jesus settled down for a nap. But soon a fierce storm came down on the lake. The boat was filling with water, and they were in real danger.
verses.textEnNasb: But as they were sailing along He fell asleep; and a fierce gale of wind descended on the lake, and they began to be swamped and to be in danger.
verses.textEn: As they sailed, he fell asleep. A squall came down on the lake, so that the boat was being swamped, and they were in great danger.

verses.textZh: 门徒来叫醒耶稣，说："主啊！主啊！我们没命了！"他醒过来，斥责风浪，风浪就止息、平静了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒来叫醒耶稣，说："主啊！主啊！我们没命了！"他醒过来，斥责风浪，风浪就止息、平静了。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒来叫醒了他，说：「夫子！夫子！我们丧命啦！」耶稣醒了，斥责那狂风大浪；风浪就止住，平静了。
verses.textEnNiv: The disciples went and woke him, saying, "Master, Master, we’re going to drown!" He got up and rebuked the wind and the raging waters; the storm subsided, and all was calm.
verses.textEnEsv: And they went and woke him, saying, "Master, Master, we are perishing!" And he awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging waves, and they ceased, and there was a calm.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they came to Him and awoke Him, saying, "Master, Master, we are perishing!" Then He arose and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water. And they ceased, and there was a calm.
verses.textEnNlt: The disciples went and woke him up, shouting, "Master, Master, we’re going to drown!" When Jesus woke up, he rebuked the wind and the raging waves. Suddenly the storm stopped and all was calm.
verses.textEnNasb: They came up to Jesus and woke Him, saying, "Master, Master, we are perishing!" And He got up and rebuked the wind and the surging waves, and they stopped, and it became calm.
verses.textEn: The disciples went and woke him, saying, "Master, Master, we’re going to drown!" He got up and rebuked the wind and the raging waters; the storm subsided, and all was calm.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他们说："你们的信心在哪里？"他们又惧怕、又希奇，彼此说："这到底是谁？他吩咐风浪，连风浪也听从他。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他们说："你们的信心在哪里？"他们又惧怕、又希奇，彼此说："这到底是谁？他吩咐风浪，连风浪也听从他。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他们说：「<red>你们的信心在哪里呢？</red>」他们又惧怕又希奇，彼此说：「<red>这到底是谁？他吩咐风和水，连风和水也听从他了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Where is your faith?”</red> he asked his disciples. In fear and amazement they asked one another, “Who is this? He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him.”
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "Where is your faith?" And they were afraid, and they marveled, saying to one another, "Who then is this, that he commands even winds and water, and they obey him?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But He said to them, "Where is your faith?" And they were afraid, and marveled, saying to one another, "Who can this be? For He commands even the winds and water, and they obey Him!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then he asked them, "Where is your faith?" The disciples were terrified and amazed. "Who is this man?" they asked each other. "When he gives a command, even the wind and waves obey him!"
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "Where is your faith?" But they were fearful and amazed, saying to one another, "Who then is this, that He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey Him?"
verses.textEn: <red>“Where is your faith?”</red> he asked his disciples. In fear and amazement they asked one another, “Who is this? He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him.”

verses.textZh: 船到了格拉森人的地区，正在加利利对面，
verses.textZhCnvs: 船到了格拉森人的地区，正在加利利对面，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们到了格拉森 人的地方，就是加利利的对面。
verses.textEnNiv: They sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, which is across the lake from Galilee.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they sailed to the country of the Gerasenes, which is opposite Galilee.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they sailed to the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.
verses.textEnNlt: So they arrived in the region of the Gerasenes, across the lake from Galilee.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they sailed to the country of the Gerasenes, which is opposite Galilee.
verses.textEn: They sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, which is across the lake from Galilee.

verses.textZh: 耶稣一上岸，就有城里一个被鬼附着的人，迎面而来。这人已经很久不穿衣服，不住在家里，只住在坟墓里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣一上岸，就有城里一个被鬼附着的人，迎面而来。这人已经很久不穿衣服，不住在家里，只住在坟墓里。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣上了岸，就有城里一个被鬼附着的人迎面而来。这个人许久不穿衣服，不住房子，只住在坟茔里。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus stepped ashore, he was met by a demon-possessed man from the town. For a long time this man had not worn clothes or lived in a house, but had lived in the tombs.
verses.textEnEsv: When Jesus had stepped out on land, there met him a man from the city who had demons. For a long time he had worn no clothes, and he had not lived in a house but among the tombs.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He stepped out on the land, there met Him a certain man from the city who had demons for a long time. And he wore no clothes, nor did he live in a house but in the tombs.
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus was climbing out of the boat, a man who was possessed by demons came out to meet him. For a long time he had been homeless and naked, living in the tombs outside the town.
verses.textEnNasb: And when He stepped out onto the land, a man from the city met Him who was possessed with demons; and he had not put on clothing for a long time and was not living in a house, but among the tombs.
verses.textEn: When Jesus stepped ashore, he was met by a demon-possessed man from the town. For a long time this man had not worn clothes or lived in a house, but had lived in the tombs.

verses.textZh: 他一见耶稣，就俯伏喊叫，大声说："至高神的儿子耶稣，我跟你有甚么关系呢？求你不要使我受苦。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一见耶稣，就俯伏喊叫，大声说："至高神的儿子耶稣，我跟你有甚么关系呢？求你不要使我受苦。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他见了耶稣，就俯伏在他面前，大声喊叫，说：「至高神的儿子耶稣，我与你有什么相干？求你不要叫我受苦！」
verses.textEnNiv: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell at his feet, shouting at the top of his voice, "What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torture me!"
verses.textEnEsv: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him and said with a loud voice, "What have you to do with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg you, do not torment me."
verses.textEnNkjv: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, fell down before Him, and with a loud voice said, "What have I to do with You, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You, do not torment me!"
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as he saw Jesus, he shrieked and fell down in front of him. Then he screamed, "Why are you interfering with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? Please, I beg you, don’t torture me!"
verses.textEnNasb: And seeing Jesus, he cried out and fell down before Him, and said with a loud voice, " What business do You have with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You, do not torment me!"
verses.textEn: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell at his feet, shouting at the top of his voice, "What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torture me!"

verses.textZh: 因为耶稣已经吩咐这污灵从那人身上出来。原来这污灵屡次抓住那人；那人被铁链和脚炼捆锁，而且有人看管，他竟挣断锁炼，被鬼赶入旷野。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶稣已经吩咐这污灵从那人身上出来。原来这污灵屡次抓住那人；那人被铁链和脚炼捆锁，而且有人看管，他竟挣断锁炼，被鬼赶入旷野。
verses.textZhCuv: 是因耶稣曾吩咐污鬼从那人身上出来。原来这鬼屡次抓住他；他常被人看守，又被铁链和脚镣捆锁，他竟把锁链挣断，被鬼赶到旷野去。
verses.textEnNiv: For Jesus had commanded the impure spirit to come out of the man. Many times it had seized him, and though he was chained hand and foot and kept under guard, he had broken his chains and had been driven by the demon into solitary places.
verses.textEnEsv: For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. (For many a time it had seized him. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and shackles, but he would break the bonds and be driven by the demon into the desert.)
verses.textEnNkjv: For He had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For it had often seized him, and he was kept under guard, bound with chains and shackles; and he broke the bonds and was driven by the demon into the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: For Jesus had already commanded the evil spirit to come out of him. This spirit had often taken control of the man. Even when he was placed under guard and put in chains and shackles, he simply broke them and rushed out into the wilderness, completely under the demon’s power.
verses.textEnNasb: For He had already commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For it had seized him many times; and he was bound with chains and shackles and kept under guard, and yet he would break the restraints and be driven by the demon into the desert.
verses.textEn: For Jesus had commanded the impure spirit to come out of the man. Many times it had seized him, and though he was chained hand and foot and kept under guard, he had broken his chains and had been driven by the demon into solitary places.

verses.textZh: 耶稣问他："你叫甚么名字？"他说："<red>群。</red>"因为进到那人里面的鬼很多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣问他："你叫甚么名字？"他说："<red>群。</red>"因为进到那人里面的鬼很多。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣问他说：「<red>你名叫什么？</red>」他说：「<red>我名叫『群』</red>」；这是因为附着他的鬼多。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus asked him, <red>“What is your name?”</red> “Legion,” he replied, because many demons had gone into him.
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus then asked him, "What is your name?" And he said, "Legion," for many demons had entered him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus asked him, saying, "What is your name?" And he said, "Legion," because many demons had entered him.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus demanded, "What is your name?" "Legion," he replied, for he was filled with many demons.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus asked him, "What is your name?" And he said, "Legion"; because many demons had entered him.
verses.textEn: Jesus asked him, <red>“What is your name?”</red> “Legion,” he replied, because many demons had gone into him.

verses.textZh: 他们求耶稣，不要赶他们进入无底坑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们求耶稣，不要赶他们进入无底坑。
verses.textZhCuv: 鬼就央求耶稣，不要吩咐他们到无底坑里去。
verses.textEnNiv: And they begged Jesus repeatedly not to order them to go into the Abyss.
verses.textEnEsv: And they begged him not to command them to depart into the abyss.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they begged Him that He would not command them to go out into the abyss.
verses.textEnNlt: The demons kept begging Jesus not to send them into the bottomless pit.
verses.textEnNasb: And they were begging Him not to command them to go away into the abyss.
verses.textEn: And they begged Jesus repeatedly not to order them to go into the Abyss.

verses.textZh: 那里有一大群猪正在山上吃东西。他们求耶稣准他们进入猪群。耶稣准许了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那里有一大群猪正在山上吃东西。他们求耶稣准他们进入猪群。耶稣准许了，
verses.textZhCuv: 那里有一大群猪在山上吃食。鬼央求耶稣，准他们进入猪里去。耶稣准了他们，
verses.textEnNiv: A large herd of pigs was feeding there on the hillside. The demons begged Jesus to let them go into the pigs, and he gave them permission.
verses.textEnEsv: Now a large herd of pigs was feeding there on the hillside, and they begged him to let them enter these. So he gave them permission.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a herd of many swine was feeding there on the mountain. So they begged Him that He would permit them to enter them. And He permitted them.
verses.textEnNlt: There happened to be a large herd of pigs feeding on the hillside nearby, and the demons begged him to let them enter into the pigs. So Jesus gave them permission.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding there on the mountain; and the demons begged Him to permit them to enter the pigs. And He gave them permission.
verses.textEn: A large herd of pigs was feeding there on the hillside. The demons begged Jesus to let them go into the pigs, and he gave them permission.

verses.textZh: 鬼就从那人身上出来，进入猪群，猪群闯下山崖，掉在海里淹死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 鬼就从那人身上出来，进入猪群，猪群闯下山崖，掉在海里淹死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 鬼就从那人出来，进入猪里去。于是那群猪闯下山崖，投在湖里淹死了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the demons came out of the man, they went into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the demons came out of the man and entered the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the demons went out of the man and entered the swine, and the herd ran violently down the steep place into the lake and drowned.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the demons came out of the man and entered the pigs, and the entire herd plunged down the steep hillside into the lake and drowned.
verses.textEnNasb: And the demons came out of the man and entered the pigs; and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.
verses.textEn: When the demons came out of the man, they went into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.

verses.textZh: 放猪的看见所发生的事就逃跑，到城里和各乡村把这事传开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 放猪的看见所发生的事就逃跑，到城里和各乡村把这事传开。
verses.textZhCuv: 放猪的看见这事就逃跑了，去告诉城里和乡下的人。
verses.textEnNiv: When those tending the pigs saw what had happened, they ran off and reported this in the town and countryside,
verses.textEnEsv: When the herdsmen saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.
verses.textEnNkjv: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.
verses.textEnNlt: When the herdsmen saw it, they fled to the nearby town and the surrounding countryside, spreading the news as they ran.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the herdsmen saw what had happened, they ran away and reported everything in the city, and in the country.
verses.textEn: When those tending the pigs saw what had happened, they ran off and reported this in the town and countryside,

verses.textZh: 众人就出来看发生了甚么事。来到耶稣那里，看见鬼已经离开的那人，穿著衣服，神志清醒，坐在耶稣脚前，他们就害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人就出来看发生了甚么事。来到耶稣那里，看见鬼已经离开的那人，穿著衣服，神志清醒，坐在耶稣脚前，他们就害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人出来要看是什么事；到了耶稣那里，看见鬼所离开的那人，坐在耶稣脚前，穿着衣服，心里明白过来，他们就害怕。
verses.textEnNiv: and the people went out to see what had happened. When they came to Jesus, they found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
verses.textEnEsv: Then people went out to see what had happened, and they came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed and in his right mind, and they were afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they went out to see what had happened, and came to Jesus, and found the man from whom the demons had departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed and in his right mind. And they were afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: People rushed out to see what had happened. A crowd soon gathered around Jesus, and they saw the man who had been freed from the demons. He was sitting at Jesus’ feet, fully clothed and perfectly sane, and they were all afraid.
verses.textEnNasb: And the people came out to see what had happened; and they came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting down at the feet of Jesus, clothed and in his right mind; and they became frightened.
verses.textEn: and the people went out to see what had happened. When they came to Jesus, they found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

verses.textZh: 当时看见的人，把被鬼附过的人怎样得到医治，说给他们听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时看见的人，把被鬼附过的人怎样得到医治，说给他们听。
verses.textZhCuv: 看见这事的便将被鬼附着的人怎么得救告诉他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who had seen it told the people how the demon-possessed man had been cured.
verses.textEnEsv: And those who had seen it told them how the demon-possessed man had been healed.
verses.textEnNkjv: They also who had seen it told them by what means he who had been demon-possessed was healed.
verses.textEnNlt: Then those who had seen what happened told the others how the demon-possessed man had been healed.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who had seen everything reported to them how the man who had been demon-possessed had been made well.
verses.textEn: Those who had seen it told the people how the demon-possessed man had been cured.

verses.textZh: 格拉森一带的人，都要求耶稣离开他们，因为他们大大惧怕。他就上船回去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 格拉森一带的人，都要求耶稣离开他们，因为他们大大惧怕。他就上船回去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 格拉森四围的人，因为害怕得很，都求耶稣离开他们；耶稣就上船回去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then all the people of the region of the Gerasenes asked Jesus to leave them, because they were overcome with fear. So he got into the boat and left.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the people of the surrounding country of the Gerasenes asked him to depart from them, for they were seized with great fear. So he got into the boat and returned.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the whole multitude of the surrounding region of the Gadarenes asked Him to depart from them, for they were seized with great fear. And He got into the boat and returned.
verses.textEnNlt: And all the people in the region of the Gerasenes begged Jesus to go away and leave them alone, for a great wave of fear swept over them. So Jesus returned to the boat and left, crossing back to the other side of the lake.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the people of the territory of the Gerasenes and the surrounding region asked Him to leave them, because they were overwhelmed by great fear; and He got into a boat and returned.
verses.textEn: Then all the people of the region of the Gerasenes asked Jesus to leave them, because they were overcome with fear. So he got into the boat and left.

verses.textZh: 鬼已经离开的那人求耶稣，要跟他在一起；但耶稣打发他回去，说：
