verses.textZhCnvs: 鬼已经离开的那人求耶稣，要跟他在一起；但耶稣打发他回去，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 鬼所离开的那人恳求和耶稣同在；耶稣却打发他回去，说：
verses.textEnNiv: The man from whom the demons had gone out begged to go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,
verses.textEnEsv: The man from whom the demons had gone begged that he might be with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the man from whom the demons had departed begged Him that he might be with Him. But Jesus sent him away, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The man who had been freed from the demons begged to go with him. But Jesus sent him home, saying,
verses.textEnNasb: But the man from whom the demons had gone out was begging Him that he might accompany Him; but Jesus sent him away, saying,
verses.textEn: The man from whom the demons had gone out begged to go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

verses.textZh: <red>"你回家去，述说神为你作了怎样的事。"他就走遍全城，传讲耶稣为他作了怎样的事。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你回家去，述说神为你作了怎样的事。"他就走遍全城，传讲耶稣为他作了怎样的事。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 「<red>你回家去，传说神为你做了何等大的事。</red>」他就去，满城里传扬耶稣为他做了何等大的事。
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Return home and tell how much God has done for you.”</red> So the man went away and told all over town how much Jesus had done for him.
verses.textEnEsv: "Return to your home, and declare how much God has done for you." And he went away, proclaiming throughout the whole city how much Jesus had done for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Return to your own house, and tell what great things God has done for you." And he went his way and proclaimed throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.
verses.textEnNlt: "No, go back to your family, and tell them everything God has done for you." So he went all through the town proclaiming the great things Jesus had done for him.
verses.textEnNasb: "Return to your home and describe what great things God has done for you." So he went away, proclaiming throughout the city what great things Jesus had done for him.
verses.textEn: <red>“Return home and tell how much God has done for you.”</red> So the man went away and told all over town how much Jesus had done for him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣回来的时候，众人欢迎他，因为大家都在等着他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回来的时候，众人欢迎他，因为大家都在等着他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣回来的时候，众人迎接他，因为他们都等候他。
verses.textEnNiv: Now when Jesus returned, a crowd welcomed him, for they were all expecting him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when Jesus returned, the crowd welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when Jesus returned, that the multitude welcomed Him, for they were all waiting for Him.
verses.textEnNlt: On the other side of the lake the crowds welcomed Jesus, because they had been waiting for him.
verses.textEnNasb: And as Jesus was returning, the people welcomed Him, for they had all been waiting for Him.
verses.textEn: Now when Jesus returned, a crowd welcomed him, for they were all expecting him.

verses.textZh: 那时，有一个人来了，名叫叶鲁，他是一位会堂主管。他俯伏在耶稣脚前，求他往他家里去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，有一个人来了，名叫叶鲁，他是一位会堂主管。他俯伏在耶稣脚前，求他往他家里去，
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个管会堂的，名叫睚鲁，来俯伏在耶稣脚前，求耶稣到他家里去；
verses.textEnNiv: Then a man named Jairus, a synagogue leader, came and fell at Jesus’ feet, pleading with him to come to his house
verses.textEnEsv: And there came a man named Jairus, who was a ruler of the synagogue. And falling at Jesus’ feet, he implored him to come to his house,
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue. And he fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged Him to come to his house,
verses.textEnNlt: Then a man named Jairus, a leader of the local synagogue, came and fell at Jesus’ feet, pleading with him to come home with him.
verses.textEnNasb: And a man named Jairus came, and he was an official of the synagogue; and he fell at Jesus’ feet, and began urging Him to come to his house;
verses.textEn: Then a man named Jairus, a synagogue leader, came and fell at Jesus’ feet, pleading with him to come to his house

verses.textZh: 因为他的独生女，约十二岁，快要死了。耶稣去的时候，群众拥挤着他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他的独生女，约十二岁，快要死了。耶稣去的时候，群众拥挤着他。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他有一个独生女儿，约有十二岁，快要死了。 耶稣去的时候，众人拥挤他。
verses.textEnNiv: because his only daughter, a girl of about twelve, was dying. As Jesus was on his way, the crowds almost crushed him.
verses.textEnEsv: for he had an only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. As Jesus went, the people pressed around him.
verses.textEnNkjv: for he had an only daughter about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as He went, the multitudes thronged Him.
verses.textEnNlt: His only daughter, who was about twelve years old, was dying. As Jesus went with him, he was surrounded by the crowds.
verses.textEnNasb: for he had an only daughter, about twelve years old, and she was dying. But as He went, the crowds were pressing against Him.
verses.textEn: because his only daughter, a girl of about twelve, was dying. As Jesus was on his way, the crowds almost crushed him.

verses.textZh: 有一个女人，患了十二年的血漏病，在医生手里花尽了全部养生的 ，没有一个能医好她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个女人，患了十二年的血漏病，在医生手里花尽了全部养生的 ，没有一个能医好她。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个女人，患了十二年的血漏，在医生手里花尽了她一切养生的，并没有一人能医好她。
verses.textEnNiv: And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years, but no one could heal her.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was a woman who had had a discharge of blood for twelve years, and though she had spent all her living on physicians, she could not be healed by anyone.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a woman, having a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her livelihood on physicians and could not be healed by any,
verses.textEnNlt: A woman in the crowd had suffered for twelve years with constant bleeding, and she could find no cure.
verses.textEnNasb: And a woman who had suffered a chronic flow of blood for twelve years, and could not be healed by anyone,
verses.textEn: And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years, but no one could heal her.

verses.textZh: 她从后面挤来，一摸耶稣的衣裳繸子，血就立刻止住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她从后面挤来，一摸耶稣的衣裳繸子，血就立刻止住。
verses.textZhCuv: 她来到耶稣背后，摸他的衣裳䍁子，血漏立刻就止住了。
verses.textEnNiv: She came up behind him and touched the edge of his cloak, and immediately her bleeding stopped.
verses.textEnEsv: She came up behind him and touched the fringe of his garment, and immediately her discharge of blood ceased.
verses.textEnNkjv: came from behind and touched the border of His garment. And immediately her flow of blood stopped.
verses.textEnNlt: Coming up behind Jesus, she touched the fringe of his robe. Immediately, the bleeding stopped.
verses.textEnNasb: came up behind Him and touched the fringe of His cloak, and immediately her bleeding stopped.
verses.textEn: She came up behind him and touched the edge of his cloak, and immediately her bleeding stopped.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："摸我的是谁？"众人都不承认。彼得说："主啊，众人都拥挤着你。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："摸我的是谁？"众人都不承认。彼得说："主啊，众人都拥挤着你。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>摸我的是谁？</red>」众人都不承认。彼得和同行的人都说：「<red>夫子，众人拥拥挤挤紧靠着你。 </red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whop touched me?”</red> Jesus asked. When they all denied it, Peter said, “Master, the people are crowding and pressing against you.”
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said, "Who was it that touched me?" When all denied it, Peter said, "Master, the crowds surround you and are pressing in on you!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus said, "Who touched Me?" When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, "Master, the multitudes throng and press You, and You say, ‘Who touched Me?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Who touched me?" Jesus asked. Everyone denied it, and Peter said, "Master, this whole crowd is pressing up against you."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said, "Who is the one who touched Me?" And while they were all denying it, Peter said, "Master, the people are crowding and pressing in on You."
verses.textEn: <red>“Whop touched me?”</red> Jesus asked. When they all denied it, Peter said, “Master, the people are crowding and pressing against you.”

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>必定有人摸我，因为我觉得有能力从我身上出去。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>必定有人摸我，因为我觉得有能力从我身上出去。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>总有人摸我，因我觉得有能力从我身上出去。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus said, <red>“Someone touched me; I know that power has gone out from me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus said, "Someone touched me, for I perceive that power has gone out from me."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus said, "Somebody touched Me, for I perceived power going out from Me."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus said, "Someone deliberately touched me, for I felt healing power go out from me."
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus said, "Someone did touch Me, for I was aware that power had left Me."
verses.textEn: But Jesus said, <red>“Someone touched me; I know that power has gone out from me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那女人见不能隐瞒，就战战兢兢地过来，向他俯伏，把摸他的缘故，和怎样立刻得到医治，在众人面前说出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那女人见不能隐瞒，就战战兢兢地过来，向他俯伏，把摸他的缘故，和怎样立刻得到医治，在众人面前说出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 那女人知道不能隐藏，就战战兢兢地来俯伏在耶稣脚前，把摸他的缘故和怎样立刻得好了，当着众人都说出来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the woman, seeing that she could not go unnoticed, came trembling and fell at his feet. In the presence of all the people, she told why she had touched him and how she had been instantly healed.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling, and falling down before him declared in the presence of all the people why she had touched him, and how she had been immediately healed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before Him, she declared to Him in the presence of all the people the reason she had touched Him and how she was healed immediately.
verses.textEnNlt: When the woman realized that she could not stay hidden, she began to tremble and fell to her knees in front of him. The whole crowd heard her explain why she had touched him and that she had been immediately healed.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the woman saw that she had not escaped notice, she came trembling and fell down before Him, and admitted in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched Him, and how she had been immediately healed.
verses.textEn: Then the woman, seeing that she could not go unnoticed, came trembling and fell at his feet. In the presence of all the people, she told why she had touched him and how she had been instantly healed.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对她说："<red>女儿，你的信使你痊愈了，平安地去吧！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对她说："<red>女儿，你的信使你痊愈了，平安地去吧！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对她说：「<red>女儿，你的信救了你；平平安安地去吧！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to her, <red>“Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to her, "Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to her, "Daughter, be of good cheer; your faith has made you well. Go in peace."
verses.textEnNlt: "Daughter," he said to her, "your faith has made you well. Go in peace."
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to her, "Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace."
verses.textEn: Then he said to her, <red>“Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣还在说话的时候，有人从会堂主管家里来，说："你的女儿死了，不必再劳动老师了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣还在说话的时候，有人从会堂主管家里来，说："你的女儿死了，不必再劳动老师了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 还说话的时候，有人从管会堂的家里来，说：「你的女儿死了，不要劳动夫子。」
verses.textEnNiv: While Jesus was still speaking, someone came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue leader. "Your daughter is dead," he said. "Don’t bother the teacher anymore."
verses.textEnEsv: While he was still speaking, someone from the ruler’s house came and said, "Your daughter is dead; do not trouble the Teacher any more."
verses.textEnNkjv: While He was still speaking, someone came from the ruler of the synagogue’s house, saying to him, "Your daughter is dead. Do not trouble the Teacher."
verses.textEnNlt: While he was still speaking to her, a messenger arrived from the home of Jairus, the leader of the synagogue. He told him, "Your daughter is dead. There’s no use troubling the Teacher now."
verses.textEnNasb: While He was still speaking, someone *came from the house of the synagogue official, saying, "Your daughter has died; do not trouble the Teacher anymore."
verses.textEn: While Jesus was still speaking, someone came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue leader. "Your daughter is dead," he said. "Don’t bother the teacher anymore."

verses.textZh: 耶稣听见就对他说："<red>不要怕，只要信，她必得痊愈。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣听见就对他说："<red>不要怕，只要信，她必得痊愈。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣听见就对他说：「<red>不要怕，只要信！你的女儿就必得救。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Hearing this, Jesus said to Jairus, <red>“Don’t be afraid; just believe, and she will be healed.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus on hearing this answered him, "Do not fear; only believe, and she will be well."
verses.textEnNkjv: But when Jesus heard it, He answered him, saying, "Do not be afraid; only believe, and she will be made well."
verses.textEnNlt: But when Jesus heard what had happened, he said to Jairus, "Don’t be afraid. Just have faith, and she will be healed."
verses.textEnNasb: But when Jesus heard this, He responded to him, "Do not be afraid any longer; only believe, and she will be made well."
verses.textEn: Hearing this, Jesus said to Jairus, <red>“Don’t be afraid; just believe, and she will be healed.”</red>

verses.textZh: 到了那家，除了彼得、约翰、雅各和女孩的父母以外，他不准任何人同他进屋里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了那家，除了彼得、约翰、雅各和女孩的父母以外，他不准任何人同他进屋里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣到了他的家，除了彼得、约翰、雅各，和女儿的父母，不许别人同他进去。
verses.textEnNiv: When he arrived at the house of Jairus, he did not let anyone go in with him except Peter, John and James, and the child’s father and mother.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he came to the house, he allowed no one to enter with him, except Peter and John and James, and the father and mother of the child.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He came into the house, He permitted no one to go in except Peter, James, and John, and the father and mother of the girl.
verses.textEnNlt: When they arrived at the house, Jesus wouldn’t let anyone go in with him except Peter, John, James, and the little girl’s father and mother.
verses.textEnNasb: When He came to the house, He did not allow anyone to enter with Him except Peter, John, and James, and the girl’s father and mother.
verses.textEn: When he arrived at the house of Jairus, he did not let anyone go in with him except Peter, John and James, and the child’s father and mother.

verses.textZh: 众人都在为女孩痛哭哀号，他说："<red>不要哭！她不是死了，而是睡着了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人都在为女孩痛哭哀号，他说："<red>不要哭！她不是死了，而是睡着了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人都为这女儿哀哭捶胸。耶稣说：「<red>不要哭！她不是死了，是睡着了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, all the people were wailing and mourning for her. <red>“Stop wailing,”</red> Jesus said. <red>“She is not dead but asleep.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And all were weeping and mourning for her, but he said, "Do not weep, for she is not dead but sleeping."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now all wept and mourned for her; but He said, "Do not weep; she is not dead, but sleeping."
verses.textEnNlt: The house was filled with people weeping and wailing, but he said, "Stop the weeping! She isn’t dead; she’s only asleep."
verses.textEnNasb: Now they were all weeping and mourning for her; but He said, "Stop weeping, for she has not died, but is asleep."
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, all the people were wailing and mourning for her. <red>“Stop wailing,”</red> Jesus said. <red>“She is not dead but asleep.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们明知女孩已经死了，就嘲笑他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们明知女孩已经死了，就嘲笑他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们晓得女儿已经死了，就嗤笑耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: They laughed at him, knowing that she was dead.
verses.textEnEsv: And they laughed at him, knowing that she was dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they ridiculed Him, knowing that she was dead.
verses.textEnNlt: But the crowd laughed at him because they all knew she had died.
verses.textEnNasb: And they began laughing at Him, knowing that she had died.
verses.textEn: They laughed at him, knowing that she was dead.

verses.textZh: 他进去拉着女孩的手，叫她说："<red>孩子，起来！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他进去拉着女孩的手，叫她说："<red>孩子，起来！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣拉着她的手，呼叫说：「<red>女儿，起来吧！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: But he took her by the hand and said, <red>“My child, get up!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But taking her by the hand he called, saying, "Child, arise."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He put them all outside, took her by the hand and called, saying, "Little girl, arise."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus took her by the hand and said in a loud voice, "My child, get up!"
verses.textEnNasb: He, however, took her by the hand and spoke forcefully, saying, "Child, arise!"
verses.textEn: But he took her by the hand and said, <red>“My child, get up!”</red>

verses.textZh: 她的灵魂回来了，她就立刻起来。耶稣吩咐给她东西吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她的灵魂回来了，她就立刻起来。耶稣吩咐给她东西吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 她的灵魂便回来，她就立刻起来了。耶稣吩咐给她东西吃。
verses.textEnNiv: Her spirit returned, and at once she stood up. Then Jesus told them to give her something to eat.
verses.textEnEsv: And her spirit returned, and she got up at once. And he directed that something should be given her to eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then her spirit returned, and she arose immediately. And He commanded that she be given something to eat.
verses.textEnNlt: And at that moment her life returned, and she immediately stood up! Then Jesus told them to give her something to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: And her spirit returned, and she got up immediately; and He ordered that something be given her to eat.
verses.textEn: Her spirit returned, and at once she stood up. Then Jesus told them to give her something to eat.

verses.textZh: 她父母非常惊奇。耶稣嘱咐他们不要把他所作的事告诉人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她父母非常惊奇。耶稣嘱咐他们不要把他所作的事告诉人。
verses.textZhCuv: 她的父母惊奇得很；耶稣嘱咐他们，不要把所做的事告诉人。
verses.textEnNiv: Her parents were astonished, but he ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.
verses.textEnEsv: And her parents were amazed, but he charged them to tell no one what had happened.
verses.textEnNkjv: And her parents were astonished, but He charged them to tell no one what had happened.
verses.textEnNlt: Her parents were overwhelmed, but Jesus insisted that they not tell anyone what had happened.
verses.textEnNasb: Her parents were amazed; but He instructed them to tell no one what had happened.
verses.textEn: Her parents were astonished, but he ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.

verses.textZh: 耶稣召齐十二门徒，给他们能力、权柄，制伏一切鬼魔，医治各样的疾病，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣召齐十二门徒，给他们能力、权柄，制伏一切鬼魔，医治各样的疾病，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣叫齐了十二个门徒，给他们能力、权柄，制伏一切的鬼，医治各样的病，
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus had called the Twelve together, he gave them power and authority to drive out all demons and to cure diseases,
verses.textEnEsv: And he called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons and to cure diseases,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He called His twelve disciples together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Jesus called together his twelve disciples and gave them power and authority to cast out all demons and to heal all diseases.
verses.textEnNasb: Now He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all the demons, and the power to heal diseases.
verses.textEn: When Jesus had called the Twelve together, he gave them power and authority to drive out all demons and to cure diseases,

verses.textZh: 差遣他们去宣讲神的国和医治病人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 差遣他们去宣讲神的国和医治病人，
verses.textZhCuv: 又差遣他们去宣传神国的道，医治病人，
verses.textEnNiv: and he sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
verses.textEnEsv: and he sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal.
verses.textEnNkjv: He sent them to preach the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he sent them out to tell everyone about the Kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
verses.textEnNasb: And He sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to perform healing.
verses.textEn: and he sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.

verses.textZh: 对他们说："<red>不要带着甚么上路，不要带手杖，不要带口袋，不要带食物，不要带银钱，也不要带两件衣服。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："<red>不要带着甚么上路，不要带手杖，不要带口袋，不要带食物，不要带银钱，也不要带两件衣服。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>对他们说：「行路的时候，不要带拐杖和口袋，不要带食物和银子，也不要带两件褂子。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He told them: <red>“Take nothing for the journey—no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no extra shirt.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Take nothing for your journey, no staff, nor bag, nor bread, nor money; and do not have two tunics.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Take nothing for the journey, neither staffs nor bag nor bread nor money; and do not have two tunics apiece.
verses.textEnNlt: "Take nothing for your journey," he instructed them. "Don’t take a walking stick, a traveler’s bag, food, money, or even a change of clothes.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "Take nothing for your journey, neither a staff, nor a bag, nor bread, nor money; and do not even have two tunics.
verses.textEn: He told them: <red>“Take nothing for the journey—no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no extra shirt.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>无论进哪一家，就住在那里，直到离开。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>无论进哪一家，就住在那里，直到离开。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>无论进哪一家，就住在那里，也从那里起行。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whatever house you enter, stay there until you leave that town.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And whatever house you enter, stay there, and from there depart.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Whatever house you enter, stay there, and from there depart.
verses.textEnNlt: Wherever you go, stay in the same house until you leave town.
verses.textEnNasb: And whatever house you enter, stay there until you leave that city.
verses.textEn: <red>Whatever house you enter, stay there until you leave that town.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡不接待你们的，你们离开那城的时候，当把脚上的灰尘跺下去，作为反对他们的表示。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡不接待你们的，你们离开那城的时候，当把脚上的灰尘跺下去，作为反对他们的表示。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡不接待你们的，你们离开那城的时候，要把脚上的尘土跺下去，见证他们的不是。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If people do not welcome you, leave their town and shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And wherever they do not receive you, when you leave that town shake off the dust from your feet as a testimony against them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And whoever will not receive you, when you go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet as a testimony against them."
verses.textEnNlt: And if a town refuses to welcome you, shake its dust from your feet as you leave to show that you have abandoned those people to their fate."
verses.textEnNasb: And as for all who do not receive you, when you leave that city, shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them."
verses.textEn: <red>If people do not welcome you, leave their town and shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是他们就出去，走遍各乡，传讲福音，到处医治病人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们就出去，走遍各乡，传讲福音，到处医治病人。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒就出去，走遍各乡宣传福音，到处治病。
verses.textEnNiv: So they set out and went from village to village, proclaiming the good news and healing people everywhere.
verses.textEnEsv: And they departed and went through the villages, preaching the gospel and healing everywhere.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they departed and went through the towns, preaching the gospel and healing everywhere.
verses.textEnNlt: So they began their circuit of the villages, preaching the Good News and healing the sick.
verses.textEnNasb: And as they were leaving, they began going throughout the villages, preaching the gospel and healing everywhere.
verses.textEn: So they set out and went from village to village, proclaiming the good news and healing people everywhere.

verses.textZh: 分封王希律听见所发生的一切事，犹豫不定，因为有人说："约翰从死人中复活了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 分封王希律听见所发生的一切事，犹豫不定，因为有人说："约翰从死人中复活了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 分封的王希律听见耶稣所做的一切事，就游移不定；因为有人说：「是约翰从死里复活」；
verses.textEnNiv: Now Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was going on. And he was perplexed because some were saying that John had been raised from the dead,
verses.textEnEsv: Now Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was happening, and he was perplexed, because it was said by some that John had been raised from the dead,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by Him; and he was perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,
verses.textEnNlt: When Herod Antipas, the ruler of Galilee, heard about everything Jesus was doing, he was puzzled. Some were saying that John the Baptist had been raised from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was happening; and he was greatly perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,
verses.textEn: Now Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was going on. And he was perplexed because some were saying that John had been raised from the dead,

verses.textZh: 又有人说："以利亚显现了。"还有人说："古时的一位先知复活了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有人说："以利亚显现了。"还有人说："古时的一位先知复活了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又有人说：「是以利亚显现」；还有人说：「是古时的一个先知又活了。」
verses.textEnNiv: others that Elijah had appeared, and still others that one of the prophets of long ago had come back to life.
verses.textEnEsv: by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the prophets of old had risen.
verses.textEnNkjv: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.
verses.textEnNlt: Others thought Jesus was Elijah or one of the other prophets risen from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the prophets of old had risen.
verses.textEn: others that Elijah had appeared, and still others that one of the prophets of long ago had come back to life.

verses.textZh: 希律说："约翰已经斩头了，但这是谁，我怎么会听到他这些事呢？"就设法要见他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希律说："约翰已经斩头了，但这是谁，我怎么会听到他这些事呢？"就设法要见他。
verses.textZhCuv: 希律说：「约翰我已经斩了，这却是什么人？我竟听见他这样的事呢？」就想要见他。
verses.textEnNiv: But Herod said, "I beheaded John. Who, then, is this I hear such things about?" And he tried to see him.
verses.textEnEsv: Herod said, "John I beheaded, but who is this about whom I hear such things?" And he sought to see him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Herod said, "John I have beheaded, but who is this of whom I hear such things?" So he sought to see Him.
verses.textEnNlt: "I beheaded John," Herod said, "so who is this man about whom I hear such stories?" And he kept trying to see him.
verses.textEnNasb: Herod said, "I myself had John beheaded; but who is this Man about whom I hear such things?" And he kept trying to see Him.
verses.textEn: But Herod said, "I beheaded John. Who, then, is this I hear such things about?" And he tried to see him.

verses.textZh: 使徒们回来，把所作的事报告耶稣。他带着他们，悄悄地退往伯赛大城去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使徒们回来，把所作的事报告耶稣。他带着他们，悄悄地退往伯赛大城去。
verses.textZhCuv: 使徒回来，将所做的事告诉耶稣，耶稣就带他们暗暗地离开那里，往一座城去；那城名叫伯赛大。
verses.textEnNiv: When the apostles returned, they reported to Jesus what they had done. Then he took them with him and they withdrew by themselves to a town called Bethsaida,
verses.textEnEsv: On their return the apostles told him all that they had done. And he took them and withdrew apart to a town called Bethsaida.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the apostles, when they had returned, told Him all that they had done. Then He took them and went aside privately into a deserted place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
verses.textEnNlt: When the apostles returned, they told Jesus everything they had done. Then he slipped quietly away with them toward the town of Bethsaida.
verses.textEnNasb: When the apostles returned, they gave an account to Him of all that they had done. And taking them with Him, He withdrew privately to a city called Bethsaida.
verses.textEn: When the apostles returned, they reported to Jesus what they had done. Then he took them with him and they withdrew by themselves to a town called Bethsaida,

verses.textZh: 群众知道了，也跟了去。他接待他们，向他们讲论神的国，医好需要医治的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众知道了，也跟了去。他接待他们，向他们讲论神的国，医好需要医治的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 但众人知道了，就跟着他去；耶稣便接待他们，对他们讲论神国的道，医治那些需医的人。
verses.textEnNiv: but the crowds learned about it and followed him. He welcomed them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and healed those who needed healing.
verses.textEnEsv: When the crowds learned it, they followed him, and he welcomed them and spoke to them of the kingdom of God and cured those who had need of healing.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the multitudes knew it, they followed Him; and He received them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and healed those who had need of healing.
verses.textEnNlt: But the crowds found out where he was going, and they followed him. He welcomed them and taught them about the Kingdom of God, and he healed those who were sick.
verses.textEnNasb: But the crowds were aware of this and followed Him; and He welcomed them and began speaking to them about the kingdom of God, and curing those who had need of healing.
verses.textEn: but the crowds learned about it and followed him. He welcomed them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and healed those who needed healing.

verses.textZh: 天将晚的时候，十二门徒来到他跟前，说："请解散众人，好让他们往周围的田舍村庄，去找地方住，找东西吃，因为我们这里是旷野。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 天将晚的时候，十二门徒来到他跟前，说："请解散众人，好让他们往周围的田舍村庄，去找地方住，找东西吃，因为我们这里是旷野。"
verses.textZhCuv: 日头快要平西，十二个门徒来对他说：「请叫众人散开，他们好往四面乡村里去借宿找吃的，因为我们这里是野地。」
verses.textEnNiv: Late in the afternoon the Twelve came to him and said, "Send the crowd away so they can go to the surrounding villages and countryside and find food and lodging, because we are in a remote place here."
verses.textEnEsv: Now the day began to wear away, and the twelve came and said to him, "Send the crowd away to go into the surrounding villages and countryside to find lodging and get provisions, for we are here in a desolate place."
verses.textEnNkjv: When the day began to wear away, the twelve came and said to Him, "Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding towns and country, and lodge and get provisions; for we are in a deserted place here."
verses.textEnNlt: Late in the afternoon the twelve disciples came to him and said, "Send the crowds away to the nearby villages and farms, so they can find food and lodging for the night. There is nothing to eat here in this remote place."
verses.textEnNasb: Now the day was ending, and the twelve came up and said to Him, "Dismiss the crowd, so that they may go into the surrounding villages and countryside and find lodging and get something to eat; because here, we are in a secluded place."
verses.textEn: Late in the afternoon the Twelve came to him and said, "Send the crowd away so they can go to the surrounding villages and countryside and find food and lodging, because we are in a remote place here."

verses.textZh: 他说："<red>你们给他们吃吧！</red>"他们说："<red>我们所有的，不过是五个饼两条鱼，除非去为这些人另买食物。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："<red>你们给他们吃吧！</red>"他们说："<red>我们所有的，不过是五个饼两条鱼，除非去为这些人另买食物。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你们给他们吃吧！</red>」门徒说：「<red>我们不过有五个饼，两条鱼，若不去为这许多人买食物就不够。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, <red>“You give them something to eat.”</red> They answered, “We have only five loaves of bread and two fish—unless we go and buy food for all this crowd.”
verses.textEnEsv: But he said to them, "You give them something to eat." They said, "We have no more than five loaves and two fish—unless we are to go and buy food for all these people."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He said to them, "You give them something to eat." And they said, "We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we go and buy food for all these people."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus said, "You feed them." "But we have only five loaves of bread and two fish," they answered. "Or are you expecting us to go and buy enough food for this whole crowd?"
verses.textEnNasb: But He said to them, "You give them something to eat!" But they said, "We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless perhaps we go and buy food for all these people."
verses.textEn: He replied, <red>“You give them something to eat.”</red> They answered, “We have only five loaves of bread and two fish—unless we go and buy food for all this crowd.”

verses.textZh: 原来男人就约有五千。他对门徒说："<red>叫他们一组一组地坐下，每组约五十人。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来男人就约有五千。他对门徒说："<red>叫他们一组一组地坐下，每组约五十人。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，人数约有五千。耶稣对门徒说：「<red>叫他们一排一排地坐下，每排大约五十个人。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: (About five thousand men were there.) But he said to his disciples, <red>“Have them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For there were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, "Have them sit down in groups of about fifty each."
verses.textEnNkjv: For there were about five thousand men. Then He said to His disciples, "Make them sit down in groups of fifty."
verses.textEnNlt: For there were about 5,000 men there. Jesus replied, "Tell them to sit down in groups of about fifty each."
verses.textEnNasb: (For there were about five thousand men.) But He said to His disciples, "Have them recline to eat in groups of about fifty each."
verses.textEn: (About five thousand men were there.) But he said to his disciples, <red>“Have them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒就照他的话，叫众人坐下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒就照他的话，叫众人坐下。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒就如此行，叫众人都坐下。
verses.textEnNiv: The disciples did so, and everyone sat down.
verses.textEnEsv: And they did so, and had them all sit down.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people all sat down.
verses.textEnNasb: They did so, and had them all recline.
verses.textEn: The disciples did so, and everyone sat down.

verses.textZh: 耶稣拿起这五个饼，两条鱼，望着天，祝谢了，擘开递给门徒，摆在众人面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣拿起这五个饼，两条鱼，望着天，祝谢了，擘开递给门徒，摆在众人面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣拿着这五个饼，两条鱼，望着天祝福，擘开，递给门徒，摆在众人面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke them. Then he gave them to the disciples to distribute to the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And taking the five loaves and the two fish, he looked up to heaven and said a blessing over them. Then he broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples to set before the crowd.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, He blessed and broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus took the five loaves and two fish, looked up toward heaven, and blessed them. Then, breaking the loaves into pieces, he kept giving the bread and fish to the disciples so they could distribute it to the people.
verses.textEnNasb: And He took the five loaves and the two fish, and, looking up to heaven, He blessed them and broke them, and gave them to the disciples again and again, to serve the crowd.
verses.textEn: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke them. Then he gave them to the disciples to distribute to the people.

verses.textZh: 他们都吃饱了，把剩下的零碎拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们都吃饱了，把剩下的零碎拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就吃，并且都吃饱了；把剩下的零碎收拾起来，装满了十二篮子。
verses.textEnNiv: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
verses.textEnEsv: And they all ate and were satisfied. And what was left over was picked up, twelve baskets of broken pieces.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they all ate and were filled, and twelve baskets of the leftover fragments were taken up by them.
verses.textEnNlt: They all ate as much as they wanted, and afterward, the disciples picked up twelve baskets of leftovers!
verses.textEnNasb: And they all ate and were satisfied; and the broken pieces which they had left over were picked up, twelve baskets full.
verses.textEn: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

verses.textZh: 有一次耶稣独自祈祷的时候，只有门徒和他在一起。他问他们："<red>人说我是谁？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一次耶稣独自祈祷的时候，只有门徒和他在一起。他问他们："<red>人说我是谁？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣自己祷告的时候，门徒也同他在那里。耶稣问他们说：「<red>众人说我是谁？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Once when Jesus was praying in private and his disciples were with him, he asked them, <red>“Who do the crowds say I am?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Now it happened that as he was praying alone, the disciples were with him. And he asked them, "Who do the crowds say that I am?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, as He was alone praying, that His disciples joined Him, and He asked them, saying, "Who do the crowds say that I am?"
verses.textEnNlt: One day Jesus left the crowds to pray alone. Only his disciples were with him, and he asked them, "Who do people say I am?"
verses.textEnNasb: And it happened that while He was praying alone, the disciples were with Him, and He questioned them, saying, "Who do the people say that I am?"
verses.textEn: Once when Jesus was praying in private and his disciples were with him, he asked them, <red>“Who do the crowds say I am?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们回答："有人说是施洗的约翰，有人说是以利亚，还有人说是古时的一位先知复活了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答："有人说是施洗的约翰，有人说是以利亚，还有人说是古时的一位先知复活了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「有人说是施洗的约翰；有人说是以利亚；还有人说是古时的一个先知又活了。」
verses.textEnNiv: They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, that one of the prophets of long ago has come back to life."
verses.textEnEsv: And they answered, "John the Baptist. But others say, Elijah, and others, that one of the prophets of old has risen."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they answered and said, "John the Baptist, but some say Elijah; and others say that one of the old prophets has risen again."
verses.textEnNlt: "Well," they replied, "some say John the Baptist, some say Elijah, and others say you are one of the other ancient prophets risen from the dead."
verses.textEnNasb: They answered and said, "John the Baptist, and others say Elijah; but others, that one of the prophets of old has risen."
verses.textEn: They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, that one of the prophets of long ago has come back to life."

verses.textZh: <red>他又问他们："你们说我是谁？"彼得回答："是神的基督！"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他又问他们："你们说我是谁？"彼得回答："是神的基督！"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你们说我是谁？</red>」彼得回答说：「<red>是神所立的基督。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp what about you?”</red> he asked. <red>“Who do you say I am?”</red> Peter answered, “God’s Messiah.”
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to them, "But who do you say that I am?" And Peter answered, "The Christ of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: He said to them, "But who do you say that I am?" Peter answered and said, "The Christ of God."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he asked them, "But who do you say I am?" Peter replied, "You are the Messiah sent from God!"
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "But who do you say that I am?" And Peter answered and said, "The Christ of God."
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp what about you?”</red> he asked. <red>“Who do you say I am?”</red> Peter answered, “God’s Messiah.”

verses.textZh: 耶稣警告他们，嘱咐他们，不要把这事告诉人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣警告他们，嘱咐他们，不要把这事告诉人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣切切地嘱咐他们，不可将这事告诉人，
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus strictly warned them not to tell this to anyone.
verses.textEnEsv: And he strictly charged and commanded them to tell this to no one,
verses.textEnNkjv: And He strictly warned and commanded them to tell this to no one,
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus warned his disciples not to tell anyone who he was.
verses.textEnNasb: But He warned them and instructed them not to tell this to anyone,
verses.textEn: Jesus strictly warned them not to tell this to anyone.

verses.textZh: 又说："<red>人子必须受许多苦，被长老、祭司长，和经学家弃绝、杀害，第三日复活。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说："<red>人子必须受许多苦，被长老、祭司长，和经学家弃绝、杀害，第三日复活。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「<red>人子必须受许多的苦，被长老、祭司长，和文士弃绝，并且被杀，第三日复活。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: And he said, <red>“The Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "The Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and on the third day be raised."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised the third day."
verses.textEnNlt: "The Son of Man must suffer many terrible things," he said. "He will be rejected by the elders, the leading priests, and the teachers of religious law. He will be killed, but on the third day he will be raised from the dead."
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "The Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed and be raised on the third day."
verses.textEn: And he said, <red>“The Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对众人说："<red>如果有人愿意跟从我，就当舍己，天天背起他的十字架来跟从我。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对众人说："<red>如果有人愿意跟从我，就当舍己，天天背起他的十字架来跟从我。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣又对众人说：「若有人要跟从我，就当舍己，天天背起他的十字架来跟从我。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to them all: <red>“Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to all, "If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to them all, "If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to the crowd, "If any of you wants to be my follower, you must give up your own way, take up your cross daily, and follow me.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was saying to them all, "If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself, take up his cross daily, and follow Me.
verses.textEn: Then he said to them all: <red>“Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡是想救自己生命的，必丧掉生命；但为我牺牲自己生命的，必救了生命。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡是想救自己生命的，必丧掉生命；但为我牺牲自己生命的，必救了生命。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为，凡要救自己生命 的，必丧掉生命；凡为我丧掉生命的，必救了生命。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me will save it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For whoever would save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for my sake will save it.
verses.textEnNkjv: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will save it.
verses.textEnNlt: If you try to hang on to your life, you will lose it. But if you give up your life for my sake, you will save it.
verses.textEnNasb: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake, this is the one who will save it.
verses.textEn: <red>For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me will save it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人若赚得全世界，却丧失自己，或赔上自己，有甚么好处呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人若赚得全世界，却丧失自己，或赔上自己，有甚么好处呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人若赚得全世界，却丧了自己，赔上自己，有什么益处呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, and yet lose or forfeit their very self?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world and loses or forfeits himself?
verses.textEnNkjv: For what profit is it to a man if he gains the whole world, and is himself destroyed or lost?
verses.textEnNlt: And what do you benefit if you gain the whole world but are yourself lost or destroyed?
verses.textEnNasb: For what good does it do a person if he gains the whole world, but loses or forfeits himself?
verses.textEn: <red>What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, and yet lose or forfeit their very self?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡是把我和我的道当作可耻的，人子在自己与父并圣天使的荣耀里降临的时候，也必把他当作可耻的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡是把我和我的道当作可耻的，人子在自己与父并圣天使的荣耀里降临的时候，也必把他当作可耻的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡把我和我的道当作可耻的，人子在自己的荣耀里，并天父与圣天使的荣耀里降临的时候，也要把那人当作可耻的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever is ashamed of me and my words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For whoever is ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory and the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.
verses.textEnNkjv: For whoever is ashamed of Me and My words, of him the Son of Man will be ashamed when He comes in His own glory, and in His Father’s, and of the holy angels.
verses.textEnNlt: If anyone is ashamed of me and my message, the Son of Man will be ashamed of that person when he returns in his glory and in the glory of the Father and the holy angels.
verses.textEnNasb: For whoever is ashamed of Me and My words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when He comes in His glory and the glory of the Father and the holy angels.
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever is ashamed of me and my words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人在没有尝过死味以前必定要看见神的国。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人在没有尝过死味以前必定要看见神的国。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人在没尝死味以前，必看见神的国。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Trulyp I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I tell you truly, there are some standing here who will not taste death until they see the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: But I tell you truly, there are some standing here who shall not taste death till they see the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, some standing here right now will not die before they see the Kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNasb: But I say to you truthfully, there are some of those standing here who will not taste death until they see the kingdom of God."
verses.textEn: <red>“Trulyp I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God.”</red>

verses.textZh: 说了这些话以后约有八天，耶稣带着彼得、约翰和雅各，上山去祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说了这些话以后约有八天，耶稣带着彼得、约翰和雅各，上山去祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 说了这话以后约有八天，耶稣带着彼得、约翰、雅各上山去祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: About eight days after Jesus said this, he took Peter, John and James with him and went up onto a mountain to pray.
verses.textEnEsv: Now about eight days after these sayings he took with him Peter and John and James and went up on the mountain to pray.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, about eight days after these sayings, that He took Peter, John, and James and went up on the mountain to pray.
verses.textEnNlt: About eight days later Jesus took Peter, John, and James up on a mountain to pray.
verses.textEnNasb: About eight days after these sayings, He took along Peter, John, and James, and went up on the mountain to pray.
verses.textEn: About eight days after Jesus said this, he took Peter, John and James with him and went up onto a mountain to pray.

verses.textZh: 正祷告的时候，他的面貌就改变了，衣服洁白发光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正祷告的时候，他的面貌就改变了，衣服洁白发光。
verses.textZhCuv: 正祷告的时候，他的面貌就改变了，衣服洁白放光。
verses.textEnNiv: As he was praying, the appearance of his face changed, and his clothes became as bright as a flash of lightning.
verses.textEnEsv: And as he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became dazzling white.
verses.textEnNkjv: As He prayed, the appearance of His face was altered, and His robe became white and glistening.
verses.textEnNlt: And as he was praying, the appearance of his face was transformed, and his clothes became dazzling white.
verses.textEnNasb: And while He was praying, the appearance of His face became different, and His clothing became white and gleaming.
verses.textEn: As he was praying, the appearance of his face changed, and his clothes became as bright as a flash of lightning.

verses.textZh: 忽然有两个人和他谈话，就是摩西和以利亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忽然有两个人和他谈话，就是摩西和以利亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 忽然有摩西、以利亚两个人同耶稣说话；
verses.textEnNiv: Two men, Moses and Elijah, appeared in glorious splendor, talking with Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, two men were talking with him, Moses and Elijah,
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, two men talked with Him, who were Moses and Elijah,
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly, two men, Moses and Elijah, appeared and began talking with Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, two men were talking with Him; and they were Moses and Elijah,
verses.textEn: Two men, Moses and Elijah, appeared in glorious splendor, talking with Jesus.

verses.textZh: 他们在荣光里显现，谈论他去世的事，就是他在耶路撒冷将要完成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在荣光里显现，谈论他去世的事，就是他在耶路撒冷将要完成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在荣光里显现，谈论耶稣去世的事，就是他在耶路撒冷将要成的事。
verses.textEnNiv: They spoke about his departure, which he was about to bring to fulfillment at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: who appeared in glory and spoke of His decease which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: They were glorious to see. And they were speaking about his exodus from this world, which was about to be fulfilled in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: who, appearing in glory, were speaking of His departure, which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: They spoke about his departure, which he was about to bring to fulfillment at Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 彼得和同伴都在打盹。醒过来之后，就看见他的荣光，并与他站在一起的那两个人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得和同伴都在打盹。醒过来之后，就看见他的荣光，并与他站在一起的那两个人。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得和他的同伴都打盹，既清醒了，就看见耶稣的荣光，并同他站着的那两个人。
verses.textEnNiv: Peter and his companions were very sleepy, but when they became fully awake, they saw his glory and the two men standing with him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they became fully awake they saw his glory and the two men who stood with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Peter and those with him were heavy with sleep; and when they were fully awake, they saw His glory and the two men who stood with Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Peter and the others had fallen asleep. When they woke up, they saw Jesus’ glory and the two men standing with him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Peter and his companions had been overcome with sleep; but when they were fully awake, they saw His glory and the two men who were standing with Him.
verses.textEn: Peter and his companions were very sleepy, but when they became fully awake, they saw his glory and the two men standing with him.

verses.textZh: 二人正要离开他的时候，彼得对耶稣说："主啊，我们在这里真好！我们可以搭三个帐棚，一个为你，一个为摩西，一个为以利亚。"他根本不知道自己在说甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 二人正要离开他的时候，彼得对耶稣说："主啊，我们在这里真好！我们可以搭三个帐棚，一个为你，一个为摩西，一个为以利亚。"他根本不知道自己在说甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 二人正要和耶稣分离的时候，彼得对耶稣说：「夫子，我们在这里真好！可以搭三座棚，一座为你，一座为摩西，一座为以利亚。」他却不知道所说的是什么。
verses.textEnNiv: As the men were leaving Jesus, Peter said to him, "Master, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah." (He did not know what he was saying.)
verses.textEnEsv: And as the men were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, "Master, it is good that we are here. Let us make three tents, one for you and one for Moses and one for Elijah"— not knowing what he said.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it happened, as they were parting from Him, that Peter said to Jesus, "Master, it is good for us to be here; and let us make three tabernacles: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah"—not knowing what he said.
verses.textEnNlt: As Moses and Elijah were starting to leave, Peter, not even knowing what he was saying, blurted out, "Master, it’s wonderful for us to be here! Let’s make three shelters as memorials —one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."
verses.textEnNasb: And as these two men were leaving Him, Peter said to Jesus, "Master, it is good that we are here; and let’s make three tabernacles: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah"—not realizing what he was saying.
verses.textEn: As the men were leaving Jesus, Peter said to him, "Master, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah." (He did not know what he was saying.)

verses.textZh: 他说这话的时候，有一片云彩笼罩他们，他们入了云彩，门徒就害怕起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说这话的时候，有一片云彩笼罩他们，他们入了云彩，门徒就害怕起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 说这话的时候，有一朵云彩来遮盖他们；他们进入云彩里就惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: While he was speaking, a cloud appeared and covered them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.
verses.textEnEsv: As he was saying these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.
verses.textEnNkjv: While he was saying this, a cloud came and overshadowed them; and they were fearful as they entered the cloud.
verses.textEnNlt: But even as he was saying this, a cloud overshadowed them, and terror gripped them as the cloud covered them.
verses.textEnNasb: But while he was saying this, a cloud formed and began to overshadow them; and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.
verses.textEn: While he was speaking, a cloud appeared and covered them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.

verses.textZh: 有声音从云彩里出来，说："这是我的儿子，我所拣选的 ，你们要听从他！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有声音从云彩里出来，说："这是我的儿子，我所拣选的 ，你们要听从他！"
verses.textZhCuv: 有声音从云彩里出来，说：「这是我的儿子，我所拣选的 ，你们要听他。」
verses.textEnNiv: A voice came from the cloud, saying, "This is my Son, whom I have chosen; listen to him."
verses.textEnEsv: And a voice came out of the cloud, saying, "This is my Son, my Chosen One; listen to him!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And a voice came out of the cloud, saying, "This is My beloved Son. Hear Him!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then a voice from the cloud said, "This is my Son, my Chosen One. Listen to him."
verses.textEnNasb: And then a voice came from the cloud, saying, "This is My Son, My Chosen One; listen to Him!"
verses.textEn: A voice came from the cloud, saying, "This is my Son, whom I have chosen; listen to him."

verses.textZh: 声音过了，只见耶稣独自在那里。在那些日子，门徒保持缄默，不把所看见的告诉任何人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 声音过了，只见耶稣独自在那里。在那些日子，门徒保持缄默，不把所看见的告诉任何人。
verses.textZhCuv: 声音住了，只见耶稣一人在那里。当那些日子，门徒不提所看见的事，一样也不告诉人。
verses.textEnNiv: When the voice had spoken, they found that Jesus was alone. The disciples kept this to themselves and did not tell anyone at that time what they had seen.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the voice had spoken, Jesus was found alone. And they kept silent and told no one in those days anything of what they had seen.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the voice had ceased, Jesus was found alone. But they kept quiet, and told no one in those days any of the things they had seen.
verses.textEnNlt: When the voice finished, Jesus was there alone. They didn’t tell anyone at that time what they had seen.
verses.textEnNasb: And when the voice had spoken, Jesus was found alone. And they kept silent, and reported to no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.
verses.textEn: When the voice had spoken, they found that Jesus was alone. The disciples kept this to themselves and did not tell anyone at that time what they had seen.

verses.textZh: 第二天，他们下了山，有一大群人迎面而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，他们下了山，有一大群人迎面而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二天，他们下了山，就有许多人迎见耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: The next day, when they came down from the mountain, a large crowd met him.
verses.textEnEsv: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great crowd met him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened on the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, that a great multitude met Him.
verses.textEnNlt: The next day, after they had come down the mountain, a large crowd met Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: On the next day, when they came down from the mountain, a large crowd met Him.
verses.textEn: The next day, when they came down from the mountain, a large crowd met him.

verses.textZh: 在人群中有一个人喊叫说："老师，求你怜悯我的儿子，因为他是我的独生子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在人群中有一个人喊叫说："老师，求你怜悯我的儿子，因为他是我的独生子。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中有一人喊叫说：「夫子！求你看顾我的儿子，因为他是我的独生子。
verses.textEnNiv: A man in the crowd called out, "Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, a man from the crowd cried out, "Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child.
verses.textEnNkjv: Suddenly a man from the multitude cried out, saying, "Teacher, I implore You, look on my son, for he is my only child.
verses.textEnNlt: A man in the crowd called out to him, "Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, my only child.
verses.textEnNasb: And a man from the crowd shouted, saying, "Teacher, I beg You to look at my son, because he is my only son,
verses.textEn: A man in the crowd called out, "Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child.

verses.textZh: 你看，污灵一抓住他，他就忽然喊叫，并且抽疯，口吐白沫；污灵又折磨糟践他，不肯放过他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看，污灵一抓住他，他就忽然喊叫，并且抽疯，口吐白沫；污灵又折磨糟践他，不肯放过他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他被鬼抓住就忽然喊叫；鬼又叫他抽风，口中流沫，并且重重地伤害他，难以离开他。
verses.textEnNiv: A spirit seizes him and he suddenly screams; it throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth. It scarcely ever leaves him and is destroying him.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, a spirit seizes him, and he suddenly cries out. It convulses him so that he foams at the mouth, and shatters him, and will hardly leave him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, a spirit seizes him, and he suddenly cries out; it convulses him so that he foams atthemouth; and it departs from him with great difficulty, bruising him.
verses.textEnNlt: An evil spirit keeps seizing him, making him scream. It throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth. It batters him and hardly ever leaves him alone.
verses.textEnNasb: and a spirit seizes him and he suddenly screams, and it throws him into a convulsion with foaming at the mouth; and only with difficulty does it leave him, mauling him as it leaves.
verses.textEn: A spirit seizes him and he suddenly screams; it throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth. It scarcely ever leaves him and is destroying him.

verses.textZh: 我求过你的门徒，把他赶出去，他们却办不到。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我求过你的门徒，把他赶出去，他们却办不到。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我求过你的门徒，把鬼赶出去，他们却是不能。」
verses.textEnNiv: I begged your disciples to drive it out, but they could not."
verses.textEnEsv: And I begged your disciples to cast it out, but they could not."
verses.textEnNkjv: So I implored Your disciples to cast it out, but they could not."
verses.textEnNlt: I begged your disciples to cast out the spirit, but they couldn’t do it."
verses.textEnNasb: And I begged Your disciples to cast it out, and they could not."
verses.textEn: I begged your disciples to drive it out, but they could not."

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："唉！这不信又乖谬的世代啊！我跟你们在一起，忍受你们，要到几时呢？把你儿子带到这里来吧！"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："唉！这不信又乖谬的世代啊！我跟你们在一起，忍受你们，要到几时呢？把你儿子带到这里来吧！"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>嗳！这又不信又悖谬的世代啊，我在你们这里，忍耐你们要到几时呢？将你的儿子带到这里来吧！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp unbelieving and perverse generation,”</red> Jesus replied, <red>“how long shall I stay with you and put up with you? Bring your son here.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus answered, "O faithless and twisted generation, how long am I to be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus answered and said, "O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said, "You faithless and corrupt people! How long must I be with you and put up with you?" Then he said to the man, "Bring your son here."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus answered and said, "You unbelieving and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and put up with you? Bring your son here."
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp unbelieving and perverse generation,”</red> Jesus replied, <red>“how long shall I stay with you and put up with you? Bring your son here.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那孩子正走过来的时候，污鬼把他摔倒，使他重重地抽疯。耶稣斥责那污灵，把孩子医好，交给他父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那孩子正走过来的时候，污鬼把他摔倒，使他重重地抽疯。耶稣斥责那污灵，把孩子医好，交给他父亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 正来的时候，鬼把他摔倒，叫他重重地抽风。耶稣就斥责那污鬼，把孩子治好了，交给他父亲。
verses.textEnNiv: Even while the boy was coming, the demon threw him to the ground in a convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the impure spirit, healed the boy and gave him back to his father.
verses.textEnEsv: While he was coming, the demon threw him to the ground and convulsed him. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit and healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him. Then Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the child, and gave him back to his father.
verses.textEnNlt: As the boy came forward, the demon knocked him to the ground and threw him into a violent convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the evil spirit and healed the boy. Then he gave him back to his father.
verses.textEnNasb: Now while he was still approaching, the demon slammed him to the ground and threw him into a convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the boy and gave him back to his father.
verses.textEn: Even while the boy was coming, the demon threw him to the ground in a convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the impure spirit, healed the boy and gave him back to his father.

verses.textEnNkjv: And they were all amazed at the majesty of God. But while everyone marveled at all the things which Jesus did, He said to His disciples,
verses.textEnNlt: Awe gripped the people as they saw this majestic display of God’s power. While everyone was marveling at everything he was doing, Jesus said to his disciples,
verses.textEnNasb: And they were all amazed at the greatness of God. But while everyone was astonished at all that He was doing, He said to His disciples,

verses.textZh: <red>"你们要把这些话存在心里：人子将要被交在人的手里。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们要把这些话存在心里：人子将要被交在人的手里。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 「<red>你们要把这些话存在耳中，因为人子将要被交在人手里。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Listen carefully to what I am about to tell you: The Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Let these words sink into your ears: The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Let these words sink down into your ears, for the Son of Man is about to be betrayed into the hands of men."
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to me and remember what I say. The Son of Man is going to be betrayed into the hands of his enemies."
verses.textEnNasb: "As for you, let these words sink into your ears: for the Son of Man is going to be handed over to men."
verses.textEn: <red>“Listen carefully to what I am about to tell you: The Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒不明白这话，因为这话的意思是隐藏的，不让他们明白，他们也不敢问。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒不明白这话，因为这话的意思是隐藏的，不让他们明白，他们也不敢问。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不明白这话，意思乃是隐藏的，叫他们不能明白，他们也不敢问这话的意思。
verses.textEnNiv: But they did not understand what this meant. It was hidden from them, so that they did not grasp it, and they were afraid to ask him about it.
verses.textEnEsv: But they did not understand this saying, and it was concealed from them, so that they might not perceive it. And they were afraid to ask him about this saying.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they did not understand this saying, and it was hidden from them so that they did not perceive it; and they were afraid to ask Him about this saying.
verses.textEnNlt: But they didn’t know what he meant. Its significance was hidden from them, so they couldn’t understand it, and they were afraid to ask him about it.
verses.textEnNasb: But they did not understand this statement, and it was concealed from them so that they would not comprehend it; and they were afraid to ask Him about this statement.
verses.textEn: But they did not understand what this meant. It was hidden from them, so that they did not grasp it, and they were afraid to ask him about it.

verses.textZh: 后来，门徒起了意见，争论谁是最大的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，门徒起了意见，争论谁是最大的。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒中间起了议论，谁将为大。
verses.textEnNiv: An argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.
verses.textEnEsv: An argument arose among them as to which of them was the greatest.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a dispute arose among them as to which of them would be greatest.
verses.textEnNlt: Then his disciples began arguing about which of them was the greatest.
verses.textEnNasb: Now an argument started among them as to which of them might be the greatest.
verses.textEn: An argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.

verses.textZh: 耶稣看出他们的心意，就领了一个小孩子来，叫他站在自己旁边，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看出他们的心意，就领了一个小孩子来，叫他站在自己旁边，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣看出他们心中的议论，就领一个小孩子来，叫他站在自己旁边，
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, took a little child and had him stand beside him.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus, knowing the reasoning of their hearts, took a child and put him by his side
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a little child and set him by Him,
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus knew their thoughts, so he brought a little child to his side.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus, knowing what they were thinking in their hearts, took a child and had him stand by His side,
verses.textEn: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, took a little child and had him stand beside him.

verses.textZh: 对他们说："<red>凡因我的名接待这小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，就是接待那差我来的。谁是你们中间最小的，那人就是最大的。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："<red>凡因我的名接待这小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，就是接待那差我来的。谁是你们中间最小的，那人就是最大的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：「<red>凡为我名接待这小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，就是接待那差我来的。你们中间最小的，他便为大。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to them, <red>“Whoever welcomes this little child in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me. For it is the one who is least among you all who is the greatest.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and said to them, "Whoever receives this child in my name receives me, and whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For he who is least among you all is the one who is great."
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to them, "Whoever receives this little child in My name receives Me; and whoever receives Me receives Him who sent Me. For he who is least among you all will be great."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to them, "Anyone who welcomes a little child like this on my behalf welcomes me, and anyone who welcomes me also welcomes my Father who sent me. Whoever is the least among you is the greatest."
verses.textEnNasb: and He said to them, "Whoever receives this child in My name receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives Him who sent Me; for the one who is least among all of you, this is the one who is great."
verses.textEn: Then he said to them, <red>“Whoever welcomes this little child in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me. For it is the one who is least among you all who is the greatest.”</red>

verses.textZh: 约翰说："主，我们看见有一个人奉你的名赶鬼，就禁止他，因为他不和我们一起跟从你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰说："主，我们看见有一个人奉你的名赶鬼，就禁止他，因为他不和我们一起跟从你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰说：「夫子，我们看见一个人奉你的名赶鬼，我们就禁止他，因为他不与我们一同跟从你。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Master," said John, "we saw someone driving out demons in your name and we tried to stop him, because he is not one of us."
verses.textEnEsv: John answered, "Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not follow with us."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now John answered and said, "Master, we saw someone casting out demons in Your name, and we forbade him because he does not follow with us."
verses.textEnNlt: John said to Jesus, "Master, we saw someone using your name to cast out demons, but we told him to stop because he isn’t in our group."
verses.textEnNasb: John answered and said, "Master, we saw someone casting out demons in Your name; and we tried to prevent him, because he does not follow along with us."
verses.textEn: "Master," said John, "we saw someone driving out demons in your name and we tried to stop him, because he is not one of us."

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："不要禁止他，因为不反对你们的，就是赞成你们的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："不要禁止他，因为不反对你们的，就是赞成你们的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>不要禁止他；因为不敌挡你们的，就是帮助你们的。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Dop not stop him,”</red> Jesus said, <red>“for whoever is not against you is for you.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus said to him, "Do not stop him, for the one who is not against you is for you."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus said to him, "Do not forbid him, for he who is not against us is on our side."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus said, "Don’t stop him! Anyone who is not against you is for you."
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus said to him, "Do not hinder him; for the one who is not against you is for you."
verses.textEn: <red>“Dop not stop him,”</red> Jesus said, <red>“for whoever is not against you is for you.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣被接上升的日子快到了，他就决意向耶路撒冷去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣被接上升的日子快到了，他就决意向耶路撒冷去，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣被接上升的日子将到，他就定意向耶路撒冷去，
verses.textEnNiv: As the time approached for him to be taken up to heaven, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: When the days drew near for him to be taken up, he set his face to go to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, when the time had come for Him to be received up, that He steadfastly set His face to go to Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNlt: As the time drew near for him to ascend to heaven, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: When the days were approaching for His ascension, He was determined to go to Jerusalem;
verses.textEn: As the time approached for him to be taken up to heaven, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 并且差遣使者走在前头；他们去了，进入撒玛利亚的一个村庄，要为他预备。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且差遣使者走在前头；他们去了，进入撒玛利亚的一个村庄，要为他预备。
verses.textZhCuv: 便打发使者在他前头走。他们到了撒马利亚的一个村庄，要为他预备。
verses.textEnNiv: And he sent messengers on ahead, who went into a Samaritan village to get things ready for him;
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent messengers ahead of him, who went and entered a village of the Samaritans, to make preparations for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: and sent messengers before His face. And as they went, they entered a village of the Samaritans, to prepare for Him.
verses.textEnNlt: He sent messengers ahead to a Samaritan village to prepare for his arrival.
verses.textEnNasb: and He sent messengers on ahead of Him, and they went and entered a village of the Samaritans to make arrangements for Him.
verses.textEn: And he sent messengers on ahead, who went into a Samaritan village to get things ready for him;

verses.textZh: 那里的人不接待他，因为他面向着耶路撒冷走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那里的人不接待他，因为他面向着耶路撒冷走。
verses.textZhCuv: 那里的人不接待他，因他面向耶路撒冷去。
verses.textEnNiv: but the people there did not welcome him, because he was heading for Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: But the people did not receive him, because his face was set toward Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they did not receive Him, because His face was set for the journey to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people of the village did not welcome Jesus because he was on his way to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: And they did not receive Him, because He was traveling toward Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: but the people there did not welcome him, because he was heading for Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他的门徒雅各、约翰看见了，就说："主啊，你要我们吩咐火从天降下来，烧灭他们吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的门徒雅各、约翰看见了，就说："主啊，你要我们吩咐火从天降下来，烧灭他们吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他的门徒雅各、约翰看见了，就说：「主啊，你要我们吩咐火从天上降下来烧灭他们，像以利亚所做的 吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: When the disciples James and John saw this, they asked, "Lord, do you want us to call fire down from heaven to destroy them ?"
verses.textEnEsv: And when his disciples James and John saw it, they said, "Lord, do you want us to tell fire to come down from heaven and consume them?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when His disciples James and John saw this, they said, "Lord, do You want us to command fire to come down from heaven and consume them, just as Elijah did?"
verses.textEnNlt: When James and John saw this, they said to Jesus, "Lord, should we call down fire from heaven to burn them up ?"
verses.textEnNasb: When His disciples James and John saw this, they said, "Lord, do You want us to command fire to come down from heaven and consume them?"
verses.textEn: When the disciples James and John saw this, they asked, "Lord, do you want us to call fire down from heaven to destroy them ?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣就转过身来，责备他们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣就转过身来，责备他们，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣转身责备两个门徒，说：「你们的心如何，你们并不知道。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus turned and rebuked them.
verses.textEnEsv: But he turned and rebuked them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He turned and rebuked them, and said, "You do not know what manner of spirit you are of.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus turned and rebuked them.
verses.textEnNasb: But He turned and rebuked them.
verses.textEn: But Jesus turned and rebuked them.

verses.textZh: 然后他们就往别的村庄去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后他们就往别的村庄去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 人子来不是要灭人的性命 ，是要救人的性命。」说着就往别的村庄去了 。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he and his disciples went to another village.
verses.textEnEsv: And they went on to another village.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Son of Man did not come to destroy men’s lives but to save them." And they went to another village.
verses.textEnNlt: So they went on to another village.
verses.textEnNasb: And they went on to another village.
verses.textEn: Then he and his disciples went to another village.

verses.textZh: 他们走路的时候，有一个人对他说："你无论往哪里去，我都要跟从你！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们走路的时候，有一个人对他说："你无论往哪里去，我都要跟从你！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们走路的时候，有一人对耶稣说：「你无论往哪里去，我要跟从你。」
verses.textEnNiv: As they were walking along the road, a man said to him, "I will follow you wherever you go."
verses.textEnEsv: As they were going along the road, someone said to him, "I will follow you wherever you go."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened as they journeyed on the road, that someone said to Him, "Lord, I will follow You wherever You go."
verses.textEnNlt: As they were walking along, someone said to Jesus, "I will follow you wherever you go."
verses.textEnNasb: As they were going on the road, someone said to Him, "I will follow You wherever You go."
verses.textEn: As they were walking along the road, a man said to him, "I will follow you wherever you go."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>狐狸有洞，天空的飞鸟有窝，人子却没有栖身的地方。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>狐狸有洞，天空的飞鸟有窝，人子却没有栖身的地方。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>狐狸有洞，天空的飞鸟有窝，只是人子没有枕头的地方。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“Foxes have dens and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to him, "Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus said to him, "Foxes have holes and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay His head."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus replied, "Foxes have dens to live in, and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place even to lay his head."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to him, "The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay His head."
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“Foxes have dens and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他对另一个人说："<red>你跟从我吧！</red>"那人说："<red>主啊，请准我先回去安葬我的父亲吧。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对另一个人说："<red>你跟从我吧！</red>"那人说："<red>主啊，请准我先回去安葬我的父亲吧。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 又对一个人说：「<red>跟从我来！</red>」那人说：「<red>主，容我先回去埋葬我的父亲。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to another man, <red>“Follow me.”</red> But he replied, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”
verses.textEnEsv: To another he said, "Follow me." But he said, "Lord, let me first go and bury my father."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to another, "Follow Me." But he said, "Lord, let me first go and bury my father."
verses.textEnNlt: He said to another person, "Come, follow me." The man agreed, but he said, "Lord, first let me return home and bury my father."
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to another, "Follow Me." But he said, "Lord, permit me first to go and bury my father."
verses.textEn: He said to another man, <red>“Follow me.”</red> But he replied, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>让死人去埋葬他们的死人，你应该去传扬神的国。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>让死人去埋葬他们的死人，你应该去传扬神的国。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>任凭死人埋葬他们的死人，你只管去传扬神国的道。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to him, <red>“Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go and proclaim the kingdom of God.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to him, "Leave the dead to bury their own dead. But as for you, go and proclaim the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus said to him, "Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go and preach the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus told him, "Let the spiritually dead bury their own dead! Your duty is to go and preach about the Kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNasb: But He said to him, "Allow the dead to bury their own dead; but as for you, go and proclaim everywhere the kingdom of God."
verses.textEn: Jesus said to him, <red>“Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go and proclaim the kingdom of God.”</red>

verses.textZh: 又有一个人说："主，我要跟从你，但容我先回去，向家人道别。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有一个人说："主，我要跟从你，但容我先回去，向家人道别。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又有一人说：「主，我要跟从你，但容我先去辞别我家里的人。」
verses.textEnNiv: Still another said, "I will follow you, Lord; but first let me go back and say goodbye to my family."
verses.textEnEsv: Yet another said, "I will follow you, Lord, but let me first say farewell to those at my home."
verses.textEnNkjv: And another also said, "Lord, I will follow You, but let me first go and bid them farewell who are at my house."
verses.textEnNlt: Another said, "Yes, Lord, I will follow you, but first let me say good-bye to my family."
verses.textEnNasb: Another also said, "I will follow You, Lord; but first permit me to say goodbye to those at my home."
verses.textEn: Still another said, "I will follow you, Lord; but first let me go back and say goodbye to my family."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>手扶着犁向后看的，不适合进神的国。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>手扶着犁向后看的，不适合进神的国。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>手扶着犁向后看的，不配进神的国。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“No one who puts a hand to the plow and looks back is fit for service in the kingdom of God.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said to him, "No one who puts his hand to the plow and looks back is fit for the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus said to him, "No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus told him, "Anyone who puts a hand to the plow and then looks back is not fit for the Kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus said to him, "No one, after putting his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God."
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“No one who puts a hand to the plow and looks back is fit for service in the kingdom of God.”</red>

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，主又另外指派了七十二个人 ，差遣他们两个两个地，在他前面，到他自己将要到的各城各地去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，主又另外指派了七十二个人 ，差遣他们两个两个地，在他前面，到他自己将要到的各城各地去。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，主又设立七十个人，差遣他们两个两个地在他前面，往自己所要到的各城各地方去，
verses.textEnNiv: After this the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them two by two ahead of him to every town and place where he was about to go.
verses.textEnEsv: After this the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them on ahead of him, two by two, into every town and place where he himself was about to go.
verses.textEnNkjv: After these things the Lord appointed seventy others also, and sent them two by two before His face into every city and place where He Himself was about to go.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord now chose seventy-two other disciples and sent them ahead in pairs to all the towns and places he planned to visit.
verses.textEnNasb: Now after this the Lord appointed seventy-two others, and sent them in pairs ahead of Him to every city and place where He Himself was going to come.
verses.textEn: After this the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them two by two ahead of him to every town and place where he was about to go.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>庄稼多，工人少，所以你们应当求庄稼的主，派工人出去收他的庄稼。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>庄稼多，工人少，所以你们应当求庄稼的主，派工人出去收他的庄稼。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>就对他们说：「要收的庄稼多，做工的人少。所以，你们当求庄稼的主打发工人出去收他的庄稼。</red>
