verses.textEnNiv: He told them, <red>“The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into his harvest field.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few. Therefore pray earnestly to the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into his harvest.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to them, "The harvest truly is great, but the laborers are few; therefore pray the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into His harvest.
verses.textEnNlt: These were his instructions to them: "The harvest is great, but the workers are few. So pray to the Lord who is in charge of the harvest; ask him to send more workers into his fields.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was saying to them, "The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few; therefore plead with the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into His harvest.
verses.textEn: He told them, <red>“The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into his harvest field.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们去吧！我差你们去，如同羊羔进入狼群。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们去吧！我差你们去，如同羊羔进入狼群。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们去吧！我差你们出去，如同羊羔进入狼群。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Go! I am sending you out like lambs among wolves.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Go your way; behold, I am sending you out as lambs in the midst of wolves.
verses.textEnNkjv: Go your way; behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
verses.textEnNlt: Now go, and remember that I am sending you out as lambs among wolves.
verses.textEnNasb: Go; behold, I am sending you out like lambs in the midst of wolves.
verses.textEn: <red>Go! I am sending you out like lambs among wolves.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不要带钱囊，不要带口袋，不要带鞋，不要在路上问候人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不要带钱囊，不要带口袋，不要带鞋，不要在路上问候人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不要带钱囊，不要带口袋，不要带鞋；在路上也不要问人的安。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Do not take a purse or bag or sandals; and do not greet anyone on the road.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Carry no moneybag, no knapsack, no sandals, and greet no one on the road.
verses.textEnNkjv: Carry neither money bag, knapsack, nor sandals; and greet no one along the road.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t take any money with you, nor a traveler’s bag, nor an extra pair of sandals. And don’t stop to greet anyone on the road.
verses.textEnNasb: Carry no money belt, no bag, no sandals, and greet no one along the way.
verses.textEn: <red>Do not take a purse or bag or sandals; and do not greet anyone on the road.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>无论进哪一家，先说：‘愿平安归与这家！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>无论进哪一家，先说：‘愿平安归与这家！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>无论进哪一家，先要说：『愿这一家平安。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whenp you enter a house, first say, ‘Peace to this house.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house!’
verses.textEnNkjv: But whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace to this house.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Whenever you enter someone’s home, first say, ‘May God’s peace be on this house.’
verses.textEnNasb: And whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Whenp you enter a house, first say, ‘Peace to this house.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那里若有配得平安的人 ，你们的平安就必临到他，不然，就归给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那里若有配得平安的人 ，你们的平安就必临到他，不然，就归给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那里若有当得平安的人 ，你们所求的平安就必临到那家；不然，就归与你们了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If someone who promotes peace is there, your peace will rest on them; if not, it will return to you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if a son of peace is there, your peace will rest upon him. But if not, it will return to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on it; if not, it will return to you.
verses.textEnNlt: If those who live there are peaceful, the blessing will stand; if they are not, the blessing will return to you.
verses.textEnNasb: And if a man of peace is there, your peace will rest upon him; but if not, it will return to you.
verses.textEn: <red>If someone who promotes peace is there, your peace will rest on them; if not, it will return to you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们要住在那家，吃喝他们所供给的，因为作工的理当得工资；不必从这家搬到那家。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们要住在那家，吃喝他们所供给的，因为作工的理当得工资；不必从这家搬到那家。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要住在那家，吃喝他们所供给的，因为工人得工价是应当的；不要从这家搬到那家。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Stay there, eating and drinking whatever they give you, for the worker deserves his wages. Do not move around from house to house.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And remain in the same house, eating and drinking what they provide, for the laborer deserves his wages. Do not go from house to house.
verses.textEnNkjv: And remain in the same house, eating and drinking such things as they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Do not go from house to house.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t move around from home to home. Stay in one place, eating and drinking what they provide. Don’t hesitate to accept hospitality, because those who work deserve their pay.
verses.textEnNasb: Stay in that house, eating and drinking what they provide; for the laborer is deserving of his wages. Do not move from house to house.
verses.textEn: <red>Stay there, eating and drinking whatever they give you, for the worker deserves his wages. Do not move around from house to house.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>无论进哪一城，人若接待你们，摆上甚么，就吃甚么。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>无论进哪一城，人若接待你们，摆上甚么，就吃甚么。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>无论进哪一城，人若接待你们，给你们摆上什么，你们就吃什么。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whenp you enter a town and are welcomed, eat what is offered to you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Whenever you enter a town and they receive you, eat what is set before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you enter a town and it welcomes you, eat whatever is set before you.
verses.textEnNasb: Whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat what is served to you;
verses.textEn: <red>“Whenp you enter a town and are welcomed, eat what is offered to you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>要医治城中的病人，对他们宣讲：‘神的国临近你们了。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>要医治城中的病人，对他们宣讲：‘神的国临近你们了。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>要医治那城里的病人，对他们说：『神的国临近你们了。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘The kingdom of God has come near to you.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Heal the sick in it and say to them, ‘The kingdom of God has come near to you.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And heal the sick there, and say to them, ‘The kingdom of God has come near to you.’
verses.textEnNlt: Heal the sick, and tell them, ‘The Kingdom of God is near you now.’
verses.textEnNasb: and heal those in it who are sick, and say to them, ‘The kingdom of God has come near to you.’
verses.textEn: <red>Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘The kingdom of God has come near to you.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>无论进哪一城，人若不接待你们，你们就出来到街上，说：</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>无论进哪一城，人若不接待你们，你们就出来到街上，说：</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>无论进哪一城，人若不接待你们，你们就到街上去，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But when you enter a town and are not welcomed, go into its streets and say,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But whenever you enter a town and they do not receive you, go into its streets and say,
verses.textEnNkjv: But whatever city you enter, and they do not receive you, go out into its streets and say,
verses.textEnNlt: But if a town refuses to welcome you, go out into its streets and say,
verses.textEnNasb: But whatever city you enter and they do not receive you, go out into its streets and say,
verses.textEn: <red>But when you enter a town and are not welcomed, go into its streets and say,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>‘连你们城里那黏在我们脚上的尘土，我们也要当着你们擦去。虽然这样，你们应该知道：神的国临近了！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>‘连你们城里那黏在我们脚上的尘土，我们也要当着你们擦去。虽然这样，你们应该知道：神的国临近了！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>说：『就是你们城里的尘土黏在我们的脚上，我们也当着你们擦去。虽然如此，你们该知道神的国临近了。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>‘Even the dust of your town we wipe from our feet as a warning to you. Yet be sure of this: The kingdom of God has come near.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Even the dust of your town that clings to our feet we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that the kingdom of God has come near.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘The very dust of your city which clings to us we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that the kingdom of God has come near you.’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘We wipe even the dust of your town from our feet to show that we have abandoned you to your fate. And know this—the Kingdom of God is near!’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Even the dust of your city which clings to our feet we wipe off in protest against you; yet be sure of this, that the kingdom of God has come near.’
verses.textEn: <red>‘Even the dust of your town we wipe from our feet as a warning to you. Yet be sure of this: The kingdom of God has come near.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，当那日，所多玛所受的，比那城所受的还轻呢。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，当那日，所多玛所受的，比那城所受的还轻呢。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我告诉你们，当审判的日子，所多玛所受的，比那城还容易受呢！」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I say to you that it will be more tolerable in that Day for Sodom than for that city.
verses.textEnNlt: I assure you, even wicked Sodom will be better off than such a town on judgment day.
verses.textEnNasb: I say to you, it will be more tolerable on that day for Sodom than for that city.
verses.textEn: <red>I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"哥拉逊啊，你有祸了！伯赛大啊，你有祸了！因为在你们那里行过的神迹，如果行在推罗和西顿，他们早已披麻蒙灰，坐在地上悔改了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"哥拉逊啊，你有祸了！伯赛大啊，你有祸了！因为在你们那里行过的神迹，如果行在推罗和西顿，他们早已披麻蒙灰，坐在地上悔改了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「哥拉汛哪，你有祸了！伯赛大啊，你有祸了！因为在你们中间所行的异能若行在泰尔、西顿，他们早已披麻蒙灰，坐在地上悔改了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woep to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works which were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you, Korazin and Bethsaida! For if the miracles I did in you had been done in wicked Tyre and Sidon, their people would have repented of their sins long ago, clothing themselves in burlap and throwing ashes on their heads to show their remorse.
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that occurred in you had occurred in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.textEn: <red>“Woep to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在审判的时候，推罗和西顿所受的，比你们所受的还轻呢。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在审判的时候，推罗和西顿所受的，比你们所受的还轻呢。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>当审判的日子，泰尔、西顿所受的，比你们还容易受呢！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But it will be more bearable in the judgment for Tyre and Sidon than for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, Tyre and Sidon will be better off on judgment day than you.
verses.textEnNasb: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.
verses.textEn: <red>But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>还有你，迦百农啊！ 你会被高举到天上吗？ 你必降到阴间。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>还有你，迦百农啊！ 你会被高举到天上吗？ 你必降到阴间。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>迦百农啊，你已经升到天上 ，将来必推下阴间。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted to the heavens? No, you will go down to Hades.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And you, Capernaum, will you be exalted to heaven? You shall be brought down to Hades.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.
verses.textEnNlt: And you people of Capernaum, will you be honored in heaven? No, you will go down to the place of the dead. "
verses.textEnNasb: And you, Capernaum, will not be exalted to heaven, will you? You will be brought down to Hades!
verses.textEn: <red>And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted to the heavens? No, you will go down to Hades.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>听从你们的，就是听从我；弃绝你们的，就是弃绝我；弃绝我的，就是弃绝那差我来的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>听从你们的，就是听从我；弃绝你们的，就是弃绝我；弃绝我的，就是弃绝那差我来的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 又对门徒说：「<red>听从你们的就是听从我；弃绝你们的就是弃绝我；弃绝我的就是弃绝那差我来的。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whoeverp listens to you listens to me; whoever rejects you rejects me; but whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "The one who hears you hears me, and the one who rejects you rejects me, and the one who rejects me rejects him who sent me."
verses.textEnNkjv: He who hears you hears Me, he who rejects you rejects Me, and he who rejects Me rejects Him who sent Me."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to the disciples, "Anyone who accepts your message is also accepting me. And anyone who rejects you is rejecting me. And anyone who rejects me is rejecting God, who sent me."
verses.textEnNasb: "The one who listens to you listens to Me, and the one who rejects you rejects Me; but the one who rejects Me rejects the One who sent Me."
verses.textEn: <red>“Whoeverp listens to you listens to me; whoever rejects you rejects me; but whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那七十二个人欢欢喜喜地回来，说："主啊，因你的名，连鬼也服了我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那七十二个人欢欢喜喜地回来，说："主啊，因你的名，连鬼也服了我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那七十个人欢欢喜喜地回来，说：「主啊！因你的名，就是鬼也服了我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: The seventy-two returned with joy and said, "Lord, even the demons submit to us in your name."
verses.textEnEsv: The seventy-two returned with joy, saying, "Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the seventy returned with joy, saying, "Lord, even the demons are subject to us in Your name."
verses.textEnNlt: When the seventy-two disciples returned, they joyfully reported to him, "Lord, even the demons obey us when we use your name!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now the seventy-two returned with joy, saying, "Lord, even the demons are subject to us in Your name!"
verses.textEn: The seventy-two returned with joy and said, "Lord, even the demons submit to us in your name."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>我看见撒但，像闪电一样从天坠落。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>我看见撒但，像闪电一样从天坠落。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「我曾看见撒但从天上坠落，像闪电一样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, <red>“I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes," he told them, "I saw Satan fall from heaven like lightning!
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "I watched Satan fall from heaven like lightning.
verses.textEn: He replied, <red>“I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我已经给你们权柄，去践踏蛇和蝎子，胜过仇敌的一切能力。绝对没有甚么能伤害你们了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我已经给你们权柄，去践踏蛇和蝎子，胜过仇敌的一切能力。绝对没有甚么能伤害你们了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我已经给你们权柄可以践踏蛇和蝎子，又胜过仇敌一切的能力，断没有什么能害你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy; nothing will harm you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I have given you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall hurt you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I give you the authority to trample on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
verses.textEnNlt: Look, I have given you authority over all the power of the enemy, and you can walk among snakes and scorpions and crush them. Nothing will injure you.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I have given you authority to walk on snakes and scorpions, and authority over all the power of the enemy, and nothing will injure you.
verses.textEn: <red>I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy; nothing will harm you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而不要因为鬼服了你们就欢喜，却要因为你们的名字记录在天上而欢喜。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而不要因为鬼服了你们就欢喜，却要因为你们的名字记录在天上而欢喜。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>然而，不要因鬼服了你们就欢喜，要因你们的名记录在天上欢喜。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>However, do not rejoice that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, do not rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven."
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless do not rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rather rejoice because your names are written in heaven."
verses.textEnNlt: But don’t rejoice because evil spirits obey you; rejoice because your names are registered in heaven."
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, do not rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are recorded in heaven."
verses.textEn: <red>However, do not rejoice that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”</red>

verses.textZh: 就在这时候，耶稣因圣灵而欢乐，说："<red>父啊，天地的主，我赞美你，因为你把这些事向智慧和聪明的人隐藏起来，却向婴孩显明。父啊，是的，这就是你的美意。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在这时候，耶稣因圣灵而欢乐，说："<red>父啊，天地的主，我赞美你，因为你把这些事向智慧和聪明的人隐藏起来，却向婴孩显明。父啊，是的，这就是你的美意。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>正当那时，耶稣被圣灵感动就欢乐，说：「父啊，天地的主，我感谢你！因为你将这些事向聪明通达人就藏起来，向婴孩就显出来。父啊！是的，因为你的美意本是如此。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Jesus, full of joy through the Holy Spirit, said, <red>“I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this is what you were pleased to do.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: In that same hour he rejoiced in the Holy Spirit and said, "I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding and revealed them to little children; yes, Father, for such was your gracious will.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in the Spirit and said, "I thank You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that You have hidden these things from the wise and prudent and revealed them to babes. Even so, Father, for so it seemed good in Your sight.
verses.textEnNlt: At that same time Jesus was filled with the joy of the Holy Spirit, and he said, "O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, thank you for hiding these things from those who think themselves wise and clever, and for revealing them to the childlike. Yes, Father, it pleased you to do it this way.
verses.textEnNasb: At that very time He rejoiced greatly in the Holy Spirit, and said, "I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that You have hidden these things from the wise and intelligent and have revealed them to infants. Yes, Father, for doing so was well pleasing in Your sight.
verses.textEn: At that time Jesus, full of joy through the Holy Spirit, said, <red>“I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this is what you were pleased to do.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我父已经把一切交给我；除了父没有人知道子是谁，除了子和子所愿意启示的人，也没有人知道父是谁。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我父已经把一切交给我；除了父没有人知道子是谁，除了子和子所愿意启示的人，也没有人知道父是谁。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>一切所有的都是我父交付我的；除了父，没有人知道子是谁；除了子和子所愿意指示的，没有人知道父是谁。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Allp things have been committed to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: All things have been handed over to me by my Father, and no one knows who the Son is except the Father, or who the Father is except the Son and anyone to whom the Son chooses to reveal him."
verses.textEnNkjv: All things have been delivered to Me by My Father, and no one knows who the Son is except the Father, and who the Father is except the Son, and the one to whom the Son wills to reveal Him."
verses.textEnNlt: "My Father has entrusted everything to me. No one truly knows the Son except the Father, and no one truly knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him."
verses.textEnNasb: All things have been handed over to Me by My Father, and no one knows who the Son is except the Father, and who the Father is except the Son, and anyone to whom the Son determines to reveal Him."
verses.textEn: <red>“Allp things have been committed to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣转过身来，悄悄地对门徒说："<red>看见你们所看见的，那眼睛有福了！</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣转过身来，悄悄地对门徒说："<red>看见你们所看见的，那眼睛有福了！</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣转身暗暗地对门徒说：「看见你们所看见的，那眼睛就有福了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then he turned to his disciples and said privately, <red>“Blessed are the eyes that see what you see.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then turning to the disciples he said privately, "Blessed are the eyes that see what you see!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He turned to His disciples and said privately, "Blessed are the eyes which see the things you see;
verses.textEnNlt: Then when they were alone, he turned to the disciples and said, "Blessed are the eyes that see what you have seen.
verses.textEnNasb: Turning to the disciples, He said privately, "Blessed are the eyes that see the things you see;
verses.textEn: Then he turned to his disciples and said privately, <red>“Blessed are the eyes that see what you see.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，曾经有许多先知和君王，想看你们所看见的，却没有看到；想听你们所听见的，却没有听到。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，曾经有许多先知和君王，想看你们所看见的，却没有看到；想听你们所听见的，却没有听到。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我告诉你们，从前有许多先知和君王要看你们所看的，却没有看见，要听你们所听的，却没有听见。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For I tell you that many prophets and kings wanted to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see what you see, and did not see it, and to hear what you hear, and did not hear it."
verses.textEnNkjv: for I tell you that many prophets and kings have desired to see what you see, and have not seen it, and to hear what you hear, and have not heard it."
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you, many prophets and kings longed to see what you see, but they didn’t see it. And they longed to hear what you hear, but they didn’t hear it."
verses.textEnNasb: for I tell you that many prophets and kings wanted to see the things that you see, and did not see them, and to hear the things that you hear, and did not hear them."
verses.textEn: <red>For I tell you that many prophets and kings wanted to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.”</red>

verses.textZh: 有一个律法师起来试探耶稣，说："老师，我应该作甚么，才可以承受永生呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个律法师起来试探耶稣，说："老师，我应该作甚么，才可以承受永生呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个律法师起来试探耶稣， 说：「夫子！我该做什么才可以承受永生？」
verses.textEnNiv: On one occasion an expert in the law stood up to test Jesus. "Teacher," he asked, "what must I do to inherit eternal life?"
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, a lawyer stood up to put him to the test, saying, "Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested Him, saying, "Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"
verses.textEnNlt: One day an expert in religious law stood up to test Jesus by asking him this question: "Teacher, what should I do to inherit eternal life?"
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, a lawyer stood up and put Him to the test, saying, "Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"
verses.textEn: On one occasion an expert in the law stood up to test Jesus. "Teacher," he asked, "what must I do to inherit eternal life?"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他说："律法上写的是甚么？你怎么念的呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他说："律法上写的是甚么？你怎么念的呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他说：「<red>律法上写的是什么？你念的是怎样呢？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whatp is written in the Law?”</red> he replied. <red>“How do you read it?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to him, "What is written in the Law? How do you read it?"
verses.textEnNkjv: He said to him, "What is written in the law? What is your reading of it?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "What does the law of Moses say? How do you read it?"
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to him, "What is written in the Law? How does it read to you?"
verses.textEn: <red>“Whatp is written in the Law?”</red> he replied. <red>“How do you read it?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他回答："你要全心、全性、全力、全意爱主你的神，并且要爱邻舍如同自己。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答："你要全心、全性、全力、全意爱主你的神，并且要爱邻舍如同自己。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他回答说：「你要尽心、尽性、尽力、尽意爱主－你的神；又要爱邻舍如同自己。」
verses.textEnNiv: He answered, " ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind’ ; and, ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And he answered, "You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind, and your neighbor as yourself."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he answered and said, " ‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind,’ and ‘your neighbor as yourself.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The man answered, "‘You must love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, all your strength, and all your mind.’ And, ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And he answered, "You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself."
verses.textEn: He answered, " ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind’ ; and, ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ "

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："你答得对，你这样行，就必得生命。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："你答得对，你这样行，就必得生命。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你回答的是；你这样行，就必得永生。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Youp have answered correctly,”</red> Jesus replied. <red>“Do this and you will live.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "You have answered correctly; do this, and you will live."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to him, "You have answered rightly; do this and you will live."
verses.textEnNlt: "Right!" Jesus told him. "Do this and you will live!"
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to him, "You have answered correctly; do this and you will live."
verses.textEn: <red>“Youp have answered correctly,”</red> Jesus replied. <red>“Do this and you will live.”</red>

verses.textZh: 那人想证明自己有理，就对耶稣说："谁是我的邻舍呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人想证明自己有理，就对耶稣说："谁是我的邻舍呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 那人要显明自己有理，就对耶稣说：「谁是我的邻舍呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But he wanted to justify himself, so he asked Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"
verses.textEnEsv: But he, desiring to justify himself, said to Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But he, wanting to justify himself, said to Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"
verses.textEnNlt: The man wanted to justify his actions, so he asked Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"
verses.textEnNasb: But wanting to justify himself, he said to Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"
verses.textEn: But he wanted to justify himself, so he asked Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣回答："有一个人从耶路撒冷下耶利哥去，落在强盗手中。他们剥去他的衣服，把他打得半死，撇下他一个人就走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣回答："有一个人从耶路撒冷下耶利哥去，落在强盗手中。他们剥去他的衣服，把他打得半死，撇下他一个人就走了。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「有一个人从耶路撒冷下耶利哥去，落在强盗手中。他们剥去他的衣裳，把他打个半死，就丢下他走了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: In reply Jesus said: <red>“A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, when he was attacked by robbers. They stripped him of his clothes, beat him and went away, leaving him half dead.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus replied, "A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who stripped him and beat him and departed, leaving him half dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus answered and said: "A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, who stripped him of his clothing, wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied with a story: "A Jewish man was traveling from Jerusalem down to Jericho, and he was attacked by bandits. They stripped him of his clothes, beat him up, and left him half dead beside the road.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus replied and said, "A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he encountered robbers, and they stripped him and beat him, and went away leaving him half dead.
verses.textEn: In reply Jesus said: <red>“A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, when he was attacked by robbers. They stripped him of his clothes, beat him and went away, leaving him half dead.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>正好有一个祭司，从那条路下来，看见他，就从旁边走过去了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>正好有一个祭司，从那条路下来，看见他，就从旁边走过去了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>偶然有一个祭司从这条路下来，看见他就从那边过去了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>A priest happened to be going down the same road, and when he saw the man, he passed by on the other side.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Now by chance a priest was going down that road, and when he saw him he passed by on the other side.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now by chance a certain priest came down that road. And when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
verses.textEnNlt: "By chance a priest came along. But when he saw the man lying there, he crossed to the other side of the road and passed him by.
verses.textEnNasb: And by coincidence a priest was going down on that road, and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
verses.textEn: <red>A priest happened to be going down the same road, and when he saw the man, he passed by on the other side.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>又有一个利未人，来到那里，看见他，也照样从旁边走过去了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>又有一个利未人，来到那里，看见他，也照样从旁边走过去了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又有一个利未人来到这地方，看见他，也照样从那边过去了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So too, a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So likewise a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise a Levite, when he arrived at the place, came and looked, and passed by on the other side.
verses.textEnNlt: A Temple assistant walked over and looked at him lying there, but he also passed by on the other side.
verses.textEnNasb: Likewise a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.
verses.textEn: <red>So too, a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>只有一个撒玛利亚人，旅行来到他那里，看见了，就动了怜悯的心，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>只有一个撒玛利亚人，旅行来到他那里，看见了，就动了怜悯的心，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>惟有一个撒马利亚人行路来到那里，看见他就动了慈心，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But a Samaritan, as he traveled, came where the man was; and when he saw him, he took pity on him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But a Samaritan, as he journeyed, came to where he was, and when he saw him, he had compassion.
verses.textEnNkjv: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was. And when he saw him, he had compassion.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then a despised Samaritan came along, and when he saw the man, he felt compassion for him.
verses.textEnNasb: But a Samaritan who was on a journey came upon him; and when he saw him, he felt compassion,
verses.textEn: <red>But a Samaritan, as he traveled, came where the man was; and when he saw him, he took pity on him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>上前用油和酒倒在他的伤处，包裹好了，把他扶上自己的牲口，带他到客店里照顾他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>上前用油和酒倒在他的伤处，包裹好了，把他扶上自己的牲口，带他到客店里照顾他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>上前用油和酒倒在他的伤处，包裹好了，扶他骑上自己的牲口，带到店里去照应他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put the man on his own donkey, brought him to an inn and took care of him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He went to him and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he set him on his own animal and brought him to an inn and took care of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine; and he set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
verses.textEnNlt: Going over to him, the Samaritan soothed his wounds with olive oil and wine and bandaged them. Then he put the man on his own donkey and took him to an inn, where he took care of him.
verses.textEnNasb: and came to him and bandaged up his wounds, pouring oil and wine on them; and he put him on his own animal, and brought him to an inn and took care of him.
verses.textEn: <red>He went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put the man on his own donkey, brought him to an inn and took care of him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>第二天，他拿出两个银币交给店主，说：‘请你照顾他，额外的开支，我回来的时候必还给你。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>第二天，他拿出两个银币交给店主，说：‘请你照顾他，额外的开支，我回来的时候必还给你。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>第二天拿出二钱银子来，交给店主，说：『你且照应他；此外所费用的，我回来必还你。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The next day he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper. ‘Look after him,’ he said, ‘and when I return, I will reimburse you for any extra expense you may have.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the next day he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper, saying, ‘Take care of him, and whatever more you spend, I will repay you when I come back.’
verses.textEnNkjv: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the innkeeper, and said to him, ‘Take care of him; and whatever more you spend, when I come again, I will repay you.’
verses.textEnNlt: The next day he handed the innkeeper two silver coins, telling him, ‘Take care of this man. If his bill runs higher than this, I’ll pay you the next time I’m here.’
verses.textEnNasb: On the next day he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper and said, ‘Take care of him; and whatever more you spend, when I return, I will repay you.’
verses.textEn: <red>The next day he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper. ‘Look after him,’ he said, ‘and when I return, I will reimburse you for any extra expense you may have.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你想，这三个人，谁是那个落在强盗手中的人的邻舍呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你想，这三个人，谁是那个落在强盗手中的人的邻舍呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你想，这三个人哪一个是落在强盗手中的邻舍呢？」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whichp of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Which of these three, do you think, proved to be a neighbor to the man who fell among the robbers?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So which of these three do you think was neighbor to him who fell among the thieves?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Now which of these three would you say was a neighbor to the man who was attacked by bandits?" Jesus asked.
verses.textEnNasb: Which of these three do you think proved to be a neighbor to the man who fell into the robbers’ hands?"
verses.textEn: <red>“Whichp of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他说："<red>是那怜悯他的。</red>"耶稣说："<red>你去，照样作吧。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："<red>是那怜悯他的。</red>"耶稣说："<red>你去，照样作吧。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「<red>是怜悯他的。</red>」耶稣说：「<red>你去照样行吧。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: The expert in the law replied, “The one who had mercy on him.” Jesus told him, <red>“Go and do likewise.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "The one who showed him mercy." And Jesus said to him, "You go, and do likewise."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "He who showed mercy on him." Then Jesus said to him, "Go and do likewise."
verses.textEnNlt: The man replied, "The one who showed him mercy." Then Jesus said, "Yes, now go and do the same."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "The one who showed compassion to him." Then Jesus said to him, "Go and do the same."
verses.textEn: The expert in the law replied, “The one who had mercy on him.” Jesus told him, <red>“Go and do likewise.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们走路的时候，耶稣进了一个村庄。有一个名叫马大的女人，接他到家里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们走路的时候，耶稣进了一个村庄。有一个名叫马大的女人，接他到家里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们走路的时候，耶稣进了一个村庄。有一个女人，名叫马大，接他到自己家里。
verses.textEnNiv: As Jesus and his disciples were on their way, he came to a village where a woman named Martha opened her home to him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now as they went on their way, Jesus entered a village. And a woman named Martha welcomed him into her house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened as they went that He entered a certain village; and a certain woman named Martha welcomed Him into her house.
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus and the disciples continued on their way to Jerusalem, they came to a certain village where a woman named Martha welcomed him into her home.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as they were traveling along, He entered a village; and a woman named Martha welcomed Him into her home.
verses.textEn: As Jesus and his disciples were on their way, he came to a village where a woman named Martha opened her home to him.

verses.textZh: 她有一个妹妹，名叫马利亚，坐在主的脚前听道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她有一个妹妹，名叫马利亚，坐在主的脚前听道。
verses.textZhCuv: 她有一个妹子，名叫马利亚，在耶稣脚前坐着听他的道。
verses.textEnNiv: She had a sister called Mary, who sat at the Lord’s feet listening to what he said.
verses.textEnEsv: And she had a sister called Mary, who sat at the Lord’s feet and listened to his teaching.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard His word.
verses.textEnNlt: Her sister, Mary, sat at the Lord’s feet, listening to what he taught.
verses.textEnNasb: And she had a sister called Mary, who was also seated at the Lord’s feet, and was listening to His word.
verses.textEn: She had a sister called Mary, who sat at the Lord’s feet listening to what he said.

verses.textZh: 马大被许多要作的事，弄得心烦意乱，就上前来，说："主啊，我妹妹让我一个人侍候，你不理吗？请吩咐她来帮助我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 马大被许多要作的事，弄得心烦意乱，就上前来，说："主啊，我妹妹让我一个人侍候，你不理吗？请吩咐她来帮助我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 马大伺候的事多，心里忙乱，就进前来，说：「主啊，我的妹子留下我一个人伺候，你不在意吗？请吩咐她来帮助我。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Martha was distracted by all the preparations that had to be made. She came to him and asked, "Lord, don’t you care that my sister has left me to do the work by myself? Tell her to help me!"
verses.textEnEsv: But Martha was distracted with much serving. And she went up to him and said, "Lord, do you not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? Tell her then to help me."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she approached Him and said, "Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? Therefore tell her to help me."
verses.textEnNlt: But Martha was distracted by the big dinner she was preparing. She came to Jesus and said, "Lord, doesn’t it seem unfair to you that my sister just sits here while I do all the work? Tell her to come and help me."
verses.textEnNasb: But Martha was distracted with all her preparations; and she came up to Him and said, "Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to do the serving by myself? Then tell her to help me."
verses.textEn: But Martha was distracted by all the preparations that had to be made. She came to him and asked, "Lord, don’t you care that my sister has left me to do the work by myself? Tell her to help me!"

verses.textZh: <red>主回答她："马大，马大，你为许多事操心忙碌，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>主回答她："马大，马大，你为许多事操心忙碌，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「马大！马大！你为许多的事思虑烦扰，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Martha,p Martha,”</red> the Lord answered, <red>“you are worried and upset about many things,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord answered her, "Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus answered and said to her, "Martha, Martha, you are worried and troubled about many things.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord said to her, "My dear Martha, you are worried and upset over all these details!
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord answered and said to her, "Martha, Martha, you are worried and distracted by many things;
verses.textEn: <red>“Martha,p Martha,”</red> the Lord answered, <red>“you are worried and upset about many things,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但是最需要的只有一件，马利亚已经选择了那上好的分，是不能从她夺去的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但是最需要的只有一件，马利亚已经选择了那上好的分，是不能从她夺去的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但是不可少的只有一件；马利亚已经选择那上好的福分，是不能夺去的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>but few things are needed—or indeed only one. Mary has chosen what is better, and it will not be taken away from her.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the good portion, which will not be taken away from her."
verses.textEnNkjv: But one thing is needed, and Mary has chosen that good part, which will not be taken away from her."
verses.textEnNlt: There is only one thing worth being concerned about. Mary has discovered it, and it will not be taken away from her."
verses.textEnNasb: but only one thing is necessary; for Mary has chosen the good part, which shall not be taken away from her."
verses.textEn: <red>but few things are needed—or indeed only one. Mary has chosen what is better, and it will not be taken away from her.”</red>

verses.textZh: 有一天，耶稣在一个地方祈祷，祈祷完了，有一个门徒对他说："主啊，求你教导我们祷告，像约翰教导他的门徒一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，耶稣在一个地方祈祷，祈祷完了，有一个门徒对他说："主啊，求你教导我们祷告，像约翰教导他的门徒一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣在一个地方祷告；祷告完了，有个门徒对他说：「求主教导我们祷告，像约翰教导他的门徒。」
verses.textEnNiv: One day Jesus was praying in a certain place. When he finished, one of his disciples said to him, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples."
verses.textEnEsv: Now Jesus was praying in a certain place, and when he finished, one of his disciples said to him, "Lord, teach us to pray, as John taught his disciples."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, as He was praying in a certain place, when He ceased, that one of His disciples said to Him, "Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples."
verses.textEnNlt: Once Jesus was in a certain place praying. As he finished, one of his disciples came to him and said, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples."
verses.textEnNasb: It happened that while Jesus was praying in a certain place, when He had finished, one of His disciples said to Him, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples."
verses.textEn: One day Jesus was praying in a certain place. When he finished, one of his disciples said to him, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>你们祷告的时候，要说： ‘父啊，愿你的名被尊为圣， 愿你的国降临 ；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>你们祷告的时候，要说： ‘父啊，愿你的名被尊为圣， 愿你的国降临 ；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「你们祷告的时候，要说： 我们在天上的父 ： 愿人都尊你的名为圣。 愿你的国降临； 愿你的旨意行在地上， 如同行在天上 。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, <red>“When you pray, say: “ ‘Father,pn hallowedln be your name, yourln kingdom come.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "When you pray, say: "Father, hallowed be your name. Your kingdom come.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He said to them, "When you pray, say: Our Father in heaven, Hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come. Your will be done On earth as it is in heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said, "This is how you should pray: "Father, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come soon.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "When you pray, say: ‘ Father, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come.
verses.textEn: He said to them, <red>“When you pray, say: “ ‘Father,pn hallowedln be your name, yourln kingdom come.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我们需用的食物， 求你每天赐给我们；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我们需用的食物， 求你每天赐给我们；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我们日用的饮食， 天天赐给我们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Giveln us each day our daily bread.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Give us each day our daily bread,
verses.textEnNkjv: Give us day by day our daily bread.
verses.textEnNlt: Give us each day the food we need,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Give us each day our daily bread.
verses.textEn: <red>Giveln us each day our daily bread.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>赦免我们的罪， 因为我们也饶恕所有亏负我们的人； 不要让我们陷入试探 。’"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>赦免我们的罪， 因为我们也饶恕所有亏负我们的人； 不要让我们陷入试探 。’"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>赦免我们的罪， 因为我们也赦免凡亏欠我们的人。 不叫我们遇见试探； 救我们脱离凶恶 。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Forgiveln us our sins, forld we also forgive everyone who sins against us. Andln lead us not into temptation.’ ”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and forgive us our sins, for we ourselves forgive everyone who is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation."
verses.textEnNkjv: And forgive us our sins, For we also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. And do not lead us into temptation, But deliver us from the evil one."
verses.textEnNlt: and forgive us our sins, as we forgive those who sin against us. And don’t let us yield to temptation. "
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And forgive us our sins, For we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. And do not lead us into temptation.’ "
verses.textEn: <red>Forgiveln us our sins, forld we also forgive everyone who sins against us. Andln lead us not into temptation.’ ”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对他们说："<red>你们当中，谁有朋友半夜去找他，说：‘请你借给我三个饼，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对他们说："<red>你们当中，谁有朋友半夜去找他，说：‘请你借给我三个饼，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣又说：「你们中间谁有一个朋友半夜到他那里去，说：『朋友！请借给我三个饼；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to them, <red>“Suppose you have a friend, and you go to him at midnight and say, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread;</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Which of you who has a friend will go to him at midnight and say to him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves,
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Which of you shall have a friend, and go to him at midnight and say to him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves;
verses.textEnNlt: Then, teaching them more about prayer, he used this story: "Suppose you went to a friend’s house at midnight, wanting to borrow three loaves of bread. You say to him,
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, " Suppose one of you has a friend, and goes to him at midnight and says to him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves,
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to them, <red>“Suppose you have a friend, and you go to him at midnight and say, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread;</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为我有一个朋友旅行来到我这里，我没有甚么可以招待他。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为我有一个朋友旅行来到我这里，我没有甚么可以招待他。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为我有一个朋友行路，来到我这里，我没有什么给他摆上。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>a friend of mine on a journey has come to me, and I have no food to offer him.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: for a friend of mine has arrived on a journey, and I have nothing to set before him’;
verses.textEnNkjv: for a friend of mine has come to me on his journey, and I have nothing to set before him’;
verses.textEnNlt: ‘A friend of mine has just arrived for a visit, and I have nothing for him to eat.’
verses.textEnNasb: because a friend of mine has come to me from a journey and I have nothing to serve him’;
verses.textEn: <red>a friend of mine on a journey has come to me, and I have no food to offer him.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>而他却在里面回答：‘不要麻烦我，门已经关好了，孩子也跟我在床上了，我不能起来拿给你。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>而他却在里面回答：‘不要麻烦我，门已经关好了，孩子也跟我在床上了，我不能起来拿给你。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那人在里面回答说：『不要搅扰我，门已经关闭，孩子们也同我在床上了，我不能起来给你。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And suppose the one inside answers, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is already locked, and my children and I are in bed. I can’t get up and give you anything.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and he will answer from within, ‘Do not bother me; the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I cannot get up and give you anything’?
verses.textEnNkjv: and he will answer from within and say, ‘Do not trouble me; the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give to you’?
verses.textEnNlt: And suppose he calls out from his bedroom, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is locked for the night, and my family and I are all in bed. I can’t help you.’
verses.textEnNasb: and from inside he answers and says, ‘Do not bother me; the door has already been shut and my children and I are in bed; I cannot get up and give you anything.’
verses.textEn: <red>And suppose the one inside answers, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is already locked, and my children and I are in bed. I can’t get up and give you anything.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，即使不因为他是朋友而起来给他，也会因为他厚颜地直求，而起来照他所需要的给他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，即使不因为他是朋友而起来给他，也会因为他厚颜地直求，而起来照他所需要的给他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我告诉你们，虽不因他是朋友起来给他，但因他情词迫切地直求，就必起来照他所需用的给他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I tell you, even though he will not get up and give you the bread because of friendship, yet because of your shameless audacity he will surely get up and give you as much as you need.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I tell you, though he will not get up and give him anything because he is his friend, yet because of his impudence he will rise and give him whatever he needs.
verses.textEnNkjv: I say to you, though he will not rise and give to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence he will rise and give him as many as he needs.
verses.textEnNlt: But I tell you this—though he won’t do it for friendship’s sake, if you keep knocking long enough, he will get up and give you whatever you need because of your shameless persistence.
verses.textEnNasb: I tell you, even if he will not get up and give him anything just because he is his friend, yet because of his shamelessness he will get up and give him as much as he needs.
verses.textEn: <red>I tell you, even though he will not get up and give you the bread because of friendship, yet because of your shameless audacity he will surely get up and give you as much as you need.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我又告诉你们，你们祈求，就给你们；寻找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我又告诉你们，你们祈求，就给你们；寻找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我又告诉你们，你们祈求，就给你们；寻找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Sop I say to you: Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And I tell you, ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So I say to you, ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
verses.textEnNlt: "And so I tell you, keep on asking, and you will receive what you ask for. Keep on seeking, and you will find. Keep on knocking, and the door will be opened to you.
verses.textEnNasb: "So I say to you, ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
verses.textEn: <red>“Sop I say to you: Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为所有祈求的就得着，寻找的就寻见，叩门的就给他开门。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为所有祈求的就得着，寻找的就寻见，叩门的就给他开门。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为，凡祈求的，就得着；寻找的，就寻见；叩门的，就给他开门。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For everyone who asks receives; the one who seeks finds; and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For everyone who asks receives, and the one who seeks finds, and to the one who knocks it will be opened.
verses.textEnNkjv: For everyone who asks receives, and he who seeks finds, and to him who knocks it will be opened.
verses.textEnNlt: For everyone who asks, receives. Everyone who seeks, finds. And to everyone who knocks, the door will be opened.
verses.textEnNasb: For everyone who asks receives, and the one who seeks finds, and to the one who knocks, it will be opened.
verses.textEn: <red>For everyone who asks receives; the one who seeks finds; and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们中间作父亲的，哪有儿子求鱼，反拿蛇当作鱼给他呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们中间作父亲的，哪有儿子求鱼，反拿蛇当作鱼给他呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们中间作父亲的，谁有儿子求饼，反给他石头呢？求鱼，反拿蛇当鱼给他呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whichp of you fathers, if your son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: What father among you, if his son asks for a fish, will instead of a fish give him a serpent;
verses.textEnNkjv: If a son asks for bread from any father among you, will he give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, will he give him a serpent instead of a fish?
verses.textEnNlt: "You fathers—if your children ask for a fish, do you give them a snake instead?
verses.textEnNasb: Now which one of you fathers will his son ask for a fish, and instead of a fish, he will give him a snake?
verses.textEn: <red>“Whichp of you fathers, if your son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>或求鸡蛋，反给他蝎子呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>或求鸡蛋，反给他蝎子呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>求鸡蛋，反给他蝎子呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or if he asks for an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
verses.textEnNlt: Or if they ask for an egg, do you give them a scorpion? Of course not!
verses.textEnNasb: Or he will even ask for an egg, and his father will give him a scorpion?
verses.textEn: <red>Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们虽然不好，尚且知道把好东西给自己的儿女，何况天父，岂不更把圣灵赐给求他的人吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们虽然不好，尚且知道把好东西给自己的儿女，何况天父，岂不更把圣灵赐给求他的人吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们虽然不好，尚且知道拿好东西给儿女；何况天父，岂不更将圣灵给求他的人吗？」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If you then, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If you then, who are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will the heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him!"
verses.textEnNkjv: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!"
verses.textEnNlt: So if you sinful people know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him."
verses.textEnNasb: So if you, despite being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him?"
verses.textEn: <red>If you then, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him!”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣赶出一个哑巴鬼，鬼既出去，哑巴就说起话来，众人都希奇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣赶出一个哑巴鬼，鬼既出去，哑巴就说起话来，众人都希奇。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣赶出一个叫人哑巴的鬼；鬼出去了，哑巴就说出话来；众人都希奇。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus was driving out a demon that was mute. When the demon left, the man who had been mute spoke, and the crowd was amazed.
verses.textEnEsv: Now he was casting out a demon that was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke, and the people marveled.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. So it was, when the demon had gone out, that the mute spoke; and the multitudes marveled.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Jesus cast out a demon from a man who couldn’t speak, and when the demon was gone, the man began to speak. The crowds were amazed,
verses.textEnNasb: And He was casting out a mute demon; when the demon had gone out, the man who was previously unable to speak talked, and the crowds were amazed.
verses.textEn: Jesus was driving out a demon that was mute. When the demon left, the man who had been mute spoke, and the crowd was amazed.

verses.textZh: 有人说："他靠鬼王别西卜赶鬼。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人说："他靠鬼王别西卜赶鬼。"
verses.textZhCuv: 内中却有人说：「他是靠着鬼王别西卜赶鬼。」
verses.textEnNiv: But some of them said, "By Beelzebul, the prince of demons, he is driving out demons."
verses.textEnEsv: But some of them said, "He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of demons,"
verses.textEnNkjv: But some of them said, "He casts out demons by Beelzebub, the ruler of the demons."
verses.textEnNlt: but some of them said, "No wonder he can cast out demons. He gets his power from Satan, the prince of demons."
verses.textEnNasb: But some of them said, "He casts out the demons by Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons."
verses.textEn: But some of them said, "By Beelzebul, the prince of demons, he is driving out demons."

verses.textZh: 又有人试探他，向他求一个从天上来的神迹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有人试探他，向他求一个从天上来的神迹。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有人试探耶稣，向他求从天上来的神迹。
verses.textEnNiv: Others tested him by asking for a sign from heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: while others, to test him, kept seeking from him a sign from heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Others, testing Him, sought from Him a sign from heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: Others, trying to test Jesus, demanded that he show them a miraculous sign from heaven to prove his authority.
verses.textEnNasb: Others, to test Him, were demanding of Him a sign from heaven.
verses.textEn: Others tested him by asking for a sign from heaven.

verses.textZh: 耶稣知道他们的心意，就对他们说："<red>如果一个国家自相纷争，就必定荒凉；如果一个家庭自相为敌，就必然败落。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣知道他们的心意，就对他们说："<red>如果一个国家自相纷争，就必定荒凉；如果一个家庭自相为敌，就必然败落。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他晓得他们的意念，便对他们说：「凡一国自相纷争，就成为荒场；凡一家自相纷争，就必败落。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them: <red>“Any kingdom divided against itself will be ruined, and a house divided against itself will fall.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste, and a divided household falls.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He, knowing their thoughts, said to them: "Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and a house divided against a house falls.
verses.textEnNlt: He knew their thoughts, so he said, "Any kingdom divided by civil war is doomed. A family splintered by feuding will fall apart.
verses.textEnNasb: But He knew their thoughts and said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste; and a house divided against itself falls.
verses.textEn: Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them: <red>“Any kingdom divided against itself will be ruined, and a house divided against itself will fall.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果撒但自相纷争，他的国怎能站立得住呢？你们说我靠别西卜赶鬼，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果撒但自相纷争，他的国怎能站立得住呢？你们说我靠别西卜赶鬼，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若撒但自相纷争，他的国怎能站得住呢？因为你们说我是靠着别西卜赶鬼。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If Satan is divided against himself, how can his kingdom stand? I say this because you claim that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.
verses.textEnNkjv: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? Because you say I cast out demons by Beelzebub.
verses.textEnNlt: You say I am empowered by Satan. But if Satan is divided and fighting against himself, how can his kingdom survive?
verses.textEnNasb: And if Satan also has been divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you claim that I cast out the demons by Beelzebul.
verses.textEn: <red>If Satan is divided against himself, how can his kingdom stand? I say this because you claim that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我若靠别西卜赶鬼，你们的子孙赶鬼又靠谁呢？因此，他们必要作你们的审判官。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我若靠别西卜赶鬼，你们的子孙赶鬼又靠谁呢？因此，他们必要作你们的审判官。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我若靠着别西卜赶鬼，你们的子弟赶鬼又靠着谁呢？这样，他们就要断定你们的是非。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Now if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your followers drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if I cast out demons by Beelzebub, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
verses.textEnNlt: And if I am empowered by Satan, what about your own exorcists? They cast out demons, too, so they will condemn you for what you have said.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet if by Beelzebul I cast out the demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore, they will be your judges.
verses.textEn: <red>Now if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your followers drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我若靠神的能力赶鬼，这就是神的国临到你们了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我若靠神的能力赶鬼，这就是神的国临到你们了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我若靠着神的能力赶鬼，这就是神的国临到你们了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But if it is by the finger of God that I cast out demons, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if I cast out demons with the finger of God, surely the kingdom of God has come upon you.
verses.textEnNlt: But if I am casting out demons by the power of God, then the Kingdom of God has arrived among you.
verses.textEnNasb: But if I cast out the demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
verses.textEn: <red>But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>一个壮汉拿着武器，看守自己的家园，他的家财就平安无事。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>一个壮汉拿着武器，看守自己的家园，他的家财就平安无事。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>壮士披挂整齐，看守自己的住宅，他所有的都平安无事；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whenp a strong man, fully armed, guards his own house, his possessions are safe.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When a strong man, fully armed, guards his own palace, his goods are safe;
verses.textEnNkjv: When a strong man, fully armed, guards his own palace, his goods are in peace.
verses.textEnNlt: For when a strong man is fully armed and guards his palace, his possessions are safe—
verses.textEnNasb: When a strong man, fully armed, guards his own house, his possessions are secure.
verses.textEn: <red>“Whenp a strong man, fully armed, guards his own house, his possessions are safe.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但是一个比他更强的人来了，胜过了他，夺去他所倚靠的武器，就把他的家财当作掠物分了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但是一个比他更强的人来了，胜过了他，夺去他所倚靠的武器，就把他的家财当作掠物分了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但有一个比他更壮的来，胜过他，就夺去他所倚靠的盔甲兵器，又分了他的赃。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But when someone stronger attacks and overpowers him, he takes away the armor in which the man trusted and divides up his plunder.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but when one stronger than he attacks him and overcomes him, he takes away his armor in which he trusted and divides his spoil.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when a stronger than he comes upon him and overcomes him, he takes from him all his armor in which he trusted, and divides his spoils.
verses.textEnNlt: until someone even stronger attacks and overpowers him, strips him of his weapons, and carries off his belongings.
verses.textEnNasb: But when someone stronger than he attacks him and overpowers him, that man takes away his armor on which he had relied and distributes his plunder.
verses.textEn: <red>But when someone stronger attacks and overpowers him, he takes away the armor in which the man trusted and divides up his plunder.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不站在我这一边的就是反对我的；不跟从一起收聚的就是分散的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不站在我这一边的就是反对我的；不跟从一起收聚的就是分散的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不与我相合的，就是敌我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whoeverp is not with me is against me, and whoever does not gather with me scatters.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever is not with me is against me, and whoever does not gather with me scatters.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
verses.textEnNlt: "Anyone who isn’t with me opposes me, and anyone who isn’t working with me is actually working against me.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who is not with Me is against Me; and the one who does not gather with Me scatters.
verses.textEn: <red>“Whoeverp is not with me is against me, and whoever does not gather with me scatters.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"一个污灵离开了一个人，走遍干旱之地，寻找栖身的地方，却没有找到，就说：‘我要回到我从前离开了的那房子。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"一个污灵离开了一个人，走遍干旱之地，寻找栖身的地方，却没有找到，就说：‘我要回到我从前离开了的那房子。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「污鬼离了人身，就在无水之地过来过去，寻求安歇之处；既寻不着，便说：『我要回到我所出来的屋里去。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whenp an impure spirit comes out of a person, it goes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it. Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "When the unclean spirit has gone out of a person, it passes through waterless places seeking rest, and finding none it says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "When an unclean spirit goes out of a man, he goes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came.’
verses.textEnNlt: "When an evil spirit leaves a person, it goes into the desert, searching for rest. But when it finds none, it says, ‘I will return to the person I came from.’
verses.textEnNasb: "When the unclean spirit comes out of a person, it passes through waterless places seeking rest, and not finding any, it then says, ‘I will return to my house from which I came.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Whenp an impure spirit comes out of a person, it goes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it. Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>到了之后，看见里面已经打扫干净，粉饰好了，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>到了之后，看见里面已经打扫干净，粉饰好了，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>到了，就看见里面打扫干净，修饰好了，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>When it arrives, it finds the house swept clean and put in order.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when it comes, it finds the house swept and put in order.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he comes, he finds it swept and put in order.
verses.textEnNlt: So it returns and finds that its former home is all swept and in order.
verses.textEnNasb: And when it comes, it finds it swept and put in order.
verses.textEn: <red>When it arrives, it finds the house swept clean and put in order.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他就去带了另外七个比自己更恶的污灵来，进去住在那里；那人后来的情况，比以前更坏了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他就去带了另外七个比自己更恶的污灵来，进去住在那里；那人后来的情况，比以前更坏了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>便去另带了七个比自己更恶的鬼来，都进去住在那里。那人末后的景况比先前更不好了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Then it goes and takes seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and live there. And the final condition of that person is worse than the first.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then it goes and brings seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they enter and dwell there. And the last state of that person is worse than the first."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he goes and takes with him seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter and dwell there; and the last state of that man is worse than the first."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the spirit finds seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they all enter the person and live there. And so that person is worse off than before."
verses.textEnNasb: Then it goes and brings along seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they come in and live there; and the last condition of that person becomes worse than the first."
verses.textEn: <red>Then it goes and takes seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and live there. And the final condition of that person is worse than the first.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣正说这些话的时候，群众中有一个女人高声对他说："怀你胎的和哺养你的有福了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣正说这些话的时候，群众中有一个女人高声对他说："怀你胎的和哺养你的有福了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣正说这话的时候，众人中间有一个女人大声说：「怀你胎的和乳养你的有福了！」
verses.textEnNiv: As Jesus was saying these things, a woman in the crowd called out, "Blessed is the mother who gave you birth and nursed you."
verses.textEnEsv: As he said these things, a woman in the crowd raised her voice and said to him, "Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts at which you nursed!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, as He spoke these things, that a certain woman from the crowd raised her voice and said to Him, "Blessed is the womb that bore You, and the breasts which nursed You!"
verses.textEnNlt: As he was speaking, a woman in the crowd called out, "God bless your mother—the womb from which you came, and the breasts that nursed you!"
verses.textEnNasb: While Jesus was saying these things, one of the women in the crowd raised her voice and said to Him, "Blessed is the womb that carried You, and the breasts at which You nursed!"
verses.textEn: As Jesus was saying these things, a woman in the crowd called out, "Blessed is the mother who gave you birth and nursed you."

verses.textZh: 他说："<red>是的，却还不如听神的道而遵守的人有福。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："<red>是的，却还不如听神的道而遵守的人有福。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>是，却还不如听神之道而遵守的人有福。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, <red>“Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he said, "Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and keep it!"
verses.textEnNkjv: But He said, "More than that, blessed are those who hear the word of God and keep it!"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "But even more blessed are all who hear the word of God and put it into practice."
verses.textEnNasb: But He said, "On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God and follow it."
verses.textEn: He replied, <red>“Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.”</red>

verses.textZh: 众人聚集的时候，耶稣就说："<red>这世代是个邪恶的世代。这世代寻求神迹，可是除了约拿的神迹以外，再没有神迹给他们了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人聚集的时候，耶稣就说："<red>这世代是个邪恶的世代。这世代寻求神迹，可是除了约拿的神迹以外，再没有神迹给他们了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>当众人聚集的时候，耶稣开讲说：「这世代是一个邪恶的世代。他们求看神迹，除了约拿的神迹以外，再没有神迹给他们看。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: As the crowds increased, Jesus said, <red>“This is a wicked generation. It asks for a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When the crowds were increasing, he began to say, "This generation is an evil generation. It seeks for a sign, but no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And while the crowds were thickly gathered together, He began to say, "This is an evil generation. It seeks a sign, and no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah the prophet.
verses.textEnNlt: As the crowd pressed in on Jesus, he said, "This evil generation keeps asking me to show them a miraculous sign. But the only sign I will give them is the sign of Jonah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as the crowds were increasing, He began to say, "This generation is a wicked generation; it demands a sign, and so no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah.
verses.textEn: As the crowds increased, Jesus said, <red>“This is a wicked generation. It asks for a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>约拿怎样成了尼尼微人的神迹，人子也照样成为这个世代的神迹。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>约拿怎样成了尼尼微人的神迹，人子也照样成为这个世代的神迹。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>约拿怎样为尼尼微人成了神迹，人子也要照样为这世代的人成了神迹。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so also will the Son of Man be to this generation.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For as Jonah became a sign to the people of Nineveh, so will the Son of Man be to this generation.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so also the Son of Man will be to this generation.
verses.textEnNlt: What happened to him was a sign to the people of Nineveh that God had sent him. What happens to the Son of Man will be a sign to these people that he was sent by God.
verses.textEnNasb: For just as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so will the Son of Man be to this generation.
verses.textEn: <red>For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so also will the Son of Man be to this generation.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>审判的时候，南方的女王要和这世代的人一同起来，她要定他们的罪，因为她从地极来到，要听所罗门智慧的话。你看，这里有一位是比所罗门更大的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>审判的时候，南方的女王要和这世代的人一同起来，她要定他们的罪，因为她从地极来到，要听所罗门智慧的话。你看，这里有一位是比所罗门更大的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>当审判的时候，南方的女王要起来定这世代的罪；因为她从地极而来，要听所罗门的智慧话。看哪，在这里有一人比所罗门更大。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with the people of this generation and condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to listen to Solomon’s wisdom; and now something greater than Solomon is here.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The queen of the South will rise up at the judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and behold, something greater than Solomon is here.
verses.textEnNkjv: The queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and indeed a greater than Solomon is here.
verses.textEnNlt: "The queen of Sheba will stand up against this generation on judgment day and condemn it, for she came from a distant land to hear the wisdom of Solomon. Now someone greater than Solomon is here—but you refuse to listen.
verses.textEnNasb: The Queen of the South will rise up with the men of this generation at the judgment and condemn them, because she came from the ends of the earth to listen to the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, something greater than Solomon is here.
verses.textEn: <red>The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with the people of this generation and condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to listen to Solomon’s wisdom; and now something greater than Solomon is here.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>审判的时候，尼尼微人要和这世代的人一同起来，他们要定这个世代的罪，因为尼尼微人听了约拿所传的就悔改了。你看，这里有一位是比约拿更大的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>审判的时候，尼尼微人要和这世代的人一同起来，他们要定这个世代的罪，因为尼尼微人听了约拿所传的就悔改了。你看，这里有一位是比约拿更大的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>当审判的时候，尼尼微人要起来定这世代的罪，因为尼尼微人听了约拿所传的就悔改了。看哪，在这里有一人比约拿更大。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The men of Nineveh will stand up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and now something greater than Jonah is here.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The men of Nineveh will rise up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and behold, something greater than Jonah is here.
verses.textEnNkjv: The men of Nineveh will rise up in the judgment with this generation and condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and indeed a greater than Jonah is here.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Nineveh will also stand up against this generation on judgment day and condemn it, for they repented of their sins at the preaching of Jonah. Now someone greater than Jonah is here—but you refuse to repent.
verses.textEnNasb: The men of Nineveh will stand up with this generation at the judgment and condemn it, because they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, something greater than Jonah is here.
verses.textEn: <red>The men of Nineveh will stand up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and now something greater than Jonah is here.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"没有人点了灯，把它放在地窖里，或量器底下，却放在灯台上，叫进来的人看得见光。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"没有人点了灯，把它放在地窖里，或量器底下，却放在灯台上，叫进来的人看得见光。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「没有人点灯放在地窨子里，或是斗底下，总是放在灯台上，使进来的人得见亮光。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Nop one lights a lamp and puts it in a place where it will be hidden, or under a bowl. Instead they put it on its stand, so that those who come in may see the light.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "No one after lighting a lamp puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, so that those who enter may see the light.
verses.textEnNkjv: "No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a secret place or under a basket, but on a lampstand, that those who come in may see the light.
verses.textEnNlt: "No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a basket. Instead, a lamp is placed on a stand, where its light can be seen by all who enter the house.
verses.textEnNasb: "No one lights a lamp and puts it away in a cellar nor under a basket, but on the lampstand, so that those who enter may see the light.
verses.textEn: <red>“Nop one lights a lamp and puts it in a place where it will be hidden, or under a bowl. Instead they put it on its stand, so that those who come in may see the light.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你的眼睛就是你身体的灯，你的眼睛健全，全身就明亮；如果不健全，全身就黑暗。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你的眼睛就是你身体的灯，你的眼睛健全，全身就明亮；如果不健全，全身就黑暗。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你眼睛就是身上的灯。你的眼睛若了亮，全身就光明；眼睛若昏花，全身就黑暗。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eyes are healthy, your whole body also is full of light. But when they are unhealthy, your body also is full of darkness.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eye is healthy, your whole body is full of light, but when it is bad, your body is full of darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore, when your eye is good, your whole body also is full of light. But when your eye is bad, your body also is full of darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: "Your eye is like a lamp that provides light for your body. When your eye is healthy, your whole body is filled with light. But when it is unhealthy, your body is filled with darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: Your eye is the lamp of your body; when your eye is clear, your whole body also is full of light; but when it is bad, your body also is full of darkness.
verses.textEn: <red>Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eyes are healthy, your whole body also is full of light. But when they are unhealthy, your body also is full of darkness.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以要谨慎，免得你里面的光黑暗了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以要谨慎，免得你里面的光黑暗了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以，你要省察，恐怕你里头的光或者黑暗了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>See to it, then, that the light within you is not darkness.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore be careful lest the light in you be darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore take heed that the light which is in you is not darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: Make sure that the light you think you have is not actually darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: So watch out that the light in you is not darkness.
verses.textEn: <red>See to it, then, that the light within you is not darkness.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你若全身明亮，没有一点黑暗，你就完全明亮，好象明亮的灯光照你一样。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你若全身明亮，没有一点黑暗，你就完全明亮，好象明亮的灯光照你一样。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若是你全身光明，毫无黑暗，就必全然光明，如同灯的明光照亮你。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Therefore, if your whole body is full of light, and no part of it dark, it will be just as full of light as when a lamp shines its light on you.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If then your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly bright, as when a lamp with its rays gives you light."
verses.textEnNkjv: If then your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, the whole body will be full of light, as when the bright shining of a lamp gives you light."
verses.textEnNlt: If you are filled with light, with no dark corners, then your whole life will be radiant, as though a floodlight were filling you with light."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore if your whole body is full of light, without any dark part, it will be wholly illuminated, as when the lamp illuminates you with its light."
verses.textEn: <red>Therefore, if your whole body is full of light, and no part of it dark, it will be just as full of light as when a lamp shines its light on you.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣说话的时候，有一个法利赛人请耶稣和他一起吃饭；他就进去坐席。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说话的时候，有一个法利赛人请耶稣和他一起吃饭；他就进去坐席。
verses.textZhCuv: 说话的时候，有一个法利赛人请耶稣同他吃饭，耶稣就进去坐席。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus had finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him to eat with him; so he went in and reclined at the table.
verses.textEnEsv: While Jesus was speaking, a Pharisee asked him to dine with him, so he went in and reclined at table.
