verses.textEnNkjv: And as He spoke, a certain Pharisee asked Him to dine with him. So He went in and sat down to eat.
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus was speaking, one of the Pharisees invited him home for a meal. So he went in and took his place at the table.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when He had spoken, a Pharisee *asked Him to have lunch with him; and He went in and reclined at the table.
verses.textEn: When Jesus had finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him to eat with him; so he went in and reclined at the table.

verses.textZh: 这个法利赛人见耶稣吃饭之前不洗手，觉得奇怪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这个法利赛人见耶稣吃饭之前不洗手，觉得奇怪。
verses.textZhCuv: 这法利赛人看见耶稣饭前不洗手便诧异。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Pharisee was surprised when he noticed that Jesus did not first wash before the meal.
verses.textEnEsv: The Pharisee was astonished to see that he did not first wash before dinner.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that He had not first washed before dinner.
verses.textEnNlt: His host was amazed to see that he sat down to eat without first performing the hand-washing ceremony required by Jewish custom.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Pharisee saw this, he was surprised that Jesus had not first ceremonially washed before the meal.
verses.textEn: But the Pharisee was surprised when he noticed that Jesus did not first wash before the meal.

verses.textZh: 主对他说："<red>你们法利赛人把杯盘的外面洗净，但你们里面却充满了抢夺和邪恶。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 主对他说："<red>你们法利赛人把杯盘的外面洗净，但你们里面却充满了抢夺和邪恶。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主对他说：「如今你们法利赛人洗净杯盘的外面，你们里面却满了勒索和邪恶。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to him, <red>“Now then, you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to him, "Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to him, "Now you Pharisees make the outside of the cup and dish clean, but your inward part is full of greed and wickedness.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to him, "You Pharisees are so careful to clean the outside of the cup and the dish, but inside you are filthy—full of greed and wickedness!
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to him, "Now you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and of the dish; but your inside is full of greed and wickedness.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to him, <red>“Now then, you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>无知的人哪，那造外面的，不也造里面吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>无知的人哪，那造外面的，不也造里面吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>无知的人哪，造外面的，不也造里面吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You foolish people! Did not the one who made the outside make the inside also?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You fools! Did not he who made the outside make the inside also?
verses.textEnNkjv: Foolish ones! Did not He who made the outside make the inside also?
verses.textEnNlt: Fools! Didn’t God make the inside as well as the outside?
verses.textEnNasb: You foolish ones, did He who made the outside not make the inside also?
verses.textEn: <red>You foolish people! Did not the one who made the outside make the inside also?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>只要把里面的施舍出去，你们的一切就都洁净了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>只要把里面的施舍出去，你们的一切就都洁净了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只要把里面的施舍给人，凡物于你们就都洁净了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But now as for what is inside you—be generous to the poor, and everything will be clean for you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But give as alms those things that are within, and behold, everything is clean for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But rather give alms of such things as you have; then indeed all things are clean to you.
verses.textEnNlt: So clean the inside by giving gifts to the poor, and you will be clean all over.
verses.textEnNasb: But give that which is within as a charitable gift, and then all things are clean for you.
verses.textEn: <red>But now as for what is inside you—be generous to the poor, and everything will be clean for you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而你们法利赛人有祸了！因为你们把薄荷、茴香和各样菜蔬献上十分之一，却把公义和爱神的事疏忽了；这些是你们应当作的，但其他的也不可疏忽。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而你们法利赛人有祸了！因为你们把薄荷、茴香和各样菜蔬献上十分之一，却把公义和爱神的事疏忽了；这些是你们应当作的，但其他的也不可疏忽。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们法利赛人有祸了！因为你们将薄荷、芸香并各样菜蔬献上十分之一，那公义和爱神的事反倒不行了。这原是你们当行的；那也是不可不行的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woep to you Pharisees, because you give God a tenth of your mint, rue and all other kinds of garden herbs, but you neglect justice and the love of God. You should have practiced the latter without leaving the former undone.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, and neglect justice and the love of God. These you ought to have done, without neglecting the others.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass by justice and the love of God. These you ought to have done, without leaving the others undone.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you Pharisees! For you are careful to tithe even the tiniest income from your herb gardens, but you ignore justice and the love of God. You should tithe, yes, but do not neglect the more important things.
verses.textEnNasb: "But woe to you Pharisees! For you pay tithes of mint, rue, and every kind of garden herb, and yet you ignore justice and the love of God; but these are the things you should have done without neglecting the others.
verses.textEn: <red>“Woep to you Pharisees, because you give God a tenth of your mint, rue and all other kinds of garden herbs, but you neglect justice and the love of God. You should have practiced the latter without leaving the former undone.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们法利赛人有祸了！因为你们喜爱会堂里的高位和人在巿中心的问安。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们法利赛人有祸了！因为你们喜爱会堂里的高位和人在巿中心的问安。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们法利赛人有祸了！因为你们喜爱会堂里的首位，又喜爱人在街市上问你们的安。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woep to you Pharisees, because you love the most important seats in the synagogues and respectful greetings in the marketplaces.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seat in the synagogues and greetings in the marketplaces.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and greetings in the marketplaces.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you Pharisees! For you love to sit in the seats of honor in the synagogues and receive respectful greetings as you walk in the marketplaces.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the seat of honor in the synagogues and personal greetings in the marketplaces.
verses.textEn: <red>“Woep to you Pharisees, because you love the most important seats in the synagogues and respectful greetings in the marketplaces.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们有祸了！因为你们好象不显露的坟墓，走在上面的人并不知道。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们有祸了！因为你们好象不显露的坟墓，走在上面的人并不知道。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们有祸了！因为你们如同不显露的坟墓，走在上面的人并不知道。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woep to you, because you are like unmarked graves, which people walk over without knowing it.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to you! For you are like unmarked graves, and people walk over them without knowing it."
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like graves which are not seen, and the men who walk over them are not aware of them."
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, what sorrow awaits you! For you are like hidden graves in a field. People walk over them without knowing the corruption they are stepping on."
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to you! For you are like unseen tombs, and the people who walk over them are unaware of it."
verses.textEn: <red>“Woep to you, because you are like unmarked graves, which people walk over without knowing it.”</red>

verses.textZh: 律法师中有一个回答他："老师，你这样说，把我们也侮辱了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 律法师中有一个回答他："老师，你这样说，把我们也侮辱了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 律法师中有一个回答耶稣说：「夫子！你这样说也把我们糟蹋了。」
verses.textEnNiv: One of the experts in the law answered him, "Teacher, when you say these things, you insult us also."
verses.textEnEsv: One of the lawyers answered him, "Teacher, in saying these things you insult us also."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one of the lawyers answered and said to Him, "Teacher, by saying these things You reproach us also."
verses.textEnNlt: "Teacher," said an expert in religious law, "you have insulted us, too, in what you just said."
verses.textEnNasb: One of the lawyers *said to Him in reply, "Teacher, when You say these things, You insult us too."
verses.textEn: One of the experts in the law answered him, "Teacher, when you say these things, you insult us also."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>你们律法师也有祸了，因为你们把难担的担子叫人担，自己连一个指头也不动。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>你们律法师也有祸了，因为你们把难担的担子叫人担，自己连一个指头也不动。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「你们律法师也有祸了！因为你们把难担的担子放在人身上，自己一个指头却不肯动。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“And you experts in the law, woe to you, because you load people down with burdens they can hardly carry, and you yourselves will not lift one finger to help them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Woe to you lawyers also! For you load people with burdens hard to bear, and you yourselves do not touch the burdens with one of your fingers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "Woe to you also, lawyers! For you load men with burdens hard to bear, and you yourselves do not touch the burdens with one of your fingers.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes," said Jesus, "what sorrow also awaits you experts in religious law! For you crush people with unbearable religious demands, and you never lift a finger to ease the burden.
verses.textEnNasb: But He said, "Woe to you lawyers as well! For you load people with burdens that are hard to bear, while you yourselves will not even touch the burdens with one of your fingers.
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“And you experts in the law, woe to you, because you load people down with burdens they can hardly carry, and you yourselves will not lift one finger to help them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们有祸了！因为你们修造先知的坟墓，而那些先知正是你们祖先所杀的，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们有祸了！因为你们修造先知的坟墓，而那些先知正是你们祖先所杀的，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们有祸了！因为你们修造先知的坟墓，那先知正是你们的祖宗所杀的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woep to you, because you build tombs for the prophets, and it was your ancestors who killed them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets whom your fathers killed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits you! For you build monuments for the prophets your own ancestors killed long ago.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and it was your fathers who killed them.
verses.textEn: <red>“Woep to you, because you build tombs for the prophets, and it was your ancestors who killed them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这样，你们就成了证人，对你们祖先的作为表示同意；他们杀害先知，你们修造先知的坟墓。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这样，你们就成了证人，对你们祖先的作为表示同意；他们杀害先知，你们修造先知的坟墓。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>可见你们祖宗所做的事，你们又证明又喜欢；因为他们杀了先知，你们修造先知的坟墓。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So you testify that you approve of what your ancestors did; they killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So you are witnesses and you consent to the deeds of your fathers, for they killed them, and you build their tombs.
verses.textEnNkjv: In fact, you bear witness that you approve the deeds of your fathers; for they indeed killed them, and you build their tombs.
verses.textEnNlt: But in fact, you stand as witnesses who agree with what your ancestors did. They killed the prophets, and you join in their crime by building the monuments!
verses.textEnNasb: So you are witnesses and you approve of the deeds of your fathers; because it was they who killed them, and you build their tombs.
verses.textEn: <red>So you testify that you approve of what your ancestors did; they killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以，神的智慧说：‘我要差遣先知和使徒到他们那里去，有的他们要杀害，有的他们要迫害，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以，神的智慧说：‘我要差遣先知和使徒到他们那里去，有的他们要杀害，有的他们要迫害，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>所以神用智慧 曾说：『我要差遣先知和使徒到他们那里去，有的他们要杀害，有的他们要逼迫』，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Because of this, God in his wisdom said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles, some of whom they will kill and others they will persecute.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore also the Wisdom of God said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles, some of whom they will kill and persecute,’
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the wisdom of God also said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they will kill and persecute,’
verses.textEnNlt: This is what God in his wisdom said about you: ‘I will send prophets and apostles to them, but they will kill some and persecute the others.’
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason also, the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they will kill, and some they will persecute,
verses.textEn: <red>Because of this, God in his wisdom said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles, some of whom they will kill and others they will persecute.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们律法师有祸了！因为你们拿去知识的钥匙，自己不进去，又阻止要进去的人。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们律法师有祸了！因为你们拿去知识的钥匙，自己不进去，又阻止要进去的人。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>使创世以来所流众先知血的罪都要问在这世代的人身上，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Therefore this generation will be held responsible for the blood of all the prophets that has been shed since the beginning of the world,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: so that the blood of all the prophets, shed from the foundation of the world, may be charged against this generation,
verses.textEnNkjv: that the blood of all the prophets which was shed from the foundation of the world may be required of this generation,
verses.textEnNlt: "As a result, this generation will be held responsible for the murder of all God’s prophets from the creation of the world—
verses.textEnNasb: so that the blood of all the prophets, shed since the foundation of the world, may be charged against this generation,
verses.textEn: <red>Therefore this generation will be held responsible for the blood of all the prophets that has been shed since the beginning of the world,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣从那里出来，经学家和法利赛人非常敌视他，质问他很多问题，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣从那里出来，经学家和法利赛人非常敌视他，质问他很多问题，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>就是从亚伯的血起，直到被杀在坛和殿中间撒迦利亚的血为止。我实在告诉你们，这都要问在这世代的人身上。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, I tell you, this generation will be held responsible for it all.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.
verses.textEnNkjv: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah who perished between the altar and the temple. Yes, I say to you, it shall be required of this generation.
verses.textEnNlt: from the murder of Abel to the murder of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, it will certainly be charged against this generation.
verses.textEnNasb: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the house of God; yes, I tell you, it shall be charged against this generation.’
verses.textEn: <red>from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, I tell you, this generation will be held responsible for it all.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>等机会从他的口中找把柄。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>等机会从他的口中找把柄。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们律法师有祸了！因为你们把知识的钥匙夺了去，自己不进去，正要进去的人你们也阻挡他们。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Woep to you experts in the law, because you have taken away the key to knowledge. You yourselves have not entered, and you have hindered those who were entering.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to you lawyers! For you have taken away the key of knowledge. You did not enter yourselves, and you hindered those who were entering."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to you lawyers! For you have taken away the key of knowledge. You did not enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in you hindered."
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you experts in religious law! For you remove the key to knowledge from the people. You don’t enter the Kingdom yourselves, and you prevent others from entering."
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to you lawyers! For you have taken away the key of knowledge; you yourselves did not enter, and you hindered those who were entering."
verses.textEn: <red>“Woep to you experts in the law, because you have taken away the key to knowledge. You yourselves have not entered, and you have hindered those who were entering.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣从那里出来，文士和法利赛人就极力地催逼他，引动他多说话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣从那里出来，文士和法利赛人就极力地催逼他，引动他多说话，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣从那里出来，文士和法利赛人就极力地催逼他，引动他多说话，
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus went outside, the Pharisees and the teachers of the law began to oppose him fiercely and to besiege him with questions,
verses.textEnEsv: As he went away from there, the scribes and the Pharisees began to press him hard and to provoke him to speak about many things,
verses.textEnNkjv: And as He said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to assail Him vehemently, and to cross-examine Him about many things,
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus was leaving, the teachers of religious law and the Pharisees became hostile and tried to provoke him with many questions.
verses.textEnNasb: When He left that place, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be very hostile and to interrogate Him about many subjects,
verses.textEn: When Jesus went outside, the Pharisees and the teachers of the law began to oppose him fiercely and to besiege him with questions,

verses.textZh: 私下窥听，要拿他的话柄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 私下窥听，要拿他的话柄。
verses.textZhCuv: 私下窥听，要拿他的话柄。
verses.textEnNiv: waiting to catch him in something he might say.
verses.textEnEsv: lying in wait for him, to catch him in something he might say.
verses.textEnNkjv: lying in wait for Him, and seeking to catch Him in something He might say, that they might accuse Him.
verses.textEnNlt: They wanted to trap him into saying something they could use against him.
verses.textEnNasb: plotting against Him to catch Him in something He might say.
verses.textEn: waiting to catch him in something he might say.

verses.textZh: 那时有成千上万的人聚在一起，甚至彼此践踏。耶稣就先对门徒说："<red>你们要提防法利赛人的酵，就是虚伪。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时有成千上万的人聚在一起，甚至彼此践踏。耶稣就先对门徒说："<red>你们要提防法利赛人的酵，就是虚伪。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这时，有几万人聚集，甚至彼此践踏。耶稣开讲，先对门徒说：「你们要防备法利赛人的酵，就是假冒为善。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, when a crowd of many thousands had gathered, so that they were trampling on one another, Jesus began to speak first to his disciples, saying: <red>“Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: In the meantime, when so many thousands of the people had gathered together that they were trampling one another, he began to say to his disciples first, "Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the meantime, when an innumerable multitude of people had gathered together, so that they trampled one another, He began to say to His disciples first ofall, "Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the crowds grew until thousands were milling about and stepping on each other. Jesus turned first to his disciples and warned them, "Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees—their hypocrisy.
verses.textEnNasb: Under these circumstances, after so many thousands of people had gathered together that they were stepping on one another, He began saying to His disciples first of all,"Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, when a crowd of many thousands had gathered, so that they were trampling on one another, Jesus began to speak first to his disciples, saying: <red>“Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>没有甚么掩盖的事不被揭露，也没有甚么隐藏的事不被人知道。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>没有甚么掩盖的事不被揭露，也没有甚么隐藏的事不被人知道。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>掩盖的事没有不露出来的；隐藏的事没有不被人知道的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, or hidden that will not be made known.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Nothing is covered up that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.
verses.textEnNkjv: For there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.
verses.textEnNlt: The time is coming when everything that is covered up will be revealed, and all that is secret will be made known to all.
verses.textEnNasb: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, and hidden that will not be known.
verses.textEn: <red>There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, or hidden that will not be made known.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>所以，你们在暗处所说的，必在明处被人听见；在内室附耳所谈的，必在房顶上宣扬出来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>所以，你们在暗处所说的，必在明处被人听见；在内室附耳所谈的，必在房顶上宣扬出来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因此，你们在暗中所说的，将要在明处被人听见；在内室附耳所说的，将要在房上被人宣扬。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>What you have said in the dark will be heard in the daylight, and what you have whispered in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed from the roofs.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore whatever you have said in the dark shall be heard in the light, and what you have whispered in private rooms shall be proclaimed on the housetops.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore whatever you have spoken in the dark will be heard in the light, and what you have spoken in the ear in inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.
verses.textEnNlt: Whatever you have said in the dark will be heard in the light, and what you have whispered behind closed doors will be shouted from the housetops for all to hear!
verses.textEnNasb: Accordingly, whatever you have said in the dark will be heard in the light, and what you have whispered in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.
verses.textEn: <red>What you have said in the dark will be heard in the daylight, and what you have whispered in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed from the roofs.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"我的朋友，我告诉你们，那杀身体以后不能再作甚么的，不要怕他们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我的朋友，我告诉你们，那杀身体以后不能再作甚么的，不要怕他们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「我的朋友，我对你们说，那杀身体以后不能再做什么的，不要怕他们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Ip tell you, my friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "I tell you, my friends, do not fear those who kill the body, and after that have nothing more that they can do.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And I say to you, My friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
verses.textEnNlt: "Dear friends, don’t be afraid of those who want to kill your body; they cannot do any more to you after that.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now I say to you, My friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have nothing more that they can do.
verses.textEn: <red>“Ip tell you, my friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我要指示你们当怕的是谁：当怕那杀身体以后，有权把人投入地狱里的；我告诉你们，应当怕他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我要指示你们当怕的是谁：当怕那杀身体以后，有权把人投入地狱里的；我告诉你们，应当怕他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我要指示你们当怕的是谁：当怕那杀了以后又有权柄丢在地狱里的。我实在告诉你们，正要怕他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear him who, after your body has been killed, has authority to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But I will warn you whom to fear: fear him who, after he has killed, has authority to cast into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear him!
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear Him who, after He has killed, has power to cast into hell; yes, I say to you, fear Him!
verses.textEnNlt: But I’ll tell you whom to fear. Fear God, who has the power to kill you and then throw you into hell. Yes, he’s the one to fear.
verses.textEnNasb: But I will warn you whom to fear: fear the One who, after He has killed someone, has the power to throw that person into hell; yes, I tell you, fear Him!
verses.textEn: <red>But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear him who, after your body has been killed, has authority to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>五只麻雀，不是卖两个大钱吗？但在神面前，一只也不被忘记。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>五只麻雀，不是卖两个大钱吗？但在神面前，一只也不被忘记。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>五个麻雀不是卖二分银子吗？但在神面前，一个也不忘记；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? And not one of them is forgotten before God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Are not five sparrows sold for two copper coins? And not one of them is forgotten before God.
verses.textEnNlt: "What is the price of five sparrows—two copper coins ? Yet God does not forget a single one of them.
verses.textEnNasb: Are five sparrows not sold for two assaria? And yet not one of them has gone unnoticed in the sight of God.
verses.textEn: <red>Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>甚至你们的头发都一一数过了。不要怕，你们比许多麻雀贵重得多呢。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>甚至你们的头发都一一数过了。不要怕，你们比许多麻雀贵重得多呢。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>就是你们的头发，也都被数过了。不要惧怕，你们比许多麻雀还贵重！」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Indeed, the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Don’t be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Why, even the hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not; you are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Do not fear therefore; you are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.textEnNlt: And the very hairs on your head are all numbered. So don’t be afraid; you are more valuable to God than a whole flock of sparrows.
verses.textEnNasb: But even the hairs of your head are all counted. Do not fear; you are more valuable than a great number of sparrows.
verses.textEn: <red>Indeed, the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Don’t be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"我告诉你们，凡在人面前承认我的，人子在神的使者面前也承认他；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我告诉你们，凡在人面前承认我的，人子在神的使者面前也承认他；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「我又告诉你们，凡在人面前认我的，人子在神的使者面前也必认他；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Ip tell you, whoever publicly acknowledges me before others, the Son of Man will also acknowledge before the angels of God.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "And I tell you, everyone who acknowledges me before men, the Son of Man also will acknowledge before the angels of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also I say to you, whoever confesses Me before men, him the Son of Man also will confess before the angels of God.
verses.textEnNlt: "I tell you the truth, everyone who acknowledges me publicly here on earth, the Son of Man will also acknowledge in the presence of God’s angels.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now I say to you, everyone who confesses Me before people, the Son of Man will also confess him before the angels of God;
verses.textEn: <red>“Ip tell you, whoever publicly acknowledges me before others, the Son of Man will also acknowledge before the angels of God.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在人面前不认我的，我在神的使者面前也不认他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在人面前不认我的，我在神的使者面前也不认他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>在人面前不认我的，人子在神的使者面前也必不认他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But whoever disowns me before others will be disowned before the angels of God.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but the one who denies me before men will be denied before the angels of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who denies Me before men will be denied before the angels of God.
verses.textEnNlt: But anyone who denies me here on earth will be denied before God’s angels.
verses.textEnNasb: but the one who denies Me before people will be denied before the angels of God.
verses.textEn: <red>But whoever disowns me before others will be disowned before the angels of God.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡说话得罪人子的，还可以赦免；但亵渎圣灵的，必不得赦免。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡说话得罪人子的，还可以赦免；但亵渎圣灵的，必不得赦免。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡说话干犯人子的，还可得赦免；惟独亵渎圣灵的，总不得赦免。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but anyone who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but the one who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And anyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but to him who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who speaks against the Son of Man can be forgiven, but anyone who blasphemes the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
verses.textEnNasb: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but the one who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him.
verses.textEn: <red>And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but anyone who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人把你们拉到会堂、官长和当权者的面前，你们不要思虑怎样申辩或说甚么话。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人把你们拉到会堂、官长和当权者的面前，你们不要思虑怎样申辩或说甚么话。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人带你们到会堂，并官府和有权柄的人面前，不要思虑怎么分诉，说什么话；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whenp you are brought before synagogues, rulers and authorities, do not worry about how you will defend yourselves or what you will say,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when they bring you before the synagogues and the rulers and the authorities, do not be anxious about how you should defend yourself or what you should say,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now when they bring you to the synagogues and magistrates and authorities, do not worry about how or what you should answer, or what you should say.
verses.textEnNlt: "And when you are brought to trial in the synagogues and before rulers and authorities, don’t worry about how to defend yourself or what to say,
verses.textEnNasb: Now when they bring you before the synagogues and the officials and the authorities, do not worry about how or what you are to speak in your defense, or what you are to say;
verses.textEn: <red>“Whenp you are brought before synagogues, rulers and authorities, do not worry about how you will defend yourselves or what you will say,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>到了时候，圣灵必把当说的话教导你们。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>到了时候，圣灵必把当说的话教导你们。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为正在那时候，圣灵要指教你们当说的话。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>for the Holy Spirit will teach you at that time what you should say.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that very hour what you ought to say."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Holy Spirit will teach you in that very hour what you ought to say."
verses.textEnNlt: for the Holy Spirit will teach you at that time what needs to be said."
verses.textEnNasb: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that very hour what you ought to say."
verses.textEn: <red>for the Holy Spirit will teach you at that time what you should say.”</red>

verses.textZh: 群众中有一个人对耶稣说："老师，请吩咐我的兄弟和我分家业。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众中有一个人对耶稣说："老师，请吩咐我的兄弟和我分家业。"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人中有一个人对耶稣说：「夫子！请你吩咐我的兄长和我分开家业。」
verses.textEnNiv: Someone in the crowd said to him, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."
verses.textEnEsv: Someone in the crowd said to him, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one from the crowd said to Him, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."
verses.textEnNlt: Then someone called from the crowd, "Teacher, please tell my brother to divide our father’s estate with me."
verses.textEnNasb: Now someone in the crowd said to Him, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the family inheritance with me."
verses.textEn: Someone in the crowd said to him, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>你这个人，谁立我作你们的审判官和分家业的人呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>你这个人，谁立我作你们的审判官和分家业的人呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你这个人！谁立我作你们断事的官，给你们分家业呢？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“Man, who appointed me a judge or an arbiter between you?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he said to him, "Man, who made me a judge or arbitrator over you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But He said to him, "Man, who made Me a judge or an arbitrator over you?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "Friend, who made me a judge over you to decide such things as that?"
verses.textEnNasb: But He said to him, " You there—who appointed Me a judge or arbitrator over the two of you?"
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“Man, who appointed me a judge or an arbiter between you?”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是他对众人说："<red>你们要谨慎，远离一切贪心，因为人的生命并不在于家道丰富。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他对众人说："<red>你们要谨慎，远离一切贪心，因为人的生命并不在于家道丰富。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是对众人说：「<red>你们要谨慎自守，免去一切的贪心，因为人的生命不在乎家道丰富。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to them, <red>“Watch out! Be on your guard against all kinds of greed; life does not consist in an abundance of possessions.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Take care, and be on your guard against all covetousness, for one’s life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Take heed and beware of covetousness, for one’s life does not consist in the abundance of the things he possesses."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "Beware! Guard against every kind of greed. Life is not measured by how much you own."
verses.textEnNasb: But He said to them, "Beware, and be on your guard against every form of greed; for not even when one is affluent does his life consist of his possessions."
verses.textEn: Then he said to them, <red>“Watch out! Be on your guard against all kinds of greed; life does not consist in an abundance of possessions.”</red>

verses.textZh: 就对他们讲了一个比喻，说："<red>有一个富翁的田地丰收。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 就对他们讲了一个比喻，说："<red>有一个富翁的田地丰收。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>就用比喻对他们说：「有一个财主田产丰盛；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: And he told them this parable: <red>“The ground of a certain rich man yielded an abundant harvest.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he told them a parable, saying, "The land of a rich man produced plentifully,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He spoke a parable to them, saying: "The ground of a certain rich man yielded plentifully.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he told them a story: "A rich man had a fertile farm that produced fine crops.
verses.textEnNasb: And He told them a parable, saying, "The land of a rich man was very productive.
verses.textEn: And he told them this parable: <red>“The ground of a certain rich man yielded an abundant harvest.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他自己心里说：‘怎么办呢？因为我没有足够的地方收藏出产了！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他自己心里说：‘怎么办呢？因为我没有足够的地方收藏出产了！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>自己心里思想说：『我的出产没有地方收藏，怎么办呢？』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He thought to himself, ‘What shall I do? I have no place to store my crops.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and he thought to himself, ‘What shall I do, for I have nowhere to store my crops?’
verses.textEnNkjv: And he thought within himself, saying, ‘What shall I do, since I have no room to store my crops?’
verses.textEnNlt: He said to himself, ‘What should I do? I don’t have room for all my crops.’
verses.textEnNasb: And he began thinking to himself, saying, ‘What shall I do, since I have no place to store my crops?’
verses.textEn: <red>He thought to himself, ‘What shall I do? I have no place to store my crops.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>又说：‘我要这样办：我要拆掉这些仓房，建造更大的，好在那里收藏我的一切粮食和货物。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>又说：‘我要这样办：我要拆掉这些仓房，建造更大的，好在那里收藏我的一切粮食和货物。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又说：『我要这么办：要把我的仓房拆了，另盖更大的，在那里好收藏我一切的粮食和财物，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thenp he said, ‘This is what I’ll do. I will tear down my barns and build bigger ones, and there I will store my surplus grain.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, ‘I will do this: I will tear down my barns and build larger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, ‘I will do this: I will pull down my barns and build greater, and there I will store all my crops and my goods.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, ‘I know! I’ll tear down my barns and build bigger ones. Then I’ll have room enough to store all my wheat and other goods.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, ‘This is what I will do: I will tear down my barns and build larger ones, and I will store all my grain and my goods there.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thenp he said, ‘This is what I’ll do. I will tear down my barns and build bigger ones, and there I will store my surplus grain.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然后，我要对我的灵魂说：灵魂啊，你拥有许多好东西，足够多年享用，只管安安逸逸地吃喝快乐吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然后，我要对我的灵魂说：灵魂啊，你拥有许多好东西，足够多年享用，只管安安逸逸地吃喝快乐吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>然后要对我的灵魂说：灵魂哪，你有许多财物积存，可作多年的费用，只管安安逸逸地吃喝快乐吧！』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And I’ll say to myself, “You have plenty of grain laid up for many years. Take life easy; eat, drink and be merry.” ’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And I will say to my soul, "Soul, you have ample goods laid up for many years; relax, eat, drink, be merry."’
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will say to my soul, "Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years; take your ease; eat, drink, and be merry." ’
verses.textEnNlt: And I’ll sit back and say to myself, "My friend, you have enough stored away for years to come. Now take it easy! Eat, drink, and be merry!"’
verses.textEnNasb: And I will say to myself, "You have many goods stored up for many years to come; relax, eat, drink, and enjoy yourself!" ’
verses.textEn: <red>And I’ll say to myself, “You have plenty of grain laid up for many years. Take life easy; eat, drink and be merry.” ’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>神却对他说：‘无知的人哪，今天晚上，你的灵魂必被取去，你所预备的要归给谁呢？’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>神却对他说：‘无知的人哪，今天晚上，你的灵魂必被取去，你所预备的要归给谁呢？’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>神却对他说：『无知的人哪，今夜必要你的灵魂；你所预备的要归谁呢？』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night your life will be demanded from you. Then who will get what you have prepared for yourself?’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But God said to him, ‘Fool! This night your soul is required of you, and the things you have prepared, whose will they be?’
verses.textEnNkjv: But God said to him, ‘Fool! This night your soul will be required of you; then whose will those things be which you have provided?’
verses.textEnNlt: "But God said to him, ‘You fool! You will die this very night. Then who will get everything you worked for?’
verses.textEnNasb: But God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night your soul is demanded of you; and as for all that you have prepared, who will own it now?’
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night your life will be demanded from you. Then who will get what you have prepared for yourself?’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡为自己积财，在神面前却不富足的，也是这样。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡为自己积财，在神面前却不富足的，也是这样。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡为自己积财，在神面前却不富足的，也是这样。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thisp is how it will be with whoever stores up things for themselves but is not rich toward God.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So is the one who lays up treasure for himself and is not rich toward God."
verses.textEnNkjv: "So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God."
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, a person is a fool to store up earthly wealth but not have a rich relationship with God."
verses.textEnNasb: Such is the one who stores up treasure for himself, and is not rich in relation to God."
verses.textEn: <red>“Thisp is how it will be with whoever stores up things for themselves but is not rich toward God.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对门徒说："<red>所以我告诉你们，不要为生命忧虑吃甚么，也不要为身体忧虑穿甚么。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对门徒说："<red>所以我告诉你们，不要为生命忧虑吃甚么，也不要为身体忧虑穿甚么。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣又对门徒说：「所以我告诉你们，不要为生命忧虑吃什么，为身体忧虑穿什么；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to his disciples: <red>“Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat; or about your body, what you will wear.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to his disciples, "Therefore I tell you, do not be anxious about your life, what you will eat, nor about your body, what you will put on.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to His disciples, "Therefore I say to you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat; nor about the body, what you will put on.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, turning to his disciples, Jesus said, "That is why I tell you not to worry about everyday life—whether you have enough food to eat or enough clothes to wear.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to His disciples, "For this reason I tell you, do not worry about your life, as to what you are to eat; nor for your body, as to what you are to wear.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to his disciples: <red>“Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat; or about your body, what you will wear.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为生命比饮食重要，身体比衣服重要。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为生命比饮食重要，身体比衣服重要。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为生命胜于饮食，身体胜于衣裳。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For life is more than food, and the body more than clothes.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For life is more than food, and the body more than clothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.
verses.textEnNlt: For life is more than food, and your body more than clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: For life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.
verses.textEn: <red>For life is more than food, and the body more than clothes.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们想想乌鸦：牠们不种也不收，无仓又无库，神尚且养活牠们；你们比飞鸟贵重得多了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们想想乌鸦：牠们不种也不收，无仓又无库，神尚且养活牠们；你们比飞鸟贵重得多了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你想乌鸦，也不种也不收，又没有仓又没有库，神尚且养活它。你们比飞鸟是何等地贵重呢！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storeroom or barn; yet God feeds them. And how much more valuable you are than birds!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Consider the ravens: they neither sow nor reap, they have neither storehouse nor barn, and yet God feeds them. Of how much more value are you than the birds!
verses.textEnNkjv: Consider the ravens, for they neither sow nor reap, which have neither storehouse nor barn; and God feeds them. Of how much more value are you than the birds?
verses.textEnNlt: Look at the ravens. They don’t plant or harvest or store food in barns, for God feeds them. And you are far more valuable to him than any birds!
verses.textEnNasb: Consider the ravens, that they neither sow nor reap; they have no storeroom nor barn, and yet God feeds them; how much more valuable you are than the birds!
verses.textEn: <red>Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storeroom or barn; yet God feeds them. And how much more valuable you are than birds!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们中间谁能用忧虑使自己的寿命延长一刻呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们中间谁能用忧虑使自己的寿命延长一刻呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们哪一个能用思虑使寿数多加一刻呢 ？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to your life?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And which of you by being anxious can add a single hour to his span of life?
verses.textEnNkjv: And which of you by worrying can add one cubit to his stature?
verses.textEnNlt: Can all your worries add a single moment to your life?
verses.textEnNasb: And which of you by worrying can add a day to his life’s span?
verses.textEn: <red>Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to your life?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>既然连这极小的事都不能作，为甚么还忧虑其他的事呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>既然连这极小的事都不能作，为甚么还忧虑其他的事呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这最小的事，你们尚且不能做，为什么还忧虑其余的事呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Since you cannot do this very little thing, why do you worry about the rest?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If then you are not able to do as small a thing as that, why are you anxious about the rest?
verses.textEnNkjv: If you then are not able to do the least, why are you anxious for the rest?
verses.textEnNlt: And if worry can’t accomplish a little thing like that, what’s the use of worrying over bigger things?
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore if you cannot do even a very little thing, why do you worry about the other things?
verses.textEn: <red>Since you cannot do this very little thing, why do you worry about the rest?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们想想百合花，怎样不劳苦，也不纺织。但我告诉你们，就是所罗门最荣华的时候所穿的，也比不上这花中的一朵呢。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们想想百合花，怎样不劳苦，也不纺织。但我告诉你们，就是所罗门最荣华的时候所穿的，也比不上这花中的一朵呢。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你想百合花怎么长起来；它也不劳苦，也不纺线。然而我告诉你们，就是所罗门极荣华的时候，他所穿戴的，还不如这花一朵呢！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Considerp how the wild flowers grow. They do not labor or spin. Yet I tell you, not even Solomon in all his splendor was dressed like one of these.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Consider the lilies, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin, yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.textEnNkjv: Consider the lilies, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin; and yet I say to you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look at the lilies and how they grow. They don’t work or make their clothing, yet Solomon in all his glory was not dressed as beautifully as they are.
verses.textEnNasb: Consider the lilies, how they grow: they neither labor nor spin; but I tell you, not even Solomon in all his glory clothed himself like one of these.
verses.textEn: <red>“Considerp how the wild flowers grow. They do not labor or spin. Yet I tell you, not even Solomon in all his splendor was dressed like one of these.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>小信的人哪，田野的草，今天还在，明天就投进炉里，神尚且这样给它装饰，何况你们呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>小信的人哪，田野的草，今天还在，明天就投进炉里，神尚且这样给它装饰，何况你们呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们这小信的人哪，野地里的草今天还在，明天就丢在炉里，神还给它这样的妆饰，何况你们呢！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today, and tomorrow is thrown into the fire, how much more will he clothe you—you of little faith!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But if God so clothes the grass, which is alive in the field today, and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith!
verses.textEnNkjv: If then God so clothes the grass, which today is in the field and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, how much more will He clothe you, O you of little faith?
verses.textEnNlt: And if God cares so wonderfully for flowers that are here today and thrown into the fire tomorrow, he will certainly care for you. Why do you have so little faith?
verses.textEnNasb: Now if God so clothes the grass in the field, which is alive today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, how much more will He clothe you? You of little faith!
verses.textEn: <red>If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today, and tomorrow is thrown into the fire, how much more will he clothe you—you of little faith!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们不要求吃甚么，喝甚么，也不要忧虑，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们不要求吃甚么，喝甚么，也不要忧虑，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们不要求吃什么，喝什么，也不要挂心；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And do not set your heart on what you will eat or drink; do not worry about it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And do not seek what you are to eat and what you are to drink, nor be worried.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And do not seek what you should eat or what you should drink, nor have an anxious mind.
verses.textEnNlt: "And don’t be concerned about what to eat and what to drink. Don’t worry about such things.
verses.textEnNasb: And do not seek what you are to eat and what you are to drink, and do not keep worrying.
verses.textEn: <red>And do not set your heart on what you will eat or drink; do not worry about it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为这一切都是世上不信的人所寻求的。你们的父原知道你们需要这一切。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为这一切都是世上不信的人所寻求的。你们的父原知道你们需要这一切。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这都是外邦人所求的。你们必须用这些东西，你们的父是知道的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For the pagan world runs after all such things, and your Father knows that you need them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For all the nations of the world seek after these things, and your Father knows that you need them.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all these things the nations of the world seek after, and your Father knows that you need these things.
verses.textEnNlt: These things dominate the thoughts of unbelievers all over the world, but your Father already knows your needs.
verses.textEnNasb: For all these things are what the nations of the world eagerly seek; and your Father knows that you need these things.
verses.textEn: <red>For the pagan world runs after all such things, and your Father knows that you need them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们只管求他的国，这些东西都必加给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们只管求他的国，这些东西都必加给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们只要求他的国，这些东西就必加给你们了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But seek his kingdom, and these things will be given to you as well.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Instead, seek his kingdom, and these things will be added to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But seek the kingdom of God, and all these things shall be added to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Seek the Kingdom of God above all else, and he will give you everything you need.
verses.textEnNasb: But seek His kingdom, and these things will be provided to you.
verses.textEn: <red>But seek his kingdom, and these things will be given to you as well.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们这小群，不要怕，因为你们的父乐意把国赐给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们这小群，不要怕，因为你们的父乐意把国赐给你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们这小群，不要惧怕，因为你们的父乐意把国赐给你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Dop not be afraid, little flock, for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Fear not, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not fear, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
verses.textEnNlt: "So don’t be afraid, little flock. For it gives your Father great happiness to give you the Kingdom.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be afraid, little flock, because your Father has chosen to give you the kingdom.
verses.textEn: <red>“Dop not be afraid, little flock, for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>当变卖你们所有的施舍给人，为自己制造不朽坏的钱囊，积蓄用不尽的财宝在天上，就是贼不能近、虫不能蛀的地方。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>当变卖你们所有的施舍给人，为自己制造不朽坏的钱囊，积蓄用不尽的财宝在天上，就是贼不能近、虫不能蛀的地方。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要变卖所有的周济人，为自己预备永不坏的钱囊，用不尽的财宝在天上，就是贼不能近、虫不能蛀的地方。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Sell your possessions and give to the poor. Provide purses for yourselves that will not wear out, a treasure in heaven that will never fail, where no thief comes near and no moth destroys.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Sell your possessions, and give to the needy. Provide yourselves with moneybags that do not grow old, with a treasure in the heavens that does not fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sell what you have and give alms; provide yourselves money bags which do not grow old, a treasure in the heavens that does not fail, where no thief approaches nor moth destroys.
verses.textEnNlt: "Sell your possessions and give to those in need. This will store up treasure for you in heaven! And the purses of heaven never get old or develop holes. Your treasure will be safe; no thief can steal it and no moth can destroy it.
verses.textEnNasb: "Sell your possessions and give to charity; make yourselves money belts that do not wear out, an inexhaustible treasure in heaven, where no thief comes near nor does a moth destroy.
verses.textEn: <red>Sell your possessions and give to the poor. Provide purses for yourselves that will not wear out, a treasure in heaven that will never fail, where no thief comes near and no moth destroys.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为你们的财宝在哪里，你们的心也在哪里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为你们的财宝在哪里，你们的心也在哪里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为，你们的财宝在哪里，你们的心也在那里。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.textEnNkjv: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
verses.textEnNlt: Wherever your treasure is, there the desires of your heart will also be.
verses.textEnNasb: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
verses.textEn: <red>For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们的腰当束起来，灯也该点着，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们的腰当束起来，灯也该点着，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们腰里要束上带，灯也要点着，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Bep dressed ready for service and keep your lamps burning,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Stay dressed for action and keep your lamps burning,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Let your waist be girded and your lamps burning;
verses.textEnNlt: "Be dressed for service and keep your lamps burning,
verses.textEnNasb: " Be prepared, and keep your lamps lit.
verses.textEn: <red>“Bep dressed ready for service and keep your lamps burning,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>像等候自己的主人从婚筵回来一样，好叫你们在主人回来敲门时，立刻给他开门。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>像等候自己的主人从婚筵回来一样，好叫你们在主人回来敲门时，立刻给他开门。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>自己好像仆人等候主人从婚姻的筵席上回来。他来到，叩门，就立刻给他开门。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>like servants waiting for their master to return from a wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks they can immediately open the door for him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and be like men who are waiting for their master to come home from the wedding feast, so that they may open the door to him at once when he comes and knocks.
verses.textEnNkjv: and you yourselves be like men who wait for their master, when he will return from the wedding, that when he comes and knocks they may open to him immediately.
verses.textEnNlt: as though you were waiting for your master to return from the wedding feast. Then you will be ready to open the door and let him in the moment he arrives and knocks.
verses.textEnNasb: You are also to be like people who are waiting for their master when he returns from the wedding feast, so that they may immediately open the door for him when he comes and knocks.
verses.textEn: <red>like servants waiting for their master to return from a wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks they can immediately open the door for him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>主人来到了，看见仆人警醒，这些仆人就有福了。我实在告诉你们，主人必亲自束腰，招待他们吃饭，进前来侍候他们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>主人来到了，看见仆人警醒，这些仆人就有福了。我实在告诉你们，主人必亲自束腰，招待他们吃饭，进前来侍候他们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主人来了，看见仆人警醒，那仆人就有福了。我实在告诉你们，主人必叫他们坐席，自己束上带，进前伺候他们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>It will be good for those servants whose master finds them watching when he comes. Truly I tell you, he will dress himself to serve, will have them recline at the table and will come and wait on them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed are those servants whom the master finds awake when he comes. Truly, I say to you, he will dress himself for service and have them recline at table, and he will come and serve them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are those servants whom the master, when he comes, will find watching. Assuredly, I say to you that he will gird himself and have them sit down to eat, and will come and serve them.
verses.textEnNlt: The servants who are ready and waiting for his return will be rewarded. I tell you the truth, he himself will seat them, put on an apron, and serve them as they sit and eat!
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed are those slaves whom the master will find on the alert when he comes; truly I say to you, that he will prepare himself to serve, and have them recline at the table, and he will come up and serve them.
verses.textEn: <red>It will be good for those servants whose master finds them watching when he comes. Truly I tell you, he will dress himself to serve, will have them recline at the table and will come and wait on them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>主人也许半夜之前，或天亮之前回来，看见他们这样，这些仆人就有福了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>主人也许半夜之前，或天亮之前回来，看见他们这样，这些仆人就有福了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>或是二更天来，或是三更天来，看见仆人这样，那仆人就有福了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>It will be good for those servants whose master finds them ready, even if he comes in the middle of the night or toward daybreak.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If he comes in the second watch, or in the third, and finds them awake, blessed are those servants!
verses.textEnNkjv: And if he should come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
verses.textEnNlt: He may come in the middle of the night or just before dawn. But whenever he comes, he will reward the servants who are ready.
verses.textEnNasb: Whether he comes in the second watch, or even in the third, and finds them so, blessed are those slaves.
verses.textEn: <red>It will be good for those servants whose master finds them ready, even if he comes in the middle of the night or toward daybreak.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们都知道，家主若晓得窃贼甚么时候来，就不会让他摸进屋里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们都知道，家主若晓得窃贼甚么时候来，就不会让他摸进屋里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>家主若知道贼什么时候来，就必警醒，不容贼挖透房屋，这是你们所知道的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But know this, that if the master of the house had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have left his house to be broken into.
verses.textEnNkjv: But know this, that if the master of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.
verses.textEnNlt: "Understand this: If a homeowner knew exactly when a burglar was coming, he would not permit his house to be broken into.
verses.textEnNasb: "But be sure of this, that if the head of the house had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have allowed his house to be broken into.
verses.textEn: <red>But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们也要准备妥当，因为在想不到的时候，人子就来了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们也要准备妥当，因为在想不到的时候，人子就来了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们也要预备；因为你们想不到的时候，人子就来了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You also must be ready, for the Son of Man is coming at an hour you do not expect."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you also be ready, for the Son of Man is coming at an hour you do not expect."
verses.textEnNlt: You also must be ready all the time, for the Son of Man will come when least expected."
verses.textEnNasb: You too, be ready; because the Son of Man is coming at an hour that you do not think He will."
verses.textEn: <red>You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.”</red>

verses.textZh: 彼得说："主啊，你说这比喻，是为我们还是为众人呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得说："主啊，你说这比喻，是为我们还是为众人呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得说：「主啊，这比喻是为我们说的呢？还是为众人呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Peter asked, "Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everyone?"
verses.textEnEsv: Peter said, "Lord, are you telling this parable for us or for all?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Peter said to Him, "Lord, do You speak this parable only to us, or to all people?"
verses.textEnNlt: Peter asked, "Lord, is that illustration just for us or for everyone?"
verses.textEnNasb: Peter said, "Lord, are You telling this parable to us, or to everyone else as well?"
verses.textEn: Peter asked, "Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everyone?"

verses.textZh: 主说："<red>谁是那忠心精明的管家，被主人指派管理家里的仆人，按时分粮呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 主说："<red>谁是那忠心精明的管家，被主人指派管理家里的仆人，按时分粮呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主说：「谁是那忠心有见识的管家，主人派他管理家里的人，按时分粮给他们呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord answered, <red>“Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their food allowance at the proper time?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said, "Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom his master will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the proper time?
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said, "Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his master will make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of food in due season?
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord replied, "A faithful, sensible servant is one to whom the master can give the responsibility of managing his other household servants and feeding them.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said, "Who then is the faithful and sensible steward, whom his master will put in charge of his servants, to give them their rations at the proper time?
verses.textEn: The Lord answered, <red>“Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their food allowance at the proper time?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>主人来到的时候，看见他这样作，那仆人就有福了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>主人来到的时候，看见他这样作，那仆人就有福了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主人来到，看见仆人这样行，那仆人就有福了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>It will be good for that servant whom the master finds doing so when he returns.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is that servant whom his master will find so doing when he comes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is that servant whom his master will find so doing when he comes.
verses.textEnNlt: If the master returns and finds that the servant has done a good job, there will be a reward.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is that slave whom his master finds so doing when he comes.
verses.textEn: <red>It will be good for that servant whom the master finds doing so when he returns.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，主人要指派他管理主人的一切财产。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，主人要指派他管理主人的一切财产。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，主人要派他管理一切所有的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, I say to you, he will set him over all his possessions.
verses.textEnNkjv: Truly, I say to you that he will make him ruler over all that he has.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, the master will put that servant in charge of all he owns.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly I say to you that he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
verses.textEn: <red>Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果那仆人心里说：‘我的主人不会那么快回来’，就动手打其他的仆人使女，并且吃喝醉酒；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果那仆人心里说：‘我的主人不会那么快回来’，就动手打其他的仆人使女，并且吃喝醉酒；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那仆人若心里说：『我的主人必来得迟』，就动手打仆人和使女，并且吃喝醉酒；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But suppose the servant says to himself, ‘My master is taking a long time in coming,’ and he then begins to beat the other servants, both men and women, and to eat and drink and get drunk.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But if that servant says to himself, ‘My master is delayed in coming,’ and begins to beat the male and female servants, and to eat and drink and get drunk,
verses.textEnNkjv: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My master is delaying his coming,’ and begins to beat the male and female servants, and to eat and drink and be drunk,
verses.textEnNlt: But what if the servant thinks, ‘My master won’t be back for a while,’ and he begins beating the other servants, partying, and getting drunk?
verses.textEnNasb: But if that slave says in his heart, ‘My master will take a long time to come,’ and he begins to beat the other slaves, both men and women, and to eat and drink and get drunk;
verses.textEn: <red>But suppose the servant says to himself, ‘My master is taking a long time in coming,’ and he then begins to beat the other servants, both men and women, and to eat and drink and get drunk.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在他想不到的日子、不知道的时间，那仆人的主人要来，严厉地处罚他，使他和不信的人同在一起。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在他想不到的日子、不知道的时间，那仆人的主人要来，严厉地处罚他，使他和不信的人同在一起。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>在他想不到的日子，不知道的时辰，那仆人的主人要来，重重地处治他 ，定他和不忠心的人同罪。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he is not aware of. He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: the master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he does not know, and will cut him in pieces and put him with the unfaithful.
verses.textEnNkjv: the master of that servant will come on a day when he is not looking for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in two and appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
verses.textEnNlt: The master will return unannounced and unexpected, and he will cut the servant in pieces and banish him with the unfaithful.
verses.textEnNasb: then the master of that slave will come on a day that he does not expect, and at an hour that he does not know, and will cut him in two, and assign him a place with the unbelievers.
verses.textEn: <red>The master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he is not aware of. He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那仆人知道主人的意思，却不预备，也不照他的意思行，必多受责打；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那仆人知道主人的意思，却不预备，也不照他的意思行，必多受责打；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>仆人知道主人的意思，却不预备，又不顺他的意思行，那仆人必多受责打；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thep servant who knows the master’s will and does not get ready or does not do what the master wants will be beaten with many blows.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And that servant who knew his master’s will but did not get ready or act according to his will, will receive a severe beating.
verses.textEnNkjv: And that servant who knew his master’s will, and did not prepare himself or do according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
verses.textEnNlt: "And a servant who knows what the master wants, but isn’t prepared and doesn’t carry out those instructions, will be severely punished.
verses.textEnNasb: And that slave who knew his master’s will and did not get ready or act in accordance with his will, will receive many blows,
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep servant who knows the master’s will and does not get ready or does not do what the master wants will be beaten with many blows.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但那不知道的，虽然作了该受责打的事，也必少受责打。多给谁就向谁多取，多托谁就向谁多要。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但那不知道的，虽然作了该受责打的事，也必少受责打。多给谁就向谁多取，多托谁就向谁多要。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>惟有那不知道的，做了当受责打的事，必少受责打；因为多给谁，就向谁多取；多托谁，就向谁多要。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But the one who does not know and does things deserving punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be demanded; and from the one who has been entrusted with much, much more will be asked.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But the one who did not know, and did what deserved a beating, will receive a light beating. Everyone to whom much was given, of him much will be required, and from him to whom they entrusted much, they will demand the more.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who did not know, yet committed things deserving of stripes, shall be beaten with few. For everyone to whom much is given, from him much will be required; and to whom much has been committed, of him they will ask the more.
verses.textEnNlt: But someone who does not know, and then does something wrong, will be punished only lightly. When someone has been given much, much will be required in return; and when someone has been entrusted with much, even more will be required.
verses.textEnNasb: but the one who did not know it, and committed acts deserving of a beating, will receive only a few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be demanded; and to whom they entrusted much, of him they will ask all the more.
verses.textEn: <red>But the one who does not know and does things deserving punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be demanded; and from the one who has been entrusted with much, much more will be asked.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"我来要把火投在地上，如果烧了起来，那是我所愿意的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"我来要把火投在地上，如果烧了起来，那是我所愿意的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「我来要把火丢在地上，倘若已经着起来，不也是我所愿意的吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Ip have come to bring fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "I came to cast fire on the earth, and would that it were already kindled!
verses.textEnNkjv: "I came to send fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!
verses.textEnNlt: "I have come to set the world on fire, and I wish it were already burning!
verses.textEnNasb: "I have come to cast fire upon the earth; and how I wish it were already kindled!
verses.textEn: <red>“Ip have come to bring fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我有应当受的洗，我是多么迫切地期待这事完成。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我有应当受的洗，我是多么迫切地期待这事完成。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我有当受的洗还没有成就，我是何等地迫切呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I have a baptism to undergo, and what constraint I am under until it is completed!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how great is my distress until it is accomplished!
verses.textEnNkjv: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am till it is accomplished!
verses.textEnNlt: I have a terrible baptism of suffering ahead of me, and I am under a heavy burden until it is accomplished.
verses.textEnNasb: But I have a baptism to undergo, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!
verses.textEn: <red>But I have a baptism to undergo, and what constraint I am under until it is completed!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们以为我来是要地上有和平吗？不是的，我告诉你们，是要有纷争。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们以为我来是要地上有和平吗？不是的，我告诉你们，是要有纷争。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们以为我来，是叫地上太平吗？我告诉你们，不是，乃是叫人纷争。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Do you think I came to bring peace on earth? No, I tell you, but division.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Do you think that I have come to give peace on earth? No, I tell you, but rather division.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you suppose that I came to give peace on earth? I tell you, not at all, but rather division.
verses.textEnNlt: Do you think I have come to bring peace to the earth? No, I have come to divide people against each other!
verses.textEnNasb: Do you think that I came to provide peace on earth? No, I tell you, but rather division;
verses.textEn: <red>Do you think I came to bring peace on earth? No, I tell you, but division.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>从今以后，一家五口将起纷争，三个反对两个，两个反对三个。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>从今以后，一家五口将起纷争，三个反对两个，两个反对三个。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>从今以后，一家五个人将要纷争：三个人和两个人相争，两个人和三个人相争；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>From now on there will be five in one family divided against each other, three against two and two against three.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For from now on in one house there will be five divided, three against two and two against three.
verses.textEnNkjv: For from now on five in one house will be divided: three against two, and two against three.
verses.textEnNlt: From now on families will be split apart, three in favor of me, and two against—or two in favor and three against.
verses.textEnNasb: for from now on five members in one household will be divided, three against two and two against three.
verses.textEn: <red>From now on there will be five in one family divided against each other, three against two and two against three.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们将起纷争： 父亲反对儿子， 儿子反对父亲， 母亲反对女儿， 女儿反对母亲， 婆婆反对媳妇， 媳妇反对婆婆。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们将起纷争： 父亲反对儿子， 儿子反对父亲， 母亲反对女儿， 女儿反对母亲， 婆婆反对媳妇， 媳妇反对婆婆。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>父亲和儿子相争， 儿子和父亲相争； 母亲和女儿相争， 女儿和母亲相争； 婆婆和媳妇相争， 媳妇和婆婆相争。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law."
verses.textEnNkjv: Father will be divided against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law."
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Father will be divided against son and son against father; mother against daughter and daughter against mother; and mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.’ "
verses.textEnNasb: They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law."
verses.textEn: <red>They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对众人说："<red>你们一看见西边有云彩升起来，就说：‘要下大雨’，果然这样；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对众人说："<red>你们一看见西边有云彩升起来，就说：‘要下大雨’，果然这样；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣又对众人说：「你们看见西边起了云彩，就说：『要下一阵雨』；果然就有。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He said to the crowd: <red>“When you see a cloud rising in the west, immediately you say, ‘It’s going to rain,’ and it does.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He also said to the crowds, "When you see a cloud rising in the west, you say at once, ‘A shower is coming.’ And so it happens.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He also said to the multitudes, "Whenever you see a cloud rising out of the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming’; and so it is.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus turned to the crowd and said, "When you see clouds beginning to form in the west, you say, ‘Here comes a shower.’ And you are right.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was also saying to the crowds, "Whenever you see a cloud rising in the west, you immediately say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it turns out.
verses.textEn: He said to the crowd: <red>“When you see a cloud rising in the west, immediately you say, ‘It’s going to rain,’ and it does.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>起了南风，就说：‘天要热了’，也果然这样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>起了南风，就说：‘天要热了’，也果然这样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>起了南风，就说：『将要燥热』；也就有了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And when the south wind blows, you say, ‘It’s going to be hot,’ and it is.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when you see the south wind blowing, you say, ‘There will be scorching heat,’ and it happens.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when you see the south wind blow, you say, ‘There will be hot weather’; and there is.
verses.textEnNlt: When the south wind blows, you say, ‘Today will be a scorcher.’ And it is.
verses.textEnNasb: And whenever you feel a south wind blowing, you say, ‘It will be a hot day,’ and it turns out that way.
verses.textEn: <red>And when the south wind blows, you say, ‘It’s going to be hot,’ and it is.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>伪君子啊！你们知道分辨天地的气象，怎么不知道分辨这个时代呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>伪君子啊！你们知道分辨天地的气象，怎么不知道分辨这个时代呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>假冒为善的人哪，你们知道分辨天地的气色，怎么不知道分辨这时候呢？」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky. How is it that you don’t know how to interpret this present time?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of earth and sky, but why do you not know how to interpret the present time?
verses.textEnNkjv: Hypocrites! You can discern the face of the sky and of the earth, but how is it you do not discern this time?
verses.textEnNlt: You fools! You know how to interpret the weather signs of the earth and sky, but you don’t know how to interpret the present times.
verses.textEnNasb: You hypocrites! You know how to analyze the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you do not know how to analyze this present time?
verses.textEn: <red>Hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky. How is it that you don’t know how to interpret this present time?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们为甚么自己不能判断甚么是对的呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们为甚么自己不能判断甚么是对的呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们又为何不自己审量什么是合理的呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whyp don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "And why do you not judge for yourselves what is right?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Yes, and why, even of yourselves, do you not judge what is right?
verses.textEnNlt: "Why can’t you decide for yourselves what is right?
verses.textEnNasb: "And why do you not even judge by yourselves what is right?
verses.textEn: <red>“Whyp don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你和你的对头去见官长，还在路上的时候，应当尽力向他求和，免得他把你拉到法官面前，法官把你交给差役，差役把你关在监里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你和你的对头去见官长，还在路上的时候，应当尽力向他求和，免得他把你拉到法官面前，法官把你交给差役，差役把你关在监里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你同告你的对头去见官，还在路上，务要尽力地和他了结；恐怕他拉你到官面前，官交付差役，差役把你下在监里。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>As you are going with your adversary to the magistrate, try hard to be reconciled on the way, or your adversary may drag you off to the judge, and the judge turn you over to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: As you go with your accuser before the magistrate, make an effort to settle with him on the way, lest he drag you to the judge, and the judge hand you over to the officer, and the officer put you in prison.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you go with your adversary to the magistrate, make every effort along the way to settle with him, lest he drag you to the judge, the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.
verses.textEnNlt: When you are on the way to court with your accuser, try to settle the matter before you get there. Otherwise, your accuser may drag you before the judge, who will hand you over to an officer, who will throw you into prison.
verses.textEnNasb: For when you are going with your accuser to appear before the magistrate, on the way, make an effort to settle with him, so that he does not drag you before the judge, and the judge hand you over to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.
verses.textEn: <red>As you are going with your adversary to the magistrate, try hard to be reconciled on the way, or your adversary may drag you off to the judge, and the judge turn you over to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你，除非你还清最后的一个小钱，否则决不能从那里出来。"</red>
