verses.textEnNiv: <red>I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I tell you, you will never get out until you have paid the very last penny."
verses.textEnNkjv: I tell you, you shall not depart from there till you have paid the very last mite."
verses.textEnNlt: And if that happens, you won’t be free again until you have paid the very last penny. "
verses.textEnNasb: I tell you, you will not get out of there until you have paid up the very last lepton."
verses.textEn: <red>I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.”</red>

verses.textZh: 就在那时候，有几个在那里的人，把加利利人的事告诉耶稣，就是彼拉多把他们的血和他们的祭物搀在一起的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在那时候，有几个在那里的人，把加利利人的事告诉耶稣，就是彼拉多把他们的血和他们的祭物搀在一起的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 正当那时，有人将彼拉多使加利利人的血搀杂在他们祭物中的事告诉耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: Now there were some present at that time who told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
verses.textEnEsv: There were some present at that very time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
verses.textEnNkjv: There were present at that season some who told Him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
verses.textEnNlt: About this time Jesus was informed that Pilate had murdered some people from Galilee as they were offering sacrifices at the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on that very occasion there were some present who reported to Him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
verses.textEn: Now there were some present at that time who told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

verses.textZh: 他回答："你们以为这些加利利人比其他的加利利人更有罪，才这样受害吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答："你们以为这些加利利人比其他的加利利人更有罪，才这样受害吗？
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「你们以为这些加利利人比众加利利人更有罪，所以受这害吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans because they suffered this way?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he answered them, "Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered in this way?
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus answered and said to them, "Do you suppose that these Galileans were worse sinners than all other Galileans, because they suffered such things?
verses.textEnNlt: "Do you think those Galileans were worse sinners than all the other people from Galilee?" Jesus asked. "Is that why they suffered?
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus responded and said to them, "Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans just because they have suffered this fate?
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans because they suffered this way?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不是的，我告诉你们，你们若不悔改，都要这样灭亡。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不是的，我告诉你们，你们若不悔改，都要这样灭亡。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我告诉你们，不是的！你们若不悔改，都要如此灭亡！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I tell you, no! But unless you repent, you too will all perish.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: No, I tell you; but unless you repent, you will all likewise perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: I tell you, no; but unless you repent you will all likewise perish.
verses.textEnNlt: Not at all! And you will perish, too, unless you repent of your sins and turn to God.

verses.textEn: <red>I tell you, no! But unless you repent, you too will all perish.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们以为从前西罗亚楼倒塌的时候，压死的那十八个人，比一切在耶路撒冷的居民更有罪吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们以为从前西罗亚楼倒塌的时候，压死的那十八个人，比一切在耶路撒冷的居民更有罪吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>从前西罗亚楼倒塌了，压死十八个人；你们以为那些人比一切住在耶路撒冷的人更有罪吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Or those eighteen who died when the tower in Siloam fell on them—do you think they were more guilty than all the others living in Jerusalem?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them: do you think that they were worse offenders than all the others who lived in Jerusalem?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them, do you think that they were worse sinners than all other men who dwelt in Jerusalem?
verses.textEnNlt: And what about the eighteen people who died when the tower in Siloam fell on them? Were they the worst sinners in Jerusalem?
verses.textEnNasb: Or do you think that those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them were worse offenders than all the other people who live in Jerusalem?
verses.textEn: <red>Or those eighteen who died when the tower in Siloam fell on them—do you think they were more guilty than all the others living in Jerusalem?</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣讲了这样一个比喻："有一个人把一棵无花果树栽在自己的葡萄园里。他来到树那里找果子，却找不到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣讲了这样一个比喻："有一个人把一棵无花果树栽在自己的葡萄园里。他来到树那里找果子，却找不到。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>于是用比喻说：「一个人有一棵无花果树栽在葡萄园里。他来到树前找果子，却找不着。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then he told this parable: <red>“A man had a fig tree growing in his vineyard, and he went to look for fruit on it but did not find any.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he told this parable: "A man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also spoke this parable: "A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus told this story: "A man planted a fig tree in his garden and came again and again to see if there was any fruit on it, but he was always disappointed.
verses.textEnNasb: And He began telling this parable: "A man had a fig tree which had been planted in his vineyard; and he came looking for fruit on it and did not find any.
verses.textEn: Then he told this parable: <red>“A man had a fig tree growing in his vineyard, and he went to look for fruit on it but did not find any.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他对管园的说：‘你看，这三年，我来到这棵无花果树那里找果子，却找不到，把它砍了吧！何必白占地土呢？’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他对管园的说：‘你看，这三年，我来到这棵无花果树那里找果子，却找不到，把它砍了吧！何必白占地土呢？’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>就对管园的说：『看哪，我这三年来到这无花果树前找果子，竟找不着。把它砍了吧，何必白占地土呢！』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So he said to the man who took care of the vineyard, ‘For three years now I’ve been coming to look for fruit on this fig tree and haven’t found any. Cut it down! Why should it use up the soil?’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to the vinedresser, ‘Look, for three years now I have come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and I find none. Cut it down. Why should it use up the ground?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to the keeper of his vineyard, ‘Look, for three years I have come seeking fruit on this fig tree and find none. Cut it down; why does it use up the ground?’
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, he said to his gardener, ‘I’ve waited three years, and there hasn’t been a single fig! Cut it down. It’s just taking up space in the garden.’
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to the vineyard-keeper, ‘Look! For three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree without finding any. Cut it down! Why does it even use up the ground?’
verses.textEn: <red>So he said to the man who took care of the vineyard, ‘For three years now I’ve been coming to look for fruit on this fig tree and haven’t found any. Cut it down! Why should it use up the soil?’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>管园的说：‘主人，今年且留着它，等我把周围的泥土挖松，加上肥料；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>管园的说：‘主人，今年且留着它，等我把周围的泥土挖松，加上肥料；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>管园的说：『主啊，今年且留着，等我周围掘开土，加上粪；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“ ‘Sir,’p the man replied, ‘leave it alone for one more year, and I’ll dig around it and fertilize it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he answered him, ‘Sir, let it alone this year also, until I dig around it and put on manure.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he answered and said to him, ‘Sir, let it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.
verses.textEnNlt: "The gardener answered, ‘Sir, give it one more chance. Leave it another year, and I’ll give it special attention and plenty of fertilizer.
verses.textEnNasb: But he answered and said to him, ‘Sir, leave it alone for this year too, until I dig around it and put in fertilizer;
verses.textEn: <red>“ ‘Sir,’p the man replied, ‘leave it alone for one more year, and I’ll dig around it and fertilize it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>以后结果子就罢，不然，再把它砍了。’"</red>

verses.textZhCuv: <red>以后若结果子便罢，不然再把它砍了。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If it bears fruit next year, fine! If not, then cut it down.’ ”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then if it should bear fruit next year, well and good; but if not, you can cut it down.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And if it bears fruit, well. But if not, after that you can cut it down.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: If we get figs next year, fine. If not, then you can cut it down.’"
verses.textEnNasb: and if it bears fruit next year, fine; but if not, cut it down.’ "
verses.textEn: <red>If it bears fruit next year, fine! If not, then cut it down.’ ”</red>

verses.textZh: 有一个女人被邪灵附着，病了十八年，弯腰曲背，完全直不起来。

verses.textZhCuv: 有一个女人被鬼附着，病了十八年，腰弯得一点直不起来。
verses.textEnNiv: and a woman was there who had been crippled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was bent over and could not straighten up at all.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, there was a woman who had had a disabling spirit for eighteen years. She was bent over and could not fully straighten herself.
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bent over and could in no way raise herself up.
verses.textEnNlt: he saw a woman who had been crippled by an evil spirit. She had been bent double for eighteen years and was unable to stand up straight.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was a woman who for eighteen years had had a sickness caused by a spirit; and she was bent over double, and could not straighten up at all.
verses.textEn: and a woman was there who had been crippled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was bent over and could not straighten up at all.

verses.textZh: 耶稣看见了，就叫她过来，对她说："<red>妇人，你脱离这疾病了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看见了，就叫她过来，对她说："<red>妇人，你脱离这疾病了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣看见，便叫过她来，对她说：「<red>女人，你脱离这病了！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus saw her, he called her forward and said to her, <red>“Woman, you are set free from your infirmity.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When Jesus saw her, he called her over and said to her, "Woman, you are freed from your disability."
verses.textEnNkjv: But when Jesus saw her, He called her to Him and said to her, "Woman, you are loosed from your infirmity."
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus saw her, he called her over and said, "Dear woman, you are healed of your sickness!"
verses.textEnNasb: When Jesus saw her, He called her over and said to her, "Woman, you are freed from your sickness."
verses.textEn: When Jesus saw her, he called her forward and said to her, <red>“Woman, you are set free from your infirmity.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣用双手按在她身上，她立刻直起腰来，颂赞神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣用双手按在她身上，她立刻直起腰来，颂赞神。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是用两只手按着她；她立刻直起腰来，就归荣耀与神。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he put his hands on her, and immediately she straightened up and praised God.
verses.textEnEsv: And he laid his hands on her, and immediately she was made straight, and she glorified God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He laid His hands on her, and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he touched her, and instantly she could stand straight. How she praised God!
verses.textEnNasb: And He laid His hands on her; and immediately she stood up straight again, and began glorifying God.
verses.textEn: Then he put his hands on her, and immediately she straightened up and praised God.

verses.textZh: 会堂的主管，因为耶稣在安息日治病，就气忿忿地对群众说："有六天是应当作工的，你们可以在这六天里来求医，但在安息日却不可以。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 会堂的主管，因为耶稣在安息日治病，就气忿忿地对群众说："有六天是应当作工的，你们可以在这六天里来求医，但在安息日却不可以。"
verses.textZhCuv: 管会堂的因为耶稣在安息日治病，就气忿忿地对众人说：「有六日应当做工；那六日之内可以来求医，在安息日却不可。」
verses.textEnNiv: Indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, the synagogue leader said to the people, "There are six days for work. So come and be healed on those days, not on the Sabbath."
verses.textEnEsv: But the ruler of the synagogue, indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the people, "There are six days in which work ought to be done. Come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath; and he said to the crowd, "There are six days on which men ought to work; therefore come and be healed on them, and not on the Sabbath day."
verses.textEnNlt: But the leader in charge of the synagogue was indignant that Jesus had healed her on the Sabbath day. "There are six days of the week for working," he said to the crowd. "Come on those days to be healed, not on the Sabbath."
verses.textEnNasb: But the synagogue leader, indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, began saying to the crowd in response, "There are six days during which work should be done; so come during them and get healed, and not on the Sabbath day."
verses.textEn: Indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, the synagogue leader said to the people, "There are six days for work. So come and be healed on those days, not on the Sabbath."

verses.textZh: 主说："<red>伪君子啊，你们哪一个人在安息日，不从槽那里解开牛、驴，牵去喝水呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 主说："<red>伪君子啊，你们哪一个人在安息日，不从槽那里解开牛、驴，牵去喝水呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主说：「假冒为善的人哪，难道你们各人在安息日不解开槽上的牛、驴，牵去饮吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord answered him, <red>“You hypocrites! Doesn’t each of you on the Sabbath untie your ox or donkey from the stall and lead it out to give it water?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord answered him, "You hypocrites! Does not each of you on the Sabbath untie his ox or his donkey from the manger and lead it away to water it?
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord then answered him and said, "Hypocrite! Does not each one of you on the Sabbath loose his ox or donkey from the stall, and lead it away to water it?
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord replied, "You hypocrites! Each of you works on the Sabbath day! Don’t you untie your ox or your donkey from its stall on the Sabbath and lead it out for water?
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord answered him and said, "You hypocrites, does each of you on the Sabbath not untie his ox or donkey from the stall and lead it away to water it?
verses.textEn: The Lord answered him, <red>“You hypocrites! Doesn’t each of you on the Sabbath untie your ox or donkey from the stall and lead it out to give it water?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>何况这个女人是亚伯拉罕的后裔，已经被撒但捆绑了十八年，不应当在安息日解开她的捆绑吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>何况这个女人是亚伯拉罕的后裔，已经被撒但捆绑了十八年，不应当在安息日解开她的捆绑吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>况且这女人本是亚伯拉罕的后裔，被撒但捆绑了这十八年，不当在安息日解开她的绑吗？」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Then should not this woman, a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has kept bound for eighteen long years, be set free on the Sabbath day from what bound her?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And ought not this woman, a daughter of Abraham whom Satan bound for eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the Sabbath day?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has bound—think of it—for eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the Sabbath?"
verses.textEnNlt: This dear woman, a daughter of Abraham, has been held in bondage by Satan for eighteen years. Isn’t it right that she be released, even on the Sabbath?"
verses.textEnNasb: And this woman, a daughter of Abraham as she is, whom Satan has bound for eighteen long years, should she not have been released from this restraint on the Sabbath day?"
verses.textEn: <red>Then should not this woman, a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has kept bound for eighteen long years, be set free on the Sabbath day from what bound her?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他说完了这些话，那些与他为敌的人都惭愧；群众却都因他所行一切荣耀的事欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说完了这些话，那些与他为敌的人都惭愧；群众却都因他所行一切荣耀的事欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说这话，他的敌人都惭愧了；众人因他所行一切荣耀的事，就都欢喜了。
verses.textEnNiv: When he said this, all his opponents were humiliated, but the people were delighted with all the wonderful things he was doing.
verses.textEnEsv: As he said these things, all his adversaries were put to shame, and all the people rejoiced at all the glorious things that were done by him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He said these things, all His adversaries were put to shame; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by Him.
verses.textEnNlt: This shamed his enemies, but all the people rejoiced at the wonderful things he did.
verses.textEnNasb: And as He said this, all His opponents were being humiliated; and the entire crowd was rejoicing over all the glorious things being done by Him.
verses.textEn: When he said this, all his opponents were humiliated, but the people were delighted with all the wonderful things he was doing.

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>神的国好象甚么呢？我要把它比作甚么呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>神的国好象甚么呢？我要把它比作甚么呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「神的国好像什么？我拿什么来比较呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus asked, <red>“What is the kingdom of God like? What shall I compare it to?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said therefore, "What is the kingdom of God like? And to what shall I compare it?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said, "What is the kingdom of God like? And to what shall I compare it?
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus said, "What is the Kingdom of God like? How can I illustrate it?
verses.textEnNasb: So He was saying, "What is the kingdom of God like, and to what shall I compare it?
verses.textEn: Then Jesus asked, <red>“What is the kingdom of God like? What shall I compare it to?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>它好象一粒芥菜种，人拿去种在自己的园子里。它长大了，成为一棵树，甚至天空的飞鸟也在它的枝头搭窝。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>它好象一粒芥菜种，人拿去种在自己的园子里。它长大了，成为一棵树，甚至天空的飞鸟也在它的枝头搭窝。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>好像一粒芥菜种，有人拿去种在园子里，长大成树，天上的飞鸟宿在它的枝上。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>It is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the birds perched in its branches.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: It is like a grain of mustard seed that a man took and sowed in his garden, and it grew and became a tree, and the birds of the air made nests in its branches."
verses.textEnNkjv: It is like a mustard seed, which a man took and put in his garden; and it grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the air nested in its branches."
verses.textEnNlt: It is like a tiny mustard seed that a man planted in a garden; it grows and becomes a tree, and the birds make nests in its branches."
verses.textEnNasb: It is like a mustard seed, which a man took and threw into his own garden; and it grew and became a tree, and the birds of the sky nested in its branches."
verses.textEn: <red>It is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the birds perched in its branches.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他又说："<red>我要把神的国比作甚么呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又说："<red>我要把神的国比作甚么呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又说：「我拿什么来比神的国呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Again he asked, <red>“What shall I compare the kingdom of God to?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And again he said, "To what shall I compare the kingdom of God?
verses.textEnNkjv: And again He said, "To what shall I liken the kingdom of God?
verses.textEnNlt: He also asked, "What else is the Kingdom of God like?
verses.textEnNasb: And again He said, "To what shall I compare the kingdom of God?
verses.textEn: Again he asked, <red>“What shall I compare the kingdom of God to?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>它好象面酵，女人拿去放在三斗面里，直到全团发起来。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>它好象面酵，女人拿去放在三斗面里，直到全团发起来。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>好比面酵，有妇人拿来藏在三斗面里，直等全团都发起来。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>It is like yeast that a woman took and mixed into about sixty pounds of flour until it worked all through the dough.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: It is like leaven that a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened."
verses.textEnNkjv: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal till it was all leavened."
verses.textEnNlt: It is like the yeast a woman used in making bread. Even though she put only a little yeast in three measures of flour, it permeated every part of the dough."
verses.textEnNasb: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three sata of flour until it was all leavened."
verses.textEn: <red>It is like yeast that a woman took and mixed into about sixty pounds of flour until it worked all through the dough.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣经过各城各乡，往耶路撒冷去，沿途教导人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣经过各城各乡，往耶路撒冷去，沿途教导人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣往耶路撒冷去，在所经过的各城各乡教训人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus went through the towns and villages, teaching as he made his way to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: He went on his way through towns and villages, teaching and journeying toward Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus went through the towns and villages, teaching as he went, always pressing on toward Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was passing through one city and village after another, teaching, and proceeding on His way to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus went through the towns and villages, teaching as he made his way to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 有一个人问他："主啊，是不是只有很少的人得救呢？"他对众人说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个人问他："主啊，是不是只有很少的人得救呢？"他对众人说：
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个人问他说：「主啊，得救的人少吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Someone asked him, "Lord, are only a few people going to be saved?" He said to them,
verses.textEnEsv: And someone said to him, "Lord, will those who are saved be few?" And he said to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one said to Him, "Lord, are there few who are saved?" And He said to them,
verses.textEnNlt: Someone asked him, "Lord, will only a few be saved?" He replied,
verses.textEnNasb: And someone said to Him, "Lord, are there just a few who are being saved?" And He said to them,
verses.textEn: Someone asked him, "Lord, are only a few people going to be saved?" He said to them,

verses.textZh: <red>"你们应当竭力进窄门！我告诉你们，将来许多人要进去，却是不能。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们应当竭力进窄门！我告诉你们，将来许多人要进去，却是不能。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对众人说：「你们要努力进窄门。我告诉你们，将来有许多人想要进去，却是不能。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Make every effort to enter through the narrow door, because many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able to.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Strive to enter through the narrow door. For many, I tell you, will seek to enter and will not be able.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Strive to enter through the narrow gate, for many, I say to you, will seek to enter and will not be able.
verses.textEnNlt: "Work hard to enter the narrow door to God’s Kingdom, for many will try to enter but will fail.
verses.textEnNasb: "Strive to enter through the narrow door; for many, I tell you, will seek to enter and will not be able.
verses.textEn: <red>“Make every effort to enter through the narrow door, because many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able to.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>等到家主起来关上门，你们站在门外叩门说：‘主啊，给我们开门！’他要回答你们：‘我不知道你们是从哪里来的。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>等到家主起来关上门，你们站在门外叩门说：‘主啊，给我们开门！’他要回答你们：‘我不知道你们是从哪里来的。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>及至家主起来关了门，你们站在外面叩门，说：『主啊，给我们开门！』他就回答说：『我不认识你们，不晓得你们是哪里来的！』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Once the owner of the house gets up and closes the door, you will stand outside knocking and pleading, ‘Sir, open the door for us.’ “Butp he will answer, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When once the master of the house has risen and shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, open to us,’ then he will answer you, ‘I do not know where you come from.’
verses.textEnNkjv: When once the Master of the house has risen up and shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open for us,’ and He will answer and say to you, ‘I do not know you, where you are from,’
verses.textEnNlt: When the master of the house has locked the door, it will be too late. You will stand outside knocking and pleading, ‘Lord, open the door for us!’ But he will reply, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’
verses.textEnNasb: Once the head of the house gets up and shuts the door, and you begin standing outside and knocking on the door, saying, ‘Lord, open up to us!’ and He then will answer and say to you, ‘I do not know where you are from.’
verses.textEn: <red>Once the owner of the house gets up and closes the door, you will stand outside knocking and pleading, ‘Sir, open the door for us.’ “Butp he will answer, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那时，你们要说：‘我们在你面前吃过喝过，你也在我们街上教导过人。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那时，你们要说：‘我们在你面前吃过喝过，你也在我们街上教导过人。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，你们要说：『我们在你面前吃过喝过，你也在我们的街上教训过人。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thenp you will say, ‘We ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’
verses.textEnNkjv: then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in Your presence, and You taught in our streets.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will say, ‘But we ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will begin saying, ‘We ate and drank in Your presence, and You taught in our streets!’
verses.textEn: <red>“Thenp you will say, ‘We ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他要说：‘我告诉你们，我不晓得你们是从哪里来的；你们所有作恶的人，离开我去吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他要说：‘我告诉你们，我不晓得你们是从哪里来的；你们所有作恶的人，离开我去吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他要说：『我告诉你们，我不晓得你们是哪里来的。你们这一切作恶的人，离开我去吧！』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp he will reply, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from. Away from me, all you evildoers!’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he will say, ‘I tell you, I do not know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of evil!’
verses.textEnNkjv: But He will say, ‘I tell you I do not know you, where you are from. Depart from Me, all you workers of iniquity.’
verses.textEnNlt: And he will reply, ‘I tell you, I don’t know you or where you come from. Get away from me, all you who do evil.’
verses.textEnNasb: And yet He will say, ‘I do not know where you are from; leave Me, all you evildoers.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp he will reply, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from. Away from me, all you evildoers!’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>当你们看见亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各和众先知都在神的国里的时候，你们却被赶到外面去，在那里必要哀哭切齿。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>当你们看见亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各和众先知都在神的国里的时候，你们却被赶到外面去，在那里必要哀哭切齿。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要看见亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各，和众先知都在神的国里，你们却被赶到外面，在那里必要哀哭切齿了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Therep will be weeping there, and gnashing of teeth, when you see Abraham, Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves thrown out.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when you see Abraham and Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets in the kingdom of God but you yourselves cast out.
verses.textEnNkjv: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when you see Abraham and Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, and yourselves thrust out.
verses.textEnNlt: "There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth, for you will see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the Kingdom of God, but you will be thrown out.
verses.textEnNasb: In that place there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but yourselves being thrown out.
verses.textEn: <red>“Therep will be weeping there, and gnashing of teeth, when you see Abraham, Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves thrown out.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>从东从南，从西从北，将有人来，在神的国里吃饭。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>从东从南，从西从北，将有人来，在神的国里吃饭。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>从东、从西、从南、从北将有人来，在神的国里坐席。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>People will come from east and west and north and south, and will take their places at the feast in the kingdom of God.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And people will come from east and west, and from north and south, and recline at table in the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: They will come from the east and the west, from the north and the south, and sit down in the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNlt: And people will come from all over the world—from east and west, north and south—to take their places in the Kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNasb: And they will come from east and west, and from north and south, and will recline at the table in the kingdom of God.
verses.textEn: <red>People will come from east and west and north and south, and will take their places at the feast in the kingdom of God.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在后的将要在前，在前的将要在后。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在后的将要在前，在前的将要在后。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只是有在后的，将要在前；有在前的，将要在后。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Indeed there are those who are last who will be first, and first who will be last.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, some are last who will be first, and some are first who will be last."
verses.textEnNkjv: And indeed there are last who will be first, and there are first who will be last."
verses.textEnNlt: And note this: Some who seem least important now will be the greatest then, and some who are the greatest now will be least important then. "
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, some are last who will be first, and some are first who will be last."
verses.textEn: <red>Indeed there are those who are last who will be first, and first who will be last.”</red>

verses.textZh: 就在那时候，有几个法利赛人来对耶稣说："你离开这里走吧！因为希律想要杀你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在那时候，有几个法利赛人来对耶稣说："你离开这里走吧！因为希律想要杀你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 正当那时，有几个法利赛人来对耶稣说：「离开这里去吧，因为希律想要杀你。」
verses.textEnNiv: At that time some Pharisees came to Jesus and said to him, "Leave this place and go somewhere else. Herod wants to kill you."
verses.textEnEsv: At that very hour some Pharisees came and said to him, "Get away from here, for Herod wants to kill you."
verses.textEnNkjv: On that very day some Pharisees came, saying to Him, "Get out and depart from here, for Herod wants to kill You."
verses.textEnNlt: At that time some Pharisees said to him, "Get away from here if you want to live! Herod Antipas wants to kill you!"
verses.textEnNasb: At that very time some Pharisees approached, saying to Him, "Go away and leave this place, because Herod wants to kill You."
verses.textEn: At that time some Pharisees came to Jesus and said to him, "Leave this place and go somewhere else. Herod wants to kill you."

verses.textZh: 他说："<red>你们去告诉那个狐狸，今天明天我赶鬼医病，第三天我的事就完成了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："<red>你们去告诉那个狐狸，今天明天我赶鬼医病，第三天我的事就完成了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「你们去告诉那个狐狸说：『今天、明天我赶鬼治病，第三天我的事就成全了。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, <red>“Go tell that fox, ‘I will keep on driving out demons and healing people today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will reach my goal.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I finish my course.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Go, tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.’
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "Go tell that fox that I will keep on casting out demons and healing people today and tomorrow; and the third day I will accomplish my purpose.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I am casting out demons and performing healings today and tomorrow, and on the third day I reach My goal.’
verses.textEn: He replied, <red>“Go tell that fox, ‘I will keep on driving out demons and healing people today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will reach my goal.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而，今天明天后天，我必须前行，因为先知不能在耶路撒冷以外丧命。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而，今天明天后天，我必须前行，因为先知不能在耶路撒冷以外丧命。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>虽然这样，今天、明天、后天，我必须前行，因为先知在耶路撒冷之外丧命是不能的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>In any case, I must press on today and tomorrow and the next day—for surely no prophet can die outside Jerusalem!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the day following, for it cannot be that a prophet should perish away from Jerusalem.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless I must journey today, tomorrow, and the day following; for it cannot be that a prophet should perish outside of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, today, tomorrow, and the next day I must proceed on my way. For it wouldn’t do for a prophet of God to be killed except in Jerusalem!
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless I must go on My journey today and tomorrow and the next day; for it cannot be that a prophet would perish outside Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: <red>In any case, I must press on today and tomorrow and the next day—for surely no prophet can die outside Jerusalem!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>耶路撒冷啊，耶路撒冷，你杀害先知，又用石头把奉派到你那里的人打死。我多次想招聚你的儿女，好象母鸡招聚小鸡到翅膀底下，只是你们不愿意。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶路撒冷啊，耶路撒冷，你杀害先知，又用石头把奉派到你那里的人打死。我多次想招聚你的儿女，好象母鸡招聚小鸡到翅膀底下，只是你们不愿意。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶路撒冷啊！耶路撒冷啊！你常杀害先知，又用石头打死那奉差遣到你这里来的人。我多次愿意聚集你的儿女，好像母鸡把小鸡聚集在翅膀底下；只是你们不愿意。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Jerusalem,p Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you were not willing.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the city that kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to it! How often would I have gathered your children together as a hen gathers her brood under her wings, and you were not willing!
verses.textEnNkjv: "O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the one who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her brood under her wings, but you were not willing!
verses.textEnNlt: "O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the city that kills the prophets and stones God’s messengers! How often I have wanted to gather your children together as a hen protects her chicks beneath her wings, but you wouldn’t let me.
verses.textEnNasb: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the city that kills the prophets and stones those who have been sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, just as a hen gathers her young under her wings, and you were unwilling!
verses.textEn: <red>“Jerusalem,p Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you were not willing.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你看，你们的家必成为荒场留给你们。我告诉你们，从今以后，你们一定见不到我，直等到你们说：‘奉主名来的，是应当称颂的。’"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你看，你们的家必成为荒场留给你们。我告诉你们，从今以后，你们一定见不到我，直等到你们说：‘奉主名来的，是应当称颂的。’"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>看哪，你们的家成为荒场留给你们。我告诉你们，从今以后你们不得再见我，直等到你们说：『奉主名来的是应当称颂的。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Look, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.’”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, your house is forsaken. And I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’"
verses.textEnNkjv: See! Your house is left to you desolate; and assuredly, I say to you, you shall not see Me until the time comes when you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And now, look, your house is abandoned. And you will never see me again until you say, ‘Blessings on the one who comes in the name of the Lord !’ "
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, your house is left to you desolate; and I say to you, you will not see Me until you say, ‘Blessed is the One who comes in the name of the Lord!’ "
verses.textEn: <red>Look, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.’”</red>

verses.textZh: 在安息日，耶稣进了一个法利赛人领袖的家里吃饭，众人都在窥探他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在安息日，耶稣进了一个法利赛人领袖的家里吃饭，众人都在窥探他。
verses.textZhCuv: 安息日，耶稣到一个法利赛人的首领家里去吃饭，他们就窥探他。
verses.textEnNiv: One Sabbath, when Jesus went to eat in the house of a prominent Pharisee, he was being carefully watched.
verses.textEnEsv: One Sabbath, when he went to dine at the house of a ruler of the Pharisees, they were watching him carefully.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, as He went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees to eat bread on the Sabbath, that they watched Him closely.
verses.textEnNlt: One Sabbath day Jesus went to eat dinner in the home of a leader of the Pharisees, and the people were watching him closely.
verses.textEnNasb: It happened that when He went into the house of one of the leaders of the Pharisees on the Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching Him closely.
verses.textEn: One Sabbath, when Jesus went to eat in the house of a prominent Pharisee, he was being carefully watched.

verses.textZh: 正好在他面前有一个患水臌病的人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 正好在他面前有一个患水臌病的人；
verses.textZhCuv: 在他面前有一个患水臌的人。
verses.textEnNiv: There in front of him was a man suffering from abnormal swelling of his body.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, there was a man before him who had dropsy.
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, there was a certain man before Him who had dropsy.
verses.textEnNlt: There was a man there whose arms and legs were swollen.
verses.textEnNasb: And there in front of Him was a man suffering from edema.
verses.textEn: There in front of him was a man suffering from abnormal swelling of his body.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对律法师和法利赛人说："<red>在安息日治病，可以不可以呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对律法师和法利赛人说："<red>在安息日治病，可以不可以呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对律法师和法利赛人说：「<red>安息日治病可以不可以？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus asked the Pharisees and experts in the law, <red>“Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath or not?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus responded to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath, or not?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus asked the Pharisees and experts in religious law, "Is it permitted in the law to heal people on the Sabbath day, or not?"
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus responded and said to the lawyers and Pharisees, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath, or not?"
verses.textEn: Jesus asked the Pharisees and experts in the law, <red>“Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath or not?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们却不出声。耶稣扶着病人，治好他，叫他走了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们却不出声。耶稣扶着病人，治好他，叫他走了，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却不言语。耶稣就治好那人，叫他走了；
verses.textEnNiv: But they remained silent. So taking hold of the man, he healed him and sent him on his way.
verses.textEnEsv: But they remained silent. Then he took him and healed him and sent him away.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they kept silent. And He took him and healed him, and let him go.
verses.textEnNlt: When they refused to answer, Jesus touched the sick man and healed him and sent him away.
verses.textEnNasb: But they kept silent. And He took hold of him and healed him, and sent him away.
verses.textEn: But they remained silent. So taking hold of the man, he healed him and sent him on his way.

verses.textZh: 就对他们说："<red>你们中间谁的儿子或牛在安息日掉在井里，不立刻把他拉上来呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就对他们说："<red>你们中间谁的儿子或牛在安息日掉在井里，不立刻把他拉上来呢？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 便对他们说：「<red>你们中间谁有驴或有牛，在安息日掉在井里，不立时拉它上来呢？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he asked them, <red>“If one of you has a child or an ox that falls into a well on the Sabbath day, will you not immediately pull it out?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Which of you, having a son or an ox that has fallen into a well on a Sabbath day, will not immediately pull him out?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He answered them, saying, "Which of you, having a donkey or an ox that has fallen into a pit, will not immediately pull him out on the Sabbath day?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then he turned to them and said, "Which of you doesn’t work on the Sabbath? If your son or your cow falls into a pit, don’t you rush to get him out?"
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, " Which one of you will have a son or an ox fall into a well, and will not immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?"
verses.textEn: Then he asked them, <red>“If one of you has a child or an ox that falls into a well on the Sabbath day, will you not immediately pull it out?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们不能回答这些话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不能回答这些话。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不能对答这话。
verses.textEnNiv: And they had nothing to say.
verses.textEnEsv: And they could not reply to these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they could not answer Him regarding these things.
verses.textEnNlt: Again they could not answer.
verses.textEnNasb: And they could offer no reply to this.
verses.textEn: And they had nothing to say.

verses.textZh: 耶稣看见被邀请的客人选择高位，就用比喻对他们说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看见被邀请的客人选择高位，就用比喻对他们说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣见所请的客拣择首位，就用比喻对他们说：
verses.textEnNiv: When he noticed how the guests picked the places of honor at the table, he told them this parable:
verses.textEnEsv: Now he told a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the places of honor, saying to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: So He told a parable to those who were invited, when He noted how they chose the best places, saying to them:
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus noticed that all who had come to the dinner were trying to sit in the seats of honor near the head of the table, he gave them this advice:
verses.textEnNasb: Now He began telling a parable to the invited guests when He noticed how they had been picking out the places of honor at the table, saying to them,
verses.textEn: When he noticed how the guests picked the places of honor at the table, he told them this parable:

verses.textZh: <red>"你被邀请参加婚筵的时候，不要自己坐在高位上，恐怕有比你更尊贵的客人也被请来；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你被邀请参加婚筵的时候，不要自己坐在高位上，恐怕有比你更尊贵的客人也被请来；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你被人请去赴婚姻的筵席，不要坐在首位上，恐怕有比你尊贵的客被他请来；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“When someone invites you to a wedding feast, do not take the place of honor, for a person more distinguished than you may have been invited.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "When you are invited by someone to a wedding feast, do not sit down in a place of honor, lest someone more distinguished than you be invited by him,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, do not sit down in the best place, lest one more honorable than you be invited by him;
verses.textEnNlt: "When you are invited to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the seat of honor. What if someone who is more distinguished than you has also been invited?
verses.textEnNasb: "Whenever you are invited by someone to a wedding feast, do not take the place of honor, for someone more distinguished than you may have been invited by him,
verses.textEn: <red>“When someone invites you to a wedding feast, do not take the place of honor, for a person more distinguished than you may have been invited.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那请你又请他的人过来对你说：‘请你让位给这个人。’那时你就惭愧地退居末位了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那请你又请他的人过来对你说：‘请你让位给这个人。’那时你就惭愧地退居末位了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那请你们的人前来对你说：『让座给这一位吧！』你就羞羞惭惭地退到末位上去了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If so, the host who invited both of you will come and say to you, ‘Give this person your seat.’ Then, humiliated, you will have to take the least important place.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and he who invited you both will come and say to you, ‘Give your place to this person,’ and then you will begin with shame to take the lowest place.
verses.textEnNkjv: and he who invited you and him come and say to you, ‘Give place to this man,’ and then you begin with shame to take the lowest place.
verses.textEnNlt: The host will come and say, ‘Give this person your seat.’ Then you will be embarrassed, and you will have to take whatever seat is left at the foot of the table!
verses.textEnNasb: and the one who invited you both will come and say to you, ‘Give your place to this person,’ and then in disgrace you will proceed to occupy the last place.
verses.textEn: <red>If so, the host who invited both of you will come and say to you, ‘Give this person your seat.’ Then, humiliated, you will have to take the least important place.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你被邀请的时候，要坐在末位上，等请你的人过来对你说：‘朋友，请上座。’那时你在同席的人面前才有光彩。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你被邀请的时候，要坐在末位上，等请你的人过来对你说：‘朋友，请上座。’那时你在同席的人面前才有光彩。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你被请的时候，就去坐在末位上，好叫那请你的人来对你说：『朋友，请上座。』那时，你在同席的人面前就有光彩了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But when you are invited, take the lowest place, so that when your host comes, he will say to you, ‘Friend, move up to a better place.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all the other guests.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when your host comes he may say to you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at table with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when you are invited, go and sit down in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes he may say to you, ‘Friend, go up higher.’ Then you will have glory in the presence of those who sit at the table with you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Instead, take the lowest place at the foot of the table. Then when your host sees you, he will come and say, ‘Friend, we have a better place for you!’ Then you will be honored in front of all the other guests.
verses.textEnNasb: But whenever you are invited, go and take the last place, so that when the one who has invited you comes, he will say to you, ‘Friend, move up higher’; then you will have honor in the sight of all who are dining at the table with you.
verses.textEn: <red>But when you are invited, take the lowest place, so that when your host comes, he will say to you, ‘Friend, move up to a better place.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all the other guests.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为凡高抬自己的，必要降卑；自己谦卑的，必要升高。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为凡高抬自己的，必要降卑；自己谦卑的，必要升高。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为，凡自高的，必降为卑；自卑的，必升为高。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For all those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted."
verses.textEnNkjv: For whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted."
verses.textEnNlt: For those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted."
verses.textEnNasb: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and the one who humbles himself will be exalted."
verses.textEn: <red>For all those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对邀请他的人说："<red>你设午餐或晚宴，不要请你的朋友、弟兄、亲戚或富裕的邻舍，恐怕他们又回请你，你就得了报答。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对邀请他的人说："<red>你设午餐或晚宴，不要请你的朋友、弟兄、亲戚或富裕的邻舍，恐怕他们又回请你，你就得了报答。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣又对请他的人说：「你摆设午饭或晚饭，不要请你的朋友、弟兄、亲属，和富足的邻舍，恐怕他们也请你，你就得了报答。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to his host, <red>“When you give a luncheon or dinner, do not invite your friends, your brothers or sisters, your relatives, or your rich neighbors; if you do, they may invite you back and so you will be repaid.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said also to the man who had invited him, "When you give a dinner or a banquet, do not invite your friends or your brothers or your relatives or rich neighbors, lest they also invite you in return and you be repaid.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He also said to him who invited Him, "When you give a dinner or a supper, do not ask your friends, your brothers, your relatives, nor rich neighbors, lest they also invite you back, and you be repaid.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he turned to his host. "When you put on a luncheon or a banquet," he said, "don’t invite your friends, brothers, relatives, and rich neighbors. For they will invite you back, and that will be your only reward.
verses.textEnNasb: Now He also went on to say to the one who had invited Him, "Whenever you give a luncheon or a dinner, do not invite your friends, your brothers, your relatives, nor wealthy neighbors, otherwise they may also invite you to a meal in return, and that will be your repayment.
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to his host, <red>“When you give a luncheon or dinner, do not invite your friends, your brothers or sisters, your relatives, or your rich neighbors; if you do, they may invite you back and so you will be repaid.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你摆筵席的时候，总要邀请那贫穷的、残废的、瘸腿的、瞎眼的，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你摆筵席的时候，总要邀请那贫穷的、残废的、瘸腿的、瞎眼的，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你摆设筵席，倒要请那贫穷的、残废的、瘸腿的、瞎眼的，你就有福了！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But when you give a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, the blind,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But when you give a feast, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, the blind,
verses.textEnNkjv: But when you give a feast, invite the poor, themaimed, the lame, the blind.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, and the blind.
verses.textEnNasb: But whenever you give a banquet, invite people who are poor, who have disabilities, who are limping, and people who are blind;
verses.textEn: <red>But when you give a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, the blind,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那你就有福了。因为他们没有甚么可以报答你，义人复活的时候，你必定得着报答。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那你就有福了。因为他们没有甚么可以报答你，义人复活的时候，你必定得着报答。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为他们没有什么可报答你。到义人复活的时候，你要得着报答。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and you will be blessed. Although they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and you will be blessed, because they cannot repay you. For you will be repaid at the resurrection of the just."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you will be blessed, because they cannot repay you; for you shall be repaid at the resurrection of the just."
verses.textEnNlt: Then at the resurrection of the righteous, God will reward you for inviting those who could not repay you."
verses.textEnNasb: and you will be blessed, since they do not have the means to repay you; for you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous."
verses.textEn: <red>and you will be blessed. Although they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.”</red>

verses.textZh: 一起吃饭的人中有一个，听了这些话，就对耶稣说："在神的国里吃饭的人有福了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 一起吃饭的人中有一个，听了这些话，就对耶稣说："在神的国里吃饭的人有福了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 同席的有一人听见这话，就对耶稣说：「在神国里吃饭的有福了！」
verses.textEnNiv: When one of those at the table with him heard this, he said to Jesus, "Blessed is the one who will eat at the feast in the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnEsv: When one of those who reclined at table with him heard these things, he said to him, "Blessed is everyone who will eat bread in the kingdom of God!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when one of those who sat at the table with Him heard these things, he said to Him, "Blessed is he who shall eat bread in the kingdom of God!"
verses.textEnNlt: Hearing this, a man sitting at the table with Jesus exclaimed, "What a blessing it will be to attend a banquet in the Kingdom of God!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now when one of those who were reclining at the table with Him heard this, he said to Him, "Blessed is everyone who will eat bread in the kingdom of God!"
verses.textEn: When one of those at the table with him heard this, he said to Jesus, "Blessed is the one who will eat at the feast in the kingdom of God."

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他说："<red>有一个人大摆筵席，请了许多客人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他说："<red>有一个人大摆筵席，请了许多客人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他说：「有一人摆设大筵席，请了许多客。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied: <red>“A certain man was preparing a great banquet and invited many guests.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he said to him, "A man once gave a great banquet and invited many.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to him, "A certain man gave a great supper and invited many,
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied with this story: "A man prepared a great feast and sent out many invitations.
verses.textEnNasb: But He said to him, "A man was giving a big dinner, and he invited many;
verses.textEn: Jesus replied: <red>“A certain man was preparing a great banquet and invited many guests.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>到了开席的时候，他打发仆人去对所请的人说：‘请来吧！样样都准备好了。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>到了开席的时候，他打发仆人去对所请的人说：‘请来吧！样样都准备好了。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>到了坐席的时候，打发仆人去对所请的人说：『请来吧！样样都齐备了。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>At the time of the banquet he sent his servant to tell those who had been invited, ‘Come, for everything is now ready.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And at the time for the banquet he sent his servant to say to those who had been invited, ‘Come, for everything is now ready.’
verses.textEnNkjv: and sent his servant at supper time to say to those who were invited, ‘Come, for all things are now ready.’
verses.textEnNlt: When the banquet was ready, he sent his servant to tell the guests, ‘Come, the banquet is ready.’
verses.textEnNasb: and at the dinner hour he sent his slave to tell those who had been invited, ‘Come, because everything is ready now.’
verses.textEn: <red>At the time of the banquet he sent his servant to tell those who had been invited, ‘Come, for everything is now ready.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>众人一致推辞，头一个说：‘我买了一块地，不得不去看一看，请原谅我。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>众人一致推辞，头一个说：‘我买了一块地，不得不去看一看，请原谅我。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>众人一口同音地推辞。头一个说：『我买了一块地，必须去看看。请你准我辞了。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp they all alike began to make excuses. The first said, ‘I have just bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please excuse me.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But they all alike began to make excuses. The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go out and see it. Please have me excused.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But they all with one accord began to make excuses. The first said to him, ‘I have bought a piece of ground, and I must go and see it. I ask you to have me excused.’
verses.textEnNlt: But they all began making excuses. One said, ‘I have just bought a field and must inspect it. Please excuse me.’
verses.textEnNasb: And yet they all alike began to make excuses. The first one said to him, ‘I purchased a field and I need to go out to look at it; please consider me excused.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp they all alike began to make excuses. The first said, ‘I have just bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please excuse me.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>另一个说：‘我买了五对牛，要去试一试，请原谅我。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>另一个说：‘我买了五对牛，要去试一试，请原谅我。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又有一个说：『我买了五对牛，要去试一试。请你准我辞了。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Anotherp said, ‘I have just bought five yoke of oxen, and I’m on my way to try them out. Please excuse me.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to examine them. Please have me excused.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I am going to test them. I ask you to have me excused.’
verses.textEnNlt: Another said, ‘I have just bought five pairs of oxen, and I want to try them out. Please excuse me.’
verses.textEnNasb: And another one said, ‘I bought five yoke of oxen, and I am going to try them out; please consider me excused.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Anotherp said, ‘I have just bought five yoke of oxen, and I’m on my way to try them out. Please excuse me.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>又一个说：‘我刚结了婚，不能去。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>又一个说：‘我刚结了婚，不能去。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又有一个说：『我才娶了妻，所以不能去。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Stillp another said, ‘I just got married, so I can’t come.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Still another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.’
verses.textEnNlt: Another said, ‘I just got married, so I can’t come.’
verses.textEnNasb: And another one said, ‘I took a woman as my wife, and for that reason I cannot come.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Stillp another said, ‘I just got married, so I can’t come.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>仆人回来把这些事告诉他主人，家主就发怒，对仆人说：‘快到城里大街小巷去，把贫穷的、残废的、瞎眼的、瘸腿的，都领到这里来。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>仆人回来把这些事告诉他主人，家主就发怒，对仆人说：‘快到城里大街小巷去，把贫穷的、残废的、瞎眼的、瘸腿的，都领到这里来。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那仆人回来，把这事都告诉了主人。家主就动怒，对仆人说：『快出去，到城里大街小巷，领那贫穷的、残废的、瞎眼的、瘸腿的来。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thep servant came back and reported this to his master. Then the owner of the house became angry and ordered his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the town and bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind and the lame.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So the servant came and reported these things to his master. Then the master of the house became angry and said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly to the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor and crippled and blind and lame.’
verses.textEnNkjv: So that servant came and reported these things to his master. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in here the poor and themaimed and the lame and the blind.’
verses.textEnNlt: "The servant returned and told his master what they had said. His master was furious and said, ‘Go quickly into the streets and alleys of the town and invite the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame.’
verses.textEnNasb: And the slave came back and reported this to his master. Then the head of the household became angry and said to his slave, ‘Go out at once into the streets and lanes of the city and bring in here those who are poor, those with disabilities, those who are blind, and those who are limping.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep servant came back and reported this to his master. Then the owner of the house became angry and ordered his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the town and bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind and the lame.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>仆人说：‘主啊，你所吩咐的已经办了，还有空位。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>仆人说：‘主啊，你所吩咐的已经办了，还有空位。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>仆人说：『主啊，你所吩咐的已经办了，还有空座。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“ ‘Sir,’p the servant said, ‘what you ordered has been done, but there is still room.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the servant said, ‘Sir, what you commanded has been done, and still there is room.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And the servant said, ‘Master, it is done as you commanded, and still there is room.’
verses.textEnNlt: After the servant had done this, he reported, ‘There is still room for more.’
verses.textEnNasb: And later the slave said, ‘Master, what you commanded has been done, and still there is room.’
verses.textEn: <red>“ ‘Sir,’p the servant said, ‘what you ordered has been done, but there is still room.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>主人就对仆人说：‘你出去到路边篱畔，勉强人进来，好把我的屋子坐满。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>主人就对仆人说：‘你出去到路边篱畔，勉强人进来，好把我的屋子坐满。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主人对仆人说：『你出去到路上和篱笆那里，勉强人进来，坐满我的屋子。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thenp the master told his servant, ‘Go out to the roads and country lanes and compel them to come in, so that my house will be full.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the master said to the servant, ‘Go out to the highways and hedges and compel people to come in, that my house may be filled.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the master said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
verses.textEnNlt: So his master said, ‘Go out into the country lanes and behind the hedges and urge anyone you find to come, so that the house will be full.
verses.textEnNasb: And the master said to the slave, ‘Go out into the roads and the hedges and press upon them to come in, so that my house will be filled.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thenp the master told his servant, ‘Go out to the roads and country lanes and compel them to come in, so that my house will be full.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，先前请的那些人，一个也不得尝我的筵席。’"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，先前请的那些人，一个也不得尝我的筵席。’"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我告诉你们，先前所请的人没有一个得尝我的筵席。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I tell you, not one of those who were invited will get a taste of my banquet.’ ”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For I tell you, none of those men who were invited shall taste my banquet.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: For I say to you that none of those men who were invited shall taste my supper.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: For none of those I first invited will get even the smallest taste of my banquet.’"
verses.textEnNasb: For I tell you, none of those men who were invited shall taste my dinner.’ "
verses.textEn: <red>I tell you, not one of those who were invited will get a taste of my banquet.’ ”</red>

verses.textZh: 有许多人与耶稣同行，他转身对他们说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 有许多人与耶稣同行，他转身对他们说：
verses.textZhCuv: 有极多的人和耶稣同行。他转过来对他们说：
verses.textEnNiv: Large crowds were traveling with Jesus, and turning to them he said:
verses.textEnEsv: Now great crowds accompanied him, and he turned and said to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now great multitudes went with Him. And He turned and said to them,
verses.textEnNlt: A large crowd was following Jesus. He turned around and said to them,
verses.textEnNasb: Now large crowds were going along with Him, and He turned and said to them,
verses.textEn: Large crowds were traveling with Jesus, and turning to them he said:

verses.textZh: <red>"如果有人到我这里来，爱我不超过爱 自己的父母、妻子、儿女、兄弟、姊妹，甚至自己的性命，就不能作我的门徒。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"如果有人到我这里来，爱我不超过爱 自己的父母、妻子、儿女、兄弟、姊妹，甚至自己的性命，就不能作我的门徒。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「人到我这里来，若不爱我胜过爱 自己的父 母、妻子、儿女、弟兄、姊妹，和自己的性命，就不能作我的门徒。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“If anyone comes to me and does not hate father and mother, wife and children, brothers and sisters—yes, even their own life—such a person cannot be my disciple.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "If anyone comes to me and does not hate his own father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters, yes, and even his own life, he cannot be my disciple.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If anyone comes to Me and does not hate his father and mother, wife and children, brothers and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he cannot be My disciple.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you want to be my disciple, you must, by comparison, hate everyone else—your father and mother, wife and children, brothers and sisters—yes, even your own life. Otherwise, you cannot be my disciple.
verses.textEnNasb: "If anyone comes to Me and does not hate his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, sisters, yes, and even his own life, he cannot be My disciple.
verses.textEn: <red>“If anyone comes to me and does not hate father and mother, wife and children, brothers and sisters—yes, even their own life—such a person cannot be my disciple.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡不背着自己的十字架跟随我的，也不能作我的门徒。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡不背着自己的十字架跟随我的，也不能作我的门徒。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡不背着自己十字架跟从我的，也不能作我的门徒。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And whoever does not carry their cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever does not bear his own cross and come after me cannot be my disciple.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whoever does not bear his cross and come after Me cannot be My disciple.
verses.textEnNlt: And if you do not carry your own cross and follow me, you cannot be my disciple.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever does not carry his own cross and come after Me cannot be My disciple.
verses.textEn: <red>And whoever does not carry their cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们当中有谁要盖一座楼，不先坐下计算费用，能不能盖成呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们当中有谁要盖一座楼，不先坐下计算费用，能不能盖成呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们哪一个要盖一座楼，不先坐下算计花费，能盖成不能呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Supposep one of you wants to build a tower. Won’t you first sit down and estimate the cost to see if you have enough money to complete it?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, does not first sit down and count the cost, whether he has enough to complete it?
verses.textEnNkjv: For which of you, intending to build a tower, does not sit down first and count the cost, whether he has enough to finish it—
verses.textEnNlt: "But don’t begin until you count the cost. For who would begin construction of a building without first calculating the cost to see if there is enough money to finish it?
verses.textEnNasb: For which one of you, when he wants to build a tower, does not first sit down and calculate the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?
verses.textEn: <red>“Supposep one of you wants to build a tower. Won’t you first sit down and estimate the cost to see if you have enough money to complete it?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>恐怕安了地基，而不能完成，所有看见的人都讥笑他，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>恐怕安了地基，而不能完成，所有看见的人都讥笑他，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>恐怕安了地基，不能成功，看见的人都笑话他，说：</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For if you lay the foundation and are not able to finish it, everyone who sees it will ridicule you,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Otherwise, when he has laid a foundation and is not able to finish, all who see it begin to mock him,
verses.textEnNkjv: lest, after he has laid the foundation, and is not able to finish, all who see it begin to mock him,
verses.textEnNlt: Otherwise, you might complete only the foundation before running out of money, and then everyone would laugh at you.
verses.textEnNasb: Otherwise, when he has laid a foundation and is not able to finish, all who are watching it will begin to ridicule him,
verses.textEn: <red>For if you lay the foundation and are not able to finish it, everyone who sees it will ridicule you,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>说：‘这个人开了工，却不能完工。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>说：‘这个人开了工，却不能完工。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>『这个人开了工，却不能完工。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>saying, ‘This person began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: saying, ‘This man began to build and was not able to finish.’
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, ‘This man began to build and was not able to finish’?
verses.textEnNlt: They would say, ‘There’s the person who started that building and couldn’t afford to finish it!’
verses.textEnNasb: saying, ‘This person began to build, and was not able to finish!’
verses.textEn: <red>saying, ‘This person began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>或者一个王去和别的王打仗，哪有不先坐下想想，能否用一万兵去抵抗那领两万来攻打他的呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>或者一个王去和别的王打仗，哪有不先坐下想想，能否用一万兵去抵抗那领两万来攻打他的呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>或是一个王出去和别的王打仗，岂不先坐下酌量，能用一万兵去敌那领二万兵来攻打他的吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Orp suppose a king is about to go to war against another king. Won’t he first sit down and consider whether he is able with ten thousand men to oppose the one coming against him with twenty thousand?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Or what king, going out to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and deliberate whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or what king, going to make war against another king, does not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?
verses.textEnNlt: "Or what king would go to war against another king without first sitting down with his counselors to discuss whether his army of 10,000 could defeat the 20,000 soldiers marching against him?
verses.textEnNasb: Or what king, when he sets out to meet another king in battle, will not first sit down and consider whether he is strong enough with ten thousand men to face the one coming against him with twenty thousand?
verses.textEn: <red>“Orp suppose a king is about to go to war against another king. Won’t he first sit down and consider whether he is able with ten thousand men to oppose the one coming against him with twenty thousand?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果不能，就该趁对方还远的时候，派使者去谈判和平的条件。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果不能，就该趁对方还远的时候，派使者去谈判和平的条件。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若是不能，就趁敌人还远的时候，派使者去求和息的条款。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If he is not able, he will send a delegation while the other is still a long way off and will ask for terms of peace.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if not, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends a delegation and asks for terms of peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Or else, while the other is still a great way off, he sends a delegation and asks conditions of peace.
verses.textEnNlt: And if he can’t, he will send a delegation to discuss terms of peace while the enemy is still far away.
verses.textEnNasb: Otherwise, while the other is still far away, he sends a delegation and requests terms of peace.
verses.textEn: <red>If he is not able, he will send a delegation while the other is still a long way off and will ask for terms of peace.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>这样，你们中间不论谁，如果不撇下一切所有的，就不能作我的门徒。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>这样，你们中间不论谁，如果不撇下一切所有的，就不能作我的门徒。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这样，你们无论什么人，若不撇下一切所有的，就不能作我的门徒。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>In the same way, those of you who do not give up everything you have cannot be my disciples.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So therefore, any one of you who does not renounce all that he has cannot be my disciple.
verses.textEnNkjv: So likewise, whoever of you does not forsake all that he has cannot be My disciple.
verses.textEnNlt: So you cannot become my disciple without giving up everything you own.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, none of you can be My disciple who does not give up all his own possessions.
verses.textEn: <red>In the same way, those of you who do not give up everything you have cannot be my disciples.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"盐本来是好的，但如果失了味，怎能使它再咸呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"盐本来是好的，但如果失了味，怎能使它再咸呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「盐本是好的；盐若失了味，可用什么叫它再咸呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Saltp is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Salt is good, but if salt has lost its taste, how shall its saltiness be restored?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Salt is good; but if the salt has lost its flavor, how shall it be seasoned?
verses.textEnNlt: "Salt is good for seasoning. But if it loses its flavor, how do you make it salty again?
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore, salt is good; but if even salt has become tasteless, with what will it be seasoned?
verses.textEn: <red>“Saltp is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>或用在田里，或放在粪里，都不合适；只好扔在外面。有耳可听的，就应当听。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>或用在田里，或放在粪里，都不合适；只好扔在外面。有耳可听的，就应当听。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>或用在田里，或堆在粪里，都不合式，只好丢在外面。有耳可听的，就应当听！」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile; it is thrown out. “Whoeverp has ears to hear, let them hear.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: It is of no use either for the soil or for the manure pile. It is thrown away. He who has ears to hear, let him hear."
verses.textEnNkjv: It is neither fit for the land nor for the dunghill, but men throw it out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear!"
verses.textEnNlt: Flavorless salt is good neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown away. Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand!"
verses.textEnNasb: It is useless either for the soil or the manure pile, so it is thrown out. The one who has ears to hear, let him hear."
verses.textEn: <red>It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile; it is thrown out. “Whoeverp has ears to hear, let them hear.”</red>

verses.textZh: 众税吏和罪人，都接近耶稣，要听他讲道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众税吏和罪人，都接近耶稣，要听他讲道。
verses.textZhCuv: 众税吏和罪人都挨近耶稣，要听他讲道。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the tax collectors and sinners were all gathering around to hear Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the tax collectors and sinners were all drawing near to hear him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the tax collectors and the sinners drew near to Him to hear Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Tax collectors and other notorious sinners often came to listen to Jesus teach.
verses.textEnNasb: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming near Jesus to listen to Him.
verses.textEn: Now the tax collectors and sinners were all gathering around to hear Jesus.

verses.textZh: 法利赛人和经学家，纷纷议论说："这个人接待罪人，又和他们一起吃饭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人和经学家，纷纷议论说："这个人接待罪人，又和他们一起吃饭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人和文士私下议论说：「这个人接待罪人，又同他们吃饭。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law muttered, "This man welcomes sinners and eats with them."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Pharisees and the scribes grumbled, saying, "This man receives sinners and eats with them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Pharisees and scribes complained, saying, "This Man receives sinners and eats with them."
verses.textEnNlt: This made the Pharisees and teachers of religious law complain that he was associating with such sinful people—even eating with them!
verses.textEnNasb: And both the Pharisees and the scribes began to complain, saying, "This Man receives sinners and eats with them."
verses.textEn: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law muttered, "This man welcomes sinners and eats with them."

verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣就对他们讲了这个比喻，说：

verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus told them this parable:
verses.textEnEsv: So he told them this parable:
verses.textEnNkjv: So He spoke this parable to them, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: So Jesus told them this story:
verses.textEnNasb: And so He told them this parable, saying,
verses.textEn: Then Jesus told them this parable:

verses.textZh: <red>"你们中间谁有一百只羊，失去一只，不把九十九只留下在旷野，去寻找那失落的，直到找着呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们中间谁有一百只羊，失去一只，不把九十九只留下在旷野，去寻找那失落的，直到找着呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们中间谁有一百只羊失去一只，不把这九十九只撇在旷野、去找那失去的羊，直到找着呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Suppose one of you has a hundred sheep and loses one of them. Doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine in the open country and go after the lost sheep until he finds it?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "What man of you, having a hundred sheep, if he has lost one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the open country, and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?
verses.textEnNkjv: "What man of you, having a hundred sheep, if he loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness, and go after the one which is lost until he finds it?
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them gets lost, what will he do? Won’t he leave the ninety-nine others in the wilderness and go to search for the one that is lost until he finds it?
verses.textEnNasb: "What man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and has lost one of them, does not leave the other ninety-nine in the open pasture and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?
verses.textEn: <red>“Suppose one of you has a hundred sheep and loses one of them. Doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine in the open country and go after the lost sheep until he finds it?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>既找着了，就欢欢喜喜地放在肩上，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>既找着了，就欢欢喜喜地放在肩上，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>找着了，就欢欢喜喜地扛在肩上，回到家里，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when he has found it, he lays it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he has found it, he lays it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
verses.textEnNlt: And when he has found it, he will joyfully carry it home on his shoulders.
verses.textEnNasb: And when he has found it, he puts it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
verses.textEn: <red>And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders</red>

verses.textZh: <red>回到家里，请朋友邻舍来，对他们说：‘请大家和我一同欢乐，因为我失去的羊已经找到了！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>回到家里，请朋友邻舍来，对他们说：‘请大家和我一同欢乐，因为我失去的羊已经找到了！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>就请朋友邻舍来，对他们说：『我失去的羊已经找着了，你们和我一同欢喜吧！』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and goes home. Then he calls his friends and neighbors together and says, ‘Rejoice with me; I have found my lost sheep.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep that was lost.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he comes home, he calls together his friends and neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’
verses.textEnNlt: When he arrives, he will call together his friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me because I have found my lost sheep.’
verses.textEnNasb: And when he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, because I have found my sheep that was lost!’
verses.textEn: <red>and goes home. Then he calls his friends and neighbors together and says, ‘Rejoice with me; I have found my lost sheep.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，因为一个罪人悔改，天上也要这样为他欢乐，比为九十九个不用悔改的义人欢乐更大。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，因为一个罪人悔改，天上也要这样为他欢乐，比为九十九个不用悔改的义人欢乐更大。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我告诉你们，一个罪人悔改，在天上也要这样为他欢喜，较比为九十九个不用悔改的义人欢喜更大。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I tell you that in the same way there will be more rejoicing in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who do not need to repent.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Just so, I tell you, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who need no repentance.
verses.textEnNkjv: I say to you that likewise there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine just persons who need no repentance.
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, there is more joy in heaven over one lost sinner who repents and returns to God than over ninety-nine others who are righteous and haven’t strayed away!
verses.textEnNasb: I tell you that in the same way, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous people who have no need of repentance.
verses.textEn: <red>I tell you that in the same way there will be more rejoicing in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who do not need to repent.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"或是一个女人，有十个银币 ，失去一个，哪能不点上灯，打扫屋子，细细地找，直到找着呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"或是一个女人，有十个银币 ，失去一个，哪能不点上灯，打扫屋子，细细地找，直到找着呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「或是一个妇人有十块钱，若失落一块，岂不点上灯，打扫屋子，细细地找，直到找着吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Orp suppose a woman has ten silver coins and loses one. Doesn’t she light a lamp, sweep the house and search carefully until she finds it?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Or what woman, having ten silver coins, if she loses one coin, does not light a lamp and sweep the house and seek diligently until she finds it?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Or what woman, having ten silver coins, if she loses one coin, does not light a lamp, sweep the house, and search carefully until she finds it?
verses.textEnNlt: "Or suppose a woman has ten silver coins and loses one. Won’t she light a lamp and sweep the entire house and search carefully until she finds it?
verses.textEnNasb: "Or what woman, if she has ten silver coins and loses one coin, does not light a lamp and sweep the house and search carefully until she finds it?
verses.textEn: <red>“Orp suppose a woman has ten silver coins and loses one. Doesn’t she light a lamp, sweep the house and search carefully until she finds it?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>既找着了，就请朋友邻舍来，说：‘请大家和我一同欢乐，因为我失去的那个银币，已经找到了。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>既找着了，就请朋友邻舍来，说：‘请大家和我一同欢乐，因为我失去的那个银币，已经找到了。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>找着了，就请朋友邻舍来，对他们说：『我失落的那块钱已经找着了，你们和我一同欢喜吧！』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And when she finds it, she calls her friends and neighbors together and says, ‘Rejoice with me; I have found my lost coin.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the coin that I had lost.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And when she has found it, she calls her friends and neighbors together, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the piece which I lost!’
verses.textEnNlt: And when she finds it, she will call in her friends and neighbors and say, ‘Rejoice with me because I have found my lost coin.’
verses.textEnNasb: And when she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, because I have found the coin which I had lost!’
