verses.textEn: <red>And when she finds it, she calls her friends and neighbors together and says, ‘Rejoice with me; I have found my lost coin.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，因为一个罪人悔改，神的使者也必这样为他欢乐。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，因为一个罪人悔改，神的使者也必这样为他欢乐。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我告诉你们，一个罪人悔改，在神的使者面前也是这样为他欢喜。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>In the same way, I tell you, there is rejoicing in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Just so, I tell you, there is joy before the angels of God over one sinner who repents."
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise, I say to you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents."
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, there is joy in the presence of God’s angels when even one sinner repents."
verses.textEnNasb: In the same way, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents."
verses.textEn: <red>In the same way, I tell you, there is rejoicing in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又说："<red>某人有两个儿子。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又说："<red>某人有两个儿子。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣又说：「一个人有两个儿子。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus continued: <red>“There was a man who had two sons.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "There was a man who had two sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said: "A certain man had two sons.
verses.textEnNlt: To illustrate the point further, Jesus told them this story: "A man had two sons.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said, "A man had two sons.
verses.textEn: Jesus continued: <red>“There was a man who had two sons.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>小儿子对父亲说：‘爸爸，请把我应得的家业给我。’父亲就把财产分给他们两兄弟。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>小儿子对父亲说：‘爸爸，请把我应得的家业给我。’父亲就把财产分给他们两兄弟。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>小儿子对父亲说：『父亲，请你把我应得的家业分给我。』他父亲就把产业分给他们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The younger one said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of the estate.’ So he divided his property between them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me the share of property that is coming to me.’ And he divided his property between them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me the portion of goods that falls to me.’ So he divided to them his livelihood.
verses.textEnNlt: The younger son told his father, ‘I want my share of your estate now before you die.’ So his father agreed to divide his wealth between his sons.
verses.textEnNasb: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me the share of the estate that is coming to me.’ And so he divided his wealth between them.
verses.textEn: <red>The younger one said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of the estate.’ So he divided his property between them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>过了不多几天，小儿子收拾一切，到远方去了，在那里生活放荡，浪费钱财。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>过了不多几天，小儿子收拾一切，到远方去了，在那里生活放荡，浪费钱财。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>过了不多几日，小儿子就把他一切所有的都收拾起来，往远方去了。在那里任意放荡，浪费资财。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Notp long after that, the younger son got together all he had, set off for a distant country and there squandered his wealth in wild living.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Not many days later, the younger son gathered all he had and took a journey into a far country, and there he squandered his property in reckless living.
verses.textEnNkjv: And not many days after, the younger son gathered all together, journeyed to a far country, and there wasted his possessions with prodigal living.
verses.textEnNlt: "A few days later this younger son packed all his belongings and moved to a distant land, and there he wasted all his money in wild living.
verses.textEnNasb: And not many days later, the younger son gathered everything together and went on a journey to a distant country, and there he squandered his estate in wild living.
verses.textEn: <red>“Notp long after that, the younger son got together all he had, set off for a distant country and there squandered his wealth in wild living.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他花尽了一切所有的，那地方又遇上了严重的饥荒，就穷困起来；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他花尽了一切所有的，那地方又遇上了严重的饥荒，就穷困起来；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>既耗尽了一切所有的，又遇着那地方大遭饥荒，就穷苦起来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>After he had spent everything, there was a severe famine in that whole country, and he began to be in need.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had spent everything, a severe famine arose in that country, and he began to be in need.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when he had spent all, there arose a severe famine in that land, and he began to be in want.
verses.textEnNlt: About the time his money ran out, a great famine swept over the land, and he began to starve.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when he had spent everything, a severe famine occurred in that country, and he began doing without.
verses.textEn: <red>After he had spent everything, there was a severe famine in that whole country, and he began to be in need.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>于是他去投靠当地的一个居民。那人打发他到田里去放猪，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>于是他去投靠当地的一个居民。那人打发他到田里去放猪，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>于是去投靠那地方的一个人；那人打发他到田里去放猪。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him to his fields to feed pigs.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So he went and hired himself out to one of the citizens of that country, who sent him into his fields to feed pigs.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
verses.textEnNlt: He persuaded a local farmer to hire him, and the man sent him into his fields to feed the pigs.
verses.textEnNasb: So he went and hired himself out to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.
verses.textEn: <red>So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him to his fields to feed pigs.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他恨不得吃猪所吃的豆荚，可是没有人给他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他恨不得吃猪所吃的豆荚，可是没有人给他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他恨不得拿猪所吃的豆荚充饥，也没有人给他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He longed to fill his stomach with the pods that the pigs were eating, but no one gave him anything.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he was longing to be fed with the pods that the pigs ate, and no one gave him anything.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he would gladly have filled his stomach with the pods that the swine ate, and no one gave him anything.
verses.textEnNlt: The young man became so hungry that even the pods he was feeding the pigs looked good to him. But no one gave him anything.
verses.textEnNasb: And he longed to have his fill of the carob pods that the pigs were eating, and no one was giving him anything.
verses.textEn: <red>He longed to fill his stomach with the pods that the pigs were eating, but no one gave him anything.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他醒悟过来，说：‘我父亲有那么多雇工，又有丰富的食物，我却要在这里饿死吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他醒悟过来，说：‘我父亲有那么多雇工，又有丰富的食物，我却要在这里饿死吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他醒悟过来，就说：『我父亲有多少的雇工，口粮有余，我倒在这里饿死吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whenp he came to his senses, he said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have food to spare, and here I am starving to death!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have more than enough bread, but I perish here with hunger!
verses.textEnNkjv: "But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
verses.textEnNlt: "When he finally came to his senses, he said to himself, ‘At home even the hired servants have food enough to spare, and here I am dying of hunger!
verses.textEnNasb: But when he came to his senses, he said, ‘How many of my father’s hired laborers have more than enough bread, but I am dying here from hunger!
verses.textEn: <red>“Whenp he came to his senses, he said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have food to spare, and here I am starving to death!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我要起来，到我父亲那里去，对他说：爸爸，我得罪了天，也得罪了你，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我要起来，到我父亲那里去，对他说：爸爸，我得罪了天，也得罪了你，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我要起来，到我父亲那里去，向他说：父亲！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I will set out and go back to my father and say to him: Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I will arise and go to my father, and I will say to him, "Father, I have sinned against heaven and before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will arise and go to my father, and will say to him, "Father, I have sinned against heaven and before you,
verses.textEnNlt: I will go home to my father and say, "Father, I have sinned against both heaven and you,
verses.textEnNasb: I will set out and go to my father, and will say to him, "Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight;
verses.textEn: <red>I will set out and go back to my father and say to him: Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不配再称为你的儿子，把我当作一个雇工吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不配再称为你的儿子，把我当作一个雇工吧！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>从今以后，我不配称为你的儿子，把我当作一个雇工吧！』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I am no longer worthy to be called your son; make me like one of your hired servants.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Treat me as one of your hired servants."’
verses.textEnNkjv: and I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants." ’
verses.textEnNlt: and I am no longer worthy of being called your son. Please take me on as a hired servant."’
verses.textEnNasb: I am no longer worthy to be called your son; treat me as one of your hired laborers." ’
verses.textEn: <red>I am no longer worthy to be called your son; make me like one of your hired servants.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>于是他起来往父亲那里去。他还在远处时，他父亲看见了他，就动了慈心，跑过去抱着他，连连与他亲吻。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>于是他起来往父亲那里去。他还在远处时，他父亲看见了他，就动了慈心，跑过去抱着他，连连与他亲吻。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>于是起来，往他父亲那里去。相离还远，他父亲看见，就动了慈心，跑去抱着他的颈项，连连与他亲嘴。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So he got up and went to his father. “Butp while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion for him; he ran to his son, threw his arms around him and kissed him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he arose and came to his father. But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and felt compassion, and ran and embraced him and kissed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And he arose and came to his father. But when he was still a great way off, his father saw him and had compassion, and ran and fell on his neck and kissed him.
verses.textEnNlt: "So he returned home to his father. And while he was still a long way off, his father saw him coming. Filled with love and compassion, he ran to his son, embraced him, and kissed him.
verses.textEnNasb: So he set out and came to his father. But when he was still a long way off, his father saw him and felt compassion for him, and ran and embraced him and kissed him.
verses.textEn: <red>So he got up and went to his father. “Butp while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion for him; he ran to his son, threw his arms around him and kissed him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>儿子说：‘爸爸，我得罪了天，也得罪了你，不配再称为你的儿子。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>儿子说：‘爸爸，我得罪了天，也得罪了你，不配再称为你的儿子。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>儿子说：『父亲！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；从今以后，我不配称为你的儿子。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thep son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and before you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And the son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight, and am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
verses.textEnNlt: His son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against both heaven and you, and I am no longer worthy of being called your son. ’
verses.textEnNasb: And the son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight; I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>父亲却吩咐仆人说：‘快把那最好的袍子拿来给他穿，把戒指戴在他手上，把鞋穿在他脚上，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>父亲却吩咐仆人说：‘快把那最好的袍子拿来给他穿，把戒指戴在他手上，把鞋穿在他脚上，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>父亲却吩咐仆人说：『把那上好的袍子快拿出来给他穿；把戒指戴在他指头上；把鞋穿在他脚上；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp the father said to his servants, ‘Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring quickly the best robe, and put it on him, and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him, and put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.
verses.textEnNlt: "But his father said to the servants, ‘Quick! Bring the finest robe in the house and put it on him. Get a ring for his finger and sandals for his feet.
verses.textEnNasb: But the father said to his slaves, ‘Quickly bring out the best robe and put it on him, and put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet;
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp the father said to his servants, ‘Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>把肥牛犊牵来宰了，我们要吃喝快乐，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>把肥牛犊牵来宰了，我们要吃喝快乐，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>把那肥牛犊牵来宰了，我们可以吃喝快乐；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let’s have a feast and celebrate.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And bring the fattened calf and kill it, and let us eat and celebrate.
verses.textEnNkjv: And bring the fatted calf here and kill it, and let us eat and be merry;
verses.textEnNlt: And kill the calf we have been fattening. We must celebrate with a feast,
verses.textEnNasb: and bring the fattened calf, slaughter it, and let’s eat and celebrate;
verses.textEn: <red>Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let’s have a feast and celebrate.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为我这儿子是死而复活、失而又得的。’他们就欢乐起来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为我这儿子是死而复活、失而又得的。’他们就欢乐起来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为我这个儿子是死而复活，失而又得的。』他们就快乐起来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For this son of mine was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’ So they began to celebrate.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found.’ And they began to celebrate.
verses.textEnNkjv: for this my son was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’ And they began to be merry.
verses.textEnNlt: for this son of mine was dead and has now returned to life. He was lost, but now he is found.’ So the party began.
verses.textEnNasb: for this son of mine was dead and has come to life again; he was lost and has been found.’ And they began to celebrate.
verses.textEn: <red>For this son of mine was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’ So they began to celebrate.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"那时，大儿子正在田里。他回来离家不远的时候，听见音乐跳舞的声音，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"那时，大儿子正在田里。他回来离家不远的时候，听见音乐跳舞的声音，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，大儿子正在田里。他回来，离家不远，听见作乐跳舞的声音，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Meanwhile,p the older son was in the field. When he came near the house, he heard music and dancing.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Now his older son was in the field, and as he came and drew near to the house, he heard music and dancing.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now his older son was in the field. And as he came and drew near to the house, he heard music and dancing.
verses.textEnNlt: "Meanwhile, the older son was in the fields working. When he returned home, he heard music and dancing in the house,
verses.textEnNasb: "Now his older son was in the field, and when he came and approached the house, he heard music and dancing.
verses.textEn: <red>“Meanwhile,p the older son was in the field. When he came near the house, he heard music and dancing.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>就叫了一个仆人来，问他这是怎么一回事。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>就叫了一个仆人来，问他这是怎么一回事。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>便叫过一个仆人来，问是什么事。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So he called one of the servants and asked him what was going on.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he called one of the servants and asked what these things meant.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he called one of the servants and asked what these things meant.
verses.textEnNlt: and he asked one of the servants what was going on.
verses.textEnNasb: And he summoned one of the servants and began inquiring what these things could be.
verses.textEn: <red>So he called one of the servants and asked him what was going on.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>仆人说：‘你弟弟回来了，你父亲因为他平安无恙地回来，就宰了肥牛犊。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>仆人说：‘你弟弟回来了，你父亲因为他平安无恙地回来，就宰了肥牛犊。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>仆人说：『你兄弟来了；你父亲因为得他无灾无病地回来，把肥牛犊宰了。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>‘Your brother has come,’ he replied, ‘and your father has killed the fattened calf because he has him back safe and sound.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and sound.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and because he has received him safe and sound, your father has killed the fatted calf.’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Your brother is back,’ he was told, ‘and your father has killed the fattened calf. We are celebrating because of his safe return.’
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has slaughtered the fattened calf because he has received him back safe and sound.’
verses.textEn: <red>‘Your brother has come,’ he replied, ‘and your father has killed the fattened calf because he has him back safe and sound.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>大儿子就生气，不肯进去；父亲出来劝他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>大儿子就生气，不肯进去；父亲出来劝他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>大儿子却生气，不肯进去；他父亲就出来劝他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thep older brother became angry and refused to go in. So his father went out and pleaded with him.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he was angry and refused to go in. His father came out and entreated him,
verses.textEnNkjv: "But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and pleaded with him.
verses.textEnNlt: "The older brother was angry and wouldn’t go in. His father came out and begged him,
verses.textEnNasb: But he became angry and was not willing to go in; and his father came out and began pleading with him.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep older brother became angry and refused to go in. So his father went out and pleaded with him.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他对父亲说：‘你看，我服事你这么多年，从来没有违背过你的命令，可是你没有给我一只山羊羔，叫我和朋友一同欢乐。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他对父亲说：‘你看，我服事你这么多年，从来没有违背过你的命令，可是你没有给我一只山羊羔，叫我和朋友一同欢乐。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他对父亲说：『我服事你这多年，从来没有违背过你的命，你并没有给我一只山羊羔，叫我和朋友一同快乐。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But he answered his father, ‘Look! All these years I’ve been slaving for you and never disobeyed your orders. Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but he answered his father, ‘Look, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed your command, yet you never gave me a young goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he answered and said to his father, ‘Lo, these many years I have been serving you; I never transgressed your commandment at any time; and yet you never gave me a young goat, that I might make merry with my friends.
verses.textEnNlt: but he replied, ‘All these years I’ve slaved for you and never once refused to do a single thing you told me to. And in all that time you never gave me even one young goat for a feast with my friends.
verses.textEnNasb: But he answered and said to his father, ‘Look! For so many years I have been serving you and I have never neglected a command of yours; and yet you never gave me a young goat, so that I might celebrate with my friends;
verses.textEn: <red>But he answered his father, ‘Look! All these years I’ve been slaving for you and never disobeyed your orders. Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但你这个儿子，常常跟娼妓在一起，花尽了你的财产，他一回来，你倒为他宰杀肥牛犊！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但你这个儿子，常常跟娼妓在一起，花尽了你的财产，他一回来，你倒为他宰杀肥牛犊！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但你这个儿子和娼妓吞尽了你的产业，他一来了，你倒为他宰了肥牛犊。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But when this son of yours who has squandered your property with prostitutes comes home, you kill the fattened calf for him!’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But when this son of yours came, who has devoured your property with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him!’
verses.textEnNkjv: But as soon as this son of yours came, who has devoured your livelihood with harlots, you killed the fatted calf for him.’
verses.textEnNlt: Yet when this son of yours comes back after squandering your money on prostitutes, you celebrate by killing the fattened calf!’
verses.textEnNasb: but when this son of yours came, who has devoured your wealth with prostitutes, you slaughtered the fattened calf for him.’
verses.textEn: <red>But when this son of yours who has squandered your property with prostitutes comes home, you kill the fattened calf for him!’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>父亲对他说：‘孩子，你常跟我在一起，我的一切都是你的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>父亲对他说：‘孩子，你常跟我在一起，我的一切都是你的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>父亲对他说：『儿啊！你常和我同在，我一切所有的都是你的；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“ ‘Myp son,’ the father said, ‘you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And he said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that I have is yours.
verses.textEnNlt: "His father said to him, ‘Look, dear son, you have always stayed by me, and everything I have is yours.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to him, ‘Son, you have always been with me, and all that is mine is yours.
verses.textEn: <red>“ ‘Myp son,’ the father said, ‘you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>只是因为你这个弟弟是死而复活、失而又得的，我们应该欢喜快乐。’"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>只是因为你这个弟弟是死而复活、失而又得的，我们应该欢喜快乐。’"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只是你这个兄弟是死而复活、失而又得的，所以我们理当欢喜快乐。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But we had to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’ ”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: It was fitting to celebrate and be glad, for this your brother was dead, and is alive; he was lost, and is found.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: It was right that we should make merry and be glad, for your brother was dead and is alive again, and was lost and is found.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: We had to celebrate this happy day. For your brother was dead and has come back to life! He was lost, but now he is found!’"
verses.textEnNasb: But we had to celebrate and rejoice, because this brother of yours was dead and has begun to live, and was lost and has been found.’ "
verses.textEn: <red>But we had to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’ ”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对门徒说："<red>有一个财主的管家，有人在他主人面前告他浪费主人的财物。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对门徒说："<red>有一个财主的管家，有人在他主人面前告他浪费主人的财物。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣又对门徒说：「有一个财主的管家，别人向他主人告他浪费主人的财物。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus told his disciples: <red>“There was a rich man whose manager was accused of wasting his possessions.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He also said to the disciples, "There was a rich man who had a manager, and charges were brought to him that this man was wasting his possessions.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also said to His disciples: "There was a certain rich man who had a steward, and an accusation was brought to him that this man was wasting his goods.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus told this story to his disciples: "There was a certain rich man who had a manager handling his affairs. One day a report came that the manager was wasting his employer’s money.
verses.textEnNasb: Now He was also saying to the disciples, "There was a rich man who had a manager, and this manager was reported to him as squandering his possessions.
verses.textEn: Jesus told his disciples: <red>“There was a rich man whose manager was accused of wasting his possessions.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>主人把他叫来，对他说：‘我听见关于你的是怎么一回事呢？把你管理的帐目交代清楚，因为你不能再作管家了。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>主人把他叫来，对他说：‘我听见关于你的是怎么一回事呢？把你管理的帐目交代清楚，因为你不能再作管家了。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主人叫他来，对他说：『我听见你这事怎么样呢？把你所经管的交代明白，因你不能再作我的管家。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So he called him in and asked him, ‘What is this I hear about you? Give an account of your management, because you cannot be manager any longer.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he called him and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Turn in the account of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’
verses.textEnNkjv: So he called him and said to him, ‘What is this I hear about you? Give an account of your stewardship, for you can no longer be steward.’
verses.textEnNlt: So the employer called him in and said, ‘What’s this I hear about you? Get your report in order, because you are going to be fired.’
verses.textEnNasb: And he summoned him and said to him, ‘What is this I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’
verses.textEn: <red>So he called him in and asked him, ‘What is this I hear about you? Give an account of your management, because you cannot be manager any longer.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那管家心里说：‘主人不要我再作管家了，我作甚么才好呢？锄地吧，没有力气！讨饭吧，怕羞！</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那管家心里说：‘主人不要我再作管家了，我作甚么才好呢？锄地吧，没有力气！讨饭吧，怕羞！</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那管家心里说：『主人辞我，不用我再作管家，我将来做什么？锄地呢？无力；讨饭呢？怕羞。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thep manager said to himself, ‘What shall I do now? My master is taking away my job. I’m not strong enough to dig, and I’m ashamed to beg—</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the manager said to himself, ‘What shall I do, since my master is taking the management away from me? I am not strong enough to dig, and I am ashamed to beg.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then the steward said within himself, ‘What shall I do? For my master is taking the stewardship away from me. I cannot dig; I am ashamed to beg.
verses.textEnNlt: "The manager thought to himself, ‘Now what? My boss has fired me. I don’t have the strength to dig ditches, and I’m too proud to beg.
verses.textEnNasb: And the manager said to himself, ‘What am I to do, since my master is taking the management away from me? I am not strong enough to dig; I am ashamed to beg.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep manager said to himself, ‘What shall I do now? My master is taking away my job. I’m not strong enough to dig, and I’m ashamed to beg—</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我知道要怎么作了，好使人在我离开管家的职务以后，接我到他们家里去。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我知道要怎么作了，好使人在我离开管家的职务以后，接我到他们家里去。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我知道怎么行，好叫人在我不作管家之后，接我到他们家里去。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I know what I’ll do so that, when I lose my job here, people will welcome me into their houses.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I have decided what to do, so that when I am removed from management, people may receive me into their houses.’
verses.textEnNkjv: I have resolved what to do, that when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.’
verses.textEnNlt: Ah, I know how to ensure that I’ll have plenty of friends who will give me a home when I am fired.’
verses.textEnNasb: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from the management people will welcome me into their homes.’
verses.textEn: <red>I know what I’ll do so that, when I lose my job here, people will welcome me into their houses.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>于是把欠他主人债的人，一个一个地叫来，问头一个说：‘你欠我主人多少？’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>于是把欠他主人债的人，一个一个地叫来，问头一个说：‘你欠我主人多少？’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>于是把欠他主人债的，一个一个地叫了来，问头一个说：『你欠我主人多少？』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Sop he called in each one of his master’s debtors. He asked the first, ‘How much do you owe my master?’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So, summoning his master’s debtors one by one, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe my master?’
verses.textEnNkjv: "So he called every one of his master’s debtors to him, and said to the first, ‘How much do you owe my master?’
verses.textEnNlt: "So he invited each person who owed money to his employer to come and discuss the situation. He asked the first one, ‘How much do you owe him?’
verses.textEnNasb: And he summoned each one of his master’s debtors, and he began saying to the first, ‘How much do you owe my master?’
verses.textEn: <red>“Sop he called in each one of his master’s debtors. He asked the first, ‘How much do you owe my master?’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他说：‘四千公升油。’管家说：‘拿你的欠单去，快坐下写二千。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他说：‘四千公升油。’管家说：‘拿你的欠单去，快坐下写二千。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他说：『一百篓 油。』管家说：『拿你的帐，快坐下，写五十。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“ ‘Ninep hundred gallons of olive oil,’ he replied. “Thep manager told him, ‘Take your bill, sit down quickly, and make it four hundred and fifty.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said, ‘A hundred measures of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, ‘A hundred measures of oil.’ So he said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’
verses.textEnNlt: The man replied, ‘I owe him 800 gallons of olive oil.’ So the manager told him, ‘Take the bill and quickly change it to 400 gallons. ’
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, ‘A hundred jugs of oil.’ And he said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’
verses.textEn: <red>“ ‘Ninep hundred gallons of olive oil,’ he replied. “Thep manager told him, ‘Take your bill, sit down quickly, and make it four hundred and fifty.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>又问一个说：‘你欠多少？’他说：‘四万公升麦子。’管家说：‘拿你的欠单去，写三万。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>又问一个说：‘你欠多少？’他说：‘四万公升麦子。’管家说：‘拿你的欠单去，写三万。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又问一个说：『你欠多少？』他说：『一百石麦子。』管家说：『拿你的帐，写八十。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thenp he asked the second, ‘And how much do you owe?’ “ ‘Ap thousand bushels of wheat,’ he replied. “Hep told him, ‘Take your bill and make it eight hundred.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to another, ‘And how much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred measures of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to another, ‘And how much do you owe?’ So he said, ‘A hundred measures of wheat.’ And he said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’
verses.textEnNlt: "‘And how much do you owe my employer?’ he asked the next man. ‘I owe him 1,000 bushels of wheat,’ was the reply. ‘Here,’ the manager said, ‘take the bill and change it to 800 bushels. ’
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to another, ‘And how much do you owe?’ And he said, ‘A hundred kors of wheat.’ He *said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Thenp he asked the second, ‘And how much do you owe?’ “ ‘Ap thousand bushels of wheat,’ he replied. “Hep told him, ‘Take your bill and make it eight hundred.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>主人就夸奖这不义的管家作事机警；因为在应付自己的世事上，今世之子比光明之子更精明。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>主人就夸奖这不义的管家作事机警；因为在应付自己的世事上，今世之子比光明之子更精明。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主人就夸奖这不义的管家做事聪明；因为今世之子，在世事之上，较比光明之子更加聪明。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thep master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the people of this world are more shrewd in dealing with their own kind than are the people of the light.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The master commended the dishonest manager for his shrewdness. For the sons of this world are more shrewd in dealing with their own generation than the sons of light.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the master commended the unjust steward because he had dealt shrewdly. For the sons of this world are more shrewd in their generation than the sons of light.
verses.textEnNlt: "The rich man had to admire the dishonest rascal for being so shrewd. And it is true that the children of this world are more shrewd in dealing with the world around them than are the children of the light.
verses.textEnNasb: And his master complimented the unrighteous manager because he had acted shrewdly; for the sons of this age are more shrewd in relation to their own kind than the sons of light.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the people of this world are more shrewd in dealing with their own kind than are the people of the light.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，要用不义的钱财 去结交朋友，好叫钱财无用的时候，他们可以接你们到永恒的帐棚里。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，要用不义的钱财 去结交朋友，好叫钱财无用的时候，他们可以接你们到永恒的帐棚里。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我又告诉你们，要藉着那不义的钱财结交朋友，到了钱财无用的时候，他们可以接你们到永存的帐幕里去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I tell you, use worldly wealth to gain friends for yourselves, so that when it is gone, you will be welcomed into eternal dwellings.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And I tell you, make friends for yourselves by means of unrighteous wealth, so that when it fails they may receive you into the eternal dwellings.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And I say to you, make friends for yourselves by unrighteous mammon, that when you fail, they may receive you into an everlasting home.
verses.textEnNlt: Here’s the lesson: Use your worldly resources to benefit others and make friends. Then, when your possessions are gone, they will welcome you to an eternal home.
verses.textEnNasb: And I say to you, make friends for yourselves by means of the wealth of unrighteousness, so that when it is all gone, they will receive you into the eternal dwellings.
verses.textEn: <red>I tell you, use worldly wealth to gain friends for yourselves, so that when it is gone, you will be welcomed into eternal dwellings.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在最小的事上忠心的，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义的，在大事上也不义。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在最小的事上忠心的，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义的，在大事上也不义。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whoeverp can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "One who is faithful in a very little is also faithful in much, and one who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who is faithful in what is least is faithful also in much; and he who is unjust in what is least is unjust also in much.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you are faithful in little things, you will be faithful in large ones. But if you are dishonest in little things, you won’t be honest with greater responsibilities.
verses.textEnNasb: "The one who is faithful in a very little thing is also faithful in much; and the one who is unrighteous in a very little thing is also unrighteous in much.
verses.textEn: <red>“Whoeverp can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果你们在不义的钱财上不忠心，谁还把真实的钱财托付给你们呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果你们在不义的钱财上不忠心，谁还把真实的钱财托付给你们呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>倘若你们在不义的钱财上不忠心，谁还把那真实的钱财托付你们呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So if you have not been trustworthy in handling worldly wealth, who will trust you with true riches?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If then you have not been faithful in the unrighteous wealth, who will entrust to you the true riches?
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore if you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
verses.textEnNlt: And if you are untrustworthy about worldly wealth, who will trust you with the true riches of heaven?
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore if you have not been faithful in the use of unrighteous wealth, who will entrust the true wealth to you?
verses.textEn: <red>So if you have not been trustworthy in handling worldly wealth, who will trust you with true riches?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果你们在别人的东西上不忠心，谁还把你们自己的东西交给你们呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果你们在别人的东西上不忠心，谁还把你们自己的东西交给你们呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>倘若你们在别人的东西上不忠心，谁还把你们自己的东西给你们呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And if you have not been trustworthy with someone else’s property, who will give you property of your own?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And if you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?
verses.textEnNkjv: And if you have not been faithful in what is another man’s, who will give you what is your own?
verses.textEnNlt: And if you are not faithful with other people’s things, why should you be trusted with things of your own?
verses.textEnNasb: And if you have not been faithful in the use of that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?
verses.textEn: <red>And if you have not been trustworthy with someone else’s property, who will give you property of your own?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"一个家仆不能服事两个主人；他若不是恨这个爱那个，就是忠于这个轻视那个。你们不能服事神，又服事金钱。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"一个家仆不能服事两个主人；他若不是恨这个爱那个，就是忠于这个轻视那个。你们不能服事神，又服事金钱。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>一个仆人不能事奉两个主；不是恶这个爱那个，就是重这个轻那个。你们不能又事奉神，又事奉玛门。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Nop one can serve two masters. Either you will hate the one and love the other, or you will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and money."
verses.textEnNkjv: "No servant can serve two masters; for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be loyal to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon."
verses.textEnNlt: "No one can serve two masters. For you will hate one and love the other; you will be devoted to one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and be enslaved to money."
verses.textEnNasb: No servant can serve two masters; for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and wealth."
verses.textEn: <red>“Nop one can serve two masters. Either you will hate the one and love the other, or you will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.”</red>

verses.textZh: 贪财的法利赛人听见这些话，就嗤笑耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 贪财的法利赛人听见这些话，就嗤笑耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人是贪爱钱财的；他们听见这一切话，就嗤笑耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: The Pharisees, who loved money, heard all this and were sneering at Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, heard all these things, and they ridiculed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they derided Him.
verses.textEnNlt: The Pharisees, who dearly loved their money, heard all this and scoffed at him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Pharisees, who were lovers of money, were listening to all these things and were ridiculing Him.
verses.textEn: The Pharisees, who loved money, heard all this and were sneering at Jesus.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>你们在人面前自称为义，神却知道你们的心；因为人所高举的，神却看作是可憎恶的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>你们在人面前自称为义，神却知道你们的心；因为人所高举的，神却看作是可憎恶的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「你们是在人面前自称为义的，你们的心，神却知道；因为人所尊贵的，是神看为可憎恶的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, <red>“You are the ones who justify yourselves in the eyes of others, but God knows your hearts. What people value highly is detestable in God’s sight.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "You are those who justify yourselves before men, but God knows your hearts. For what is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "You are those who justify yourselves before men, but God knows your hearts. For what is highly esteemed among men is an abomination in the sight of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to them, "You like to appear righteous in public, but God knows your hearts. What this world honors is detestable in the sight of God.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "You are the ones who justify yourselves in the sight of people, but God knows your hearts; because that which is highly esteemed among people is detestable in the sight of God.
verses.textEn: He said to them, <red>“You are the ones who justify yourselves in the eyes of others, but God knows your hearts. What people value highly is detestable in God’s sight.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>律法和先知到约翰就结束了。从此，神的国的福音就传开了，人人都要努力进去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>律法和先知到约翰就结束了。从此，神的国的福音就传开了，人人都要努力进去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>律法和先知到约翰为止，从此神国的福音传开了，人人努力要进去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thep Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John. Since that time, the good news of the kingdom of God is being preached, and everyone is forcing their way into it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "The Law and the Prophets were until John; since then the good news of the kingdom of God is preached, and everyone forces his way into it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The law and the prophets were until John. Since that time the kingdom of God has been preached, and everyone is pressing into it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Until John the Baptist, the law of Moses and the messages of the prophets were your guides. But now the Good News of the Kingdom of God is preached, and everyone is eager to get in.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John came; since that time the gospel of the kingdom of God has been preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John. Since that time, the good news of the kingdom of God is being preached, and everyone is forcing their way into it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>天地过去，要比律法的一点一画失效还容易呢。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>天地过去，要比律法的一点一画失效还容易呢。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>天地废去较比律法的一点一画落空还容易。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>It is easier for heaven and earth to disappear than for the least stroke of a pen to drop out of the Law.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one dot of the Law to become void.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tittle of the law to fail.
verses.textEnNlt: But that doesn’t mean that the law has lost its force. It is easier for heaven and earth to disappear than for the smallest point of God’s law to be overturned.
verses.textEnNasb: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one stroke of a letter of the Law to fail.
verses.textEn: <red>It is easier for heaven and earth to disappear than for the least stroke of a pen to drop out of the Law.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡休妻另娶的，就犯了奸淫；娶被丈夫所休的，也是犯了奸淫。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡休妻另娶的，就犯了奸淫；娶被丈夫所休的，也是犯了奸淫。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡休妻另娶的就是犯奸淫；娶被休之妻的也是犯奸淫。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Anyonep who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and the man who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery, and he who marries a woman divorced from her husband commits adultery.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery; and whoever marries her who is divorced from her husband commits adultery.
verses.textEnNlt: "For example, a man who divorces his wife and marries someone else commits adultery. And anyone who marries a woman divorced from her husband commits adultery."
verses.textEnNasb: "Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery, and he who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.
verses.textEn: <red>“Anyonep who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and the man who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"有一个财主，身穿紫色袍和细麻衣，天天奢华宴乐。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"有一个财主，身穿紫色袍和细麻衣，天天奢华宴乐。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「有一个财主穿着紫色袍和细麻布衣服，天天奢华宴乐。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Therep was a rich man who was dressed in purple and fine linen and lived in luxury every day.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "There was a rich man who was clothed in purple and fine linen and who feasted sumptuously every day.
verses.textEnNkjv: "There was a certain rich man who was clothed in purple and fine linen and fared sumptuously every day.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said, "There was a certain rich man who was splendidly clothed in purple and fine linen and who lived each day in luxury.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now there was a rich man, and he habitually dressed in purple and fine linen, enjoying himself in splendor every day.
verses.textEn: <red>“Therep was a rich man who was dressed in purple and fine linen and lived in luxury every day.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>又有一个乞丐，名叫拉撒路，满身是疮，被人放在财主门口，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>又有一个乞丐，名叫拉撒路，满身是疮，被人放在财主门口，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又有一个讨饭的，名叫拉撒路，浑身生疮，被人放在财主门口，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>At his gate was laid a beggar named Lazarus, covered with sores</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And at his gate was laid a poor man named Lazarus, covered with sores,
verses.textEnNkjv: But there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, full of sores, who was laid at his gate,
verses.textEnNlt: At his gate lay a poor man named Lazarus who was covered with sores.
verses.textEnNasb: And a poor man named Lazarus was laid at his gate, covered with sores,
verses.textEn: <red>At his gate was laid a beggar named Lazarus, covered with sores</red>

verses.textZh: <red>想得财主桌子上掉下来的零碎充饥；并且有狗来舔他的疮。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>想得财主桌子上掉下来的零碎充饥；并且有狗来舔他的疮。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>要得财主桌子上掉下来的零碎充饥，并且狗来舔他的疮。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and longing to eat what fell from the rich man’s table. Even the dogs came and licked his sores.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: who desired to be fed with what fell from the rich man’s table. Moreover, even the dogs came and licked his sores.
verses.textEnNkjv: desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man’s table. Moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
verses.textEnNlt: As Lazarus lay there longing for scraps from the rich man’s table, the dogs would come and lick his open sores.
verses.textEnNasb: and longing to be fed from the scraps which fell from the rich man’s table; not only that, the dogs also were coming and licking his sores.
verses.textEn: <red>and longing to eat what fell from the rich man’s table. Even the dogs came and licked his sores.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>后来乞丐死了，被天使送到亚伯拉罕的怀里。那财主也死了，并且埋葬了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>后来乞丐死了，被天使送到亚伯拉罕的怀里。那财主也死了，并且埋葬了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>后来那讨饭的死了，被天使带去放在亚伯拉罕的怀里。财主也死了，并且埋葬了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thep time came when the beggar died and the angels carried him to Abraham’s side. The rich man also died and was buried.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The poor man died and was carried by the angels to Abraham’s side. The rich man also died and was buried,
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.
verses.textEnNlt: "Finally, the poor man died and was carried by the angels to sit beside Abraham at the heavenly banquet. The rich man also died and was buried,
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened that the poor man died and was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s arms; and the rich man also died and was buried.
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep time came when the beggar died and the angels carried him to Abraham’s side. The rich man also died and was buried.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>财主在阴间受痛苦，举目远远望见亚伯拉罕，和他怀里的拉撒路，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>财主在阴间受痛苦，举目远远望见亚伯拉罕，和他怀里的拉撒路，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他在阴间受痛苦，举目远远地望见亚伯拉罕，又望见拉撒路在他怀里，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>In Hades, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham far away, with Lazarus by his side.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and in Hades, being in torment, he lifted up his eyes and saw Abraham far off and Lazarus at his side.
verses.textEnNkjv: And being in torments in Hades, he lifted up his eyes and saw Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
verses.textEnNlt: and he went to the place of the dead. There, in torment, he saw Abraham in the far distance with Lazarus at his side.
verses.textEnNasb: And in Hades he raised his eyes, being in torment, and *saw Abraham far away and Lazarus in his arms.
verses.textEn: <red>In Hades, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham far away, with Lazarus by his side.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>就喊着说：‘我祖亚伯拉罕啊，可怜我吧！打发拉撒路来用指头蘸点水，凉凉我的舌头吧！因为我在这火焰里非常痛苦。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>就喊着说：‘我祖亚伯拉罕啊，可怜我吧！打发拉撒路来用指头蘸点水，凉凉我的舌头吧！因为我在这火焰里非常痛苦。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>就喊着说：『我祖亚伯拉罕哪，可怜我吧！打发拉撒路来，用指头尖蘸点水，凉凉我的舌头；因为我在这火焰里，极其痛苦。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So he called to him, ‘Father Abraham, have pity on me and send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, because I am in agony in this fire.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he called out, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus to dip the end of his finger in water and cool my tongue, for I am in anguish in this flame.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then he cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.’
verses.textEnNlt: "The rich man shouted, ‘Father Abraham, have some pity! Send Lazarus over here to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue. I am in anguish in these flames.’
verses.textEnNasb: And he cried out and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me and send Lazarus, so that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool off my tongue, for I am in agony in this flame.’
verses.textEn: <red>So he called to him, ‘Father Abraham, have pity on me and send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, because I am in agony in this fire.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>亚伯拉罕说：‘孩子，你应该回想你生前享过福，同样拉撒路受过苦，现在他在这里得安慰，你却要受苦了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>亚伯拉罕说：‘孩子，你应该回想你生前享过福，同样拉撒路受过苦，现在他在这里得安慰，你却要受苦了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>亚伯拉罕说：『儿啊，你该回想你生前享过福，拉撒路也受过苦；如今他在这里得安慰，你倒受痛苦。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp Abraham replied, ‘Son, remember that in your lifetime you received your good things, while Lazarus received bad things, but now he is comforted here and you are in agony.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Abraham said, ‘Child, remember that you in your lifetime received your good things, and Lazarus in like manner bad things; but now he is comforted here, and you are in anguish.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that in your lifetime you received your good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things; but now he is comforted and you are tormented.
verses.textEnNlt: "But Abraham said to him, ‘Son, remember that during your lifetime you had everything you wanted, and Lazarus had nothing. So now he is here being comforted, and you are in anguish.
verses.textEnNasb: But Abraham said, ‘Child, remember that during your life you received your good things, and likewise Lazarus bad things; but now he is being comforted here, and you are in agony.
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp Abraham replied, ‘Son, remember that in your lifetime you received your good things, while Lazarus received bad things, but now he is comforted here and you are in agony.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>不但这样，我们与你们之间，有深渊隔开，人想从这边过到你们那里是不可能的，从那边过到我们这边也是不可能的。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>不但这样，我们与你们之间，有深渊隔开，人想从这边过到你们那里是不可能的，从那边过到我们这边也是不可能的。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不但这样，并且在你我之间，有深渊限定，以致人要从这边过到你们那边是不能的；要从那边过到我们这边也是不能的。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And besides all this, between us and you a great chasm has been set in place, so that those who want to go from here to you cannot, nor can anyone cross over from there to us.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And besides all this, between us and you a great chasm has been fixed, in order that those who would pass from here to you may not be able, and none may cross from there to us.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, so that those who want to pass from here to you cannot, nor can those from there pass to us.’
verses.textEnNlt: And besides, there is a great chasm separating us. No one can cross over to you from here, and no one can cross over to us from there.’
verses.textEnNasb: And besides all this, between us and you a great chasm has been set, so that those who want to go over from here to you will not be able, nor will any people cross over from there to us.’
verses.textEn: <red>And besides all this, between us and you a great chasm has been set in place, so that those who want to go from here to you cannot, nor can anyone cross over from there to us.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那人说：‘我祖啊，那么求你差遣拉撒路到我家里去，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那人说：‘我祖啊，那么求你差遣拉撒路到我家里去，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>财主说：『我祖啊！既是这样，求你打发拉撒路到我父家去；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Hep answered, ‘Then I beg you, father, send Lazarus to my family,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, ‘Then I beg you, father, to send him to my father’s house—
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then he said, ‘I beg you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house,
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the rich man said, ‘Please, Father Abraham, at least send him to my father’s home.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, ‘Then I request of you, father, that you send him to my father’s house—
verses.textEn: <red>“Hep answered, ‘Then I beg you, father, send Lazarus to my family,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为我有五个兄弟，他可以警告他们，免得他们也到这受苦的地方来。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为我有五个兄弟，他可以警告他们，免得他们也到这受苦的地方来。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为我还有五个弟兄，他可以对他们作见证，免得他们也来到这痛苦的地方。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>for I have five brothers. Let him warn them, so that they will not also come to this place of torment.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: for I have five brothers—so that he may warn them, lest they also come into this place of torment.’
verses.textEnNkjv: for I have five brothers, that he may testify to them, lest they also come to this place of torment.’
verses.textEnNlt: For I have five brothers, and I want him to warn them so they don’t end up in this place of torment.’
verses.textEnNasb: for I have five brothers—in order that he may warn them, so that they will not come to this place of torment as well.’
verses.textEn: <red>for I have five brothers. Let him warn them, so that they will not also come to this place of torment.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>亚伯拉罕说：‘他们有摩西和先知可以听从。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>亚伯拉罕说：‘他们有摩西和先知可以听从。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>亚伯拉罕说：『他们有摩西和先知的话可以听从。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Abrahamp replied, ‘They have Moses and the Prophets; let them listen to them.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Abraham said, ‘They have Moses and the Prophets; let them hear them.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.’
verses.textEnNlt: "But Abraham said, ‘Moses and the prophets have warned them. Your brothers can read what they wrote.’
verses.textEnNasb: But Abraham *said, ‘They have Moses and the Prophets; let them hear them.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Abrahamp replied, ‘They have Moses and the Prophets; let them listen to them.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他说：‘不然，我祖亚伯拉罕啊，如果有人从死人中复活，到他们那里去，他们必定会悔改。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他说：‘不然，我祖亚伯拉罕啊，如果有人从死人中复活，到他们那里去，他们必定会悔改。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他说：『我祖亚伯拉罕哪，不是的，若有一个从死里复活的，到他们那里去的，他们必要悔改。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“ ‘No,p father Abraham,’ he said, ‘but if someone from the dead goes to them, they will repent.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if someone goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, ‘No, father Abraham; but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’
verses.textEnNlt: "The rich man replied, ‘No, Father Abraham! But if someone is sent to them from the dead, then they will repent of their sins and turn to God.’
verses.textEnNasb: But he said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if someone goes to them from the dead, they will repent!’
verses.textEn: <red>“ ‘No,p father Abraham,’ he said, ‘but if someone from the dead goes to them, they will repent.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>亚伯拉罕说：‘如果他们不听从摩西和先知，就算有一个从死人中复活的人，他们也不会接受劝告。’"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>亚伯拉罕说：‘如果他们不听从摩西和先知，就算有一个从死人中复活的人，他们也不会接受劝告。’"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>亚伯拉罕说：『若不听从摩西和先知的话，就是有一个从死里复活的，他们也是不听劝。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Hep said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be convinced even if someone rises from the dead.’ ”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to him, ‘If they do not hear Moses and the Prophets, neither will they be convinced if someone should rise from the dead.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: But he said to him, ‘If they do not hear Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded though one rise from the dead.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "But Abraham said, ‘If they won’t listen to Moses and the prophets, they won’t be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.’"
verses.textEnNasb: But he said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.’ "
verses.textEn: <red>“Hep said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be convinced even if someone rises from the dead.’ ”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对门徒说："<red>使人犯罪的事是免不了的，但那使人犯罪的人有祸了！</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对门徒说："<red>使人犯罪的事是免不了的，但那使人犯罪的人有祸了！</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣又对门徒说：「绊倒人的事是免不了的；但那绊倒人的有祸了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to his disciples: <red>“Things that cause people to stumble are bound to come, but woe to anyone through whom they come.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to his disciples, "Temptations to sin are sure to come, but woe to the one through whom they come!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to the disciples, "It is impossible that no offenses should come, but woe to him through whom they do come!
verses.textEnNlt: One day Jesus said to his disciples, "There will always be temptations to sin, but what sorrow awaits the person who does the tempting!
verses.textEnNasb: Now He said to His disciples, "It is inevitable that stumbling blocks come, but woe to one through whom they come!
verses.textEn: Jesus said to his disciples: <red>“Things that cause people to stumble are bound to come, but woe to anyone through whom they come.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>就算拿一块大磨石拴在他的颈项上，把他沉在深海里，比他使这小子中的一个犯罪还好。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>就算拿一块大磨石拴在他的颈项上，把他沉在深海里，比他使这小子中的一个犯罪还好。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>就是把磨石拴在这人的颈项上，丢在海里，还强如他把这小子里的一个绊倒了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>It would be better for them to be thrown into the sea with a millstone tied around their neck than to cause one of these little ones to stumble.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck and he were cast into the sea than that he should cause one of these little ones to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
verses.textEnNlt: It would be better to be thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around your neck than to cause one of these little ones to fall into sin.
verses.textEnNasb: It is better for him if a millstone is hung around his neck and he is thrown into the sea, than that he may cause one of these little ones to sin.
verses.textEn: <red>It would be better for them to be thrown into the sea with a millstone tied around their neck than to cause one of these little ones to stumble.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们应当谨慎。如果你弟兄得罪你，就劝戒他；他若懊悔，就饶恕他。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们应当谨慎。如果你弟兄得罪你，就劝戒他；他若懊悔，就饶恕他。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要谨慎！若是你的弟兄得罪你，就劝戒他；他若懊悔，就饶恕他。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So watch yourselves. “Ifp your brother or sister sins against you, rebuke them; and if they repent, forgive them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Pay attention to yourselves! If your brother sins, rebuke him, and if he repents, forgive him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Take heed to yourselves. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him.
verses.textEnNlt: So watch yourselves! "If another believer sins, rebuke that person; then if there is repentance, forgive.
verses.textEnNasb: Be on your guard! If your brother sins, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him.
verses.textEn: <red>So watch yourselves. “Ifp your brother or sister sins against you, rebuke them; and if they repent, forgive them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果他一天七次得罪你，又七次回转，对你说：‘我懊悔了！’你总要饶恕他。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果他一天七次得罪你，又七次回转，对你说：‘我懊悔了！’你总要饶恕他。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>倘若他一天七次得罪你，又七次回转，说：『我懊悔了』，你总要饶恕他。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Even if they sin against you seven times in a day and seven times come back to you saying ‘I repent,’ you must forgive them.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and if he sins against you seven times in the day, and turns to you seven times, saying, ‘I repent,’ you must forgive him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And if he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times in a day returns to you, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him."
verses.textEnNlt: Even if that person wrongs you seven times a day and each time turns again and asks forgiveness, you must forgive."
verses.textEnNasb: And if he sins against you seven times a day, and returns to you seven times, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him."
verses.textEn: <red>Even if they sin against you seven times in a day and seven times come back to you saying ‘I repent,’ you must forgive them.”</red>

verses.textZh: 使徒对主说："请你加添我们的信心。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 使徒对主说："请你加添我们的信心。"
verses.textZhCuv: 使徒对主说：「求主加增我们的信心。」
verses.textEnNiv: The apostles said to the Lord, "Increase our faith!"
verses.textEnEsv: The apostles said to the Lord, "Increase our faith!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the apostles said to the Lord, "Increase our faith."
verses.textEnNlt: The apostles said to the Lord, "Show us how to increase our faith."
verses.textEnNasb: The apostles said to the Lord, "Increase our faith!"
verses.textEn: The apostles said to the Lord, "Increase our faith!"

verses.textZh: 主说："<red>如果你们有信心像一粒芥菜种，就是对这棵桑树说：‘拔起根来，栽到海里去！’它也必听从你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 主说："<red>如果你们有信心像一粒芥菜种，就是对这棵桑树说：‘拔起根来，栽到海里去！’它也必听从你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主说：「你们若有信心像一粒芥菜种，就是对这棵桑树说：『你要拔起根来，栽在海里』，它也必听从你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, <red>“If you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and planted in the sea,’ and it will obey you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said, "If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you could say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord said, "If you have faith as a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be pulled up by the roots and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord answered, "If you had faith even as small as a mustard seed, you could say to this mulberry tree, ‘May you be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you!
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said, "If you had faith the size of a mustard seed, you could say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea’; and it would obey you.
verses.textEn: He replied, <red>“If you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and planted in the sea,’ and it will obey you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们中间谁有仆人去耕地或是放羊，从田里回来，你就对他说：‘快过来坐下吃饭’；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们中间谁有仆人去耕地或是放羊，从田里回来，你就对他说：‘快过来坐下吃饭’；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们谁有仆人耕地或是放羊，从田里回来，就对他说：『你快来坐下吃饭』呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Supposep one of you has a servant plowing or looking after the sheep. Will he say to the servant when he comes in from the field, ‘Come along now and sit down to eat’?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Will any one of you who has a servant plowing or keeping sheep say to him when he has come in from the field, ‘Come at once and recline at table’?
verses.textEnNkjv: And which of you, having a servant plowing or tending sheep, will say to him when he has come in from the field, ‘Come at once and sit down to eat’?
verses.textEnNlt: "When a servant comes in from plowing or taking care of sheep, does his master say, ‘Come in and eat with me’?
verses.textEnNasb: "Now which of you, having a slave plowing or tending sheep, will say to him after he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and recline at the table to eat’?
verses.textEn: <red>“Supposep one of you has a servant plowing or looking after the sheep. Will he say to the servant when he comes in from the field, ‘Come along now and sit down to eat’?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>而不对他说：‘给我预备晚餐，束起腰来服事我，等我吃喝完了，你才吃喝’呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>而不对他说：‘给我预备晚餐，束起腰来服事我，等我吃喝完了，你才吃喝’呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>岂不对他说：『你给我预备晚饭，束上带子伺候我，等我吃喝完了，你才可以吃喝』吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Won’t he rather say, ‘Prepare my supper, get yourself ready and wait on me while I eat and drink; after that you may eat and drink’?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Will he not rather say to him, ‘Prepare supper for me, and dress properly, and serve me while I eat and drink, and afterward you will eat and drink’?
verses.textEnNkjv: But will he not rather say to him, ‘Prepare something for my supper, and gird yourself and serve me till I have eaten and drunk, and afterward you will eat and drink’?
verses.textEnNlt: No, he says, ‘Prepare my meal, put on your apron, and serve me while I eat. Then you can eat later.’
verses.textEnNasb: On the contrary, will he not say to him, ‘Prepare something for me to eat, and properly clothe yourself and serve me while I eat and drink; and afterward you may eat and drink’?
verses.textEn: <red>Won’t he rather say, ‘Prepare my supper, get yourself ready and wait on me while I eat and drink; after that you may eat and drink’?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>仆人作了所吩咐的事，主人还谢谢他吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>仆人作了所吩咐的事，主人还谢谢他吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>仆人照所吩咐的去做，主人还谢谢他吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Will he thank the servant because he did what he was told to do?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Does he thank the servant because he did what was commanded?
verses.textEnNkjv: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I think not.
verses.textEnNlt: And does the master thank the servant for doing what he was told to do? Of course not.
verses.textEnNasb: He does not thank the slave because he did the things which were commanded, does he?
verses.textEn: <red>Will he thank the servant because he did what he was told to do?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们也是这样，作完一切吩咐你们的事，应该说：‘我们是无用的仆人，我们只作了应分作的。’"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们也是这样，作完一切吩咐你们的事，应该说：‘我们是无用的仆人，我们只作了应分作的。’"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这样，你们做完了一切所吩咐的，只当说：『我们是无用的仆人，所做的本是我们应分做的。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So you also, when you have done everything you were told to do, should say, ‘We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.’ ”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So you also, when you have done all that you were commanded, say, ‘We are unworthy servants; we have only done what was our duty.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: So likewise you, when you have done all those things which you are commanded, say, ‘We are unprofitable servants. We have done what was our duty to do.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, when you obey me you should say, ‘We are unworthy servants who have simply done our duty.’"
verses.textEnNasb: So you too, when you do all the things which were commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy slaves; we have done only that which we ought to have done.’ "
verses.textEn: <red>So you also, when you have done everything you were told to do, should say, ‘We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.’ ”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣往耶路撒冷去，经过撒玛利亚和加利利的边境。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣往耶路撒冷去，经过撒玛利亚和加利利的边境。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣往耶路撒冷去，经过撒马利亚和加利利。
verses.textEnNiv: Now on his way to Jerusalem, Jesus traveled along the border between Samaria and Galilee.
verses.textEnEsv: On the way to Jerusalem he was passing along between Samaria and Galilee.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened as He went to Jerusalem that He passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus continued on toward Jerusalem, he reached the border between Galilee and Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: While He was on the way to Jerusalem, He was passing between Samaria and Galilee.
verses.textEn: Now on his way to Jerusalem, Jesus traveled along the border between Samaria and Galilee.

verses.textZh: 他走进一个村庄，有十个痲风病人迎面而来，远远地站着，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他走进一个村庄，有十个痲风病人迎面而来，远远地站着，
verses.textZhCuv: 进入一个村子，有十个长大麻风的，迎面而来，远远地站着，
verses.textEnNiv: As he was going into a village, ten men who had leprosy met him. They stood at a distance
verses.textEnEsv: And as he entered a village, he was met by ten lepers, who stood at a distance
verses.textEnNkjv: Then as He entered a certain village, there met Him ten men who were lepers, who stood afar off.
verses.textEnNlt: As he entered a village there, ten men with leprosy stood at a distance,
verses.textEnNasb: And as He entered a village, ten men with leprosy who stood at a distance met Him;
verses.textEn: As he was going into a village, ten men who had leprosy met him. They stood at a distance

verses.textZh: 大声说："主耶稣啊，可怜我们吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大声说："主耶稣啊，可怜我们吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 高声说：「耶稣，夫子，可怜我们吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: and called out in a loud voice, "Jesus, Master, have pity on us!"
verses.textEnEsv: and lifted up their voices, saying, "Jesus, Master, have mercy on us."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they lifted up their voices and said, "Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!"
verses.textEnNlt: crying out, "Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!"
verses.textEnNasb: and they raised their voices, saying, "Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!"
verses.textEn: and called out in a loud voice, "Jesus, Master, have pity on us!"

verses.textZh: 他看见了，就对他们说："<red>你们去给祭司检查吧。</red>"他们去的时候就洁净了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他看见了，就对他们说："<red>你们去给祭司检查吧。</red>"他们去的时候就洁净了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣看见，就对他们说：「<red>你们去把身体给祭司察看。</red>」他们去的时候就洁净了。
verses.textEnNiv: When he saw them, he said, <red>“Go, show yourselves to the priests.”</red> And as they went, they were cleansed.
verses.textEnEsv: When he saw them he said to them, "Go and show yourselves to the priests." And as they went they were cleansed.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when He saw them, He said to them, "Go, show yourselves to the priests." And so it was that as they went, they were cleansed.
verses.textEnNlt: He looked at them and said, "Go show yourselves to the priests." And as they went, they were cleansed of their leprosy.
verses.textEnNasb: When He saw them, He said to them, "Go and show yourselves to the priests." And as they were going, they were cleansed.
verses.textEn: When he saw them, he said, <red>“Go, show yourselves to the priests.”</red> And as they went, they were cleansed.

verses.textZh: 内中有一个人见自己已经好了，就回来大声颂赞神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 内中有一个人见自己已经好了，就回来大声颂赞神，
verses.textZhCuv: 内中有一个见自己已经好了，就回来大声归荣耀与神，
verses.textEnNiv: One of them, when he saw he was healed, came back, praising God in a loud voice.
verses.textEnEsv: Then one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, praising God with a loud voice;
verses.textEnNkjv: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, returned, and with a loud voice glorified God,
verses.textEnNlt: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, came back to Jesus, shouting, "Praise God!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now one of them, when he saw that he had been healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice,
verses.textEn: One of them, when he saw he was healed, came back, praising God in a loud voice.

verses.textZh: 在耶稣脚前把脸伏在地上感谢他。他是一个撒玛利亚人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶稣脚前把脸伏在地上感谢他。他是一个撒玛利亚人。
verses.textZhCuv: 又俯伏在耶稣脚前感谢他；这人是撒马利亚人。
verses.textEnNiv: He threw himself at Jesus’ feet and thanked him—and he was a Samaritan.
verses.textEnEsv: and he fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks. Now he was a Samaritan.
verses.textEnNkjv: and fell down on his face at His feet, giving Him thanks. And he was a Samaritan.
verses.textEnNlt: He fell to the ground at Jesus’ feet, thanking him for what he had done. This man was a Samaritan.
verses.textEnNasb: and he fell on his face at His feet, giving thanks to Him. And he was a Samaritan.
verses.textEn: He threw himself at Jesus’ feet and thanked him—and he was a Samaritan.

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>洁净了的不是有十个人吗？那九个在哪里？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>洁净了的不是有十个人吗？那九个在哪里？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「洁净了的不是十个人吗？那九个在哪里呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus asked, <red>“Were not all ten cleansed? Where are the other nine?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus answered, "Were not ten cleansed? Where are the nine?
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesus answered and said, "Were there not ten cleansed? But where are the nine?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus asked, "Didn’t I heal ten men? Where are the other nine?
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus responded and said, "Were there not ten cleansed? But the nine—where are they?
verses.textEn: Jesus asked, <red>“Were not all ten cleansed? Where are the other nine?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>除了这外族人，再没有一个回来颂赞神吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>除了这外族人，再没有一个回来颂赞神吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>除了这外族人，再没有别人回来归荣耀与神吗？」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Has no one returned to give praise to God except this foreigner?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Was no one found to return and give praise to God except this foreigner?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Were there not any found who returned to give glory to God except this foreigner?"
verses.textEnNlt: Has no one returned to give glory to God except this foreigner?"
verses.textEnNasb: Was no one found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?"
verses.textEn: <red>Has no one returned to give praise to God except this foreigner?”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣就对他说："<red>起来，走吧，你的信使你痊愈了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣就对他说："<red>起来，走吧，你的信使你痊愈了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 就对那人说：「<red>起来，走吧！你的信救了你了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to him, <red>“Rise and go; your faith has made you well.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "Rise and go your way; your faith has made you well."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to him, "Arise, go your way. Your faith has made you well."
verses.textEnNlt: And Jesus said to the man, "Stand up and go. Your faith has healed you. "
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to him, "Stand up and go; your faith has made you well."
verses.textEn: Then he said to him, <red>“Rise and go; your faith has made you well.”</red>

verses.textZh: 法利赛人问耶稣："<red>神的国甚么时候来到呢？</red>"他回答："神的国来到，是眼睛看不见的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法利赛人问耶稣："<red>神的国甚么时候来到呢？</red>"他回答："神的国来到，是眼睛看不见的。
verses.textZhCuv: 法利赛人问：「<red>神的国几时来到？</red>」耶稣回答说：「神的国来到不是眼所能见的。
verses.textEnNiv: Once, on being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus replied, <red>“The coming of the kingdom of God is not something that can be observed,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, he answered them, "The kingdom of God is not coming in ways that can be observed,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when He was asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, He answered them and said, "The kingdom of God does not come with observation;
verses.textEnNlt: One day the Pharisees asked Jesus, "When will the Kingdom of God come?" Jesus replied, "The Kingdom of God can’t be detected by visible signs.
verses.textEnNasb: Now He was questioned by the Pharisees as to when the kingdom of God was coming, and He answered them and said, "The kingdom of God is not coming with signs that can be observed;
verses.textEn: Once, on being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus replied, <red>“The coming of the kingdom of God is not something that can be observed,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人不能说：‘看哪！在这里’，或说：‘在那里’；因为神的国就在你们里面。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人不能说：‘看哪！在这里’，或说：‘在那里’；因为神的国就在你们里面。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人也不得说：『看哪，在这里！看哪，在那里！』因为神的国就在你们心里 。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>nor will people say, ‘Here it is,’ or ‘There it is,’ because the kingdom of God is in your midst.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: nor will they say, ‘Look, here it is!’ or ‘There!’ for behold, the kingdom of God is in the midst of you."
verses.textEnNkjv: nor will they say, ‘See here!’ or ‘See there!’ For indeed, the kingdom of God is within you."
verses.textEnNlt: You won’t be able to say, ‘Here it is!’ or ‘It’s over there!’ For the Kingdom of God is already among you. "
verses.textEnNasb: nor will they say, ‘Look, here it is!’ or, ‘There it is!’ For behold, the kingdom of God is in your midst."
verses.textEn: <red>nor will people say, ‘Here it is,’ or ‘There it is,’ because the kingdom of God is in your midst.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他又对门徒说："<red>日子将到，你们渴望看见人子的一个日子，却见不到。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对门徒说："<red>日子将到，你们渴望看见人子的一个日子，却见不到。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他又对门徒说：「日子将到，你们巴不得看见人子的一个日子，却不得看见。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to his disciples, <red>“The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to the disciples, "The days are coming when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to the disciples, "The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to his disciples, "The time is coming when you will long to see the day when the Son of Man returns, but you won’t see it.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to the disciples, "The days will come when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.
verses.textEn: Then he said to his disciples, <red>“The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有人会对你们说：‘看哪，在那里；看哪，在这里！’你们不要出去，也不要追随他们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有人会对你们说：‘看哪，在那里；看哪，在这里！’你们不要出去，也不要追随他们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人将要对你们说：『看哪，在那里！看哪，在这里！』你们不要出去，也不要跟随他们！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>People will tell you, ‘There he is!’ or ‘Here he is!’ Do not go running off after them.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And they will say to you, ‘Look, there!’ or ‘Look, here!’ Do not go out or follow them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they will say to you, ‘Look here!’ or ‘Look there!’ Do not go after them or follow them.
verses.textEnNlt: People will tell you, ‘Look, there is the Son of Man,’ or ‘Here he is,’ but don’t go out and follow them.
verses.textEnNasb: And they will say to you, ‘Look there,’ or, ‘Look here!’ Do not leave, and do not run after them.
verses.textEn: <red>People will tell you, ‘There he is!’ or ‘Here he is!’ Do not go running off after them.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>电光怎样从天这边一闪，直照到天那边，人子在他的日子也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>电光怎样从天这边一闪，直照到天那边，人子在他的日子也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为人子在他降临的日子，好像闪电从天这边一闪直照到天那边。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For the Son of Man in his day will be like the lightning, which flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For as the lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one side to the other, so will the Son of Man be in his day.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as the lightning that flashes out of one part under heaven shines to the other part under heaven, so also the Son of Man will be in His day.
verses.textEnNlt: For as the lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other, so it will be on the day when the Son of Man comes.
verses.textEnNasb: For just like the lightning, when it flashes out of one part of the sky, shines to the other part of the sky, so will the Son of Man be in His day.
verses.textEn: <red>For the Son of Man in his day will be like the lightning, which flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但他必须先受许多苦，被这个世代弃绝。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但他必须先受许多苦，被这个世代弃绝。</red>
