verses.textZhCuv: <red>只是他必须先受许多苦，又被这世代弃绝。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
verses.textEnNkjv: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
verses.textEnNlt: But first the Son of Man must suffer terribly and be rejected by this generation.
verses.textEnNasb: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
verses.textEn: <red>But first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>挪亚的时代怎样，人子的时代也是怎样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>挪亚的时代怎样，人子的时代也是怎样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>挪亚的日子怎样，人子的日子也要怎样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Justp as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Just as it was in the days of Noah, so will it be in the days of the Son of Man.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as it was in the days of Noah, so it will be also in the days of the Son of Man:
verses.textEnNlt: "When the Son of Man returns, it will be like it was in Noah’s day.
verses.textEnNasb: And just as it happened in the days of Noah, so will it also be in the days of the Son of Man:
verses.textEn: <red>“Justp as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>当时人们吃喝嫁娶，直到挪亚进入方舟的那一天，洪水来了，把他们全都灭掉。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>当时人们吃喝嫁娶，直到挪亚进入方舟的那一天，洪水来了，把他们全都灭掉。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时候的人又吃又喝，又娶又嫁，到挪亚进方舟的那日，洪水就来，把他们全都灭了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>People were eating, drinking, marrying and being given in marriage up to the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: They were eating and drinking and marrying and being given in marriage, until the day when Noah entered the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all.
verses.textEnNkjv: They ate, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all.
verses.textEnNlt: In those days, the people enjoyed banquets and parties and weddings right up to the time Noah entered his boat and the flood came and destroyed them all.
verses.textEnNasb: people were eating, they were drinking, they were marrying, and they were being given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all.
verses.textEn: <red>People were eating, drinking, marrying and being given in marriage up to the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在罗得的时代也是这样，人们吃喝买卖，耕种建造，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在罗得的时代也是这样，人们吃喝买卖，耕种建造，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又好像罗得的日子；人又吃又喝，又买又卖，又耕种又盖造。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Itp was the same in the days of Lot. People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Likewise, just as it was in the days of Lot—they were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building,
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise as it was also in the days of Lot: They ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;
verses.textEnNlt: "And the world will be as it was in the days of Lot. People went about their daily business—eating and drinking, buying and selling, farming and building—
verses.textEnNasb: It was the same as happened in the days of Lot: they were eating, they were drinking, they were buying, they were selling, they were planting, and they were building;
verses.textEn: <red>“Itp was the same in the days of Lot. People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>直到罗得离开所多玛的那一天，火与硫磺从天上降下来，把他们全都灭掉。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>直到罗得离开所多玛的那一天，火与硫磺从天上降下来，把他们全都灭掉。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>到罗得出所多玛的那日，就有火与硫磺从天上降下来，把他们全都灭了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but on the day when Lot went out from Sodom, fire and sulfur rained from heaven and destroyed them all—
verses.textEnNkjv: but on the day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven and destroyed them all.
verses.textEnNlt: until the morning Lot left Sodom. Then fire and burning sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.
verses.textEnNasb: but on the day that Lot left Sodom, it rained fire and brimstone from heaven and destroyed them all.
verses.textEn: <red>But the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人子显现的日子也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人子显现的日子也是这样。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人子显现的日子也要这样。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Itp will be just like this on the day the Son of Man is revealed.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: so will it be on the day when the Son of Man is revealed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even so will it be in the day when the Son of Man is revealed.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, it will be ‘business as usual’ right up to the day when the Son of Man is revealed.
verses.textEnNasb: It will be just the same on the day that the Son of Man is revealed.
verses.textEn: <red>“Itp will be just like this on the day the Son of Man is revealed.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>当那日，人在房顶上，器具在屋里，不要下来拿；在田里的，照样不要回家。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>当那日，人在房顶上，器具在屋里，不要下来拿；在田里的，照样不要回家。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>当那日，人在房上，器具在屋里，不要下来拿；人在田里，也不要回家。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>On that day no one who is on the housetop, with possessions inside, should go down to get them. Likewise, no one in the field should go back for anything.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: On that day, let the one who is on the housetop, with his goods in the house, not come down to take them away, and likewise let the one who is in the field not turn back.
verses.textEnNkjv: "In that day, he who is on the housetop, and his goods are in the house, let him not come down to take them away. And likewise the one who is in the field, let him not turn back.
verses.textEnNlt: On that day a person out on the deck of a roof must not go down into the house to pack. A person out in the field must not return home.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day, the one who will be on the housetop, with his goods in the house, must not go down to take them out; and likewise the one in the field must not turn back.
verses.textEn: <red>On that day no one who is on the housetop, with possessions inside, should go down to get them. Likewise, no one in the field should go back for anything.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>应当记着罗得的妻子的教训。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>应当记着罗得的妻子的教训。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要回想罗得的妻子。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Remember Lot’s wife!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Remember Lot’s wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember Lot’s wife.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember what happened to Lot’s wife!
verses.textEnNasb: Remember Lot’s wife.
verses.textEn: <red>Remember Lot’s wife!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡是想保全生命的，必丧掉生命；凡是牺牲生命的，却必保全生命。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡是想保全生命的，必丧掉生命；凡是牺牲生命的，却必保全生命。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡想要保全生命的，必丧掉生命；凡丧掉生命的，必救活生命。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Whoever tries to keep their life will lose it, and whoever loses their life will preserve it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever seeks to preserve his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life will keep it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever seeks to save his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life will preserve it.
verses.textEnNlt: If you cling to your life, you will lose it, and if you let your life go, you will save it.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever strives to save his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life will keep it.
verses.textEn: <red>Whoever tries to keep their life will lose it, and whoever loses their life will preserve it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，当那夜，两个人在一张床上，一个被接去，一个被撇下。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，当那夜，两个人在一张床上，一个被接去，一个被撇下。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我对你们说，当那一夜，两个人在一个床上，要取去一个，撇下一个。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed; one will be taken and the other left.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I tell you, in that night there will be two in one bed. One will be taken and the other left.
verses.textEnNkjv: I tell you, in that night there will be two men in one bed: the one will be taken and the other will be left.
verses.textEnNlt: That night two people will be asleep in one bed; one will be taken, the other left.
verses.textEnNasb: I tell you, on that night there will be two in one bed; one will be taken and the other will be left.
verses.textEn: <red>I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed; one will be taken and the other left.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>两个女人一起推磨，一个被接去，一个被撇下。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>两个女人一起推磨，一个被接去，一个被撇下。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>两个女人一同推磨，要取去一个，撇下一个。 」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Two women will be grinding grain together; one will be taken and the other left.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: There will be two women grinding together. One will be taken and the other left."
verses.textEnNkjv: Two women will be grinding together: the one will be taken and the other left.
verses.textEnNlt: Two women will be grinding flour together at the mill; one will be taken, the other left. "
verses.textEnNasb: There will be two women grinding at the same place; one will be taken and the other will be left.
verses.textEn: <red>Two women will be grinding grain together; one will be taken and the other left.”</red>

verses.textZh: 门徒问耶稣："主啊，这些事会在哪里发生呢？"主说："尸首在哪里，鹰也会聚集在哪里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒问耶稣："主啊，这些事会在哪里发生呢？"主说："尸首在哪里，鹰也会聚集在哪里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒说：「主啊，在哪里有这事呢？」耶稣说：「尸首在哪里，鹰也必聚在那里。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Where, Lord?" they asked. He replied, "Where there is a dead body, there the vultures will gather."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to him, "Where, Lord?" He said to them, "Where the corpse is, there the vultures will gather."
verses.textEnNkjv: Two men will be in the field: the one will be taken and the other left."
verses.textEnNlt: "Where will this happen, Lord?" the disciples asked. Jesus replied, "Just as the gathering of vultures shows there is a carcass nearby, so these signs indicate that the end is near."
verses.textEnNasb: [ Two men will be in the field; one will be taken and the other will be left."]
verses.textEn: "Where, Lord?" they asked. He replied, "Where there is a dead body, there the vultures will gather."

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们讲一个比喻，论到人必须常常祈祷，不可灰心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们讲一个比喻，论到人必须常常祈祷，不可灰心。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣设一个比喻，是要人常常祷告，不可灰心。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus told his disciples a parable to show them that they should always pray and not give up.
verses.textEnEsv: And he told them a parable to the effect that they ought always to pray and not lose heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He spoke a parable to them, that men always ought to pray and not lose heart,
verses.textEnNlt: One day Jesus told his disciples a story to show that they should always pray and never give up.
verses.textEnNasb: Now He was telling them a parable to show that at all times they ought to pray and not become discouraged,
verses.textEn: Then Jesus told his disciples a parable to show them that they should always pray and not give up.

verses.textZh: 他说："<red>某城里有一个法官，不惧怕神，也不尊敬人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："<red>某城里有一个法官，不惧怕神，也不尊敬人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>说：「某城里有一个官，不惧怕神，也不尊重世人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He said: <red>“In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor cared what people thought.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "In a certain city there was a judge who neither feared God nor respected man.
verses.textEnNkjv: saying: "There was in a certain city a judge who did not fear God nor regard man.
verses.textEnNlt: "There was a judge in a certain city," he said, "who neither feared God nor cared about people.
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "In a certain city there was a judge who did not fear God and did not respect any person.
verses.textEn: He said: <red>“In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor cared what people thought.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那城里有一个寡妇，常常来到他那里，说：‘求你给我伸冤，使我脱离我的对头！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那城里有一个寡妇，常常来到他那里，说：‘求你给我伸冤，使我脱离我的对头！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那城里有个寡妇，常到他那里，说：『我有一个对头，求你给我伸冤。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And there was a widow in that town who kept coming to him with the plea, ‘Grant me justice against my adversary.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And there was a widow in that city who kept coming to him and saying, ‘Give me justice against my adversary.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was a widow in that city; and she came to him, saying, ‘Get justice for me from my adversary.’
verses.textEnNlt: A widow of that city came to him repeatedly, saying, ‘Give me justice in this dispute with my enemy.’
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a widow in that city, and she kept coming to him, saying, ‘Give me justice against my opponent.’
verses.textEn: <red>And there was a widow in that town who kept coming to him with the plea, ‘Grant me justice against my adversary.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他多次不肯，后来心里说：‘我虽然不惧怕神，也不尊敬人，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他多次不肯，后来心里说：‘我虽然不惧怕神，也不尊敬人，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他多日不准，后来心里说：『我虽不惧怕神，也不尊重世人，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Forp some time he refused. But finally he said to himself, ‘Even though I don’t fear God or care what people think,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For a while he refused, but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he would not for a while; but afterward he said within himself, ‘Though I do not fear God nor regard man,
verses.textEnNlt: The judge ignored her for a while, but finally he said to himself, ‘I don’t fear God or care about people,
verses.textEnNasb: For a while he was unwilling; but later he said to himself, ‘Even though I do not fear God nor respect any person,
verses.textEn: <red>“Forp some time he refused. But finally he said to himself, ‘Even though I don’t fear God or care what people think,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>只是因为这寡妇常常来麻烦我，就给她伸冤吧，免得她不断地来缠扰我。’"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>只是因为这寡妇常常来麻烦我，就给她伸冤吧，免得她不断地来缠扰我。’"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>只因这寡妇烦扰我，我就给她伸冤吧，免得她常来缠磨我！』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>yet because this widow keeps bothering me, I will see that she gets justice, so that she won’t eventually come and attack me!’ ”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: yet because this widow keeps bothering me, I will give her justice, so that she will not beat me down by her continual coming.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: yet because this widow troubles me I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: but this woman is driving me crazy. I’m going to see that she gets justice, because she is wearing me out with her constant requests!’"
verses.textEnNasb: yet because this widow is bothering me, I will give her justice; otherwise by continually coming she will wear me out.’ "
verses.textEn: <red>yet because this widow keeps bothering me, I will see that she gets justice, so that she won’t eventually come and attack me!’ ”</red>

verses.textZh: 主说："<red>你们听听这不义的法官所说的话吧。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 主说："<red>你们听听这不义的法官所说的话吧。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主说：「你们听这不义之官所说的话。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord said, <red>“Listen to what the unjust judge says.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said, "Hear what the unrighteous judge says.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said, "Hear what the unjust judge said.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said, "Learn a lesson from this unjust judge.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said, "Listen to what the unrighteous judge *said;
verses.textEn: And the Lord said, <red>“Listen to what the unjust judge says.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>难道神不会为昼夜呼吁他的选民伸冤吗？难道神会耽误他们吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>难道神不会为昼夜呼吁他的选民伸冤吗？难道神会耽误他们吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>神的选民昼夜呼吁他，他纵然为他们忍了多时，岂不终久给他们伸冤吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And will not God bring about justice for his chosen ones, who cry out to him day and night? Will he keep putting them off?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And will not God give justice to his elect, who cry to him day and night? Will he delay long over them?
verses.textEnNkjv: And shall God not avenge His own elect who cry out day and night to Him, though He bears long with them?
verses.textEnNlt: Even he rendered a just decision in the end. So don’t you think God will surely give justice to his chosen people who cry out to him day and night? Will he keep putting them off?
verses.textEnNasb: now, will God not bring about justice for His elect who cry out to Him day and night, and will He delay long for them?
verses.textEn: <red>And will not God bring about justice for his chosen ones, who cry out to him day and night? Will he keep putting them off?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，他要快快地给他们伸冤。然而人子来的时候，在世上找得到这种信心吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，他要快快地给他们伸冤。然而人子来的时候，在世上找得到这种信心吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我告诉你们，要快快地给他们伸冤了。然而，人子来的时候，遇得见世上有信德吗？」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I tell you, he will see that they get justice, and quickly. However, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I tell you, he will give justice to them speedily. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on earth?"
verses.textEnNkjv: I tell you that He will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will He really find faith on the earth?"
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you, he will grant justice to them quickly! But when the Son of Man returns, how many will he find on the earth who have faith?"
verses.textEnNasb: I tell you that He will bring about justice for them quickly. However, when the Son of Man comes, will He find faith on the earth?"
verses.textEn: <red>I tell you, he will see that they get justice, and quickly. However, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: Also He spoke this parable to some who trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus told this story to some who had great confidence in their own righteousness and scorned everyone else:

verses.textZh: <red>"有两个人上圣殿去祈祷，一个是法利赛人，一个是税吏。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"有两个人上圣殿去祈祷，一个是法利赛人，一个是税吏。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>说：「有两个人上殿里去祷告：一个是法利赛人，一个是税吏。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Two men went up to the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Two men went up into the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Two men went up to the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.
verses.textEnNlt: "Two men went to the Temple to pray. One was a Pharisee, and the other was a despised tax collector.
verses.textEnNasb: "Two men went up into the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.
verses.textEn: <red>“Two men went up to the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>法利赛人站着，祷告给自己听，这样说：‘神啊，我感谢你，我不像别人，勒索、不义、奸淫，也不像这个税吏。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>法利赛人站着，祷告给自己听，这样说：‘神啊，我感谢你，我不像别人，勒索、不义、奸淫，也不像这个税吏。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>法利赛人站着，自言自语地祷告说：『神啊，我感谢你，我不像别人勒索、不义、奸淫，也不像这个税吏。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like other people—robbers, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The Pharisee, standing by himself, prayed thus: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like other men, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, ‘God, I thank You that I am not like other men—extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this tax collector.
verses.textEnNlt: The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed this prayer : ‘I thank you, God, that I am not like other people—cheaters, sinners, adulterers. I’m certainly not like that tax collector!
verses.textEnNasb: The Pharisee stood and began praying this in regard to himself: ‘God, I thank You that I am not like other people: swindlers, crooked, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.
verses.textEn: <red>The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like other people—robbers, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我一个礼拜禁食两次，我的一切收入都奉献十分之一。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我一个礼拜禁食两次，我的一切收入都奉献十分之一。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我一个礼拜禁食两次，凡我所得的都捐上十分之一。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I fast twice a week and give a tenth of all I get.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I fast twice a week; I give tithes of all that I get.’
verses.textEnNkjv: I fast twice a week; I give tithes of all that I possess.’
verses.textEnNlt: I fast twice a week, and I give you a tenth of my income.’
verses.textEnNasb: I fast twice a week; I pay tithes of all that I get.’
verses.textEn: <red>I fast twice a week and give a tenth of all I get.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>税吏却远远站着，连举目望天也不敢，只捶着胸说：‘神啊，可怜我这个罪人！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>税吏却远远站着，连举目望天也不敢，只捶着胸说：‘神啊，可怜我这个罪人！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那税吏远远地站着，连举目望天也不敢，只捶着胸说：『神啊，开恩可怜我这个罪人！』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp the tax collector stood at a distance. He would not even look up to heaven, but beat his breast and said, ‘God, have mercy on me, a sinner.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But the tax collector, standing far off, would not even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’
verses.textEnNkjv: And the tax collector, standing afar off, would not so much as raise his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me a sinner!’
verses.textEnNlt: "But the tax collector stood at a distance and dared not even lift his eyes to heaven as he prayed. Instead, he beat his chest in sorrow, saying, ‘O God, be merciful to me, for I am a sinner.’
verses.textEnNasb: But the tax collector, standing some distance away, was even unwilling to raise his eyes toward heaven, but was beating his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, the sinner!’
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp the tax collector stood at a distance. He would not even look up to heaven, but beat his breast and said, ‘God, have mercy on me, a sinner.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，这个人回家去，比那个倒算为义了。因为高抬自己的，必要降卑；自己谦卑的，必要升高。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，这个人回家去，比那个倒算为义了。因为高抬自己的，必要降卑；自己谦卑的，必要升高。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我告诉你们，这人回家去比那人倒算为义了；因为，凡自高的，必降为卑；自卑的，必升为高。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Ip tell you that this man, rather than the other, went home justified before God. For all those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified, rather than the other. For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but the one who humbles himself will be exalted."
verses.textEnNkjv: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted."
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you, this sinner, not the Pharisee, returned home justified before God. For those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted."
verses.textEnNasb: I tell you, this man went to his house justified rather than the other one; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but the one who humbles himself will be exalted."
verses.textEn: <red>“Ip tell you that this man, rather than the other, went home justified before God. For all those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.”</red>

verses.textZh: 有人抱着婴孩到耶稣面前，要他触摸他们。门徒看见了，就责备那些人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人抱着婴孩到耶稣面前，要他触摸他们。门徒看见了，就责备那些人。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人抱着自己的婴孩来见耶稣，要他摸他们；门徒看见就责备那些人。
verses.textEnNiv: People were also bringing babies to Jesus for him to place his hands on them. When the disciples saw this, they rebuked them.
verses.textEnEsv: Now they were bringing even infants to him that he might touch them. And when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they also brought infants to Him that He might touch them; but when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
verses.textEnNlt: One day some parents brought their little children to Jesus so he could touch and bless them. But when the disciples saw this, they scolded the parents for bothering him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now they were bringing even their babies to Him so that He would touch them; but when the disciples saw it, they began rebuking them.
verses.textEn: People were also bringing babies to Jesus for him to place his hands on them. When the disciples saw this, they rebuked them.

verses.textZh: 耶稣却叫他们过来，说："<red>让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们，因为神的国正属于这样的人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣却叫他们过来，说："<red>让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们，因为神的国正属于这样的人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣却叫他们来，说：「让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们，因为在神国的正是这样的人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus called the children to him and said, <red>“Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus called them to him, saying, "Let the children come to me, and do not hinder them, for to such belongs the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus called them to Him and said, "Let the little children come to Me, and do not forbid them; for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus called for the children and said to the disciples, "Let the children come to me. Don’t stop them! For the Kingdom of God belongs to those who are like these children.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus called for the little ones, saying, "Allow the children to come to Me, and do not forbid them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
verses.textEn: But Jesus called the children to him and said, <red>“Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，凡不像小孩子一样接受神的国的，决不能进去。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，凡不像小孩子一样接受神的国的，决不能进去。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，凡要承受神国的，若不像小孩子，断不能进去。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Truly I tell you, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, I say to you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God like a child shall not enter it."
verses.textEnNkjv: Assuredly, I say to you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God as a little child will by no means enter it."
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, anyone who doesn’t receive the Kingdom of God like a child will never enter it."
verses.textEnNasb: Truly I say to you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God like a child will not enter it at all."
verses.textEn: <red>Truly I tell you, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”</red>

verses.textZh: 有一个官长问耶稣："良善的老师，我当作甚么，才可以承受永生？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个官长问耶稣："良善的老师，我当作甚么，才可以承受永生？"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个官问耶稣说：「良善的夫子，我该做什么事才可以承受永生？」
verses.textEnNiv: A certain ruler asked him, "Good teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?"
verses.textEnEsv: And a ruler asked him, "Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a certain ruler asked Him, saying, "Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"
verses.textEnNlt: Once a religious leader asked Jesus this question: "Good Teacher, what should I do to inherit eternal life?"
verses.textEnNasb: A ruler questioned Him, saying, "Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"
verses.textEn: A certain ruler asked him, "Good teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他说："你为甚么称我是良善的呢？除了神一位以外，没有良善的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他说："你为甚么称我是良善的呢？除了神一位以外，没有良善的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他说：「你为什么称我是良善的？除了神一位之外，再没有良善的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whyp do you call me good?”</red> Jesus answered. <red>“No one is good—except God alone.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to him, "Why do you call me good? No one is good except God alone.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesus said to him, "Why do you call Me good? No one is good but One, that is, God.
verses.textEnNlt: "Why do you call me good?" Jesus asked him. "Only God is truly good.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus said to him, "Why do you call Me good? No one is good except God alone.
verses.textEn: <red>“Whyp do you call me good?”</red> Jesus answered. <red>“No one is good—except God alone.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>诫命你是知道的：不可奸淫，不可杀人，不可偷盗，不可作假见证，当孝敬父母。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>诫命你是知道的：不可奸淫，不可杀人，不可偷盗，不可作假见证，当孝敬父母。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>诫命你是晓得的：『不可奸淫；不可杀人；不可偷盗；不可作假见证；当孝敬父母。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You know the commandments: ‘You shall not commit adultery, you shall not murder, you shall not steal, you shall not give false testimony, honor your father and mother.’”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You know the commandments: ‘Do not commit adultery, Do not murder, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honor your father and mother.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: You know the commandments: ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not bear false witness,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’"
verses.textEnNlt: But to answer your question, you know the commandments: ‘You must not commit adultery. You must not murder. You must not steal. You must not testify falsely. Honor your father and mother.’ "
verses.textEnNasb: You know the commandments, ‘Do not commit adultery, Do not murder, Do not steal, Do not give false testimony, Honor your father and mother.’ "
verses.textEn: <red>You know the commandments: ‘You shall not commit adultery, you shall not murder, you shall not steal, you shall not give false testimony, honor your father and mother.’”</red>

verses.textZh: 他说："这一切我从小都遵守了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："这一切我从小都遵守了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那人说：「这一切我从小都遵守了。」
verses.textEnNiv: "All these I have kept since I was a boy," he said.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "All these I have kept from my youth."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "All these things I have kept from my youth."
verses.textEnNlt: The man replied, "I’ve obeyed all these commandments since I was young."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "All these things I have kept since my youth."
verses.textEn: "All these I have kept since I was a boy," he said.

verses.textZh: 耶稣听了，就告诉他："<red>你还缺少一件，应当变卖你一切所有的，分给穷人，你就必定有财宝在天上，而且你还要来跟从我。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣听了，就告诉他："<red>你还缺少一件，应当变卖你一切所有的，分给穷人，你就必定有财宝在天上，而且你还要来跟从我。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣听见了，就说：「<red>你还缺少一件：要变卖你一切所有的，分给穷人，就必有财宝在天上；你还要来跟从我。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus heard this, he said to him, <red>“You still lack one thing. Sell everything you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When Jesus heard this, he said to him, "One thing you still lack. Sell all that you have and distribute to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when Jesus heard these things, He said to him, "You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow Me."
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus heard his answer, he said, "There is still one thing you haven’t done. Sell all your possessions and give the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Jesus heard this, He said to him, "One thing you still lack; sell all that you possess and distribute the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow Me."
verses.textEn: When Jesus heard this, he said to him, <red>“You still lack one thing. Sell everything you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他听见这话，非常忧愁，因为他十分富有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他听见这话，非常忧愁，因为他十分富有。
verses.textZhCuv: 他听见这话，就甚忧愁，因为他很富足。
verses.textEnNiv: When he heard this, he became very sad, because he was very wealthy.
verses.textEnEsv: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was extremely rich.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when he heard this, he became very sorrowful, for he was very rich.
verses.textEnNlt: But when the man heard this he became very sad, for he was very rich.
verses.textEnNasb: But when he had heard these things, he became very sad, for he was extremely wealthy.
verses.textEn: When he heard this, he became very sad, because he was very wealthy.

verses.textZh: 耶稣见他这样，就说："<red>富有的人要进神的国，是多么难哪！</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣见他这样，就说："<red>富有的人要进神的国，是多么难哪！</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣看见他，就说：「有钱财的人进神的国是何等的难哪！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus looked at him and said, <red>“How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus, seeing that he had become sad, said, "How difficult it is for those who have wealth to enter the kingdom of God!
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Jesus saw that he became very sorrowful, He said, "How hard it is for those who have riches to enter the kingdom of God!
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus saw this, he said, "How hard it is for the rich to enter the Kingdom of God!
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus looked at him and said, "How hard it is for those who are wealthy to enter the kingdom of God!
verses.textEn: Jesus looked at him and said, <red>“How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!</red>

verses.textZh: <red>骆驼穿过针眼，比有钱的人进神的国还容易呢。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>骆驼穿过针眼，比有钱的人进神的国还容易呢。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>骆驼穿过针的眼比财主进神的国还容易呢！」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Indeed, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: For it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the Kingdom of God!"
verses.textEnNasb: For it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God!"
verses.textEn: <red>Indeed, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God.”</red>

verses.textZh: 听见的人说："这样，谁可以得救呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 听见的人说："这样，谁可以得救呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 听见的人说：「这样，谁能得救呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Those who heard this asked, "Who then can be saved?"
verses.textEnEsv: Those who heard it said, "Then who can be saved?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And those who heard it said, "Who then can be saved?"
verses.textEnNlt: Those who heard this said, "Then who in the world can be saved?"
verses.textEnNasb: Those who heard Him said, "And so who can be saved?"
verses.textEn: Those who heard this asked, "Who then can be saved?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>人所不能的，在神却是可能的。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>人所不能的，在神却是可能的。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>在人所不能的事，在神却能。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“What is impossible with man is possible with God.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he said, "What is impossible with man is possible with God."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He said, "The things which are impossible with men are possible with God."
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "What is impossible for people is possible with God."
verses.textEnNasb: But He said, "The things that are impossible with people are possible with God."
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“What is impossible with man is possible with God.”</red>

verses.textZh: 彼得说："你看，我们已舍弃自己所有的，跟从你了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得说："你看，我们已舍弃自己所有的，跟从你了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得说：「看哪，我们已经撇下自己所有的跟从你了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Peter said to him, "We have left all we had to follow you!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Peter said, "See, we have left our homes and followed you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Peter said, "See, we have left all and followed You."
verses.textEnNlt: Peter said, "We’ve left our homes to follow you."
verses.textEnNasb: Peter said, "Behold, we have left our own homes and followed You."
verses.textEn: Peter said to him, "We have left all we had to follow you!"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："我实在告诉你们，人为神的国撇下房屋、妻子、弟兄、父母或儿女，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："我实在告诉你们，人为神的国撇下房屋、妻子、弟兄、父母或儿女，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「我实在告诉你们，人为神的国撇下房屋，或是妻子、弟兄、父母、儿女，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Trulyp I tell you,”</red> Jesus said to them, <red>“no one who has left home or wife or brothers or sisters or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Truly, I say to you, there is no one who has left house or wife or brothers or parents or children, for the sake of the kingdom of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: So He said to them, "Assuredly, I say to you, there is no one who has left house or parents or brothers or wife or children, for the sake of the kingdom of God,
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes," Jesus replied, "and I assure you that everyone who has given up house or wife or brothers or parents or children, for the sake of the Kingdom of God,
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "Truly I say to you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children for the sake of the kingdom of God,
verses.textEn: <red>“Trulyp I tell you,”</red> Jesus said to them, <red>“no one who has left home or wife or brothers or sisters or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God</red>

verses.textZh: <red>没有不在今世得许多倍，来世得永生的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>没有不在今世得许多倍，来世得永生的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>没有在今世不得百倍，在来世不得永生的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>will fail to receive many times as much in this age, and in the age to come eternal life.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the age to come eternal life."
verses.textEnNkjv: who shall not receive many times more in this present time, and in the age to come eternal life."
verses.textEnNlt: will be repaid many times over in this life, and will have eternal life in the world to come."
verses.textEnNasb: who will not receive many times as much at this time, and in the age to come, eternal life."
verses.textEn: <red>will fail to receive many times as much in this age, and in the age to come eternal life.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣把十二门徒带到一边，对他们说："<red>我们现在上耶路撒冷去，先知所写的一切，都要成就在人子身上。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣把十二门徒带到一边，对他们说："<red>我们现在上耶路撒冷去，先知所写的一切，都要成就在人子身上。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣带着十二个门徒，对他们说：「看哪，我们上耶路撒冷去，先知所写的一切事都要成就在人子身上。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus took the Twelve aside and told them, <red>“We are going up to Jerusalem, and everything that is written by the prophets about the Son of Man will be fulfilled.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And taking the twelve, he said to them, "See, we are going up to Jerusalem, and everything that is written about the Son of Man by the prophets will be accomplished.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He took the twelve aside and said to them, "Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be accomplished.
verses.textEnNlt: Taking the twelve disciples aside, Jesus said, "Listen, we’re going up to Jerusalem, where all the predictions of the prophets concerning the Son of Man will come true.
verses.textEnNasb: Now He took the twelve aside and said to them, "Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that have been written through the prophets about the Son of Man will be accomplished.
verses.textEn: Jesus took the Twelve aside and told them, <red>“We are going up to Jerusalem, and everything that is written by the prophets about the Son of Man will be fulfilled.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他要被交给外族人，受戏弄，被凌辱，他们要向他吐唾沫，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他要被交给外族人，受戏弄，被凌辱，他们要向他吐唾沫，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他将要被交给外邦人；他们要戏弄他，凌辱他，吐唾沫在他脸上，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He will be delivered over to the Gentiles. They will mock him, insult him and spit on him;</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For he will be delivered over to the Gentiles and will be mocked and shamefully treated and spit upon.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He will be delivered to the Gentiles and will be mocked and insulted and spit upon.
verses.textEnNlt: He will be handed over to the Romans, and he will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit upon.
verses.textEnNasb: For He will be handed over to the Gentiles, and will be ridiculed, and abused, and spit upon,
verses.textEn: <red>He will be delivered over to the Gentiles. They will mock him, insult him and spit on him;</red>

verses.textZh: <red>鞭打他，杀害他；第三日他要复活。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>鞭打他，杀害他；第三日他要复活。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>并要鞭打他，杀害他；第三日他要复活。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>they will flog him and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And after flogging him, they will kill him, and on the third day he will rise."
verses.textEnNkjv: They will scourge Him and kill Him. And the third day He will rise again."
verses.textEnNlt: They will flog him with a whip and kill him, but on the third day he will rise again."
verses.textEnNasb: and after they have flogged Him, they will kill Him; and on the third day He will rise."
verses.textEn: <red>they will flog him and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”</red>

verses.textZh: 这些话的含义对门徒是隐藏的。他们听了，一点也不明白，不知道他说的是甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些话的含义对门徒是隐藏的。他们听了，一点也不明白，不知道他说的是甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事门徒一样也不懂得，意思乃是隐藏的；他们不晓得所说的是什么。
verses.textEnNiv: The disciples did not understand any of this. Its meaning was hidden from them, and they did not know what he was talking about.
verses.textEnEsv: But they understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they did not grasp what was said.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they understood none of these things; this saying was hidden from them, and they did not know the things which were spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: But they didn’t understand any of this. The significance of his words was hidden from them, and they failed to grasp what he was talking about.
verses.textEnNasb: The disciples understood none of these things, and the meaning of this statement was hidden from them, and they did not comprehend the things that were said.
verses.textEn: The disciples did not understand any of this. Its meaning was hidden from them, and they did not know what he was talking about.

verses.textZh: 耶稣走近耶利哥的时候，有一个瞎眼的人坐在路旁讨饭，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣走近耶利哥的时候，有一个瞎眼的人坐在路旁讨饭，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣将近耶利哥的时候，有一个瞎子坐在路旁讨饭。
verses.textEnNiv: As Jesus approached Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the roadside begging.
verses.textEnEsv: As he drew near to Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the roadside begging.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it happened, as He was coming near Jericho, that a certain blind man sat by the road begging.
verses.textEnNlt: As Jesus approached Jericho, a blind beggar was sitting beside the road.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as Jesus was approaching Jericho, a man who was blind was sitting by the road, begging.
verses.textEn: As Jesus approached Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the roadside begging.

verses.textZh: 他听见人群经过，就问是甚么事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他听见人群经过，就问是甚么事。
verses.textZhCuv: 听见许多人经过，就问是什么事。
verses.textEnNiv: When he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.
verses.textEnEsv: And hearing a crowd going by, he inquired what this meant.
verses.textEnNkjv: And hearing a multitude passing by, he asked what it meant.
verses.textEnNlt: When he heard the noise of a crowd going past, he asked what was happening.
verses.textEnNasb: But when he heard a crowd going by, he began inquiring what this was.
verses.textEn: When he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.

verses.textZh: 别人告诉他，是拿撒勒人耶稣经过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 别人告诉他，是拿撒勒人耶稣经过。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们告诉他，是拿撒勒人耶稣经过。
verses.textEnNiv: They told him, "Jesus of Nazareth is passing by."
verses.textEnEsv: They told him, "Jesus of Nazareth is passing by."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
verses.textEnNlt: They told him that Jesus the Nazarene was going by.
verses.textEnNasb: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
verses.textEn: They told him, "Jesus of Nazareth is passing by."

verses.textZh: 他就喊叫说："大卫的子孙耶稣啊，可怜我吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就喊叫说："大卫的子孙耶稣啊，可怜我吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他就呼叫说：「大卫的子孙耶稣啊，可怜我吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: He called out, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnEsv: And he cried out, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he cried out, saying, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnNlt: So he began shouting, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnNasb: And he called out, saying, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEn: He called out, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"

verses.textZh: 在前头走的人责备他，叫他不要出声；但他越发喊叫："大卫的子孙，可怜我吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在前头走的人责备他，叫他不要出声；但他越发喊叫："大卫的子孙，可怜我吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 在前头走的人就责备他，不许他作声；他却越发喊叫说：「大卫的子孙，可怜我吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Those who led the way rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnEsv: And those who were in front rebuked him, telling him to be silent. But he cried out all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then those who went before warned him that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Be quiet!" the people in front yelled at him. But he only shouted louder, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEnNasb: Those who led the way were sternly telling him to be quiet; but he kept crying out all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
verses.textEn: Those who led the way rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"

verses.textZh: 耶稣站住，吩咐领他过来。等他走近，就问他：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣站住，吩咐领他过来。等他走近，就问他：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣站住，吩咐把他领过来，到了跟前，就问他说：
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus stopped and ordered the man to be brought to him. When he came near, Jesus asked him,
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus stopped and commanded him to be brought to him. And when he came near, he asked him,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jesus stood still and commanded him to be brought to Him. And when he had come near, He asked him,
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus heard him, he stopped and ordered that the man be brought to him. As the man came near, Jesus asked him,
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus stopped and commanded that he be brought to Him; and when he came near, He asked him,
verses.textEn: Jesus stopped and ordered the man to be brought to him. When he came near, Jesus asked him,

verses.textZh: <red>"你要我为你作甚么？"他说："主啊，叫我能看见！"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你要我为你作甚么？"他说："主啊，叫我能看见！"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要我为你做什么？」他说：「<red>主啊，我要能看见。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“What do you want me to do for you?”</red> “Lord, I want to see,” he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: "What do you want me to do for you?" He said, "Lord, let me recover my sight."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "What do you want Me to do for you?" He said, "Lord, that I may receive my sight."
verses.textEnNlt: "What do you want me to do for you?" "Lord," he said, "I want to see!"
verses.textEnNasb: "What do you want Me to do for you?" And he said, "Lord, I want to regain my sight!"
verses.textEn: <red>“What do you want me to do for you?”</red> “Lord, I want to see,” he replied.

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>你就看见吧！你的信使你痊愈了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>你就看见吧！你的信使你痊愈了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>你可以看见！你的信救了你了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to him, <red>“Receive your sight; your faith has healed you.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to him, "Recover your sight; your faith has made you well."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to him, "Receive your sight; your faith has made you well."
verses.textEnNlt: And Jesus said, "All right, receive your sight! Your faith has healed you."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to him, "Regain your sight; your faith has made you well."
verses.textEn: Jesus said to him, <red>“Receive your sight; your faith has healed you.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他立刻看见了，就跟随耶稣，颂赞神。众人看见这事，也赞美神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他立刻看见了，就跟随耶稣，颂赞神。众人看见这事，也赞美神。
verses.textZhCuv: 瞎子立刻看见了，就跟随耶稣，一路归荣耀与神。众人看见这事，也赞美神。
verses.textEnNiv: Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus, praising God. When all the people saw it, they also praised God.
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately he recovered his sight and followed him, glorifying God. And all the people, when they saw it, gave praise to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And immediately he received his sight, and followed Him, glorifying God. And all the people, when they saw it, gave praise to God.
verses.textEnNlt: Instantly the man could see, and he followed Jesus, praising God. And all who saw it praised God, too.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately he regained his sight and began following Him, glorifying God; and when all the people saw it, they gave praise to God.
verses.textEn: Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus, praising God. When all the people saw it, they also praised God.

verses.textZh: 耶稣进了耶利哥，正经过的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣进了耶利哥，正经过的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣进了耶利哥，正经过的时候，
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.
verses.textEnEsv: He entered Jericho and was passing through.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus entered Jericho and made his way through the town.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.
verses.textEn: Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.

verses.textZh: 有一个人名叫撒该，是税吏长，又很富有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个人名叫撒该，是税吏长，又很富有。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个人名叫撒该，作税吏长，是个财主。
verses.textEnNiv: A man was there by the name of Zacchaeus; he was a chief tax collector and was wealthy.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector and was rich.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now behold, therewas a man named Zacchaeus who was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.
verses.textEnNlt: There was a man there named Zacchaeus. He was the chief tax collector in the region, and he had become very rich.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was a man called by the name of Zaccheus; he was a chief tax collector and he was rich.
verses.textEn: A man was there by the name of Zacchaeus; he was a chief tax collector and was wealthy.

verses.textZh: 他想看看耶稣是怎么样的，因为人多，他又身材矮小，就看不见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他想看看耶稣是怎么样的，因为人多，他又身材矮小，就看不见。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要看看耶稣是怎样的人；只因人多，他的身量又矮，所以不得看见，
verses.textEnNiv: He wanted to see who Jesus was, but because he was short he could not see over the crowd.
verses.textEnEsv: And he was seeking to see who Jesus was, but on account of the crowd he could not, because he was small in stature.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he sought to see who Jesus was, but could not because of the crowd, for he was of short stature.
verses.textEnNlt: He tried to get a look at Jesus, but he was too short to see over the crowd.
verses.textEnNasb: Zaccheus was trying to see who Jesus was, and he was unable due to the crowd, because he was short in stature.
verses.textEn: He wanted to see who Jesus was, but because he was short he could not see over the crowd.

verses.textZh: 于是他跑到前头，爬上一棵桑树，要看看耶稣，因为耶稣就要从那里经过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他跑到前头，爬上一棵桑树，要看看耶稣，因为耶稣就要从那里经过。
verses.textZhCuv: 就跑到前头，爬上桑树，要看耶稣，因为耶稣必从那里经过。
verses.textEnNiv: So he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore-fig tree to see him, since Jesus was coming that way.
verses.textEnEsv: So he ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was about to pass that way.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he ran ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see Him, for He was going to pass that way.
verses.textEnNlt: So he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore-fig tree beside the road, for Jesus was going to pass that way.
verses.textEnNasb: So he ran on ahead and climbed up a sycamore tree in order to see Him, because He was about to pass through that way.
verses.textEn: So he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore-fig tree to see him, since Jesus was coming that way.

verses.textZh: 耶稣到了那里，往上一看，对他说："<red>撒该，快下来，今天我要住在你家里。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣到了那里，往上一看，对他说："<red>撒该，快下来，今天我要住在你家里。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣到了那里，抬头一看，对他说：「<red>撒该，快下来！今天我必住在你家里。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus reached the spot, he looked up and said to him, <red>“Zacchaeus, come down immediately. I must stay at your house today.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up and said to him, "Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for I must stay at your house today."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Jesus came to the place, He looked up and saw him, and said to him, "Zacchaeus, make haste and come down, for today I must stay at your house."
verses.textEnNlt: When Jesus came by, he looked up at Zacchaeus and called him by name. "Zacchaeus!" he said. "Quick, come down! I must be a guest in your home today."
verses.textEnNasb: And when Jesus came to the place, He looked up and said to him, "Zaccheus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house."
verses.textEn: When Jesus reached the spot, he looked up and said to him, <red>“Zacchaeus, come down immediately. I must stay at your house today.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他就赶快下来，欢欢喜喜地接待耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就赶快下来，欢欢喜喜地接待耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就急忙下来，欢欢喜喜地接待耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: So he came down at once and welcomed him gladly.
verses.textEnEsv: So he hurried and came down and received him joyfully.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he made haste and came down, and received Him joyfully.
verses.textEnNlt: Zacchaeus quickly climbed down and took Jesus to his house in great excitement and joy.
verses.textEnNasb: And he hurried and came down, and received Him joyfully.
verses.textEn: So he came down at once and welcomed him gladly.

verses.textZh: 众人看见就纷纷议论说："他竟到罪人家里去住宿！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人看见就纷纷议论说："他竟到罪人家里去住宿！"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人看见，都私下议论说：「他竟到罪人家里去住宿。」
verses.textEnNiv: All the people saw this and began to mutter, "He has gone to be the guest of a sinner."
verses.textEnEsv: And when they saw it, they all grumbled, "He has gone in to be the guest of a man who is a sinner."
verses.textEnNkjv: But when they saw it, they all complained, saying, "He has gone to be a guest with a man who is a sinner."
verses.textEnNlt: But the people were displeased. "He has gone to be the guest of a notorious sinner," they grumbled.
verses.textEnNasb: When the people saw this, they all began to complain, saying, "He has gone in to be the guest of a man who is a sinner!"
verses.textEn: All the people saw this and began to mutter, "He has gone to be the guest of a sinner."

verses.textZh: 撒该站着对主说："主啊，请看，我要把家财的一半分给穷人，我若敲诈了谁，就还他四倍。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒该站着对主说："主啊，请看，我要把家财的一半分给穷人，我若敲诈了谁，就还他四倍。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒该站着对主说：「主啊，我把所有的一半给穷人；我若讹诈了谁，就还他四倍。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, "Look, Lord! Here and now I give half of my possessions to the poor, and if I have cheated anybody out of anything, I will pay back four times the amount."
verses.textEnEsv: And Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, "Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor. And if I have defrauded anyone of anything, I restore it fourfold."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, "Look, Lord, I give half of my goods to the poor; and if I have taken anything from anyone by false accusation, I restore fourfold."
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Zacchaeus stood before the Lord and said, "I will give half my wealth to the poor, Lord, and if I have cheated people on their taxes, I will give them back four times as much!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Zaccheus stopped and said to the Lord, "Behold, Lord, half of my possessions I am giving to the poor, and if I have extorted anything from anyone, I am giving back four times as much."
verses.textEn: But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, "Look, Lord! Here and now I give half of my possessions to the poor, and if I have cheated anybody out of anything, I will pay back four times the amount."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>今天救恩到了这家，他也是亚伯拉罕的子孙。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>今天救恩到了这家，他也是亚伯拉罕的子孙。</red>

verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to him, <red>“Today salvation has come to this house, because this man, too, is a son of Abraham.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to him, "Today salvation has come to this house, since he also is a son of Abraham.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus said to him, "Today salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham;
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus responded, "Salvation has come to this home today, for this man has shown himself to be a true son of Abraham.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to him, "Today salvation has come to this house, because he, too, is a son of Abraham.
verses.textEn: Jesus said to him, <red>“Today salvation has come to this house, because this man, too, is a son of Abraham.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为人子来，是要寻找拯救失丧的人。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为人子来，是要寻找拯救失丧的人。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人子来，为要寻找、拯救失丧的人。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost."
verses.textEnNkjv: for the Son of Man has come to seek and to save that which was lost."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Son of Man came to seek and save those who are lost."
verses.textEnNasb: For the Son of Man has come to seek and to save that which was lost."
verses.textEn: <red>For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.”</red>

verses.textZh: 众人听这些话的时候，因为耶稣已经接近耶路撒冷，又因他们以为神的国快要出现，他就讲了一个比喻，
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人听这些话的时候，因为耶稣已经接近耶路撒冷，又因他们以为神的国快要出现，他就讲了一个比喻，
verses.textZhCuv: 众人正在听见这些话的时候，耶稣因为将近耶路撒冷，又因他们以为神的国快要显出来，就另设一个比喻，说：
verses.textEnNiv: While they were listening to this, he went on to tell them a parable, because he was near Jerusalem and the people thought that the kingdom of God was going to appear at once.
verses.textEnEsv: As they heard these things, he proceeded to tell a parable, because he was near to Jerusalem, and because they supposed that the kingdom of God was to appear immediately.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as they heard these things, He spoke another parable, because He was near Jerusalem and because they thought the kingdom of God would appear immediately.
verses.textEnNlt: The crowd was listening to everything Jesus said. And because he was nearing Jerusalem, he told them a story to correct the impression that the Kingdom of God would begin right away.
verses.textEnNasb: Now while they were listening to these things, Jesus went on to tell a parable, because He was near Jerusalem and they thought that the kingdom of God was going to appear immediately.
verses.textEn: While they were listening to this, he went on to tell them a parable, because he was near Jerusalem and the people thought that the kingdom of God was going to appear at once.

verses.textZh: 说："<red>有一个贵族往远方去要接受王位，然后回来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："<red>有一个贵族往远方去要接受王位，然后回来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「有一个贵胄往远方去，要得国回来，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He said: <red>“A man of noble birth went to a distant country to have himself appointed king and then to return.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said therefore, "A nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and then return.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore He said: "A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.
verses.textEnNlt: He said, "A nobleman was called away to a distant empire to be crowned king and then return.
verses.textEnNasb: So He said, "A nobleman went to a distant country to receive a kingdom for himself, and then to return.
verses.textEn: He said: <red>“A man of noble birth went to a distant country to have himself appointed king and then to return.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他叫了自己的十个仆人来，给他们一千银币，说：‘你们拿去作生意，等到我回来。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他叫了自己的十个仆人来，给他们一千银币，说：‘你们拿去作生意，等到我回来。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>便叫了他的十个仆人来，交给他们十锭 银子，说：『你们去做生意，直等我回来。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas. ‘Put this money to work,’ he said, ‘until I come back.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Calling ten of his servants, he gave them ten minas, and said to them, ‘Engage in business until I come.’
verses.textEnNkjv: So he called ten of his servants, delivered to them ten minas, and said to them, ‘Do business till I come.’
verses.textEnNlt: Before he left, he called together ten of his servants and divided among them ten pounds of silver, saying, ‘Invest this for me while I am gone.’
verses.textEnNasb: And he called ten of his own slaves and gave them ten minas, and said to them, ‘Do business with this money until I come back.’
verses.textEn: <red>So he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas. ‘Put this money to work,’ he said, ‘until I come back.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他本国的人却恨他，就派使者跟着去说：‘我们不愿意这个人作王统治我们。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他本国的人却恨他，就派使者跟着去说：‘我们不愿意这个人作王统治我们。’</red>

verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, ‘We don’t want this man to be our king.’</red>

verses.textEnNkjv: But his citizens hated him, and sent a delegation after him, saying, ‘We will not have this man to reign over us.’
verses.textEnNlt: But his people hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, ‘We do not want him to be our king.’
verses.textEnNasb: But his citizens hated him and sent a delegation after him, saying, ‘We do not want this man to reign over us.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, ‘We don’t want this man to be our king.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他得了王位回来，就吩咐把那些领了钱的仆人召来，要知道他们作生意赚了多少。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他得了王位回来，就吩咐把那些领了钱的仆人召来，要知道他们作生意赚了多少。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他既得国回来，就吩咐叫那领银子的仆人来，要知道他们做生意赚了多少。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Hep was made king, however, and returned home. Then he sent for the servants to whom he had given the money, in order to find out what they had gained with it.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When he returned, having received the kingdom, he ordered these servants to whom he had given the money to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by doing business.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And so it was that when he returned, having received the kingdom, he then commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.
verses.textEnNlt: "After he was crowned king, he returned and called in the servants to whom he had given the money. He wanted to find out what their profits were.
verses.textEnNasb: When he returned after receiving the kingdom, he ordered that these slaves, to whom he had given the money, be summoned to him so that he would learn how much they had made by the business they had done.
verses.textEn: <red>“Hep was made king, however, and returned home. Then he sent for the servants to whom he had given the money, in order to find out what they had gained with it.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>第一个走过来说：‘主啊，你的一百银币，已经赚了一千。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>第一个走过来说：‘主啊，你的一百银币，已经赚了一千。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>头一个上来，说：『主啊，你的一锭银子已经赚了十锭。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thep first one came and said, ‘Sir, your mina has earned ten more.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten minas more.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then came the first, saying, ‘Master, your mina has earned ten minas.’
verses.textEnNlt: The first servant reported, ‘Master, I invested your money and made ten times the original amount!’
verses.textEnNasb: The first slave appeared, saying, ‘ Master, your mina has made ten minas more.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Thep first one came and said, ‘Sir, your mina has earned ten more.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>主人说：‘好，良善的仆人，你既然在最小的事上忠心，可以有权管理十座城。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>主人说：‘好，良善的仆人，你既然在最小的事上忠心，可以有权管理十座城。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主人说：『好！良善的仆人，你既在最小的事上有忠心，可以有权柄管十座城。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“ ‘Wellp done, my good servant!’ his master replied. ‘Because you have been trustworthy in a very small matter, take charge of ten cities.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, ‘Well done, good servant! Because you have been faithful in a very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to him, ‘Well done, good servant; because you were faithful in a very little, have authority over ten cities.’
verses.textEnNlt: "‘Well done!’ the king exclaimed. ‘You are a good servant. You have been faithful with the little I entrusted to you, so you will be governor of ten cities as your reward.’
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to him, ‘Well done, good slave; since you have been faithful in a very little thing, you are to have authority over ten cities.’
verses.textEn: <red>“ ‘Wellp done, my good servant!’ his master replied. ‘Because you have been trustworthy in a very small matter, take charge of ten cities.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>第二个来说：‘主啊，你的一百银币，已经赚了五百。’</red>

verses.textEn: <red>“Thep second came and said, ‘Sir, your mina has earned five more.’</red>

verses.textZhCnvs: <red>主人说：‘你可以管理五座城。’</red>

verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Hisp master answered, ‘You take charge of five cities.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise he said to him, ‘You also be over five cities.’
verses.textEnNlt: "‘Well done!’ the king said. ‘You will be governor over five cities.’
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to him also, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Hisp master answered, ‘You take charge of five cities.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>另一个来说：‘主啊，你看，你的一百银币，我一直保存在手巾里，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>另一个来说：‘主啊，你看，你的一百银币，我一直保存在手巾里，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又有一个来说：『主啊，看哪，你的一锭银子在这里，我把它包在手巾里存着。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thenp another servant came and said, ‘Sir, here is your mina; I have kept it laid away in a piece of cloth.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then another came, saying, ‘Lord, here is your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then another came, saying, ‘Master, here is your mina, which I have kept put away in a handkerchief.
verses.textEnNlt: "But the third servant brought back only the original amount of money and said, ‘Master, I hid your money and kept it safe.
verses.textEnNasb: And then another came, saying, ‘Master, here is your mina, which I kept tucked away in a handkerchief;
verses.textEn: <red>“Thenp another servant came and said, ‘Sir, here is your mina; I have kept it laid away in a piece of cloth.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为我怕你，你一向是严厉的人，没有存的要提取，没有种的要收割。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为我怕你，你一向是严厉的人，没有存的要提取，没有种的要收割。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我原是怕你，因为你是严厉的人；没有放下的，还要去拿，没有种下的，还要去收。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I was afraid of you, because you are a hard man. You take out what you did not put in and reap what you did not sow.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: for I was afraid of you, because you are a severe man. You take what you did not deposit, and reap what you did not sow.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For I feared you, because you are an austere man. You collect what you did not deposit, and reap what you did not sow.’
verses.textEnNlt: I was afraid because you are a hard man to deal with, taking what isn’t yours and harvesting crops you didn’t plant.’
verses.textEnNasb: for I was afraid of you, because you are a demanding man; you take up what you did not lay down, and reap what you did not sow.’
verses.textEn: <red>I was afraid of you, because you are a hard man. You take out what you did not put in and reap what you did not sow.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>主人说：‘可恶的仆人！我要凭你的口定你的罪。你知道我是严厉的人，没有存的要提取，没有种的要收割吗？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>主人说：‘可恶的仆人！我要凭你的口定你的罪。你知道我是严厉的人，没有存的要提取，没有种的要收割吗？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主人对他说：『你这恶仆，我要凭你的口定你的罪。你既知道我是严厉的人，没有放下的，还要去拿，没有种下的，还要去收，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Hisp master replied, ‘I will judge you by your own words, you wicked servant! You knew, did you, that I am a hard man, taking out what I did not put in, and reaping what I did not sow?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to him, ‘I will condemn you with your own words, you wicked servant! You knew that I was a severe man, taking what I did not deposit and reaping what I did not sow?
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant. You knew that I was an austere man, collecting what I did not deposit and reaping what I did not sow.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘You wicked servant!’ the king roared. ‘Your own words condemn you. If you knew that I’m a hard man who takes what isn’t mine and harvests crops I didn’t plant,
verses.textEnNasb: He *said to him, ‘ From your own lips I will judge you, you worthless slave. Did you know that I am a demanding man, taking up what I did not lay down, and reaping what I did not sow?
verses.textEn: <red>“Hisp master replied, ‘I will judge you by your own words, you wicked servant! You knew, did you, that I am a hard man, taking out what I did not put in, and reaping what I did not sow?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那你为甚么不把我的钱存入银行，等我回来的时候，把它连本带利取回来呢？’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那你为甚么不把我的钱存入银行，等我回来的时候，把它连本带利取回来呢？’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>为什么不把我的银子交给银行，等我来的时候，连本带利都可以要回来呢？』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Why then didn’t you put my money on deposit, so that when I came back, I could have collected it with interest?’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Why then did you not put my money in the bank, and at my coming I might have collected it with interest?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Why then did you not put my money in the bank, that at my coming I might have collected it with interest?’
verses.textEnNlt: why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank? At least I could have gotten some interest on it.’
verses.textEnNasb: And so why did you not put my money in the bank, and when I came back, I would have collected it with interest?’
verses.textEn: <red>Why then didn’t you put my money on deposit, so that when I came back, I could have collected it with interest?’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他就对侍卫说：‘夺过他的一百银币，给那有一千的。’</red>
