verses.textZhCuv: <red>就对旁边站着的人说：『夺过他这一锭来，给那有十锭的。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thenp he said to those standing by, ‘Take his mina away from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina from him, and give it to the one who has the ten minas.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "And he said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina from him, and give it to him who has ten minas.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Then, turning to the others standing nearby, the king ordered, ‘Take the money from this servant, and give it to the one who has ten pounds.’
verses.textEnNasb: And then he said to the other slaves who were present, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to the one who has the ten minas.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Thenp he said to those standing by, ‘Take his mina away from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们说：‘主啊，他已经有一千银币了。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们说：‘主啊，他已经有一千银币了。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他们说：『主啊，他已经有十锭了。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“ ‘Sir,’p they said, ‘he already has ten!’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’
verses.textEnNkjv: (But they said to him, ‘Master, he has ten minas.’)
verses.textEnNlt: "‘But, master,’ they said, ‘he already has ten pounds!’
verses.textEnNasb: And they said to him, ‘Master, he already has ten minas.’
verses.textEn: <red>“ ‘Sir,’p they said, ‘he already has ten!’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>主人说：‘我告诉你们，凡是有的，还要给他；没有的，就算他有甚么也要拿去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>主人说：‘我告诉你们，凡是有的，还要给他；没有的，就算他有甚么也要拿去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主人说：『我告诉你们，凡有的，还要加给他；没有的，连他所有的也要夺过来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Hep replied, ‘I tell you that to everyone who has, more will be given, but as for the one who has nothing, even what they have will be taken away.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: ‘I tell you that to everyone who has, more will be given, but from the one who has not, even what he has will be taken away.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘For I say to you, that to everyone who has will be given; and from him who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘Yes,’ the king replied, ‘and to those who use well what they are given, even more will be given. But from those who do nothing, even what little they have will be taken away.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I tell you that to everyone who has, more shall be given, but from the one who does not have, even what he does have shall be taken away.
verses.textEn: <red>“Hep replied, ‘I tell you that to everyone who has, more will be given, but as for the one who has nothing, even what they have will be taken away.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>至于我那些仇敌，就是不愿意我作王统治他们的，把他们拉到这里来，在我面前杀掉！’"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>至于我那些仇敌，就是不愿意我作王统治他们的，把他们拉到这里来，在我面前杀掉！’"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>至于我那些仇敌，不要我作他们王的，把他们拉来，在我面前杀了吧！』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But those enemies of mine who did not want me to be king over them—bring them here and kill them in front of me.’ ”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But as for these enemies of mine, who did not want me to reign over them, bring them here and slaughter them before me.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: But bring here those enemies of mine, who did not want me to reign over them, and slay them before me.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And as for these enemies of mine who didn’t want me to be their king—bring them in and execute them right here in front of me.’"
verses.textEnNasb: But as for these enemies of mine who did not want me to reign over them, bring them here and slaughter them in my presence.’ "
verses.textEn: <red>But those enemies of mine who did not want me to be king over them—bring them here and kill them in front of me.’ ”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣讲完这些话，就往前走，上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣讲完这些话，就往前走，上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说完了这话，就在前面走，上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textEnNiv: After Jesus had said this, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He had said this, He went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: After telling this story, Jesus went on toward Jerusalem, walking ahead of his disciples.
verses.textEnNasb: After Jesus said these things, He was going on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: After Jesus had said this, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 将到伯法其和伯大尼，就在橄榄山那里，他差派两个门徒，
verses.textZhCnvs: 将到伯法其和伯大尼，就在橄榄山那里，他差派两个门徒，
verses.textZhCuv: 将近伯法其和伯大尼，在一座山名叫橄榄山那里，就打发两个门徒，说：
verses.textEnNiv: As he approached Bethphage and Bethany at the hill called the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples, saying to them,
verses.textEnEsv: When he drew near to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount that is called Olivet, he sent two of the disciples,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when He drew near to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mountain called Olivet, that He sent two of His disciples,
verses.textEnNlt: As he came to the towns of Bethphage and Bethany on the Mount of Olives, he sent two disciples ahead.
verses.textEnNasb: When He approached Bethphage and Bethany, near the mountain that is called Olivet, He sent two of the disciples,
verses.textEn: As he approached Bethphage and Bethany at the hill called the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples, saying to them,

verses.textZh: <red>说："你们往对面的村子里去，走进去的时候，就会看见一头从来没有人骑过的小驴，拴在那里，把牠解开牵来。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>说："你们往对面的村子里去，走进去的时候，就会看见一头从来没有人骑过的小驴，拴在那里，把牠解开牵来。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们往对面村子里去，进去的时候，必看见一匹驴驹拴在那里，是从来没有人骑过的，可以解开牵来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Go to the village ahead of you, and as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, which no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "Go into the village in front of you, where on entering you will find a colt tied, on which no one has ever yet sat. Untie it and bring it here.
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "Go into the village opposite you, where as you enter you will find a colt tied, on which no one has ever sat. Loose it and bring it here.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go into that village over there," he told them. "As you enter it, you will see a young donkey tied there that no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "Go into the village ahead of you; there, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, on which no one yet has ever sat; untie it and bring it here.
verses.textEn: <red>“Go to the village ahead of you, and as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, which no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>如果有人问为甚么解开牠，你们要这样说：‘主需要牠。’"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>如果有人问为甚么解开牠，你们要这样说：‘主需要牠。’"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>若有人问为什么解它，你们就说：『主要用它。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say, ‘The Lord needs it.’ ”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ you shall say this: ‘The Lord has need of it.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And if anyone asks you, ‘Why are you loosing it?’ thus you shall say to him, ‘Because the Lord has need of it.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you untying that colt?’ just say, ‘The Lord needs it.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And if anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ you shall say this: ‘ The Lord has need of it.’ "
verses.textEn: <red>If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say, ‘The Lord needs it.’ ”</red>

verses.textZh: 被差的人去了，发现和主所说的一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 被差的人去了，发现和主所说的一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 打发的人去了，所遇见的正如耶稣所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who were sent ahead went and found it just as he had told them.
verses.textEnEsv: So those who were sent went away and found it just as he had told them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So those who were sent went their way and found it just as He had said to them.
verses.textEnNlt: So they went and found the colt, just as Jesus had said.
verses.textEnNasb: So those who were sent left and found it just as He had told them.
verses.textEn: Those who were sent ahead went and found it just as he had told them.

verses.textZh: 他们解开小驴的时候，主人问他们："你们为甚么解开牠？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们解开小驴的时候，主人问他们："你们为甚么解开牠？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们解驴驹的时候，主人问他们说：「解驴驹做什么？」
verses.textEnNiv: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked them, "Why are you untying the colt?"
verses.textEnEsv: And as they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, "Why are you untying the colt?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But as they were loosing the colt, the owners of it said to them, "Why are you loosing the colt?"
verses.textEnNlt: And sure enough, as they were untying it, the owners asked them, "Why are you untying that colt?"
verses.textEnNasb: And as they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, "Why are you untying the colt?"
verses.textEn: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked them, "Why are you untying the colt?"

verses.textZh: 他们说："主需要牠。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："主需要牠。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「主要用它。」
verses.textEnNiv: They replied, "The Lord needs it."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said, "The Lord has need of it."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said, "The Lord has need of him."
verses.textEnNlt: And the disciples simply replied, "The Lord needs it."
verses.textEnNasb: They said, " The Lord has need of it."
verses.textEn: They replied, "The Lord needs it."

verses.textZh: 他们把小驴牵到耶稣那里，把自己的衣服搭在上面，扶着耶稣上去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把小驴牵到耶稣那里，把自己的衣服搭在上面，扶着耶稣上去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们牵到耶稣那里，把自己的衣服搭在上面，扶着耶稣骑上。
verses.textEnNiv: They brought it to Jesus, threw their cloaks on the colt and put Jesus on it.
verses.textEnEsv: And they brought it to Jesus, and throwing their cloaks on the colt, they set Jesus on it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they brought him to Jesus. And they threw their own clothes on the colt, and they set Jesus on him.
verses.textEnNlt: So they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their garments over it for him to ride on.
verses.textEnNasb: And they brought it to Jesus, and they threw their cloaks on the colt and put Jesus on it.
verses.textEn: They brought it to Jesus, threw their cloaks on the colt and put Jesus on it.

verses.textZh: 耶稣前行的时候，众人把自己的衣服铺在路上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣前行的时候，众人把自己的衣服铺在路上。
verses.textZhCuv: 走的时候，众人把衣服铺在路上。
verses.textEnNiv: As he went along, people spread their cloaks on the road.
verses.textEnEsv: And as he rode along, they spread their cloaks on the road.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as He went, many spread their clothes on the road.
verses.textEnNlt: As he rode along, the crowds spread out their garments on the road ahead of him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as He was going, they were spreading their cloaks on the road.
verses.textEn: As he went along, people spread their cloaks on the road.

verses.textZh: 他走近耶路撒冷，快要下橄榄山的时候，全体门徒因为所看见的一切神迹，就欢乐起来，大声赞美神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他走近耶路撒冷，快要下橄榄山的时候，全体门徒因为所看见的一切神迹，就欢乐起来，大声赞美神，
verses.textZhCuv: 将近耶路撒冷，正下橄榄山的时候，众门徒因所见过的一切异能，都欢乐起来，大声赞美神，
verses.textEnNiv: When he came near the place where the road goes down the Mount of Olives, the whole crowd of disciples began joyfully to praise God in loud voices for all the miracles they had seen:
verses.textEnEsv: As he was drawing near—already on the way down the Mount of Olives— the whole multitude of his disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, as He was now drawing near the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works they had seen,
verses.textEnNlt: When he reached the place where the road started down the Mount of Olives, all of his followers began to shout and sing as they walked along, praising God for all the wonderful miracles they had seen.
verses.textEnNasb: And as soon as He was approaching, near the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole crowd of the disciples began to praise God joyfully with a loud voice for all the miracles which they had seen,
verses.textEn: When he came near the place where the road goes down the Mount of Olives, the whole crowd of disciples began joyfully to praise God in loud voices for all the miracles they had seen:

verses.textZh: 说： "奉主名来的王， 是应当称颂的！ 在天上有和平， 在至高之处有荣耀！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说： "奉主名来的王， 是应当称颂的！ 在天上有和平， 在至高之处有荣耀！"
verses.textZhCuv: 说： 奉主名来的王是应当称颂的！ 在天上有和平； 在至高之处有荣光。
verses.textEnNiv: "Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord!" "Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!"
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!"
verses.textEnNkjv: saying: " ‘Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!’ Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Blessings on the King who comes in the name of the Lord ! Peace in heaven, and glory in highest heaven!"
verses.textEnNasb: shouting: "Blessed is the King, the One who comes in the name of the Lord; Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!"
verses.textEn: "Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord!" "Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!"

verses.textZh: 群众中有几个法利赛人对他说："先生，责备你的门徒吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众中有几个法利赛人对他说："先生，责备你的门徒吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人中有几个法利赛人对耶稣说：「夫子，责备你的门徒吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Jesus, "Teacher, rebuke your disciples!"
verses.textEnEsv: And some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to him, "Teacher, rebuke your disciples."
verses.textEnNkjv: And some of the Pharisees called to Him from the crowd, "Teacher, rebuke Your disciples."
verses.textEnNlt: But some of the Pharisees among the crowd said, "Teacher, rebuke your followers for saying things like that!"
verses.textEnNasb: And yet some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Him, "Teacher, rebuke Your disciples!"
verses.textEn: Some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Jesus, "Teacher, rebuke your disciples!"

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣说："我告诉你们，他们若不出声，石头都要呼叫了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣说："我告诉你们，他们若不出声，石头都要呼叫了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>我告诉你们，若是他们闭口不说，这些石头必要呼叫起来。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Ip tell you,”</red> he replied, <red>“if they keep quiet, the stones will cry out.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He answered, "I tell you, if these were silent, the very stones would cry out."
verses.textEnNkjv: But He answered and said to them, "I tell you that if these should keep silent, the stones would immediately cry out."
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "If they kept quiet, the stones along the road would burst into cheers!"
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus replied, "I tell you, if these stop speaking, the stones will cry out!"
verses.textEn: <red>“Ip tell you,”</red> he replied, <red>“if they keep quiet, the stones will cry out.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣走近耶路撒冷的时候，看见了城，就为城哀哭，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣走近耶路撒冷的时候，看见了城，就为城哀哭，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣快到耶路撒冷，看见城，就为它哀哭，
verses.textEnNiv: As he approached Jerusalem and saw the city, he wept over it
verses.textEnEsv: And when he drew near and saw the city, he wept over it,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as He drew near, He saw the city and wept over it,
verses.textEnNlt: But as he came closer to Jerusalem and saw the city ahead, he began to weep.
verses.textEnNasb: When He approached Jerusalem, He saw the city and wept over it,
verses.textEn: As he approached Jerusalem and saw the city, he wept over it

verses.textZh: 说："<red>巴不得你在这日子，知道关于你平安的事，但现在这事在你眼前是隐藏的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："<red>巴不得你在这日子，知道关于你平安的事，但现在这事在你眼前是隐藏的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>说：「巴不得你在这日子知道关系你平安的事；无奈这事现在是隐藏的，叫你的眼看不出来。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: and said, <red>“If you, even you, had only known on this day what would bring you peace—but now it is hidden from your eyes.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "Would that you, even you, had known on this day the things that make for peace! But now they are hidden from your eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "If you had known, even you, especially in this your day, the things that make for your peace! But now they are hidden from your eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: "How I wish today that you of all people would understand the way to peace. But now it is too late, and peace is hidden from your eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "If you had known on this day, even you, the conditions for peace! But now they have been hidden from your eyes.
verses.textEn: and said, <red>“If you, even you, had only known on this day what would bring you peace—but now it is hidden from your eyes.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>日子将到，你的仇敌必筑垒攻击你，周围环绕你，四面困住你，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>日子将到，你的仇敌必筑垒攻击你，周围环绕你，四面困住你，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为日子将到，你的仇敌必筑起土垒，周围环绕你，四面困住你，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The days will come upon you when your enemies will build an embankment against you and encircle you and hem you in on every side.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For the days will come upon you, when your enemies will set up a barricade around you and surround you and hem you in on every side
verses.textEnNkjv: For days will come upon you when your enemies will build an embankment around you, surround you and close you in on every side,
verses.textEnNlt: Before long your enemies will build ramparts against your walls and encircle you and close in on you from every side.
verses.textEnNasb: For the days will come upon you when your enemies will put up a barricade against you, and surround you and hem you in on every side,
verses.textEn: <red>The days will come upon you when your enemies will build an embankment against you and encircle you and hem you in on every side.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>要摧毁你和你里面的儿女，没有一块石头留在另一块石头上面，因为你不知道那眷顾你的时期。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>要摧毁你和你里面的儿女，没有一块石头留在另一块石头上面，因为你不知道那眷顾你的时期。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>并要扫灭你和你里头的儿女，连一块石头也不留在石头上，因你不知道眷顾你的时候。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>They will dash you to the ground, you and the children within your walls. They will not leave one stone on another, because you did not recognize the time of God’s coming to you.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and tear you down to the ground, you and your children within you. And they will not leave one stone upon another in you, because you did not know the time of your visitation."
verses.textEnNkjv: and level you, and your children within you, to the ground; and they will not leave in you one stone upon another, because you did not know the time of your visitation."
verses.textEnNlt: They will crush you into the ground, and your children with you. Your enemies will not leave a single stone in place, because you did not recognize it when God visited you. "
verses.textEnNasb: and they will level you to the ground, and throw down your children within you, and they will not leave in you one stone upon another, because you did not recognize the time of your visitation."
verses.textEn: <red>They will dash you to the ground, you and the children within your walls. They will not leave one stone on another, because you did not recognize the time of God’s coming to you.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣进了圣殿，就赶走作买卖的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣进了圣殿，就赶走作买卖的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣进了殿，赶出里头做买卖的人，
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus entered the temple courts, he began to drive out those who were selling.
verses.textEnEsv: And he entered the temple and began to drive out those who sold,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He went into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus entered the Temple and began to drive out the people selling animals for sacrifices.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus entered the temple grounds and began to drive out those who were selling,
verses.textEn: When Jesus entered the temple courts, he began to drive out those who were selling.

verses.textZh: <red>对他们说："经上记着： ‘我的殿是祷告的殿’， 你们竟把它弄成贼窝了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>对他们说："经上记着： ‘我的殿是祷告的殿’， 你们竟把它弄成贼窝了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：「<red>经上说： 我的殿必作祷告的殿， 你们倒使它成为贼窝了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“It is written,”</red> he said to them, <red>“ ‘My house will be a house of prayer’; but you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: saying to them, "It is written, ‘My house shall be a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying to them, "It is written, ‘My house isa house of prayer,’but you have made it a ‘den of thieves.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: He said to them, "The Scriptures declare, ‘My Temple will be a house of prayer,’ but you have turned it into a den of thieves."
verses.textEnNasb: saying to them, "It is written: ‘And My house will be a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers."
verses.textEn: <red>“It is written,”</red> he said to them, <red>“ ‘My house will be a house of prayer’; but you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”</red>

verses.textZh: 他天天在圣殿里教导人，祭司长、经学家和民间的首领，都想杀害他；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他天天在圣殿里教导人，祭司长、经学家和民间的首领，都想杀害他；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣天天在殿里教训人。祭司长和文士与百姓的尊长都想要杀他，
verses.textEnNiv: Every day he was teaching at the temple. But the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the leaders among the people were trying to kill him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he was teaching daily in the temple. The chief priests and the scribes and the principal men of the people were seeking to destroy him,
verses.textEnNkjv: And He was teaching daily in the temple. But the chief priests, the scribes, and the leaders of the people sought to destroy Him,
verses.textEnNlt: After that, he taught daily in the Temple, but the leading priests, the teachers of religious law, and the other leaders of the people began planning how to kill him.
verses.textEnNasb: And He was teaching daily in the temple; but the chief priests and the scribes and the leading men among the people were trying to put Him to death,
verses.textEn: Every day he was teaching at the temple. But the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the leaders among the people were trying to kill him.

verses.textZh: 但他们不知道要怎样下手，因为众人都围着他，听他的教训。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们不知道要怎样下手，因为众人都围着他，听他的教训。
verses.textZhCuv: 但寻不出法子来，因为百姓都侧耳听他。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet they could not find any way to do it, because all the people hung on his words.
verses.textEnEsv: but they did not find anything they could do, for all the people were hanging on his words.
verses.textEnNkjv: and were unable to do anything; for all the people were very attentive to hear Him.
verses.textEnNlt: But they could think of nothing, because all the people hung on every word he said.
verses.textEnNasb: and yet they could not find anything that they might do, for all the people were hanging on to every word He said.
verses.textEn: Yet they could not find any way to do it, because all the people hung on his words.

verses.textZh: 有一天，耶稣在殿里教导人，宣讲福音，众祭司长、经学家和长老上前来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，耶稣在殿里教导人，宣讲福音，众祭司长、经学家和长老上前来，
verses.textZhCuv: 有一天，耶稣在殿里教训百姓，讲福音的时候，祭司长和文士并长老上前来，
verses.textEnNiv: One day as Jesus was teaching the people in the temple courts and proclaiming the good news, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, together with the elders, came up to him.
verses.textEnEsv: One day, as Jesus was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes with the elders came up
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened on one of those days, as He taught the people in the temple and preached the gospel, that the chief priests and the scribes, together with the elders, confronted Him
verses.textEnNlt: One day as Jesus was teaching the people and preaching the Good News in the Temple, the leading priests, the teachers of religious law, and the elders came up to him.
verses.textEnNasb: On one of the days while He was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes with the elders confronted Him,
verses.textEn: One day as Jesus was teaching the people in the temple courts and proclaiming the good news, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, together with the elders, came up to him.

verses.textZh: 对他说："告诉我们，你凭着甚么权柄作这些事？给你这权柄的是谁？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他说："告诉我们，你凭着甚么权柄作这些事？给你这权柄的是谁？"
verses.textZhCuv: 问他说：「你告诉我们，你仗着什么权柄做这些事？给你这权柄的是谁呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell us by what authority you are doing these things," they said. "Who gave you this authority?"
verses.textEnEsv: and said to him, "Tell us by what authority you do these things, or who it is that gave you this authority."
verses.textEnNkjv: and spoke to Him, saying, "Tell us, by what authority are You doing these things? Or who is he who gave You this authority?"
verses.textEnNlt: They demanded, "By what authority are you doing all these things? Who gave you the right?"
verses.textEnNasb: and they declared, saying to Him, "Tell us by what authority You are doing these things, or who is the one who gave You this authority?"
verses.textEn: "Tell us by what authority you are doing these things," they said. "Who gave you this authority?"

verses.textZh: 他回答他们："我也要问你们一句话，你们告诉我：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答他们："我也要问你们一句话，你们告诉我：
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣回答说：「我也要问你们一句话，你们且告诉我。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, <red>“I will also ask you a question. Tell me:</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He answered them, "I also will ask you a question. Now tell me,
verses.textEnNkjv: But He answered and said to them, "I also will ask you one thing, and answer Me:
verses.textEnNlt: "Let me ask you a question first," he replied.
verses.textEnNasb: But He replied to them, "I will also ask you a question, and you tell Me:
verses.textEn: He replied, <red>“I will also ask you a question. Tell me:</red>

verses.textZh: <red>约翰的洗礼是从天上来的，还是从人来的呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>约翰的洗礼是从天上来的，还是从人来的呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>约翰的洗礼是从天上来的？是从人间来的呢？」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or of human origin?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: was the baptism of John from heaven or from man?"
verses.textEnNkjv: The baptism of John—was it from heaven or from men?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Did John’s authority to baptize come from heaven, or was it merely human?"
verses.textEnNasb: Was the baptism of John from heaven or from men?"
verses.textEn: <red>John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or of human origin?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们就彼此议论说："如果我们说：‘是从天上来的’，他就会问：‘那你们为甚么不相信他呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就彼此议论说："如果我们说：‘是从天上来的’，他就会问：‘那你们为甚么不相信他呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们彼此商议说：「我们若说『从天上来』，他必说：『你们为什么不信他呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: They discussed it among themselves and said, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’
verses.textEnEsv: And they discussed it with one another, saying, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why did you not believe him?’
verses.textEnNkjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
verses.textEnNlt: They talked it over among themselves. "If we say it was from heaven, he will ask why we didn’t believe John.
verses.textEnNasb: They discussed among themselves, saying, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will say, ‘Why did you not believe him?’
verses.textEn: They discussed it among themselves and said, "If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

verses.textZh: 如果我们说：‘是从人来的’，众人都会用石头打我们，因为他们都认定约翰是先知。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我们说：‘是从人来的’，众人都会用石头打我们，因为他们都认定约翰是先知。"
verses.textZhCuv: 若说『从人间来』，百姓都要用石头打死我们，因为他们信约翰是先知。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if we say, ‘Of human origin,’ all the people will stone us, because they are persuaded that John was a prophet."
verses.textEnEsv: But if we say, ‘From man,’ all the people will stone us to death, for they are convinced that John was a prophet."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet."
verses.textEnNlt: But if we say it was merely human, the people will stone us because they are convinced John was a prophet."
verses.textEnNasb: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us to death, since they are convinced that John was a prophet."
verses.textEn: But if we say, ‘Of human origin,’ all the people will stone us, because they are persuaded that John was a prophet."

verses.textZh: 于是他们回答耶稣："我们不知道是从哪里来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们回答耶稣："我们不知道是从哪里来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是回答说：「不知道是从哪里来的。」
verses.textEnNiv: So they answered, "We don’t know where it was from."
verses.textEnEsv: So they answered that they did not know where it came from.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they answered that they did not know where itwas from.
verses.textEnNlt: So they finally replied that they didn’t know.
verses.textEnNasb: And so they answered that they did not know where it came from.
verses.textEn: So they answered, "We don’t know where it was from."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>我也不告诉你们，我凭着甚么权柄作这些事。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>我也不告诉你们，我凭着甚么权柄作这些事。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>我也不告诉你们，我仗着什么权柄做这些事。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said, <red>“Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things."
verses.textEnNlt: And Jesus responded, "Then I won’t tell you by what authority I do these things."
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to them, "Neither am I telling you by what authority I do these things."
verses.textEn: Jesus said, <red>“Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是耶稣向众人讲了这个比喻："有一个人栽种了一个葡萄园，租给佃户，就远行去了很久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶稣向众人讲了这个比喻："有一个人栽种了一个葡萄园，租给佃户，就远行去了很久。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣就设比喻对百姓说：「有人栽了一个葡萄园，租给园户，就往外国去住了许久。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He went on to tell the people this parable: <red>“A man planted a vineyard, rented it to some farmers and went away for a long time.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he began to tell the people this parable: "A man planted a vineyard and let it out to tenants and went into another country for a long while.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He began to tell the people this parable: "A certain man planted a vineyard, leased it to vinedressers, and went into a far country for a long time.
verses.textEnNlt: Now Jesus turned to the people again and told them this story: "A man planted a vineyard, leased it to tenant farmers, and moved to another country to live for several years.
verses.textEnNasb: But He began to tell the people this parable: "A man planted a vineyard and leased it to vine-growers, and went on a journey for a long time.
verses.textEn: He went on to tell the people this parable: <red>“A man planted a vineyard, rented it to some farmers and went away for a long time.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>到了时候，园主派了一个仆人到佃户那里，叫他们把葡萄园当纳的果子交给他。佃户却打了他，放他空手回去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>到了时候，园主派了一个仆人到佃户那里，叫他们把葡萄园当纳的果子交给他。佃户却打了他，放他空手回去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>到了时候，打发一个仆人到园户那里去，叫他们把园中当纳的果子交给他；园户竟打了他，叫他空手回去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>At harvest time he sent a servant to the tenants so they would give him some of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat him and sent him away empty-handed.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When the time came, he sent a servant to the tenants, so that they would give him some of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now at vintage-time he sent a servant to the vinedressers, that they might give him some of the fruit of the vineyard. But the vinedressers beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
verses.textEnNlt: At the time of the grape harvest, he sent one of his servants to collect his share of the crop. But the farmers attacked the servant, beat him up, and sent him back empty-handed.
verses.textEnNasb: At the harvest time he sent a slave to the vine-growers, so that they would give him his share of the produce of the vineyard; but the vine-growers beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
verses.textEn: <red>At harvest time he sent a servant to the tenants so they would give him some of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat him and sent him away empty-handed.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>园主又派另一个仆人去，佃户又打了他，并且侮辱他，也叫他空手回去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>园主又派另一个仆人去，佃户又打了他，并且侮辱他，也叫他空手回去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又打发一个仆人去，他们也打了他，并且凌辱他，叫他空手回去。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He sent another servant, but that one also they beat and treated shamefully and sent away empty-handed.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent another servant. But they also beat and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty-handed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again he sent another servant; and they beat him also, treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty-handed.
verses.textEnNlt: So the owner sent another servant, but they also insulted him, beat him up, and sent him away empty-handed.
verses.textEnNasb: And he proceeded to send another slave; but they beat him also and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty-handed.
verses.textEn: <red>He sent another servant, but that one also they beat and treated shamefully and sent away empty-handed.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>于是他又派第三个去，佃户把他打伤，赶他走了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>于是他又派第三个去，佃户把他打伤，赶他走了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又打发第三个仆人去，他们也打伤了他，把他推出去了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He sent still a third, and they wounded him and threw him out.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent yet a third. This one also they wounded and cast out.
verses.textEnNkjv: And again he sent a third; and they wounded him also and cast him out.
verses.textEnNlt: A third man was sent, and they wounded him and chased him away.
verses.textEnNasb: And he proceeded to send a third; but this one too they wounded and threw out.
verses.textEn: <red>He sent still a third, and they wounded him and threw him out.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>葡萄园的主人说：‘怎么办呢？我要派我的爱子去，也许这一个他们会尊敬的。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>葡萄园的主人说：‘怎么办呢？我要派我的爱子去，也许这一个他们会尊敬的。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>园主说：『我怎么办呢？我要打发我的爱子去，或者他们尊敬他。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Thenp the owner of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my son, whom I love; perhaps they will respect him.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then the owner of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son; perhaps they will respect him.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then the owner of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. Probably they will respect him when they see him.’
verses.textEnNlt: "‘What will I do?’ the owner asked himself. ‘I know! I’ll send my cherished son. Surely they will respect him.’
verses.textEnNasb: Now the owner of the vineyard said, ‘What am I to do? I will send my beloved son; perhaps they will respect him.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Thenp the owner of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my son, whom I love; perhaps they will respect him.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>佃户一看他，就彼此商议说：‘这是继承产业的，让我们杀了他，那么，产业就成为我们的了。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>佃户一看他，就彼此商议说：‘这是继承产业的，让我们杀了他，那么，产业就成为我们的了。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>不料，园户看见他，就彼此商量说：『这是承受产业的，我们杀他吧，使产业归于我们！』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Butp when the tenants saw him, they talked the matter over. ‘This is the heir,’ they said. ‘Let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But when the tenants saw him, they said to themselves, ‘This is the heir. Let us kill him, so that the inheritance may be ours.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the vinedressers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’
verses.textEnNlt: "But when the tenant farmers saw his son, they said to each other, ‘Here comes the heir to this estate. Let’s kill him and get the estate for ourselves!’
verses.textEnNasb: But when the vine-growers saw him, they discussed with one another, saying, ‘This is the heir; let’s kill him so that the inheritance will be ours.’
verses.textEn: <red>“Butp when the tenants saw him, they talked the matter over. ‘This is the heir,’ they said. ‘Let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>于是他们把园主的爱子推出葡萄园外杀了。主人要怎样对待他们呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>于是他们把园主的爱子推出葡萄园外杀了。主人要怎样对待他们呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>于是把他推出葡萄园外，杀了。这样，葡萄园的主人要怎样处治他们呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. “Whatp then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?
verses.textEnNkjv: So they cast him out of the vineyard and killed him. Therefore what will the owner of the vineyard do to them?
verses.textEnNlt: So they dragged him out of the vineyard and murdered him. "What do you suppose the owner of the vineyard will do to them?" Jesus asked.
verses.textEnNasb: And so they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What, then, will the owner of the vineyard do to them?
verses.textEn: <red>So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. “Whatp then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他要来除掉这些佃户，把葡萄园租给别人。"他们听见了就说："千万不要有这样的事发生！"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他要来除掉这些佃户，把葡萄园租给别人。"他们听见了就说："千万不要有这样的事发生！"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 他要来除灭这些园户，将葡萄园转给别人。」听见的人说：「<red>这是万不可的！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.”</red> When the people heard this, they said, “God forbid!”
verses.textEnEsv: He will come and destroy those tenants and give the vineyard to others." When they heard this, they said, "Surely not!"
verses.textEnNkjv: He will come and destroy those vinedressers and give the vineyard to others." And when they heard it they said, "Certainly not!"
verses.textEnNlt: "I’ll tell you—he will come and kill those farmers and lease the vineyard to others." "How terrible that such a thing should ever happen," his listeners protested.
verses.textEnNasb: He will come and put these vine-growers to death, and will give the vineyard to others." However, when they heard this, they said, "May it never happen!"
verses.textEn: <red>He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.”</red> When the people heard this, they said, “God forbid!”

verses.textZh: 耶稣看着他们，说："<red>那么， ‘建筑工人所弃的石头， 成了房角的主要石头’， 这经文是甚么意思呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看着他们，说："<red>那么， ‘建筑工人所弃的石头， 成了房角的主要石头’， 这经文是甚么意思呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣看着他们说：「经上记着： 匠人所弃的石头 已作了房角的头块石头。 这是什么意思呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus looked directly at them and asked, <red>“Then what is the meaning of that which is written: “ ‘Thepn stone the builders rejected hasld become the cornerstone’?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But he looked directly at them and said, "What then is this that is written: "‘The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone’?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He looked at them and said, "What then is this that is written: ‘The stone which the builders rejected Has become the chief cornerstone’?
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus looked at them and said, "Then what does this Scripture mean? ‘The stone that the builders rejected has now become the cornerstone.’
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus looked at them and said, "Then what is this statement that has been written: ‘A stone which the builders rejected, This has become the chief cornerstone’?
verses.textEn: Jesus looked directly at them and asked, <red>“Then what is the meaning of that which is written: “ ‘Thepn stone the builders rejected hasld become the cornerstone’?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>凡是跌在那石头上的，就必摔碎；那石头掉在谁的身上，就必把他压得粉碎。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>凡是跌在那石头上的，就必摔碎；那石头掉在谁的身上，就必把他压得粉碎。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>凡掉在那石头上的，必要跌碎；那石头掉在谁的身上，就要把谁砸得稀烂。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Everyonep who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces; anyone on whom it falls will be crushed.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, and when it falls on anyone, it will crush him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever falls on that stone will be broken; but on whomever it falls, it will grind him to powder."
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone who stumbles over that stone will be broken to pieces, and it will crush anyone it falls on."
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces; but on whomever it falls, it will crush him."
verses.textEn: <red>Everyonep who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces; anyone on whom it falls will be crushed.”</red>

verses.textZh: 经学家和祭司长知道这比喻是针对他们说的，当时就想动手拿他，可是又害怕群众。
verses.textZhCnvs: 经学家和祭司长知道这比喻是针对他们说的，当时就想动手拿他，可是又害怕群众。
verses.textZhCuv: 文士和祭司长看出这比喻是指着他们说的，当时就想要下手拿他，只是惧怕百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: The teachers of the law and the chief priests looked for a way to arrest him immediately, because they knew he had spoken this parable against them. But they were afraid of the people.
verses.textEnEsv: The scribes and the chief priests sought to lay hands on him at that very hour, for they perceived that he had told this parable against them, but they feared the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the chief priests and the scribes that very hour sought to lay hands on Him, but they feared the people —for they knew He had spoken this parable against them.
verses.textEnNlt: The teachers of religious law and the leading priests wanted to arrest Jesus immediately because they realized he was telling the story against them—they were the wicked farmers. But they were afraid of the people’s reaction.
verses.textEnNasb: The scribes and the chief priests tried to lay hands on Him that very hour, and yet they feared the people; for they were aware that He had spoken this parable against them.
verses.textEn: The teachers of the law and the chief priests looked for a way to arrest him immediately, because they knew he had spoken this parable against them. But they were afraid of the people.

verses.textZh: 经学家和祭司长差派奸细伪装好人去窥探耶稣，要在他的话上抓着把柄，好把他交由总督全权裁决。
verses.textZhCnvs: 经学家和祭司长差派奸细伪装好人去窥探耶稣，要在他的话上抓着把柄，好把他交由总督全权裁决。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是窥探耶稣，打发奸细装作好人，要在他的话上得把柄，好将他交在巡抚的政权之下。
verses.textEnNiv: Keeping a close watch on him, they sent spies, who pretended to be sincere. They hoped to catch Jesus in something he said, so that they might hand him over to the power and authority of the governor.
verses.textEnEsv: So they watched him and sent spies, who pretended to be sincere, that they might catch him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the authority and jurisdiction of the governor.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they watched Him, and sent spies who pretended to be righteous, that they might seize on His words, in order to deliver Him to the power and the authority of the governor.
verses.textEnNlt: Watching for their opportunity, the leaders sent spies pretending to be honest men. They tried to get Jesus to say something that could be reported to the Roman governor so he would arrest Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: And so they watched Him closely, and sent spies who pretended to be righteous, in order that they might catch Him in some statement, so that they could hand Him over to the jurisdiction and authority of the governor.
verses.textEn: Keeping a close watch on him, they sent spies, who pretended to be sincere. They hoped to catch Jesus in something he said, so that they might hand him over to the power and authority of the governor.

verses.textZh: 奸细问他："老师，我们知道你所说所教的都对，并且不讲情面，只照着真理把神的道教导人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 奸细问他："老师，我们知道你所说所教的都对，并且不讲情面，只照着真理把神的道教导人。
verses.textZhCuv: 奸细就问耶稣说：「夫子，我们晓得你所讲所传都是正道，也不取人的外貌，乃是诚诚实实传神的道。
verses.textEnNiv: So the spies questioned him: "Teacher, we know that you speak and teach what is right, and that you do not show partiality but teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: So they asked him, "Teacher, we know that you speak and teach rightly, and show no partiality, but truly teach the way of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they asked Him, saying, "Teacher, we know that You say and teach rightly, and You do not show personal favoritism, but teach the way of God in truth:
verses.textEnNlt: "Teacher," they said, "we know that you speak and teach what is right and are not influenced by what others think. You teach the way of God truthfully.
verses.textEnNasb: And the spies questioned Him, saying, "Teacher, we know that You speak and teach correctly, and You are not partial to anyone, but You teach the way of God on the basis of truth.
verses.textEn: So the spies questioned him: "Teacher, we know that you speak and teach what is right, and that you do not show partiality but teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.

verses.textZh: 我们纳税给凯撒可以不可以？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们纳税给凯撒可以不可以？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们纳税给凯撒，可以不可以？」
verses.textEnNiv: Is it right for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"
verses.textEnEsv: Is it lawful for us to give tribute to Caesar, or not?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"
verses.textEnNlt: Now tell us—is it right for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"
verses.textEnNasb: Is it permissible for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?"
verses.textEn: Is it right for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣看透他们的诡计，就对他们说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣看透他们的诡计，就对他们说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣看出他们的诡诈，就对他们说：
verses.textEnNiv: He saw through their duplicity and said to them,
verses.textEnEsv: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: But He perceived their craftiness, and said to them, "Why do you test Me?
verses.textEnNlt: He saw through their trickery and said,
verses.textEnNasb: But He saw through their trickery and said to them,
verses.textEn: He saw through their duplicity and said to them,

verses.textZh: <red>"给我一个银币看看，上面是谁的像，谁的名号？"他们说："凯撒的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"给我一个银币看看，上面是谁的像，谁的名号？"他们说："凯撒的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 「拿一个银钱来给我看。这像和这号是谁的？」他们说：「<red>是凯撒的。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?”</red> “Caesar’s,” they replied.
verses.textEnEsv: "Show me a denarius. Whose likeness and inscription does it have?" They said, "Caesar’s."
verses.textEnNkjv: Show Me a denarius. Whose image and inscription does it have?" They answered and said, "Caesar’s."
verses.textEnNlt: "Show me a Roman coin. Whose picture and title are stamped on it?" "Caesar’s," they replied.
verses.textEnNasb: "Show Me a denarius. Whose image and inscription does it have?" They said, "Caesar’s."
verses.textEn: <red>“Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?”</red> “Caesar’s,” they replied.

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>这样，凯撒的应当归给凯撒，神的应当归给神。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>这样，凯撒的应当归给凯撒，神的应当归给神。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>这样，凯撒的物当归给凯撒，神的物当归给神。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, <red>“Then give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "Then render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Render therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s."
verses.textEnNlt: "Well then," he said, "give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar, and give to God what belongs to God."
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "Then pay to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s."
verses.textEn: He said to them, <red>“Then give back to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们在群众面前，不能抓住耶稣的把柄，又希奇他的回答，就沉默下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在群众面前，不能抓住耶稣的把柄，又希奇他的回答，就沉默下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们当着百姓，在这话上得不着把柄，又希奇他的应对，就闭口无言了。
verses.textEnNiv: They were unable to trap him in what he had said there in public. And astonished by his answer, they became silent.
verses.textEnEsv: And they were not able in the presence of the people to catch him in what he said, but marveling at his answer they became silent.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they could not catch Him in His words in the presence of the people. And they marveled at His answer and kept silent.
verses.textEnNlt: So they failed to trap him by what he said in front of the people. Instead, they were amazed by his answer, and they became silent.
verses.textEnNasb: And they were unable to catch Him in a statement in the presence of the people; and they were amazed at His answer, and said nothing.
verses.textEn: They were unable to trap him in what he had said there in public. And astonished by his answer, they became silent.

verses.textZh: 撒都该人向来否认有复活的事，他们当中有几个人来问耶稣：
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒都该人向来否认有复活的事，他们当中有几个人来问耶稣：
verses.textZhCuv: 撒都该人常说没有复活的事。有几个来问耶稣说：
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus with a question.
verses.textEnEsv: There came to him some Sadducees, those who deny that there is a resurrection,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then some of the Sadducees, who deny that there is a resurrection, came to Him and asked Him,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus was approached by some Sadducees—religious leaders who say there is no resurrection from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: Now some of the Sadducees (who maintain that there is no resurrection) came to Him,
verses.textEn: Some of the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus with a question.

verses.textZh: "老师，摩西曾写给我们说：‘如果一个人娶了妻子，还没有儿女就死了，他的弟弟就应当娶他的妻子，为哥哥立后。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "老师，摩西曾写给我们说：‘如果一个人娶了妻子，还没有儿女就死了，他的弟弟就应当娶他的妻子，为哥哥立后。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「夫子！摩西为我们写着说：『人若有妻无子就死了，他兄弟当娶他的妻，为哥哥生子立后。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Teacher," they said, "Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man must marry the widow and raise up offspring for his brother.
verses.textEnEsv: and they asked him a question, saying, "Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies, having a wife but no children, the man must take the widow and raise up offspring for his brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: saying: "Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies, having a wife, and he dies without children, his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.
verses.textEnNlt: They posed this question: "Teacher, Moses gave us a law that if a man dies, leaving a wife but no children, his brother should marry the widow and have a child who will carry on the brother’s name.
verses.textEnNasb: and they questioned Him, saying, "Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies, leaving a wife, and he is childless, that his brother is to marry the wife and raise up children for his brother.
verses.textEn: "Teacher," they said, "Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man must marry the widow and raise up offspring for his brother.

verses.textZh: 从前有兄弟七人，头一个娶了妻子，没有孩子就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前有兄弟七人，头一个娶了妻子，没有孩子就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 有弟兄七人，第一个娶了妻，没有孩子死了；
verses.textEnNiv: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married a woman and died childless.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died without children.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there were seven brothers. And the first took a wife, and died without children.
verses.textEnNlt: Well, suppose there were seven brothers. The oldest one married and then died without children.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, there were seven brothers; and the first took a wife and died childless;
verses.textEn: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married a woman and died childless.

verses.textZh: 第二个、
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二个、
verses.textZhCuv: 第二个、第三个也娶过她；
verses.textEnNiv: The second
verses.textEnEsv: And the second
verses.textEnNkjv: And the second took her as wife, and he died childless.
verses.textEnNlt: So the second brother married the widow, but he also died.
verses.textEnNasb: and the second
verses.textEn: The second

verses.textZh: 第三个，也娶过她；七个都是这样，都没有留下孩子就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三个，也娶过她；七个都是这样，都没有留下孩子就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那七个人都娶过她，没有留下孩子就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: and then the third married her, and in the same way the seven died, leaving no children.
verses.textEnEsv: and the third took her, and likewise all seven left no children and died.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the third took her, and in like manner the seven also; and they left no children, and died.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the third brother married her. This continued with all seven of them, who died without children.
verses.textEnNasb: and the third married her; and in the same way all seven died, leaving no children.
verses.textEn: and then the third married her, and in the same way the seven died, leaving no children.

verses.textZh: 后来那女人也死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来那女人也死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来妇人也死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Finally, the woman died too.
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward the woman also died.
verses.textEnNkjv: Last of all the woman died also.
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, the woman also died.
verses.textEnNasb: Finally the woman also died.
verses.textEn: Finally, the woman died too.

verses.textZh: 那么，这女人在复活的时候，要作哪一个的妻子呢？因为七个人都娶过她。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，这女人在复活的时候，要作哪一个的妻子呢？因为七个人都娶过她。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，当复活的时候，她是哪一个的妻子呢？因为他们七个人都娶过她。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now then, at the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?"
verses.textEnEsv: In the resurrection, therefore, whose wife will the woman be? For the seven had her as wife."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, in the resurrection, whose wife does she become? For all seven had her as wife."
verses.textEnNlt: So tell us, whose wife will she be in the resurrection? For all seven were married to her!"
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, in the resurrection, which one’s wife does the woman become? For all seven married her."
verses.textEn: Now then, at the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>这世界的人又娶又嫁，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>这世界的人又娶又嫁，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「这世界的人有娶有嫁；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus replied, <red>“The people of this age marry and are given in marriage.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said to them, "The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage,
verses.textEnNkjv: Jesus answered and said to them, "The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus replied, "Marriage is for people here on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Jesus said to them, "The sons of this age marry and the women are given in marriage,
verses.textEn: Jesus replied, <red>“The people of this age marry and are given in marriage.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但配得那世界的，又配从死人中复活的人，也不娶也不嫁。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但配得那世界的，又配从死人中复活的人，也不娶也不嫁。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>惟有算为配得那世界，与从死里复活的人也不娶也不嫁；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But those who are considered worthy of taking part in the age to come and in the resurrection from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and to the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage,
verses.textEnNkjv: But those who are counted worthy to attain that age, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry nor are given in marriage;
verses.textEnNlt: But in the age to come, those worthy of being raised from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage.
verses.textEnNasb: but those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry nor are given in marriage;
verses.textEn: <red>But those who are considered worthy of taking part in the age to come and in the resurrection from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们和天使一样，不能再死；既然是复活了的人，就是神的儿子了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们和天使一样，不能再死；既然是复活了的人，就是神的儿子了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为他们不能再死，和天使一样；既是复活的人，就为神的儿子。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and they can no longer die; for they are like the angels. They are God’s children, since they are children of the resurrection.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: for they cannot die anymore, because they are equal to angels and are sons of God, being sons of the resurrection.
verses.textEnNkjv: nor can they die anymore, for they are equal to the angels and are sons of God, being sons of the resurrection.
verses.textEnNlt: And they will never die again. In this respect they will be like angels. They are children of God and children of the resurrection.
verses.textEnNasb: for they cannot even die anymore, for they are like angels, and are sons of God, being sons of the resurrection.
verses.textEn: <red>and they can no longer die; for they are like the angels. They are God’s children, since they are children of the resurrection.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>至于死人复活的事，摩西在荆棘篇上提过，他称主是亚伯拉罕的神、以撒的神、雅各的神；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>至于死人复活的事，摩西在荆棘篇上提过，他称主是亚伯拉罕的神、以撒的神、雅各的神；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>至于死人复活，摩西在荆棘篇上，称主是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，就指示明白了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But in the account of the burning bush, even Moses showed that the dead rise, for he calls the Lord ‘the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed, in the passage about the bush, where he calls the Lord the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: But even Moses showed in the burning bush passage that the dead are raised, when he called the Lord ‘the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
verses.textEnNlt: "But now, as to whether the dead will be raised—even Moses proved this when he wrote about the burning bush. Long after Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob had died, he referred to the Lord as ‘the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
verses.textEnNasb: But as for the fact that the dead are raised, even Moses revealed this in the passage about the burning bush, where he calls the Lord the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
verses.textEn: <red>But in the account of the burning bush, even Moses showed that the dead rise, for he calls the Lord ‘the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>神不是死人的神，而是活人的神，因为在他那里的人都是活的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>神不是死人的神，而是活人的神，因为在他那里的人都是活的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>神原不是死人的神，乃是活人的神；因为在他那里 ，人都是活的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to him all are alive.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Now he is not God of the dead, but of the living, for all live to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: For He is not the God of the dead but of the living, for all live to Him."
verses.textEnNlt: So he is the God of the living, not the dead, for they are all alive to him."
verses.textEnNasb: Now He is not the God of the dead, but of the living; for all live to Him."
verses.textEn: <red>He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to him all are alive.”</red>

verses.textZh: 经学家中有几个说："老师，你说得好。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 经学家中有几个说："老师，你说得好。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有几个文士说：「夫子！你说得好。」
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the teachers of the law responded, "Well said, teacher!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then some of the scribes answered, "Teacher, you have spoken well."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then some of the scribes answered and said, "Teacher, You have spoken well."
verses.textEnNlt: "Well said, Teacher!" remarked some of the teachers of religious law who were standing there.
verses.textEnNasb: Some of the scribes answered and said, "Teacher, You have spoken well."
verses.textEn: Some of the teachers of the law responded, "Well said, teacher!"

verses.textZh: 从此他们再不敢问他甚么了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从此他们再不敢问他甚么了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以后他们不敢再问他什么。
verses.textEnNiv: And no one dared to ask him any more questions.
verses.textEnEsv: For they no longer dared to ask him any question.
verses.textEnNkjv: But after that they dared not question Him anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: And then no one dared to ask him any more questions.
verses.textEnNasb: For they did not have the courage to question Him any longer about anything.
verses.textEn: And no one dared to ask him any more questions.

verses.textZh: 耶稣问他们："人怎么能说基督是大卫的子孙呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣问他们："人怎么能说基督是大卫的子孙呢？
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「人怎么说基督是大卫的子孙呢？</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们要提防经学家，他们好穿长袍走来走去，喜欢人在巿中心向他们问安，并且喜欢会堂里的高位、筵席上的首座。</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为我必赐给你们口才、智慧，是你们所有的敌人不能抵抗，也不能驳倒的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为我必赐给你们口才、智慧，是你们所有的敌人不能抵抗，也不能驳倒的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为我必赐你们口才、智慧，是你们一切敌人所敌不住、驳不倒的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For I will give you words and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which none of your adversaries will be able to withstand or contradict.
verses.textEnNkjv: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to contradict or resist.
verses.textEnNlt: for I will give you the right words and such wisdom that none of your opponents will be able to reply or refute you!
verses.textEnNasb: for I will provide you eloquence and wisdom which none of your adversaries will be able to oppose or refute.
verses.textEn: <red>For I will give you words and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们也会被父母、弟兄、亲戚、朋友出卖，他们又要害死你们一些人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们也会被父母、弟兄、亲戚、朋友出卖，他们又要害死你们一些人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>连你们的父母、弟兄、亲族、朋友也要把你们交官；你们也有被他们害死的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You will be betrayed even by parents, brothers and sisters, relatives and friends, and they will put some of you to death.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You will be delivered up even by parents and brothers and relatives and friends, and some of you they will put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers, relatives and friends; and they will put some of you to death.
verses.textEnNlt: Even those closest to you—your parents, brothers, relatives, and friends—will betray you. They will even kill some of you.
verses.textEnNasb: But you will be betrayed even by parents, brothers and sisters, other relatives, and friends, and they will put some of you to death,
verses.textEn: <red>You will be betrayed even by parents, brothers and sisters, relatives and friends, and they will put some of you to death.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们要因我的名，被众人恨恶，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们要因我的名，被众人恨恶，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要为我的名被众人恨恶，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Everyone will hate you because of me.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You will be hated by all for my name’s sake.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you will be hated by all for My name’s sake.
verses.textEnNlt: And everyone will hate you because you are my followers.
verses.textEnNasb: and you will be hated by all people because of My name.
verses.textEn: <red>Everyone will hate you because of me.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>然而连你们的一根头发，也必不失落。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>然而连你们的一根头发，也必不失落。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>然而，你们连一根头发也必不损坏。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But not a hair of your head will perish.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But not a hair of your head will perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: But not a hair of your head shall be lost.
verses.textEnNlt: But not a hair of your head will perish!
verses.textEnNasb: And yet not a hair of your head will perish.
verses.textEn: <red>But not a hair of your head will perish.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们要以坚忍的心志，赢取自己的灵魂。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们要以坚忍的心志，赢取自己的灵魂。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们常存忍耐，就必保全灵魂 。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Stand firm, and you will win life.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: By your endurance you will gain your lives.
verses.textEnNkjv: By your patience possess your souls.
verses.textEnNlt: By standing firm, you will win your souls.
verses.textEnNasb: By your endurance you will gain your lives.
verses.textEn: <red>Stand firm, and you will win life.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"当你们看见耶路撒冷被军队围困的时候，就知道它荒凉的日子近了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"当你们看见耶路撒冷被军队围困的时候，就知道它荒凉的日子近了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们看见耶路撒冷被兵围困，就可知道它成荒场的日子近了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Whenp you see Jerusalem being surrounded by armies, you will know that its desolation is near.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation has come near.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is near.
verses.textEnNlt: "And when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then you will know that the time of its destruction has arrived.
verses.textEnNasb: "But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then recognize that her desolation is near.
verses.textEn: <red>“Whenp you see Jerusalem being surrounded by armies, you will know that its desolation is near.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那时，住在犹太的，应该逃到山上；住在城里的，要离开；住在乡下的，不要进城。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那时，住在犹太的，应该逃到山上；住在城里的，要离开；住在乡下的，不要进城。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，在犹太的应当逃到山上；在城里的应当出来；在乡下的不要进城；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country not enter the city.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, and let those who are inside the city depart, and let not those who are out in the country enter it,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those who are in the midst of her depart, and let not those who are in the country enter her.
verses.textEnNlt: Then those in Judea must flee to the hills. Those in Jerusalem must get out, and those out in the country should not return to the city.
verses.textEnNasb: Then those who are in Judea must flee to the mountains, and those who are inside the city must leave, and those who are in the country must not enter the city;
verses.textEn: <red>Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country not enter the city.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>因为这是报仇的日子，使经上的一切话都得应验。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>因为这是报仇的日子，使经上的一切话都得应验。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为这是报应的日子，使经上所写的都得应验。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For this is the time of punishment in fulfillment of all that has been written.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: for these are days of vengeance, to fulfill all that is written.
verses.textEnNkjv: For these are the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
verses.textEnNlt: For those will be days of God’s vengeance, and the prophetic words of the Scriptures will be fulfilled.
verses.textEnNasb: because these are days of punishment, so that all things which have been written will be fulfilled.
verses.textEn: <red>For this is the time of punishment in fulfillment of all that has been written.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>当那些日子，怀孕的和乳养孩子的有祸了！因为大灾难要临到这地，烈怒要临到这民。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>当那些日子，怀孕的和乳养孩子的有祸了！因为大灾难要临到这地，烈怒要临到这民。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>当那些日子，怀孕的和奶孩子的有祸了！因为将有大灾难降在这地方，也有震怒临到这百姓。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers! There will be great distress in the land and wrath against this people.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Alas for women who are pregnant and for those who are nursing infants in those days! For there will be great distress upon the earth and wrath against this people.
verses.textEnNkjv: But woe to those who are pregnant and to those who are nursing babies in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath upon this people.
verses.textEnNlt: How terrible it will be for pregnant women and for nursing mothers in those days. For there will be disaster in the land and great anger against this people.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to those women who are pregnant, and to those who are nursing babies in those days; for there will be great distress upon the land, and wrath to this people;
verses.textEn: <red>How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers! There will be great distress in the land and wrath against this people.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们将倒在刀下，被掳到各国，耶路撒冷必被外族人践踏，直到外族人的日期满足。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们将倒在刀下，被掳到各国，耶路撒冷必被外族人践踏，直到外族人的日期满足。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他们要倒在刀下，又被掳到各国去。耶路撒冷要被外邦人践踏，直到外邦人的日期满了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>They will fall by the sword and will be taken as prisoners to all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled on by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: They will fall by the edge of the sword and be led captive among all nations, and Jerusalem will be trampled underfoot by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they will fall by the edge of the sword, and be led away captive into all nations. And Jerusalem will be trampled by Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
verses.textEnNlt: They will be killed by the sword or sent away as captives to all the nations of the world. And Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the period of the Gentiles comes to an end.
verses.textEnNasb: and they will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations; and Jerusalem will be trampled underfoot by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
verses.textEn: <red>They will fall by the sword and will be taken as prisoners to all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled on by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"日月星辰将有异兆；在地上，各国也要因着海洋波涛的咆哮而困苦不安。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"日月星辰将有异兆；在地上，各国也要因着海洋波涛的咆哮而困苦不安。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「日、月、星辰要显出异兆，地上的邦国也有困苦；因海中波浪的响声，就慌慌不定。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Therep will be signs in the sun, moon and stars. On the earth, nations will be in anguish and perplexity at the roaring and tossing of the sea.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "And there will be signs in sun and moon and stars, and on the earth distress of nations in perplexity because of the roaring of the sea and the waves,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And there will be signs in the sun, in the moon, and in the stars; and on the earth distress of nations, with perplexity, the sea and the waves roaring;
verses.textEnNlt: "And there will be strange signs in the sun, moon, and stars. And here on earth the nations will be in turmoil, perplexed by the roaring seas and strange tides.
verses.textEnNasb: "There will be signs in the sun and moon and stars, and on the earth distress among nations, in perplexity at the roaring of the sea and the waves,
verses.textEn: <red>“Therep will be signs in the sun, moon and stars. On the earth, nations will be in anguish and perplexity at the roaring and tossing of the sea.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>天上的万象震动，人因为等待即将临到世界的事，都吓昏了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>天上的万象震动，人因为等待即将临到世界的事，都吓昏了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>天势都要震动，人想起那将要临到世界的事，就都吓得魂不附体。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>People will faint from terror, apprehensive of what is coming on the world, for the heavenly bodies will be shaken.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: people fainting with fear and with foreboding of what is coming on the world. For the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
verses.textEnNkjv: men’s hearts failing them from fear and the expectation of those things which are coming on the earth, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
verses.textEnNlt: People will be terrified at what they see coming upon the earth, for the powers in the heavens will be shaken.
verses.textEnNasb: people fainting from fear and the expectation of the things that are coming upon the world; for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
verses.textEn: <red>People will faint from terror, apprehensive of what is coming on the world, for the heavenly bodies will be shaken.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那时，他们要看见人子，带着能力，满有荣耀，驾着云降临。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那时，他们要看见人子，带着能力，满有荣耀，驾着云降临。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，他们要看见人子有能力，有大荣耀驾云降临。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.textEnNlt: Then everyone will see the Son of Man coming on a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.textEnNasb: And then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.textEn: <red>At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>一有这些事，你们就当挺身昂首，因为你们的救赎近了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>一有这些事，你们就当挺身昂首，因为你们的救赎近了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>一有这些事，你们就当挺身昂首，因为你们得赎的日子近了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>When these things begin to take place, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Now when these things begin to take place, straighten up and raise your heads, because your redemption is drawing near."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption draws near."
verses.textEnNlt: So when all these things begin to happen, stand and look up, for your salvation is near!"
verses.textEnNasb: But when these things begin to take place, straighten up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near."
verses.textEn: <red>When these things begin to take place, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又给他们讲了一个比喻："你们看看无花果树和各样的树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又给他们讲了一个比喻："你们看看无花果树和各样的树。
verses.textZhCuv: <red>这样，你们看见这些事渐渐地成就，也该晓得神的国近了。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He told them this parable: <red>“Look at the fig tree and all the trees.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he told them a parable: "Look at the fig tree, and all the trees.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He spoke to them a parable: "Look at the fig tree, and all the trees.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he gave them this illustration: "Notice the fig tree, or any other tree.
verses.textEnNasb: And He told them a parable: "Look at the fig tree and all the trees:
verses.textEn: He told them this parable: <red>“Look at the fig tree and all the trees.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>它们甚么时候发芽，你们看见了，就知道夏天近了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>它们甚么时候发芽，你们看见了，就知道夏天近了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我实在告诉你们，这世代还没有过去，这些事都要成就。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as they come out in leaf, you see for yourselves and know that the summer is already near.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they are already budding, you see and know for yourselves that summer is now near.
verses.textEnNlt: When the leaves come out, you know without being told that summer is near.
verses.textEnNasb: as soon as they put forth leaves, you see for yourselves and know that summer is now near.
verses.textEn: <red>When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>同样，你们甚么时候看见这些事发生，也应该知道神的国近了。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>同样，你们甚么时候看见这些事发生，也应该知道神的国近了。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>天地要废去，我的话却不能废去。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that the kingdom of God is near.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So also, when you see these things taking place, you know that the kingdom of God is near.
verses.textEnNkjv: So you also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, when you see all these things taking place, you can know that the Kingdom of God is near.
verses.textEnNasb: So you too, when you see these things happening, recognize that the kingdom of God is near.
verses.textEn: <red>Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that the kingdom of God is near.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我实在告诉你们，这一切都必定发生，然后这世代才会过去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我实在告诉你们，这一切都必定发生，然后这世代才会过去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>「你们要谨慎，恐怕因贪食、醉酒，并今生的思虑累住你们的心，那日子就如同网罗忽然临到你们；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Trulyp I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Truly, I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all has taken place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Assuredly, I say to you, this generation will by no means pass away till all things take place.
verses.textEnNlt: I tell you the truth, this generation will not pass from the scene until all these things have taken place.
verses.textEnNasb: Truly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all things take place.
verses.textEn: <red>“Trulyp I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>天地都过去，但我的话决不会废去。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>天地都过去，但我的话决不会废去。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为那日子要这样临到全地上一切居住的人。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will by no means pass away.
verses.textEnNlt: Heaven and earth will disappear, but my words will never disappear.
verses.textEnNasb: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will not pass away.
verses.textEn: <red>Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"你们应当自己小心，免得在贪食醉酒和生活的挂虑压住你们的心的时候，那日子突然临到你们，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"你们应当自己小心，免得在贪食醉酒和生活的挂虑压住你们的心的时候，那日子突然临到你们，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们要时时警醒，常常祈求，使你们能逃避这一切要来的事，得以站立在人子面前。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Bep careful, or your hearts will be weighed down with carousing, drunkenness and the anxieties of life, and that day will close on you suddenly like a trap.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "But watch yourselves lest your hearts be weighed down with dissipation and drunkenness and cares of this life, and that day come upon you suddenly like a trap.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But take heed to yourselves, lest your hearts be weighed down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that Day come on you unexpectedly.
verses.textEnNlt: "Watch out! Don’t let your hearts be dulled by carousing and drunkenness, and by the worries of this life. Don’t let that day catch you unaware,
verses.textEnNasb: "But be on your guard, so that your hearts will not be weighed down with dissipation and drunkenness and the worries of life, and that this day will not come on you suddenly, like a trap;
verses.textEn: <red>“Bep careful, or your hearts will be weighed down with carousing, drunkenness and the anxieties of life, and that day will close on you suddenly like a trap.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>正如网罗临到全地的所有居民。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>正如网罗临到全地的所有居民。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣每日在殿里教训人，每夜出城在一座山，名叫橄榄山住宿。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For it will come on all those who live on the face of the whole earth.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For it will come upon all who dwell on the face of the whole earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: For it will come as a snare on all those who dwell on the face of the whole earth.
verses.textEnNlt: like a trap. For that day will come upon everyone living on the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: for it will come upon all those who live on the face of all the earth.
verses.textEn: <red>For it will come on all those who live on the face of the whole earth.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们要时刻警醒，常常祈求，好让你们能逃避这一切要发生的事，可以站在人子面前。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们要时刻警醒，常常祈求，好让你们能逃避这一切要发生的事，可以站在人子面前。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>众百姓清早上圣殿，到耶稣那里，要听他讲道。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Be always on the watch, and pray that you may be able to escape all that is about to happen, and that you may be able to stand before the Son of Man.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But stay awake at all times, praying that you may have strength to escape all these things that are going to take place, and to stand before the Son of Man."
verses.textEnNkjv: Watch therefore, and pray always that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will come to pass, and to stand before the Son of Man."
verses.textEnNlt: Keep alert at all times. And pray that you might be strong enough to escape these coming horrors and stand before the Son of Man."
