verses.textEnNasb: But stay alert at all times, praying that you will have strength to escape all these things that are going to take place, and to stand before the Son of Man."
verses.textEn: <red>Be always on the watch, and pray that you may be able to escape all that is about to happen, and that you may be able to stand before the Son of Man.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣白天在殿里教导人，晚上就到橄榄山上去过夜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣白天在殿里教导人，晚上就到橄榄山上去过夜。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣白天在殿里教导人，晚上就到橄榄山上去过夜。
verses.textEnNiv: Each day Jesus was teaching at the temple, and each evening he went out to spend the night on the hill called the Mount of Olives,
verses.textEnEsv: And every day he was teaching in the temple, but at night he went out and lodged on the mount called Olivet.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in the daytime He was teaching in the temple, but at night He went out and stayed on the mountain called Olivet.
verses.textEnNlt: Every day Jesus went to the Temple to teach, and each evening he returned to spend the night on the Mount of Olives.
verses.textEnNasb: Now during the day He was teaching in the temple, but at evening He would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.
verses.textEn: Each day Jesus was teaching at the temple, and each evening he went out to spend the night on the hill called the Mount of Olives,

verses.textZh: 群众清早起来上圣殿，到他那里要听他讲道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众清早起来上圣殿，到他那里要听他讲道。
verses.textZhCuv: 群众清早起来上圣殿，到他那里要听他讲道。
verses.textEnNiv: and all the people came early in the morning to hear him at the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: And early in the morning all the people came to him in the temple to hear him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then early in the morning all the people came to Him in the temple to hear Him.
verses.textEnNlt: The crowds gathered at the Temple early each morning to hear him.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the people would get up very early in the morning to come to Him in the temple to listen to Him.
verses.textEn: and all the people came early in the morning to hear him at the temple.

verses.textZh: 除酵节又名逾越节近了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 除酵节又名逾越节近了。
verses.textZhCuv: 除酵节（又名逾越节）近了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Festival of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread drew near, which is called the Passover.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread drew near, which is called Passover.
verses.textEnNlt: The Festival of Unleavened Bread, which is also called Passover, was approaching.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.
verses.textEn: Now the Festival of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,

verses.textZh: 祭司长和经学家设法怎样杀害耶稣，因为他们惧怕群众。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司长和经学家设法怎样杀害耶稣，因为他们惧怕群众。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司长和文士想法子怎么才能杀害耶稣，是因他们惧怕百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: and the chief priests and the teachers of the law were looking for some way to get rid of Jesus, for they were afraid of the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And the chief priests and the scribes were seeking how to put him to death, for they feared the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might kill Him, for they feared the people.
verses.textEnNlt: The leading priests and teachers of religious law were plotting how to kill Jesus, but they were afraid of the people’s reaction.
verses.textEnNasb: And the chief priests and the scribes were trying to find a way to put Him to death, since they were afraid of the people.
verses.textEn: and the chief priests and the teachers of the law were looking for some way to get rid of Jesus, for they were afraid of the people.

verses.textZh: 那时，撒但已经进入加略人犹大的心，他原是十二门徒中的一个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，撒但已经进入加略人犹大的心，他原是十二门徒中的一个。
verses.textZhCuv: 这时，撒但入了那称为加略人犹大的心；他本是十二门徒里的一个。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Satan entered Judas, called Iscariot, one of the Twelve.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Satan entered into Judas called Iscariot, who was of the number of the twelve.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Satan entered Judas, surnamed Iscariot, who was numbered among the twelve.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Satan entered into Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve disciples,
verses.textEnNasb: And Satan entered Judas, the one called Iscariot, who belonged to the number of the twelve.
verses.textEn: Then Satan entered Judas, called Iscariot, one of the Twelve.

verses.textZh: 他去与祭司长和守殿官商量怎样把耶稣交给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他去与祭司长和守殿官商量怎样把耶稣交给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他去和祭司长并守殿官商量，怎么可以把耶稣交给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: And Judas went to the chief priests and the officers of the temple guard and discussed with them how he might betray Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: He went away and conferred with the chief priests and officers how he might betray him to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he went his way and conferred with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray Him to them.
verses.textEnNlt: and he went to the leading priests and captains of the Temple guard to discuss the best way to betray Jesus to them.
verses.textEnNasb: And he left and discussed with the chief priests and officers how he was to betray Him to them.
verses.textEn: And Judas went to the chief priests and the officers of the temple guard and discussed with them how he might betray Jesus.

verses.textZh: 他们很高兴，约定了给他银子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们很高兴，约定了给他银子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们欢喜，就约定给他银子。
verses.textEnNiv: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.
verses.textEnEsv: And they were glad, and agreed to give him money.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were glad, and agreed to give him money.
verses.textEnNlt: They were delighted, and they promised to give him money.
verses.textEnNasb: And they were delighted, and agreed to give him money.
verses.textEn: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.

verses.textZh: 他答应了，就寻找机会，要趁群众不在的时候，把耶稣交给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他答应了，就寻找机会，要趁群众不在的时候，把耶稣交给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他应允了，就找机会，要趁众人不在跟前的时候把耶稣交给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: He consented, and watched for an opportunity to hand Jesus over to them when no crowd was present.
verses.textEnEsv: So he consented and sought an opportunity to betray him to them in the absence of a crowd.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he promised and sought opportunity to betray Him to them in the absence of the multitude.
verses.textEnNlt: So he agreed and began looking for an opportunity to betray Jesus so they could arrest him when the crowds weren’t around.
verses.textEnNasb: And so he consented, and began looking for a good opportunity to betray Him to them away from the crowd.
verses.textEn: He consented, and watched for an opportunity to hand Jesus over to them when no crowd was present.

verses.textZh: 除酵日到了，在这一天应当宰杀逾越节的羊羔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 除酵日到了，在这一天应当宰杀逾越节的羊羔。
verses.textZhCuv: 除酵节，须宰逾越羊羔的那一天到了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed.
verses.textEnEsv: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread, on which the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then came the Day of Unleavened Bread, when the Passover must be killed.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the Festival of Unleavened Bread arrived, when the Passover lamb is sacrificed.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the first day of Unleavened Bread came, on which the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed.
verses.textEn: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed.

verses.textZh: 耶稣差派彼得和约翰，说："<red>你们去为我们预备逾越节的晚餐给我们吃。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣差派彼得和约翰，说："<red>你们去为我们预备逾越节的晚餐给我们吃。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣打发彼得、约翰，说：「<red>你们去为我们预备逾越节的筵席，好叫我们吃。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, <red>“Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat it."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat."
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus sent Peter and John ahead and said, "Go and prepare the Passover meal, so we can eat it together."
verses.textEnNasb: And so Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and prepare the Passover for us, so that we may eat it."
verses.textEn: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, <red>“Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们说："你要我们在哪里预备呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："你要我们在哪里预备呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们问他说：「要我们在哪里预备？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Where do you want us to prepare for it?" they asked.
verses.textEnEsv: They said to him, "Where will you have us prepare it?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said to Him, "Where do You want us to prepare?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Where do you want us to prepare it?" they asked him.
verses.textEnNasb: They said to Him, "Where do You want us to prepare it?"
verses.textEn: "Where do you want us to prepare for it?" they asked.

verses.textZh: 他说："<red>你们进了城，必有一个人顶着水罐，迎面而来，你们就跟着他，到他所进的那一家，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："<red>你们进了城，必有一个人顶着水罐，迎面而来，你们就跟着他，到他所进的那一家，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「你们进了城，必有人拿着一瓶水迎面而来，你们就跟着他，到他所进的房子里去，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, <red>“As you enter the city, a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him to the house that he enters,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "Behold, when you have entered the city, a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him into the house that he enters
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Behold, when you have entered the city, a man will meet you carrying a pitcher of water; follow him into the house which he enters.
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "As soon as you enter Jerusalem, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him. At the house he enters,
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "When you have entered the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you; follow him into the house that he enters.
verses.textEn: He replied, <red>“As you enter the city, a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him to the house that he enters,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>对家主说，老师问你：‘客厅在哪里？我和门徒好在那里吃逾越节的晚餐。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>对家主说，老师问你：‘客厅在哪里？我和门徒好在那里吃逾越节的晚餐。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>对那家的主人说：『夫子说：客房在哪里？我与门徒好在那里吃逾越节的筵席。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and say to the owner of the house, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall say to the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, "Where is the guest room where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?" ’
verses.textEnNlt: say to the owner, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room where I can eat the Passover meal with my disciples?’
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall say to the owner of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, "Where is the guest room in which I may eat the Passover with My disciples?" ’
verses.textEn: <red>and say to the owner of the house, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他必指示你们楼上一间布置整齐的大房子，你们就在那里预备。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他必指示你们楼上一间布置整齐的大房子，你们就在那里预备。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>他必指给你们摆设整齐的一间大楼，你们就在那里预备。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>He will show you a large room upstairs, all furnished. Make preparations there.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he will show you a large upper room furnished; prepare it there."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he will show you a large, furnished upper room; there make ready."
verses.textEnNlt: He will take you upstairs to a large room that is already set up. That is where you should prepare our meal."
verses.textEnNasb: And he will show you a large, furnished upstairs room; prepare it there."
verses.textEn: <red>He will show you a large room upstairs, all furnished. Make preparations there.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们去了，所遇见的正像耶稣所说的一样，就预备好了逾越节的晚餐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们去了，所遇见的正像耶稣所说的一样，就预备好了逾越节的晚餐。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们去了，所遇见的正如耶稣所说的；他们就预备了逾越节的筵席。
verses.textEnNiv: They left and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.
verses.textEnEsv: And they went and found it just as he had told them, and they prepared the Passover.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went and found it just as He had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.
verses.textEnNlt: They went off to the city and found everything just as Jesus had said, and they prepared the Passover meal there.
verses.textEnNasb: And they left and found everything just as He had told them; and they prepared the Passover.
verses.textEn: They left and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.

verses.textZh: 到了时候，耶稣和使徒一同吃饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了时候，耶稣和使徒一同吃饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 时候到了，耶稣坐席，使徒也和他同坐。
verses.textEnNiv: When the hour came, Jesus and his apostles reclined at the table.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the hour came, he reclined at table, and the apostles with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the hour had come, He sat down, and the twelve apostles with Him.
verses.textEnNlt: When the time came, Jesus and the apostles sat down together at the table.
verses.textEnNasb: When the hour came, He reclined at the table, and the apostles with Him.
verses.textEn: When the hour came, Jesus and his apostles reclined at the table.

verses.textZh: 他说："<red>我十分愿意在受难以前，跟你们吃这逾越节的晚餐。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："<red>我十分愿意在受难以前，跟你们吃这逾越节的晚餐。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「我很愿意在受害以先和你们吃这逾越节的筵席。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: And he said to them, <red>“I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to them, "With fervent desire I have desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer;
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said, "I have been very eager to eat this Passover meal with you before my suffering begins.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer;
verses.textEn: And he said to them, <red>“I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，我决不再吃这晚餐，直到它成就在神的国里。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，我决不再吃这晚餐，直到它成就在神的国里。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我告诉你们，我不再吃这筵席，直到成就在神的国里。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For I tell you, I will not eat it again until it finds fulfillment in the kingdom of God.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For I tell you I will not eat it until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: for I say to you, I will no longer eat of it until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNlt: For I tell you now that I won’t eat this meal again until its meaning is fulfilled in the Kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNasb: for I say to you, I shall not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God."
verses.textEn: <red>For I tell you, I will not eat it again until it finds fulfillment in the kingdom of God.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣接过杯来，感谢了，说："<red>你们拿这个，大家分着喝。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣接过杯来，感谢了，说："<red>你们拿这个，大家分着喝。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣接过杯来，祝谢了，说：「你们拿这个，大家分着喝。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: After taking the cup, he gave thanks and said, <red>“Take this and divide it among you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he took a cup, and when he had given thanks he said, "Take this, and divide it among yourselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, "Take this and divide it among yourselves;
verses.textEnNlt: Then he took a cup of wine and gave thanks to God for it. Then he said, "Take this and share it among yourselves.
verses.textEnNasb: And when He had taken a cup and given thanks, He said, "Take this and share it among yourselves;
verses.textEn: After taking the cup, he gave thanks and said, <red>“Take this and divide it among you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，从今以后，我决不再喝这葡萄酒，直到神的国来临。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，从今以后，我决不再喝这葡萄酒，直到神的国来临。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我告诉你们，从今以后，我不再喝这葡萄汁，直等神的国来到。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For I tell you I will not drink again from the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For I tell you that from now on I will not drink of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes."
verses.textEnNkjv: for I say to you,I will not drink of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes."
verses.textEnNlt: For I will not drink wine again until the Kingdom of God has come."
verses.textEnNasb: for I say to you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine from now on until the kingdom of God comes."
verses.textEn: <red>For I tell you I will not drink again from the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他拿起饼来，感谢了，擘开递给他们，说："<red>这是我的身体，为你们舍的，你们应当这样行，为的是记念我。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他拿起饼来，感谢了，擘开递给他们，说："<red>这是我的身体，为你们舍的，你们应当这样行，为的是记念我。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 又拿起饼来，祝谢了，就擘开，递给他们，说：「<red>这是我的身体，为你们舍的，你们也应当如此行，为的是记念我。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: And he took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, <red>“This is my body given for you; do this in remembrance of me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to them, saying, "This is my body, which is given for you. Do this in remembrance of me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, "This is My body which is given for you; do this in remembrance of Me."
verses.textEnNlt: He took some bread and gave thanks to God for it. Then he broke it in pieces and gave it to the disciples, saying, "This is my body, which is given for you. Do this in remembrance of me."
verses.textEnNasb: And when He had taken some bread and given thanks, He broke it and gave it to them, saying, "This is My body, which is being given for you; do this in remembrance of Me."
verses.textEn: And he took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, <red>“This is my body given for you; do this in remembrance of me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 饭后，他照样拿起杯来，说："<red>这杯是用我的血所立的新约，这血是为你们流的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 饭后，他照样拿起杯来，说："<red>这杯是用我的血所立的新约，这血是为你们流的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>饭后也照样拿起杯来，说：「这杯是用我血所立的新约，是为你们流出来的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way, after the supper he took the cup, saying, <red>“This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And likewise the cup after they had eaten, saying, "This cup that is poured out for you is the new covenant in my blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise He also took the cup after supper, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is shed for you.
verses.textEnNlt: After supper he took another cup of wine and said, "This cup is the new covenant between God and his people—an agreement confirmed with my blood, which is poured out as a sacrifice for you.
verses.textEnNasb: And in the same way He took the cup after they had eaten, saying, "This cup, which is poured out for you, is the new covenant in My blood.
verses.textEn: In the same way, after the supper he took the cup, saying, <red>“This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你看，出卖我的人的手和我一同在桌子上，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你看，出卖我的人的手和我一同在桌子上，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>看哪，那卖我之人的手与我一同在桌子上。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But the hand of him who is going to betray me is with mine on the table.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.
verses.textEnNkjv: But behold, the hand of My betrayer is with Me on the table.
verses.textEnNlt: "But here at this table, sitting among us as a friend, is the man who will betray me.
verses.textEnNasb: But behold, the hand of the one betraying Me is with Mine on the table.
verses.textEn: <red>But the hand of him who is going to betray me is with mine on the table.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人子固然要照所预定的离世，但出卖人子的那人有祸了！"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人子固然要照所预定的离世，但出卖人子的那人有祸了！"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>人子固然要照所预定的去世，但卖人子的人有祸了！」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>The Son of Man will go as it has been decreed. But woe to that man who betrays him!”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For the Son of Man goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man by whom he is betrayed!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And truly the Son of Man goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed!"
verses.textEnNlt: For it has been determined that the Son of Man must die. But what sorrow awaits the one who betrays him."
verses.textEnNasb: For indeed, the Son of Man is going as it has been determined; but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed!"
verses.textEn: <red>The Son of Man will go as it has been decreed. But woe to that man who betrays him!”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是，门徒彼此对问，他们中间谁要作这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，门徒彼此对问，他们中间谁要作这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就彼此对问，是哪一个要做这事。
verses.textEnNiv: They began to question among themselves which of them it might be who would do this.
verses.textEnEsv: And they began to question one another, which of them it could be who was going to do this.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they began to question among themselves, which of them it was who would do this thing.
verses.textEnNlt: The disciples began to ask each other which of them would ever do such a thing.
verses.textEnNasb: And they began to debate among themselves which one of them it was who was going to do this.
verses.textEn: They began to question among themselves which of them it might be who would do this.

verses.textZh: 门徒中间又起了争论：他们中间谁是最大的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒中间又起了争论：他们中间谁是最大的。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒起了争论，他们中间哪一个可算为大。
verses.textEnNiv: A dispute also arose among them as to which of them was considered to be greatest.
verses.textEnEsv: A dispute also arose among them, as to which of them was to be regarded as the greatest.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was also a dispute among them, as to which of them should be considered the greatest.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they began to argue among themselves about who would be the greatest among them.
verses.textEnNasb: And a dispute also developed among them as to which one of them was regarded as being the greatest.
verses.textEn: A dispute also arose among them as to which of them was considered to be greatest.

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他们说："<red>各国都有君王统治他们，他们的掌权者称为恩主，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他们说："<red>各国都有君王统治他们，他们的掌权者称为恩主，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「外邦人有君王为主治理他们，那掌权管他们的称为恩主。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said to them, <red>“The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them; and those who exercise authority over them call themselves Benefactors.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them, and those in authority over them are called benefactors.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them, and those who exercise authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus told them, "In this world the kings and great men lord it over their people, yet they are called ‘friends of the people.’
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "The kings of the Gentiles domineer over them; and those who have authority over them are called ‘Benefactors.’
verses.textEn: Jesus said to them, <red>“The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them; and those who exercise authority over them call themselves Benefactors.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但你们却不要这样；你们中间最大的，应当像最小的；作首领的，应当像服事人的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但你们却不要这样；你们中间最大的，应当像最小的；作首领的，应当像服事人的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但你们不可这样；你们里头为大的，倒要像年幼的，为首领的，倒要像服事人的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But you are not to be like that. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who rules like the one who serves.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But not so with you. Rather, let the greatest among you become as the youngest, and the leader as one who serves.
verses.textEnNkjv: But not so among you; on the contrary, he who is greatest among you, let him be as the younger, and he who governs as he who serves.
verses.textEnNlt: But among you it will be different. Those who are the greatest among you should take the lowest rank, and the leader should be like a servant.
verses.textEnNasb: But it is not this way for you; rather, the one who is the greatest among you must become like the youngest, and the leader like the servant.
verses.textEn: <red>But you are not to be like that. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who rules like the one who serves.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>哪一个大呢？是坐着吃喝的还是服事人的呢？不是坐着吃喝的吗？然而我在你们中间，如同服事人的。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>哪一个大呢？是坐着吃喝的还是服事人的呢？不是坐着吃喝的吗？然而我在你们中间，如同服事人的。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>是谁为大？是坐席的呢？是服事人的呢？不是坐席的大吗？然而，我在你们中间如同服事人的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For who is greater, the one who is at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who is at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For who is the greater, one who reclines at table or one who serves? Is it not the one who reclines at table? But I am among you as the one who serves.
verses.textEnNkjv: For who is greater, he who sits at the table, or he who serves? Is it not he who sits at the table? Yet I am among you as the One who serves.
verses.textEnNlt: Who is more important, the one who sits at the table or the one who serves? The one who sits at the table, of course. But not here! For I am among you as one who serves.
verses.textEnNasb: For who is greater, the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who reclines at the table? But I am among you as the one who serves.
verses.textEn: <red>For who is greater, the one who is at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who is at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我在磨炼之中，常常和我同在的就是你们。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我在磨炼之中，常常和我同在的就是你们。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我在磨炼之中，常和我同在的就是你们。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You are those who have stood by me in my trials.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "You are those who have stayed with me in my trials,
verses.textEnNkjv: "But you are those who have continued with Me in My trials.
verses.textEnNlt: "You have stayed with me in my time of trial.
verses.textEnNasb: "You are the ones who have stood by Me in My trials;
verses.textEn: <red>You are those who have stood by me in my trials.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>父怎样把王权赐给我，我也照样赐给你们，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>父怎样把王权赐给我，我也照样赐给你们，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我将国赐给你们，正如我父赐给我一样，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>And I confer on you a kingdom, just as my Father conferred one on me,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and I assign to you, as my Father assigned to me, a kingdom,
verses.textEnNkjv: And I bestow upon you a kingdom, just as My Father bestowed one upon Me,
verses.textEnNlt: And just as my Father has granted me a Kingdom, I now grant you the right
verses.textEnNasb: and just as My Father has granted Me a kingdom, I grant you
verses.textEn: <red>And I confer on you a kingdom, just as my Father conferred one on me,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>叫你们在我的国里坐在我的席上吃喝，又坐在宝座上审判以色列的十二支派。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>叫你们在我的国里坐在我的席上吃喝，又坐在宝座上审判以色列的十二支派。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>叫你们在我国里，坐在我的席上吃喝，并且坐在宝座上，审判以色列十二个支派。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>so that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: to eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. And you will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom, and you will sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.textEn: <red>so that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>"西门，西门，撒但设法要得着你们，好筛你们像筛麦子一样；</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"西门，西门，撒但设法要得着你们，好筛你们像筛麦子一样；</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主又说：「西门！西门！撒但想要得着你们，好筛你们像筛麦子一样；</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Simon,p Simon, Satan has asked to sift all of you as wheat.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "Simon, Simon, behold, Satan demanded to have you, that he might sift you like wheat,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said, "Simon, Simon! Indeed, Satan has asked for you, that he may sift you as wheat.
verses.textEnNlt: "Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift each of you like wheat.
verses.textEnNasb: "Simon, Simon, behold, Satan has demanded to sift you men like wheat;
verses.textEn: <red>“Simon,p Simon, Satan has asked to sift all of you as wheat.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>但我已经为你祈求，叫你的信心不至失掉。你回头的时候，要坚固你的弟兄。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>但我已经为你祈求，叫你的信心不至失掉。你回头的时候，要坚固你的弟兄。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但我已经为你祈求，叫你不至于失了信心。你回头以后，要坚固你的弟兄。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith may not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but I have prayed for you that your faith may not fail. And when you have turned again, strengthen your brothers."
verses.textEnNkjv: But I have prayed for you, that your faith should not fail; and when you have returned to Me, strengthen your brethren."
verses.textEnNlt: But I have pleaded in prayer for you, Simon, that your faith should not fail. So when you have repented and turned to me again, strengthen your brothers."
verses.textEnNasb: but I have prayed for you, that your faith will not fail; and you, when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers."
verses.textEn: <red>But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith may not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.”</red>

verses.textZh: 彼得说："主啊！我已经准备好要跟你一同下监，一同死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得说："主啊！我已经准备好要跟你一同下监，一同死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得说：「主啊，我就是同你下监，同你受死，也是甘心！」
verses.textEnNiv: But he replied, "Lord, I am ready to go with you to prison and to death."
verses.textEnEsv: Peter said to him, "Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death."
verses.textEnNkjv: But he said to Him, "Lord, I am ready to go with You, both to prison and to death."
verses.textEnNlt: Peter said, "Lord, I am ready to go to prison with you, and even to die with you."
verses.textEnNasb: But he said to Him, "Lord, I am ready to go with You both to prison and to death!"
verses.textEn: But he replied, "Lord, I am ready to go with you to prison and to death."

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>彼得，我告诉你，今天鸡叫以前，你会三次说不认得我。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>彼得，我告诉你，今天鸡叫以前，你会三次说不认得我。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>彼得，我告诉你，今日鸡还没有叫，你要三次说不认得我。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered, <red>“I tell you, Peter, before the rooster crows today, you will deny three times that you know me.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Jesus said, "I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow this day, until you deny three times that you know me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said, "I tell you, Peter, the rooster shall not crow this day before you will deny three times that you know Me."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus said, "Peter, let me tell you something. Before the rooster crows tomorrow morning, you will deny three times that you even know me."
verses.textEnNasb: But He said, "I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow today until you have denied three times that you know Me."
verses.textEn: Jesus answered, <red>“I tell you, Peter, before the rooster crows today, you will deny three times that you know me.”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣又对他们说："<red>从前我差你们出去，没有带钱囊、口袋、鞋子，你们缺乏甚么没有？</red>"他们说："<red>没有。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣又对他们说："<red>从前我差你们出去，没有带钱囊、口袋、鞋子，你们缺乏甚么没有？</red>"他们说："<red>没有。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣又对他们说：「<red>我差你们出去的时候，没有钱囊，没有口袋，没有鞋，你们缺少什么没有？</red>」他们说：「<red>没有。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus asked them, <red>“When I sent you without purse, bag or sandals, did you lack anything?”</red> “Nothing,” they answered.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "When I sent you out with no moneybag or knapsack or sandals, did you lack anything?" They said, "Nothing."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "When I sent you without money bag, knapsack, and sandals, did you lack anything?" So they said, "Nothing."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus asked them, "When I sent you out to preach the Good News and you did not have money, a traveler’s bag, or an extra pair of sandals, did you need anything?" "No," they replied.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "When I sent you out without money belt and bag and sandals, you did not lack anything, did you?" They said, "No, nothing."
verses.textEn: Then Jesus asked them, <red>“When I sent you without purse, bag or sandals, did you lack anything?”</red> “Nothing,” they answered.

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>但现在，有钱囊的应当带着，有口袋的也是这样；没有刀的，要卖掉衣服去买刀。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>但现在，有钱囊的应当带着，有口袋的也是这样；没有刀的，要卖掉衣服去买刀。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「但如今有钱囊的可以带着，有口袋的也可以带着，没有刀的要卖衣服买刀。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, <red>“But now if you have a purse, take it, and also a bag; and if you don’t have a sword, sell your cloak and buy one.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "But now let the one who has a moneybag take it, and likewise a knapsack. And let the one who has no sword sell his cloak and buy one.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to them, "But now, he who has a money bag, let him take it, and likewise a knapsack; and he who has no sword, let him sell his garment and buy one.
verses.textEnNlt: "But now," he said, "take your money and a traveler’s bag. And if you don’t have a sword, sell your cloak and buy one!
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "But now, whoever has a money belt is to take it along, likewise also a bag, and whoever has no sword is to sell his cloak and buy one.
verses.textEn: He said to them, <red>“But now if you have a purse, take it, and also a bag; and if you don’t have a sword, sell your cloak and buy one.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我告诉你们，‘他被列在不法者之中’这句经文，必定应验在我身上，因为关于我的事必然成就。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我告诉你们，‘他被列在不法者之中’这句经文，必定应验在我身上，因为关于我的事必然成就。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我告诉你们，经上写着说：『他被列在罪犯之中。』这话必应验在我身上，因为那关系我的事必然成就。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>It is written: ‘And he was numbered with the transgressors’; and I tell you that this must be fulfilled in me. Yes, what is written about me is reaching its fulfillment.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For I tell you that this Scripture must be fulfilled in me: ‘And he was numbered with the transgressors.’ For what is written about me has its fulfillment."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I say to you that this which is written must still be accomplished in Me: ‘And He was numbered with the transgressors.’ For the things concerning Me have an end."
verses.textEnNlt: For the time has come for this prophecy about me to be fulfilled: ‘He was counted among the rebels.’ Yes, everything written about me by the prophets will come true."
verses.textEnNasb: For I tell you that this which is written must be fulfilled in Me: ‘And He was counted with wrongdoers’; for that which refers to Me has its fulfillment."
verses.textEn: <red>It is written: ‘And he was numbered with the transgressors’; and I tell you that this must be fulfilled in me. Yes, what is written about me is reaching its fulfillment.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们说："<red>主啊，请看，这里有两把刀。</red>"耶稣说："<red>够了。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："<red>主啊，请看，这里有两把刀。</red>"耶稣说："<red>够了。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「<red>主啊，请看！这里有两把刀。</red>」耶稣说：「<red>够了。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: The disciples said, “See, Lord, here are two swords.” <red>“That’sp enough!”</red> he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And they said, "Look, Lord, here are two swords." And he said to them, "It is enough."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said, "Lord, look, here are two swords." And He said to them, "It is enough."
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, Lord," they replied, "we have two swords among us." "That’s enough," he said.
verses.textEnNasb: They said, "Lord, look, here are two swords." And He said to them, "It is enough."
verses.textEn: The disciples said, “See, Lord, here are two swords.” <red>“That’sp enough!”</red> he replied.

verses.textZh: 耶稣照常到橄榄山去，门徒也跟着他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣照常到橄榄山去，门徒也跟着他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣出来，照常往橄榄山去，门徒也跟随他。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and his disciples followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he came out and went, as was his custom, to the Mount of Olives, and the disciples followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Coming out, He went to the Mount of Olives, as He was accustomed, and His disciples also followed Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, accompanied by the disciples, Jesus left the upstairs room and went as usual to the Mount of Olives.
verses.textEnNasb: And He came out and went, as was His habit, to the Mount of Olives; and the disciples also followed Him.
verses.textEn: Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and his disciples followed him.

verses.textZh: 到了那里，他对门徒说："<red>你们应当祷告，免得陷入试探。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了那里，他对门徒说："<red>你们应当祷告，免得陷入试探。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 到了那地方，就对他们说：「<red>你们要祷告，免得入了迷惑。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: On reaching the place, he said to them, <red>“Pray that you will not fall into temptation.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And when he came to the place, he said to them, "Pray that you may not enter into temptation."
verses.textEnNkjv: When He came to the place, He said to them, "Pray that you may not enter into temptation."
verses.textEnNlt: There he told them, "Pray that you will not give in to temptation."
verses.textEnNasb: Now when He arrived at the place, He said to them, "Pray that you do not come into temptation."
verses.textEn: On reaching the place, he said to them, <red>“Pray that you will not fall into temptation.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是耶稣离开他们约有扔一块石头那么远，跪下祷告说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶稣离开他们约有扔一块石头那么远，跪下祷告说：
verses.textZhCuv: 于是离开他们约有扔一块石头那么远，跪下祷告，
verses.textEnNiv: He withdrew about a stone’s throw beyond them, knelt down and prayed,
verses.textEnEsv: And he withdrew from them about a stone’s throw, and knelt down and prayed,
verses.textEnNkjv: And He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and He knelt down and prayed,
verses.textEnNlt: He walked away, about a stone’s throw, and knelt down and prayed,
verses.textEnNasb: And He withdrew from them about a stone’s throw, and He knelt down and began to pray,
verses.textEn: He withdrew about a stone’s throw beyond them, knelt down and prayed,

verses.textZh: <red>"父啊，如果你愿意，就把这杯拿走！但不要成就我的意思，只要成就你的旨意。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>"父啊，如果你愿意，就把这杯拿走！但不要成就我的意思，只要成就你的旨意。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「<red>父啊！你若愿意，就把这杯撤去；然而，不要成就我的意思，只要成就你的意思。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Father, if you are willing, take this cup from me; yet not my will, but yours be done.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "Father, if it is Your will, take this cup away from Me; nevertheless not My will, but Yours, be done."
verses.textEnNlt: "Father, if you are willing, please take this cup of suffering away from me. Yet I want your will to be done, not mine."
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "Father, if You are willing, remove this cup from Me; yet not My will, but Yours be done."
verses.textEn: <red>“Father, if you are willing, take this cup from me; yet not my will, but yours be done.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他祷告完了，就起来到门徒那里，看见他们因为忧愁都睡着了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他祷告完了，就起来到门徒那里，看见他们因为忧愁都睡着了，
verses.textZhCuv: 有一位天使从天上显现，加添他的力量。
verses.textEnNiv: An angel from heaven appeared to him and strengthened him.
verses.textEnEsv: And there appeared to him an angel from heaven, strengthening him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then an angel appeared to Him from heaven, strengthening Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then an angel from heaven appeared and strengthened him.
verses.textEnNasb: [ Now an angel from heaven appeared to Him, strengthening Him.
verses.textEn: An angel from heaven appeared to him and strengthened him.

verses.textZh: 就说："你们为甚么睡觉呢？起来祷告！免得陷入试探。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就说："你们为甚么睡觉呢？起来祷告！免得陷入试探。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣极其伤痛，祷告更加恳切，汗珠如大血点滴在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: And being in anguish, he prayed more earnestly, and his sweat was like drops of blood falling to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: And being in agony he prayed more earnestly; and his sweat became like great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: And being in agony, He prayed more earnestly. Then His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: He prayed more fervently, and he was in such agony of spirit that his sweat fell to the ground like great drops of blood.
verses.textEnNasb: And being in agony, He was praying very fervently; and His sweat became like drops of blood, falling down upon the ground].
verses.textEn: And being in anguish, he prayed more earnestly, and his sweat was like drops of blood falling to the ground.

verses.textZh: 耶稣还在说话的时候，来了一群人，十二门徒中的犹大走在前头，到了耶稣跟前要用嘴亲他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣还在说话的时候，来了一群人，十二门徒中的犹大走在前头，到了耶稣跟前要用嘴亲他。
verses.textZhCuv: 祷告完了，就起来，到门徒那里，见他们因为忧愁都睡着了，
verses.textEnNiv: When he rose from prayer and went back to the disciples, he found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he rose from prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping for sorrow,
verses.textEnNkjv: When He rose up from prayer, and had come to His disciples, He found them sleeping from sorrow.
verses.textEnNlt: At last he stood up again and returned to the disciples, only to find them asleep, exhausted from grief.
verses.textEnNasb: When He rose from prayer, He came to the disciples and found them sleeping from sorrow,
verses.textEn: When he rose from prayer and went back to the disciples, he found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.

verses.textZh: <red>耶稣对他说："犹大，你用亲吻作暗号出卖人子吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>耶稣对他说："犹大，你用亲吻作暗号出卖人子吗？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 就对他们说：「<red>你们为什么睡觉呢？起来祷告，免得入了迷惑！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Why are you sleeping?”</red> he asked them. <red>“Get up and pray so that you will not fall into temptation.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and he said to them, "Why are you sleeping? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to them, "Why do you sleep? Rise and pray, lest you enter into temptation."
verses.textEnNlt: "Why are you sleeping?" he asked them. "Get up and pray, so that you will not give in to temptation."
verses.textEnNasb: and He said to them, "Why are you sleeping? Get up and pray that you do not come into temptation."
verses.textEn: <red>“Why are you sleeping?”</red> he asked them. <red>“Get up and pray so that you will not fall into temptation.”</red>

verses.textZh: 左右的人见了，就说："主啊，我们用刀砍好吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 左右的人见了，就说："主啊，我们用刀砍好吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 说话之间，来了许多人。那十二个门徒里名叫犹大的，走在前头，就近耶稣，要与他亲嘴。
verses.textEnNiv: While he was still speaking a crowd came up, and the man who was called Judas, one of the Twelve, was leading them. He approached Jesus to kiss him,
verses.textEnEsv: While he was still speaking, there came a crowd, and the man called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He drew near to Jesus to kiss him,
verses.textEnNkjv: And while He was still speaking, behold, a multitude; and he who was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them and drew near to Jesus to kiss Him.
verses.textEnNlt: But even as Jesus said this, a crowd approached, led by Judas, one of the twelve disciples. Judas walked over to Jesus to greet him with a kiss.
verses.textEnNasb: While He was still speaking, behold, a crowd came, and the one called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading the way for them; and he approached Jesus to kiss Him.
verses.textEn: While he was still speaking a crowd came up, and the man who was called Judas, one of the Twelve, was leading them. He approached Jesus to kiss him,

verses.textZh: <red>他们中间有一个人砍了大祭司的仆人一刀，削掉他的右耳。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们中间有一个人砍了大祭司的仆人一刀，削掉他的右耳。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他说：「<red>犹大！你用亲嘴的暗号卖人子吗？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: but Jesus asked him, <red>“Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: but Jesus said to him, "Judas, would you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus said to him, "Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus said, "Judas, would you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?"
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus said to him, "Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?"
verses.textEn: but Jesus asked him, <red>“Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”</red>

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："由他们吧！"就摸那人的耳朵，医好了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："由他们吧！"就摸那人的耳朵，医好了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 左右的人见光景不好，就说：「主啊！我们拿刀砍可以不可以？」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jesus’ followers saw what was going to happen, they said, "Lord, should we strike with our swords?"
verses.textEnEsv: And when those who were around him saw what would follow, they said, "Lord, shall we strike with the sword?"
verses.textEnNkjv: When those around Him saw what was going to happen, they said to Him, "Lord, shall we strike with the sword?"
verses.textEnNlt: When the other disciples saw what was about to happen, they exclaimed, "Lord, should we fight? We brought the swords!"
verses.textEnNasb: When those who were around Him saw what was going to happen, they said, "Lord, shall we strike with the sword?"
verses.textEn: When Jesus’ followers saw what was going to happen, they said, "Lord, should we strike with our swords?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣对那些前来捉拿他的祭司长、守殿官和长老说："你们带着刀棒出来，把我当作强盗捉拿吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对那些前来捉拿他的祭司长、守殿官和长老说："你们带着刀棒出来，把我当作强盗捉拿吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 内中有一个人把大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉了他的右耳。
verses.textEnNiv: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
verses.textEnEsv: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his right ear.
verses.textEnNkjv: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his right ear.
verses.textEnNlt: And one of them struck at the high priest’s slave, slashing off his right ear.
verses.textEnNasb: And one of them struck the slave of the high priest and cut off his right ear.
verses.textEn: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.

verses.textZh: 我天天跟你们在殿里，你们不向我下手；但现在是你们的时候了，也是黑暗掌权的时候了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我天天跟你们在殿里，你们不向我下手；但现在是你们的时候了，也是黑暗掌权的时候了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣说：「<red>到了这个地步，由他们吧！</red>」就摸那人的耳朵，把他治好了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jesus answered, <red>“No more of this!”</red> And he touched the man’s ear and healed him.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jesus said, "No more of this!" And he touched his ear and healed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus answered and said, "Permit even this." And He touched his ear and healed him.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus said, "No more of this." And he touched the man’s ear and healed him.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus responded and said, " Stop! No more of this." And He touched his ear and healed him.
verses.textEn: But Jesus answered, <red>“No more of this!”</red> And he touched the man’s ear and healed him.

verses.textZh: <red>他们拿住耶稣，押到大祭司家里，彼得远远地跟着。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们拿住耶稣，押到大祭司家里，彼得远远地跟着。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对那些来拿他的祭司长和守殿官并长老说：「你们带着刀棒出来拿我，如同拿强盗吗？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, the officers of the temple guard, and the elders, who had come for him, <red>“Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come with swords and clubs?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus said to the chief priests and officers of the temple and elders, who had come out against him, "Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and the elders who had come to Him, "Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs?
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus spoke to the leading priests, the captains of the Temple guard, and the elders who had come for him. "Am I some dangerous revolutionary," he asked, "that you come with swords and clubs to arrest me?
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus said to the chief priests and officers of the temple and elders who had come against Him, "Have you come out with swords and clubs as you would against a man inciting a revolt?
verses.textEn: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, the officers of the temple guard, and the elders, who had come for him, <red>“Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come with swords and clubs?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们在院内生了火，一同坐着，彼得也坐在他们中间。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们在院内生了火，一同坐着，彼得也坐在他们中间。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我天天同你们在殿里，你们不下手拿我。现在却是你们的时候，黑暗掌权了。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on me. But this is your hour—when darkness reigns.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: When I was with you day after day in the temple, you did not lay hands on me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness."
verses.textEnNkjv: When I was with you daily in the temple, you did not try to seize Me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness."
verses.textEnNlt: Why didn’t you arrest me in the Temple? I was there every day. But this is your moment, the time when the power of darkness reigns."
verses.textEnNasb: While I was with you daily in the temple, you did not lay hands on Me; but this hour and the power of darkness are yours."
verses.textEn: <red>Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on me. But this is your hour—when darkness reigns.”</red>

verses.textZh: 有一个使女，见他面向火光坐着，就注视他，说："这人是和他一伙的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个使女，见他面向火光坐着，就注视他，说："这人是和他一伙的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们拿住耶稣，把他带到大祭司的宅里。彼得远远地跟着。
verses.textEnNiv: Then seizing him, they led him away and took him into the house of the high priest. Peter followed at a distance.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they seized him and led him away, bringing him into the high priest’s house, and Peter was following at a distance.
verses.textEnNkjv: Having arrested Him, they led Him and brought Him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed at a distance.
verses.textEnNlt: So they arrested him and led him to the high priest’s home. And Peter followed at a distance.
verses.textEnNasb: Now they arrested Him and led Him away, and brought Him to the house of the high priest; but Peter was following at a distance.
verses.textEn: Then seizing him, they led him away and took him into the house of the high priest. Peter followed at a distance.

verses.textZh: 彼得却否认，说："你这个女人，我不认得他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得却否认，说："你这个女人，我不认得他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在院子里生了火，一同坐着；彼得也坐在他们中间。
verses.textEnNiv: And when some there had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat down with them.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat down among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat among them.
verses.textEnNlt: The guards lit a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat around it, and Peter joined them there.
verses.textEnNasb: After they kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter was sitting among them.
verses.textEn: And when some there had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat down with them.

verses.textZh: 不久，另一个人看见他，就说："你也是他们中间的一个。"彼得说："你这个人，我不是。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不久，另一个人看见他，就说："你也是他们中间的一个。"彼得说："你这个人，我不是。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个使女看见彼得坐在火光里，就定睛看他，说：「这个人素来也是同那人一伙的。」
verses.textEnNiv: A servant girl saw him seated there in the firelight. She looked closely at him and said, "This man was with him."
verses.textEnEsv: Then a servant girl, seeing him as he sat in the light and looking closely at him, said, "This man also was with him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And a certain servant girl, seeing him as he sat by the fire, looked intently at him and said, "This man was also with Him."
verses.textEnNlt: A servant girl noticed him in the firelight and began staring at him. Finally she said, "This man was one of Jesus’ followers!"
verses.textEnNasb: And a slave woman, seeing him as he sat in the firelight, and staring at him, said, "This man was with Him as well."
verses.textEn: A servant girl saw him seated there in the firelight. She looked closely at him and said, "This man was with him."

verses.textZh: 大约过了一小时，又有一个人肯定地说："这人真是和他一伙的，因为他也是加利利人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大约过了一小时，又有一个人肯定地说："这人真是和他一伙的，因为他也是加利利人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得却不承认，说：「女子，我不认得他。」
verses.textEnNiv: But he denied it. "Woman, I don’t know him," he said.
verses.textEnEsv: But he denied it, saying, "Woman, I do not know him."
verses.textEnNkjv: But he denied Him, saying, "Woman, I do not know Him."
verses.textEnNlt: But Peter denied it. "Woman," he said, "I don’t even know him!"
verses.textEnNasb: But he denied it, saying, "I do not know Him, woman!"
verses.textEn: But he denied it. "Woman, I don’t know him," he said.

verses.textZh: 彼得说："你这个人，我不知道你说的是甚么！"他还在说话的时候，鸡就叫了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得说："你这个人，我不知道你说的是甚么！"他还在说话的时候，鸡就叫了。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了不多的时候，又有一个人看见他，说：「你也是他们一党的。」彼得说：「你这个人！我不是。」
verses.textEnNiv: A little later someone else saw him and said, "You also are one of them." "Man, I am not!" Peter replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And a little later someone else saw him and said, "You also are one of them." But Peter said, "Man, I am not."
verses.textEnNkjv: And after a little while another saw him and said, "You also are of them." But Peter said, "Man, I am not!"
verses.textEnNlt: After a while someone else looked at him and said, "You must be one of them!" "No, man, I’m not!" Peter retorted.
verses.textEnNasb: And a little later, another person saw him and said, "You are one of them too!" But Peter said, "Man, I am not!"
verses.textEn: A little later someone else saw him and said, "You also are one of them." "Man, I am not!" Peter replied.

verses.textZh: 主转过身来看彼得，彼得就想起主对他说过的话："今天鸡叫以前，你要三次说不认得我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 主转过身来看彼得，彼得就想起主对他说过的话："今天鸡叫以前，你要三次说不认得我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约过了一小时，又有一个人极力地说：「他实在是同那人一伙的，因为他也是加利利人。」
verses.textEnNiv: About an hour later another asserted, "Certainly this fellow was with him, for he is a Galilean."
verses.textEnEsv: And after an interval of about an hour still another insisted, saying, "Certainly this man also was with him, for he too is a Galilean."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then after about an hour had passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, "Surely this fellow also was with Him, for he is a Galilean."
verses.textEnNlt: About an hour later someone else insisted, "This must be one of them, because he is a Galilean, too."
verses.textEnNasb: And after about an hour had passed, some other man began to insist, saying, "Certainly this man also was with Him, for he, too, is a Galilean."
verses.textEn: About an hour later another asserted, "Certainly this fellow was with him, for he is a Galilean."

verses.textZh: 他就出去痛哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就出去痛哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得说：「你这个人！我不晓得你说的是什么！」正说话之间，鸡就叫了。
verses.textEnNiv: Peter replied, "Man, I don’t know what you’re talking about!" Just as he was speaking, the rooster crowed.
verses.textEnEsv: But Peter said, "Man, I do not know what you are talking about." And immediately, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Peter said, "Man, I do not know what you are saying!" Immediately, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.
verses.textEnNlt: But Peter said, "Man, I don’t know what you are talking about." And immediately, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter said, "Man, I do not know what you are talking about!" And immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.
verses.textEn: Peter replied, "Man, I don’t know what you’re talking about!" Just as he was speaking, the rooster crowed.

verses.textZh: <red>看管耶稣的人戏弄他，打他，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>看管耶稣的人戏弄他，打他，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 主转过身来看彼得，彼得便想起主对他所说的话：「<red>今日鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord turned and looked straight at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word the Lord had spoken to him: <red>“Before the rooster crows today, you will disown me three times.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord turned and looked at Peter. And Peter remembered the saying of the Lord, how he had said to him, "Before the rooster crows today, you will deny me three times."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how He had said to him, "Before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times."
verses.textEnNlt: At that moment the Lord turned and looked at Peter. Suddenly, the Lord’s words flashed through Peter’s mind: "Before the rooster crows tomorrow morning, you will deny three times that you even know me."
verses.textEnNasb: And then the Lord turned and looked at Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how He had told him, "Before a rooster crows today, you will deny Me three times."
verses.textEn: The Lord turned and looked straight at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word the Lord had spoken to him: <red>“Before the rooster crows today, you will disown me three times.”</red>

verses.textZh: 蒙住他的眼睛问他："你说预言吧，说打你的是谁。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 蒙住他的眼睛问他："你说预言吧，说打你的是谁。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他就出去痛哭。
verses.textEnNiv: And he went outside and wept bitterly.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went out and wept bitterly.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Peter went out and wept bitterly.
verses.textEnNlt: And Peter left the courtyard, weeping bitterly.
verses.textEnNasb: And he went out and wept bitterly.
verses.textEn: And he went outside and wept bitterly.

verses.textZh: 他们还说了许多别的辱骂他的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们还说了许多别的辱骂他的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 看守耶稣的人戏弄他，打他，
verses.textEnNiv: The men who were guarding Jesus began mocking and beating him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the men who were holding Jesus in custody were mocking him as they beat him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the men who held Jesus mocked Him and beat Him.
verses.textEnNlt: The guards in charge of Jesus began mocking and beating him.
verses.textEnNasb: The men who were holding Jesus in custody began mocking Him and beating Him,
verses.textEn: The men who were guarding Jesus began mocking and beating him.

verses.textZh: 天一亮，民间的长老、祭司长和经学家就都聚集，把他带到他们的公议会里，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 天一亮，民间的长老、祭司长和经学家就都聚集，把他带到他们的公议会里，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 又蒙着他的眼，问他说：「你是先知，告诉我们打你的是谁？」
verses.textEnNiv: They blindfolded him and demanded, "Prophesy! Who hit you?"
verses.textEnEsv: They also blindfolded him and kept asking him, "Prophesy! Who is it that struck you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And having blindfolded Him, they struck Him on the face and asked Him, saying, "Prophesy! Who is the one who struck You?"
verses.textEnNlt: They blindfolded him and said, "Prophesy to us! Who hit you that time?"
verses.textEnNasb: and they blindfolded Him and repeatedly asked Him, saying, "Prophesy, who is the one who hit You?"
verses.textEn: They blindfolded him and demanded, "Prophesy! Who hit you?"

verses.textZh: "你若是基督，就告诉我们吧。"耶稣说："就算我告诉你们，你们也决不相信。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你若是基督，就告诉我们吧。"耶稣说："就算我告诉你们，你们也决不相信。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们还用许多别的话辱骂他。
verses.textEnNiv: And they said many other insulting things to him.
verses.textEnEsv: And they said many other things against him, blaspheming him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And many other things they blasphemously spoke against Him.
verses.textEnNlt: And they hurled all sorts of terrible insults at him.
verses.textEnNasb: And they were saying many other things against Him, blaspheming.
verses.textEn: And they said many other insulting things to him.

verses.textZh: 如果我问你们，你们也决不回答。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我问你们，你们也决不回答。
verses.textZhCuv: 天一亮，民间的众长老连祭司长带文士都聚会，把耶稣带到他们的公会里，
verses.textEnNiv: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and the teachers of the law, met together, and Jesus was led before them.
verses.textEnEsv: When day came, the assembly of the elders of the people gathered together, both chief priests and scribes. And they led him away to their council, and they said,
verses.textEnNkjv: As soon as it was day, the elders of the people, both chief priests and scribes, came together and led Him into their council, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: At daybreak all the elders of the people assembled, including the leading priests and the teachers of religious law. Jesus was led before this high council,
verses.textEnNasb: When it was day, the Council of elders of the people assembled, both chief priests and scribes, and they led Him away to their council chamber, saying,
verses.textEn: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and the teachers of the law, met together, and Jesus was led before them.

verses.textZh: 从今以后，人子要坐在神权能的右边。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 从今以后，人子要坐在神权能的右边。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「<red>你若是基督，就告诉我们。</red>」耶稣说：「我若告诉你们，你们也不信；
verses.textEnNiv: “If you are the Messiah,” they said, “tell us.” Jesus answered, <red>“If I tell you, you will not believe me,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: "If you are the Christ, tell us." But he said to them, "If I tell you, you will not believe,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If You are the Christ, tell us." But He said to them, "If I tell you, you will by no means believe.
verses.textEnNlt: and they said, "Tell us, are you the Messiah?" But he replied, "If I tell you, you won’t believe me.
verses.textEnNasb: "If You are the Christ, tell us." But He said to them, "If I tell you, you will not believe;
verses.textEn: “If you are the Messiah,” they said, “tell us.” Jesus answered, <red>“If I tell you, you will not believe me,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们说："那么你是神的儿子吗？"耶稣说："你们说了，我是。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们说："那么你是神的儿子吗？"耶稣说："你们说了，我是。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我若问你们，你们也不回答。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and if I asked you, you would not answer.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and if I ask you, you will not answer.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if I also ask you, you will by no means answer Me or let Me go.
verses.textEnNlt: And if I ask you a question, you won’t answer.
verses.textEnNasb: and if I ask a question, you will not answer.
verses.textEn: <red>and if I asked you, you would not answer.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们说："我们还需要甚么见证呢？我们亲自听见他所说的话了。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们说："我们还需要甚么见证呢？我们亲自听见他所说的话了。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>从今以后，人子要坐在神权能的右边。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the mighty God.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But from now on the Son of Man shall be seated at the right hand of the power of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Hereafter the Son of Man will sit on the right hand of the power of God."
verses.textEnNlt: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated in the place of power at God’s right hand. "
verses.textEnNasb: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God."
verses.textEn: <red>But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the mighty God.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们都说：「<red>这样，你是神的儿子吗？</red>」耶稣说：「<red>你们所说的是。</red>」
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们都说：「<red>这样，你是神的儿子吗？</red>」耶稣说：「<red>你们所说的是。</red>」
verses.textZhCuv: 他们都说：「<red>这样，你是神的儿子吗？</red>」耶稣说：「<red>你们所说的是。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: They all asked, “Are you then the Son of God?” He replied, <red>“You say that I am.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: So they all said, "Are you the Son of God, then?" And he said to them, "You say that I am."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they all said, "Are You then the Son of God?" So He said to them, "You rightly say that I am."
verses.textEnNlt: They all shouted, "So, are you claiming to be the Son of God?" And he replied, "You say that I am."
verses.textEnNasb: And they all said, "So You are the Son of God?" And He said to them, "You say correctly that I am."
verses.textEn: They all asked, “Are you then the Son of God?” He replied, <red>“You say that I am.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们说：「何必再用见证呢？他亲口所说的，我们都亲自听见了。」
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说：「何必再用见证呢？他亲口所说的，我们都亲自听见了。」
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「何必再用见证呢？他亲口所说的，我们都亲自听见了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they said, "Why do we need any more testimony? We have heard it from his own lips."
verses.textEnEsv: Then they said, "What further testimony do we need? We have heard it ourselves from his own lips."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said, "What further testimony do we need? For we have heard it ourselves from His own mouth."
verses.textEnNlt: "Why do we need other witnesses?" they said. "We ourselves heard him say it."
verses.textEnNasb: And then they said, "What further need do we have of testimony? For we have heard it ourselves from His own mouth!"
verses.textEn: Then they said, "Why do we need any more testimony? We have heard it from his own lips."

verses.textZh: 众人都起来，把耶稣押到彼拉多那里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人都起来，把耶稣押到彼拉多那里，
verses.textZhCuv: 众人都起来，把耶稣解到彼拉多面前，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the whole assembly rose and led him off to Pilate.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the whole company of them arose and brought him before Pilate.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the whole multitude of them arose and led Him to Pilate.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the entire council took Jesus to Pilate, the Roman governor.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the entire assembly of them set out and brought Him before Pilate.
verses.textEn: Then the whole assembly rose and led him off to Pilate.

verses.textZh: 控告他说："我们查出这个人煽惑我们的同胞，阻止纳税给凯撒，并且自称是基督，是王。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 控告他说："我们查出这个人煽惑我们的同胞，阻止纳税给凯撒，并且自称是基督，是王。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就告他说：「我们见这人诱惑国民，禁止纳税给凯撒，并说自己是基督，是王。」
verses.textEnNiv: And they began to accuse him, saying, "We have found this man subverting our nation. He opposes payment of taxes to Caesar and claims to be Messiah, a king."
verses.textEnEsv: And they began to accuse him, saying, "We found this man misleading our nation and forbidding us to give tribute to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they began to accuse Him, saying, "We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to pay taxes to Caesar, saying that He Himself is Christ, a King."
verses.textEnNlt: They began to state their case: "This man has been leading our people astray by telling them not to pay their taxes to the Roman government and by claiming he is the Messiah, a king."
verses.textEnNasb: And they began to bring charges against Him, saying, "We found this Man misleading our nation and forbidding us to pay taxes to Caesar, and saying that He Himself is Christ, a King."
verses.textEn: And they began to accuse him, saying, "We have found this man subverting our nation. He opposes payment of taxes to Caesar and claims to be Messiah, a king."

verses.textZh: 彼拉多问他："<red>你是犹太人的王吗？</red>"耶稣回答："<red>你已经说了 。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多问他："<red>你是犹太人的王吗？</red>"耶稣回答："<red>你已经说了 。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多问耶稣说：「<red>你是犹太人的王吗？</red>」耶稣回答说：「<red>你说的是。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: So Pilate asked Jesus, “Are you the king of the Jews?” <red>“Youp have said so,”</red> Jesus replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And Pilate asked him, "Are you the King of the Jews?" And he answered him, "You have said so."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pilate asked Him, saying, "Are You the King of the Jews?" He answered him and said, "It is as you say."
verses.textEnNlt: So Pilate asked him, "Are you the king of the Jews?" Jesus replied, "You have said it."
verses.textEnNasb: Now Pilate asked Him, saying, "So You are the King of the Jews?" And He answered him and said, "It is as you say."
verses.textEn: So Pilate asked Jesus, “Are you the king of the Jews?” <red>“Youp have said so,”</red> Jesus replied.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多对祭司长和众人说："我在这人身上，查不出有甚么罪。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多对祭司长和众人说："我在这人身上，查不出有甚么罪。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多对祭司长和众人说：「我查不出这人有什么罪来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Pilate announced to the chief priests and the crowd, "I find no basis for a charge against this man."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, "I find no guilt in this man."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowd, "I find no fault in this Man."
verses.textEnNlt: Pilate turned to the leading priests and to the crowd and said, "I find nothing wrong with this man!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, "I find no grounds for charges in the case of this Man."
verses.textEn: Then Pilate announced to the chief priests and the crowd, "I find no basis for a charge against this man."

verses.textZh: 但他们极力说："他在犹太全地教导人，煽动群众，从加利利直到这里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们极力说："他在犹太全地教导人，煽动群众，从加利利直到这里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但他们越发极力地说：「他煽惑百姓，在犹太遍地传道，从加利利起，直到这里了。」
verses.textEnNiv: But they insisted, "He stirs up the people all over Judea by his teaching. He started in Galilee and has come all the way here."
verses.textEnEsv: But they were urgent, saying, "He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, from Galilee even to this place."
verses.textEnNkjv: But they were the more fierce, saying, "He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee to this place."
verses.textEnNlt: Then they became insistent. "But he is causing riots by his teaching wherever he goes—all over Judea, from Galilee to Jerusalem!"
verses.textEnNasb: But they kept on insisting, saying, "He is stirring up the people, teaching all over Judea, starting from Galilee, as far as this place!"
verses.textEn: But they insisted, "He stirs up the people all over Judea by his teaching. He started in Galilee and has come all the way here."

verses.textZh: 彼拉多听见了，就问耶稣是不是加利利人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多听见了，就问耶稣是不是加利利人。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多一听见，就问：「这人是加利利人吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: On hearing this, Pilate asked if the man was a Galilean.
verses.textEnEsv: When Pilate heard this, he asked whether the man was a Galilean.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked if the Man were a Galilean.
verses.textEnNlt: "Oh, is he a Galilean?" Pilate asked.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Pilate heard this, he asked whether the Man was a Galilean.
verses.textEn: On hearing this, Pilate asked if the man was a Galilean.

verses.textZh: 既然知道他是属于希律管辖的，就把他送回希律那里；那时希律正在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 既然知道他是属于希律管辖的，就把他送回希律那里；那时希律正在耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 既晓得耶稣属希律所管，就把他送到希律那里去。那时希律正在耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: When he learned that Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he learned that he belonged to Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him over to Herod, who was himself in Jerusalem at that time.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as soon as he knew that He belonged to Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.
verses.textEnNlt: When they said that he was, Pilate sent him to Herod Antipas, because Galilee was under Herod’s jurisdiction, and Herod happened to be in Jerusalem at the time.
verses.textEnNasb: And when he learned that He belonged to Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, since he also was in Jerusalem at this time.
verses.textEn: When he learned that Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.

verses.textZh: 希律看见耶稣，非常欢喜，因为他曾经听过耶稣的事，早就想要见他，希望看他行个神迹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希律看见耶稣，非常欢喜，因为他曾经听过耶稣的事，早就想要见他，希望看他行个神迹。
verses.textZhCuv: 希律看见耶稣，就很欢喜；因为听见过他的事，久已想要见他，并且指望看他行一件神迹，
verses.textEnNiv: When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased, because for a long time he had been wanting to see him. From what he had heard about him, he hoped to see him perform a sign of some sort.
verses.textEnEsv: When Herod saw Jesus, he was very glad, for he had long desired to see him, because he had heard about him, and he was hoping to see some sign done by him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad; for he had desired for a long time to see Him, because he had heard many things about Him, and he hoped to see some miracle done by Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Herod was delighted at the opportunity to see Jesus, because he had heard about him and had been hoping for a long time to see him perform a miracle.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Herod was overjoyed when he saw Jesus; for he had wanted to see Him for a long time, because he had been hearing about Him and was hoping to see some sign performed by Him.
verses.textEn: When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased, because for a long time he had been wanting to see him. From what he had heard about him, he hoped to see him perform a sign of some sort.

verses.textZh: 于是他问了耶稣许多话，但耶稣甚么也不回答。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他问了耶稣许多话，但耶稣甚么也不回答。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是问他许多的话，耶稣却一言不答。
verses.textEnNiv: He plied him with many questions, but Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.textEnEsv: So he questioned him at some length, but he made no answer.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he questioned Him with many words, but He answered him nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: He asked Jesus question after question, but Jesus refused to answer.
verses.textEnNasb: And he questioned Him at some length; but He offered him no answer at all.
verses.textEn: He plied him with many questions, but Jesus gave him no answer.

verses.textZh: 祭司长和经学家站着，猛烈地控告他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司长和经学家站着，猛烈地控告他。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司长和文士都站着，极力地告他。
verses.textEnNiv: The chief priests and the teachers of the law were standing there, vehemently accusing him.
verses.textEnEsv: The chief priests and the scribes stood by, vehemently accusing him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the leading priests and the teachers of religious law stood there shouting their accusations.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the chief priests and the scribes stood there, vehemently charging Him.
verses.textEn: The chief priests and the teachers of the law were standing there, vehemently accusing him.

verses.textZh: 希律和他的侍卫就藐视耶稣，戏弄他，给他穿上华丽的衣服，把他送回彼拉多那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希律和他的侍卫就藐视耶稣，戏弄他，给他穿上华丽的衣服，把他送回彼拉多那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 希律和他的兵丁就藐视耶稣，戏弄他，给他穿上华丽衣服，把他送回彼拉多那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked him. Dressing him in an elegant robe, they sent him back to Pilate.
verses.textEnEsv: And Herod with his soldiers treated him with contempt and mocked him. Then, arraying him in splendid clothing, he sent him back to Pilate.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Herod, with his men of war, treated Him with contempt and mocked Him, arrayed Him in a gorgeous robe, and sent Him back to Pilate.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Herod and his soldiers began mocking and ridiculing Jesus. Finally, they put a royal robe on him and sent him back to Pilate.
verses.textEnNasb: And Herod, together with his soldiers, treated Him with contempt and mocked Him, dressing Him in a brightly shining robe, and sent Him back to Pilate.
verses.textEn: Then Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked him. Dressing him in an elegant robe, they sent him back to Pilate.

verses.textZh: 希律和彼拉多从前原是彼此为仇，在那一天就成了朋友。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希律和彼拉多从前原是彼此为仇，在那一天就成了朋友。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前希律和彼拉多彼此有仇，在那一天就成了朋友。
verses.textEnNiv: That day Herod and Pilate became friends—before this they had been enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: And Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before this they had been at enmity with each other.
verses.textEnNkjv: That very day Pilate and Herod became friends with each other, for previously they had been at enmity with each other.
verses.textEnNlt: (Herod and Pilate, who had been enemies before, became friends that day.)
verses.textEnNasb: And so Herod and Pilate became friends with one another that very day; for previously, they had been enemies toward each other.
verses.textEn: That day Herod and Pilate became friends—before this they had been enemies.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多召集了祭司长、官长和民众，
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多召集了祭司长、官长和民众，
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多传齐了祭司长和官府并百姓，
verses.textEnNiv: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers and the people,
verses.textEnEsv: Pilate then called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pilate called together the leading priests and other religious leaders, along with the people,
verses.textEnNasb: Now Pilate summoned to himself the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
verses.textEn: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers and the people,

verses.textZh: 对他们说："你们把这人押到我这里来，说他煽惑群众，我已经在你们面前审讯过，在他身上一点也找不到你们控告他的罪状，
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："你们把这人押到我这里来，说他煽惑群众，我已经在你们面前审讯过，在他身上一点也找不到你们控告他的罪状，
verses.textZhCuv: 就对他们说：「你们解这人到我这里，说他是诱惑百姓的。看哪，我也曾将你们告他的事，在你们面前审问他，并没有查出他什么罪来；
verses.textEnNiv: and said to them, "You brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. I have examined him in your presence and have found no basis for your charges against him.
verses.textEnEsv: and said to them, "You brought me this man as one who was misleading the people. And after examining him before you, behold, I did not find this man guilty of any of your charges against him.
verses.textEnNkjv: said to them, "You have brought this Man to me, as one who misleads the people. And indeed, having examined Him in your presence, I have found no fault in this Man concerning those things of which you accuse Him;
verses.textEnNlt: and he announced his verdict. "You brought this man to me, accusing him of leading a revolt. I have examined him thoroughly on this point in your presence and find him innocent.
verses.textEnNasb: and he said to them, "You brought this Man to me on the ground that He is inciting the people to revolt; and behold, after examining Him before you, I have found no basis at all in the case of this Man for the charges which you are bringing against Him.
verses.textEn: and said to them, "You brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. I have examined him in your presence and have found no basis for your charges against him.

verses.textZh: 连希律也找不到，又把他送回我这里，可见他没有作过该死的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 连希律也找不到，又把他送回我这里，可见他没有作过该死的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是希律也是如此，所以把他送回来。可见他没有做什么该死的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Neither has Herod, for he sent him back to us; as you can see, he has done nothing to deserve death.
verses.textEnEsv: Neither did Herod, for he sent him back to us. Look, nothing deserving death has been done by him.
verses.textEnNkjv: no, neither did Herod, for I sent you back to him; and indeed nothing deserving of death has been done by Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Herod came to the same conclusion and sent him back to us. Nothing this man has done calls for the death penalty.
verses.textEnNasb: No, nor has Herod, for he sent Him back to us; and behold, nothing deserving death has been done by Him.
verses.textEn: Neither has Herod, for he sent him back to us; as you can see, he has done nothing to deserve death.

verses.textZh: 我要责打他，然后把他释放。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要责打他，然后把他释放。"
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，我要责打他，把他释放了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, I will punish him and then release him."
verses.textEnEsv: I will therefore punish and release him."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will therefore chastise Him and release Him"
verses.textEnNlt: So I will have him flogged, and then I will release him."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I will punish Him and release Him."
verses.textEn: Therefore, I will punish him and then release him."

verses.textZh: 众人齐声喊叫："除掉这个人，给我们释放巴拉巴！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人齐声喊叫："除掉这个人，给我们释放巴拉巴！"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人却一齐喊着说：「除掉这个人！释放巴拉巴给我们！」
verses.textEnNiv: But the whole crowd shouted, "Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!"
verses.textEnEsv: But they all cried out together, "Away with this man, and release to us Barabbas"—
verses.textEnNkjv: (for it was necessary for him to release one to them at the feast).
verses.textEnNlt: Then a mighty roar rose from the crowd, and with one voice they shouted, "Kill him, and release Barabbas to us!"
