verses.textEnNasb: [ Now he was obligated to release to them at the feast one prisoner.]
verses.textEn: But the whole crowd shouted, "Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!"

verses.textZh: 这巴拉巴是因为在城里作乱杀人而入狱的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这巴拉巴是因为在城里作乱杀人而入狱的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这巴拉巴是因在城里作乱杀人，下在监里的。
verses.textEnNiv: (Barabbas had been thrown into prison for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)
verses.textEnEsv: a man who had been thrown into prison for an insurrection started in the city and for murder.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they all cried out at once, saying, "Away with this Man, and release to us Barabbas"—
verses.textEnNlt: (Barabbas was in prison for taking part in an insurrection in Jerusalem against the government, and for murder.)
verses.textEnNasb: But they cried out all together, saying, "Away with this Man, and release to us Barabbas!"
verses.textEn: (Barabbas had been thrown into prison for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)

verses.textZh: 彼拉多再向他们说明，愿意释放耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多再向他们说明，愿意释放耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多愿意释放耶稣，就又劝解他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate appealed to them again.
verses.textEnEsv: Pilate addressed them once more, desiring to release Jesus,
verses.textEnNkjv: who had been thrown into prison for a certain rebellion made in the city, and for murder.
verses.textEnNlt: Pilate argued with them, because he wanted to release Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: (He was one who had been thrown into prison for a revolt that took place in the city, and for murder.)
verses.textEn: Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate appealed to them again.

verses.textZh: 然而他们高声呼叫："把他钉十字架，把他钉十字架！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而他们高声呼叫："把他钉十字架，把他钉十字架！"
verses.textZhCuv: 无奈他们喊着说：「钉他十字架！钉他十字架！」
verses.textEnNiv: But they kept shouting, "Crucify him! Crucify him!"
verses.textEnEsv: but they kept shouting, "Crucify, crucify him!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Pilate, therefore, wishing to release Jesus, again called out to them.
verses.textEnNlt: But they kept shouting, "Crucify him! Crucify him!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Pilate, wanting to release Jesus, addressed them again,
verses.textEn: But they kept shouting, "Crucify him! Crucify him!"

verses.textZh: 彼拉多第三次对他们说："这人作过甚么恶事呢？我在他身上找不出甚么该死的罪。所以我要责打他，然后把他释放。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多第三次对他们说："这人作过甚么恶事呢？我在他身上找不出甚么该死的罪。所以我要责打他，然后把他释放。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多第三次对他们说：「为什么呢？这人做了什么恶事呢？我并没有查出他什么该死的罪来。所以，我要责打他，把他释放了。」
verses.textEnNiv: For the third time he spoke to them: "Why? What crime has this man committed? I have found in him no grounds for the death penalty. Therefore I will have him punished and then release him."
verses.textEnEsv: A third time he said to them, "Why? What evil has he done? I have found in him no guilt deserving death. I will therefore punish and release him."
verses.textEnNkjv: But they shouted, saying, "Crucify Him, crucify Him!"
verses.textEnNlt: For the third time he demanded, "Why? What crime has he committed? I have found no reason to sentence him to death. So I will have him flogged, and then I will release him."
verses.textEnNasb: but they kept on crying out, saying, "Crucify, crucify Him!"
verses.textEn: For the third time he spoke to them: "Why? What crime has this man committed? I have found in him no grounds for the death penalty. Therefore I will have him punished and then release him."

verses.textZh: 但他们大声吵闹，要他把耶稣钉十字架，他们的声音就得了胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们大声吵闹，要他把耶稣钉十字架，他们的声音就得了胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们大声催逼彼拉多，求他把耶稣钉在十字架上。他们的声音就得了胜。
verses.textEnNiv: But with loud shouts they insistently demanded that he be crucified, and their shouts prevailed.
verses.textEnEsv: But they were urgent, demanding with loud cries that he should be crucified. And their voices prevailed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to them the third time, "Why, what evil has He done? I have found no reason for death in Him. I will therefore chastise Him and let Him go."
verses.textEnNlt: But the mob shouted louder and louder, demanding that Jesus be crucified, and their voices prevailed.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to them a third time, "Why, what has this Man done wrong? I have found in His case no grounds for a sentence of death; therefore I will punish Him and release Him."
verses.textEn: But with loud shouts they insistently demanded that he be crucified, and their shouts prevailed.

verses.textZh: 彼拉多就宣判，照他们的要求，
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼拉多就宣判，照他们的要求，
verses.textZhCuv: 彼拉多这才照他们所求的定案，
verses.textEnNiv: So Pilate decided to grant their demand.
verses.textEnEsv: So Pilate decided that their demand should be granted.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they were insistent, demanding with loud voices that He be crucified. And the voices of these men and of the chief priests prevailed.
verses.textEnNlt: So Pilate sentenced Jesus to die as they demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: But they were insistent, with loud voices, demanding that He be crucified. And their voices began to prevail.
verses.textEn: So Pilate decided to grant their demand.

verses.textZh: 把他们所求那作乱杀人入狱的释放了，却把耶稣交出来，随他们的意思处理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把他们所求那作乱杀人入狱的释放了，却把耶稣交出来，随他们的意思处理。
verses.textZhCuv: 把他们所求的那作乱杀人、下在监里的释放了，把耶稣交给他们，任凭他们的意思行。
verses.textEnNiv: He released the man who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, the one they asked for, and surrendered Jesus to their will.
verses.textEnEsv: He released the man who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus over to their will.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they requested.
verses.textEnNlt: As they had requested, he released Barabbas, the man in prison for insurrection and murder. But he turned Jesus over to them to do as they wished.
verses.textEnNasb: And so Pilate decided to have their demand carried out.
verses.textEn: He released the man who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, the one they asked for, and surrendered Jesus to their will.

verses.textZh: 他们把耶稣带走的时候，抓住了一个从乡下来的古利奈人西门，把十字架放在他身上，叫他背着跟在耶稣后面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把耶稣带走的时候，抓住了一个从乡下来的古利奈人西门，把十字架放在他身上，叫他背着跟在耶稣后面。
verses.textZhCuv: 带耶稣去的时候，有一个古利奈人西门，从乡下来；他们就抓住他，把十字架搁在他身上，叫他背着跟随耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: As the soldiers led him away, they seized Simon from Cyrene, who was on his way in from the country, and put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: And as they led him away, they seized one Simon of Cyrene, who was coming in from the country, and laid on him the cross, to carry it behind Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he released to them the one they requested, who for rebellion and murder had been thrown into prison; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
verses.textEnNlt: As they led Jesus away, a man named Simon, who was from Cyrene, happened to be coming in from the countryside. The soldiers seized him and put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: And he released the man for whom they were asking, who had been thrown into prison for a revolt and murder; but he handed Jesus over to their will.
verses.textEn: As the soldiers led him away, they seized Simon from Cyrene, who was on his way in from the country, and put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.

verses.textZh: 一大群人跟随他，有些妇女为他捶胸痛哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一大群人跟随他，有些妇女为他捶胸痛哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 有许多百姓跟随耶稣，内中有好些妇女；妇女们为他号咷痛哭。
verses.textEnNiv: A large number of people followed him, including women who mourned and wailed for him.
verses.textEnEsv: And there followed him a great multitude of the people and of women who were mourning and lamenting for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as they led Him away, they laid hold of a certain man, Simon a Cyrenian, who was coming from the country, and on him they laid the cross that he might bear it after Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: A large crowd trailed behind, including many grief-stricken women.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they led Him away, they seized a man, Simon of Cyrene, as he was coming in from the country, and placed on him the cross to carry behind Jesus.
verses.textEn: A large number of people followed him, including women who mourned and wailed for him.

verses.textZh: 耶稣转过身来对她们说："耶路撒冷的女儿啊，不要为我哭，却要为你们自己和你们的儿女哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣转过身来对她们说："耶路撒冷的女儿啊，不要为我哭，却要为你们自己和你们的儿女哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣转身对她们说：「耶路撒冷的女子，不要为我哭，当为自己和自己的儿女哭。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus turned and said to them, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me; weep for yourselves and for your children.
verses.textEnEsv: But turning to them Jesus said, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
verses.textEnNkjv: And a great multitude of the people followed Him, and women who also mourned and lamented Him.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jesus turned and said to them, "Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
verses.textEnNasb: Now following Him was a large crowd of the people, and of women who were mourning and grieving for Him.
verses.textEn: Jesus turned and said to them, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me; weep for yourselves and for your children.

verses.textZh: <red>日子将到，人必说：‘不生育的和没有怀过胎的，也没有哺养过婴儿的有福了。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>日子将到，人必说：‘不生育的和没有怀过胎的，也没有哺养过婴儿的有福了。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>因为日子要到，人必说：『不生育的，和未曾怀胎的，未曾乳养婴孩的，有福了！』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus turned and said to them, <red>“Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me; weep for yourselves and for your children.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, the days are coming when they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren and the wombs that never bore and the breasts that never nursed!’
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jesus, turning to them, said, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
verses.textEnNlt: For the days are coming when they will say, ‘Fortunate indeed are the women who are childless, the wombs that have not borne a child and the breasts that have never nursed.’
verses.textEnNasb: But Jesus turned to them and said, "Daughters of Jerusalem, stop weeping for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
verses.textEn: Jesus turned and said to them, <red>“Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me; weep for yourselves and for your children.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>那时人要对大山说： ‘倒在我们身上！’ 对小山说： ‘遮盖我们！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>那时人要对大山说： ‘倒在我们身上！’ 对小山说： ‘遮盖我们！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>那时，人要向大山说： 倒在我们身上！ 向小山说： 遮盖我们！</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For the time will come when you will say, ‘Blessed are the childless women, the wombs that never bore and the breasts that never nursed!’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then they will begin to say to the mountains, ‘Fall on us,’ and to the hills, ‘Cover us.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For indeed the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, wombs that never bore, and breasts which never nursed!’
verses.textEnNlt: People will beg the mountains, ‘Fall on us,’ and plead with the hills, ‘Bury us.’
verses.textEnNasb: For behold, days are coming when they will say, ‘Blessed are those who cannot bear, and the wombs that have not given birth, and the breasts that have not nursed.’
verses.textEn: <red>For the time will come when you will say, ‘Blessed are the childless women, the wombs that never bore and the breasts that never nursed!’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们在青绿的树上，既然这样作；在枯干的树上，又会怎样呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们在青绿的树上，既然这样作；在枯干的树上，又会怎样呢？"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 「<red>这些事既行在有汁水的树上，那枯干的树将来怎么样呢？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Then “ ‘theypn will say to the mountains, “Fall on us!” andld to the hills, “Cover us!” ’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For if they do these things when the wood is green, what will happen when it is dry?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they will begin ‘to say to the mountains, "Fall on us!" and to the hills, "Cover us!" ’
verses.textEnNlt: For if these things are done when the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry? "
verses.textEnNasb: Then they will begin to say to the mountains, ‘Fall on us,’ and to the hills, ‘Cover us.’
verses.textEn: <red>Then “ ‘theypn will say to the mountains, “Fall on us!” andld to the hills, “Cover us!” ’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>他们另外带来两个犯人，和耶稣一同处死，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>他们另外带来两个犯人，和耶稣一同处死，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又有两个犯人，和耶稣一同带来处死。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Forp if people do these things when the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Two others, who were criminals, were led away to be put to death with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if they do these things in the green wood, what will be done in the dry?"
verses.textEnNlt: Two others, both criminals, were led out to be executed with him.
verses.textEnNasb: For if they do these things when the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?"
verses.textEn: <red>Forp if people do these things when the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?”</red>

verses.textZh: 到了那名叫"髑髅"的地方，就把耶稣钉在十字架上，也钉了那两个犯人，一左一右。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了那名叫"髑髅"的地方，就把耶稣钉在十字架上，也钉了那两个犯人，一左一右。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了一个地方，名叫「髑髅地」，就在那里把耶稣钉在十字架上，又钉了两个犯人：一个在左边，一个在右边。
verses.textEnNiv: When they came to the place called the Skull, they crucified him there, along with the criminals—one on his right, the other on his left.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they came to the place that is called The Skull, there they crucified him, and the criminals, one on his right and one on his left.
verses.textEnNkjv: There were also two others, criminals, led with Him to be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: When they came to a place called The Skull, they nailed him to the cross. And the criminals were also crucified—one on his right and one on his left.
verses.textEnNasb: Now two others, who were criminals, were also being led away to be put to death with Him.
verses.textEn: When they came to the place called the Skull, they crucified him there, along with the criminals—one on his right, the other on his left.

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："父啊，赦免他们！因为他们不知道自己所作的是甚么。"士兵抽签，分了他的衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："父啊，赦免他们！因为他们不知道自己所作的是甚么。"士兵抽签，分了他的衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 当下耶稣说：「父啊！赦免他们；因为他们所做的，他们不晓得。」兵丁就拈阄分他的衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing." And they divided up his clothes by casting lots.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they know not what they do." And they cast lots to divide his garments.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had come to the place called Calvary, there they crucified Him, and the criminals, one on the right hand and the other on the left.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing." And the soldiers gambled for his clothes by throwing dice.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they came to the place called The Skull, there they crucified Him and the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.
verses.textEn: Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing." And they divided up his clothes by casting lots.

verses.textZh: 群众站着观看，官长们嗤笑说："<red>他救了别人，如果他是基督，是神所拣选的，让他救自己吧！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众站着观看，官长们嗤笑说："<red>他救了别人，如果他是基督，是神所拣选的，让他救自己吧！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓站在那里观看。官府也嗤笑他，说：「<red>他救了别人；他若是基督，神所拣选的，可以救自己吧！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus said, <red>“Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.”</red> And they divided up his clothes by casting lots.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people stood by, watching, but the rulers scoffed at him, saying, "He saved others; let him save himself, if he is the Christ of God, his Chosen One!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they do." And they divided His garments and cast lots.
verses.textEnNlt: The crowd watched and the leaders scoffed. "He saved others," they said, "let him save himself if he is really God’s Messiah, the Chosen One."
verses.textEnNasb: [ But Jesus was saying, "Father, forgive them; for they do not know what they are doing."] And they cast lots, dividing His garments among themselves.
verses.textEn: Jesus said, <red>“Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.”</red> And they divided up his clothes by casting lots.

verses.textZh: 士兵也上前戏弄他，拿酸酒给他喝，
verses.textZhCnvs: 士兵也上前戏弄他，拿酸酒给他喝，
verses.textZhCuv: 兵丁也戏弄他，上前拿醋送给他喝，
verses.textEnNiv: The soldiers also came up and mocked him. They offered him wine vinegar
verses.textEnEsv: The soldiers also mocked him, coming up and offering him sour wine
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people stood looking on. But even the rulers with them sneered, saying, "He saved others; let Him save Himself if He is the Christ, the chosen of God."
verses.textEnNlt: The soldiers mocked him, too, by offering him a drink of sour wine.
verses.textEnNasb: And the people stood by, watching. And even the rulers were sneering at Him, saying, "He saved others; let Him save Himself if this is the Christ of God, His Chosen One."
verses.textEn: The soldiers also came up and mocked him. They offered him wine vinegar

verses.textZh: 说："如果你是犹太人的王，救你自己吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："如果你是犹太人的王，救你自己吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「你若是犹太人的王，可以救自己吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: and said, "If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself."
verses.textEnEsv: and saying, "If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!"
verses.textEnNkjv: The soldiers also mocked Him, coming and offering Him sour wine,
verses.textEnNlt: They called out to him, "If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!"
verses.textEnNasb: The soldiers also ridiculed Him, coming up to Him, offering Him sour wine,
verses.textEn: and said, "If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself."

verses.textZh: 在耶稣的头以上有一个牌子写着："这是犹太人的王。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶稣的头以上有一个牌子写着："这是犹太人的王。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶稣以上有一个牌子 写着：「这是犹太人的王。」
verses.textEnNiv: There was a written notice above him, which read: this is the king of the jews.
verses.textEnEsv: There was also an inscription over him, "This is the King of the Jews."
verses.textEnNkjv: and saying, "If You are the King of the Jews, save Yourself."
verses.textEnNlt: A sign was fastened above him with these words: "This is the King of the Jews."
verses.textEnNasb: and saying, "If You are the King of the Jews, save Yourself!"
verses.textEn: There was a written notice above him, which read: this is the king of the jews.

verses.textZh: 悬挂着的犯人中，有一个侮辱他说："你不是基督吗？救你自己和我们吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 悬挂着的犯人中，有一个侮辱他说："你不是基督吗？救你自己和我们吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 那同钉的两个犯人有一个讥笑他，说：「你不是基督吗？可以救自己和我们吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: One of the criminals who hung there hurled insults at him: "Aren’t you the Messiah? Save yourself and us!"
verses.textEnEsv: One of the criminals who were hanged railed at him, saying, "Are you not the Christ? Save yourself and us!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And an inscription also was written over Him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.textEnNlt: One of the criminals hanging beside him scoffed, "So you’re the Messiah, are you? Prove it by saving yourself—and us, too, while you’re at it!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was also an inscription above Him, "THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS."
verses.textEn: One of the criminals who hung there hurled insults at him: "Aren’t you the Messiah? Save yourself and us!"

verses.textZh: 另一个就应声责备他说："你是同样受刑的，还不惧怕神吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 另一个就应声责备他说："你是同样受刑的，还不惧怕神吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 那一个就应声责备他，说：「你既是一样受刑的，还不怕神吗？
verses.textEnNiv: But the other criminal rebuked him. "Don’t you fear God," he said, "since you are under the same sentence?
verses.textEnEsv: But the other rebuked him, saying, "Do you not fear God, since you are under the same sentence of condemnation?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one of the criminals who were hanged blasphemed Him, saying, "If You are the Christ, save Yourself and us."
verses.textEnNlt: But the other criminal protested, "Don’t you fear God even when you have been sentenced to die?
verses.textEnNasb: One of the criminals who were hanged there was hurling abuse at Him, saying, "Are You not the Christ? Save Yourself and us!"
verses.textEn: But the other criminal rebuked him. "Don’t you fear God," he said, "since you are under the same sentence?

verses.textZh: 我们是罪有应得的。我们所受的与所作的相称，然而这个人并没有作过甚么不对的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们是罪有应得的。我们所受的与所作的相称，然而这个人并没有作过甚么不对的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们是应该的，因我们所受的与我们所做的相称，但这个人没有做过一件不好的事。」
verses.textEnNiv: We are punished justly, for we are getting what our deeds deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong."
verses.textEnEsv: And we indeed justly, for we are receiving the due reward of our deeds; but this man has done nothing wrong."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the other, answering, rebuked him, saying, "Do you not even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?
verses.textEnNlt: We deserve to die for our crimes, but this man hasn’t done anything wrong."
verses.textEnNasb: But the other responded, and rebuking him, said, "Do you not even fear God, since you are under the same sentence of condemnation?
verses.textEn: We are punished justly, for we are getting what our deeds deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong."

verses.textZh: 他又对耶稣说："耶稣啊，你得国降临的时候，求你记念我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对耶稣说："耶稣啊，你得国降临的时候，求你记念我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就说：「耶稣啊，你得国降临的时候，求你记念我！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said, "Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom. "
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom."
verses.textEnNkjv: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward of our deeds; but this Man has done nothing wrong."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "Jesus, remember me when you come into your Kingdom."
verses.textEnNasb: And we indeed are suffering justly, for we are receiving what we deserve for our crimes; but this Man has done nothing wrong."
verses.textEn: Then he said, "Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom. "

verses.textZh: 耶稣对他说："我实在告诉你，今天你必定同我在乐园里了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣对他说："我实在告诉你，今天你必定同我在乐园里了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他说：「我实在告诉你，今日你要同我在乐园里了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus answered him, "Truly I tell you, today you will be with me in paradise."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "Truly, I say to you, today you will be with me in paradise."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to Jesus, "Lord, remember me when You come into Your kingdom."
verses.textEnNlt: And Jesus replied, "I assure you, today you will be with me in paradise."
verses.textEnNasb: And he was saying, "Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom!"
verses.textEn: Jesus answered him, "Truly I tell you, today you will be with me in paradise."

verses.textZh: <red>从大约正午直到下午三点钟，遍地都黑暗了。</red>

verses.textEnEsv: It was now about the sixth hour, and there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jesus said to him, "Assuredly, I say to you, today you will be with Me in Paradise."
verses.textEnNlt: By this time it was about noon, and darkness fell across the whole land until three o’clock.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to him, "Truly I say to you, today you will be with Me in Paradise."
verses.textEn: Jesus answered him, <red>“Truly I tell you, today you will be with me in paradise.”</red>

verses.textZhCnvs: 太阳没有光，圣所的幔子从当中裂开。

verses.textEnNiv: for the sun stopped shining. And the curtain of the temple was torn in two.

verses.textEnNlt: The light from the sun was gone. And suddenly, the curtain in the sanctuary of the Temple was torn down the middle.

verses.textEn: for the sun stopped shining. And the curtain of the temple was torn in two.

verses.textZh: 耶稣大声呼叫："父啊，我把我的灵魂交在你手里。"说了这话，气就断了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣大声呼叫："父啊，我把我的灵魂交在你手里。"说了这话，气就断了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣大声喊着说：「父啊！我将我的灵魂交在你手里。」说了这话，气就断了。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus called out with a loud voice, "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit." When he had said this, he breathed his last.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jesus, calling out with a loud voice, said, "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!" And having said this he breathed his last.

verses.textEn: Jesus called out with a loud voice, "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit." When he had said this, he breathed his last.

verses.textZh: 百夫长看见所发生的事，就颂赞神，说："<red>这真是个义人！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 百夫长看见所发生的事，就颂赞神，说："<red>这真是个义人！</red>"

verses.textEnNiv: Jesus called out with a loud voice, <red>“Father, into your hands I commit my spirit.”</red> When he had said this, he breathed his last.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the centurion saw what had taken place, he praised God, saying, "Certainly this man was innocent!"

verses.textEnNlt: When the Roman officer overseeing the execution saw what had happened, he worshiped God and said, "Surely this man was innocent. "
verses.textEnNasb: And Jesus, crying out with a loud voice, said, "Father, into Your hands I entrust My spirit." And having said this, He died.
verses.textEn: Jesus called out with a loud voice, <red>“Father, into your hands I commit my spirit.”</red> When he had said this, he breathed his last.

verses.textZh: 聚集观看的群众，看见所发生的事，都捶着胸回去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 聚集观看的群众，看见所发生的事，都捶着胸回去了。

verses.textEnNiv: When all the people who had gathered to witness this sight saw what took place, they beat their breasts and went away.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the crowds that had assembled for this spectacle, when they saw what had taken place, returned home beating their breasts.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when the centurion saw what had happened, he glorified God, saying, "Certainly this was a righteous Man!"
verses.textEnNlt: And when all the crowd that came to see the crucifixion saw what had happened, they went home in deep sorrow.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the centurion saw what had happened, he began praising God, saying, "This Man was in fact innocent."
verses.textEn: When all the people who had gathered to witness this sight saw what took place, they beat their breasts and went away.

verses.textZh: 与耶稣熟悉的人，和从加利利跟随他来的妇女，都远远地站着，看这些事。

verses.textEnNiv: But all those who knew him, including the women who had followed him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.
verses.textEnEsv: And all his acquaintances and the women who had followed him from Galilee stood at a distance watching these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the whole crowd who came together to that sight, seeing what had been done, beat their breasts and returned.

verses.textEnNasb: And all the crowds who came together for this spectacle, after watching what had happened, began to return home, beating their chests.
verses.textEn: But all those who knew him, including the women who had followed him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.

verses.textEn: Now there was a man named Joseph, a member of the Council, a good and upright man,

verses.textEnNiv: who had not consented to their decision and action. He came from the Judean town of Arimathea, and he himself was waiting for the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnEsv: who had not consented to their decision and action; and he was looking for the kingdom of God.

verses.textEn: Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. Bending over, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he went away, wondering to himself what had happened.

verses.textEnNasb: And they approached the village where they were going, and He gave the impression that He was going farther.
verses.textEn: As they approached the village to which they were going, Jesus continued on as if he were going farther.

verses.textZh: 他们强留他说："天晚了，太阳下山了，请与我们同住吧！"他就进去与他们同住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们强留他说："天晚了，太阳下山了，请与我们同住吧！"他就进去与他们同住。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却强留他，说：「时候晚了，日头已经平西了，请你同我们住下吧！」耶稣就进去，要同他们住下。
verses.textEnNiv: But they urged him strongly, "Stay with us, for it is nearly evening; the day is almost over." So he went in to stay with them.
verses.textEnEsv: but they urged him strongly, saying, "Stay with us, for it is toward evening and the day is now far spent." So he went in to stay with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they constrained Him, saying, "Abide with us, for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent." And He went in to stay with them.
verses.textEnNlt: but they begged him, "Stay the night with us, since it is getting late." So he went home with them.
verses.textEnNasb: And so they strongly urged Him, saying, "Stay with us, for it is getting toward evening, and the day is now nearly over." So He went in to stay with them.
verses.textEn: But they urged him strongly, "Stay with us, for it is nearly evening; the day is almost over." So he went in to stay with them.

verses.textZh: 到了吃饭的时候，他拿起饼来，感谢了，擘开递给他们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了吃饭的时候，他拿起饼来，感谢了，擘开递给他们，
verses.textZhCuv: 到了坐席的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了，擘开，递给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: When he was at the table with them, he took bread, gave thanks, broke it and began to give it to them.
verses.textEnEsv: When he was at table with them, he took the bread and blessed and broke it and gave it to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, as He sat at the table with them, that He took bread, blessed and broke it, and gave it to them.
verses.textEnNlt: As they sat down to eat, he took the bread and blessed it. Then he broke it and gave it to them.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, when He had reclined at the table with them, that He took the bread and blessed it, and He broke it and began giving it to them.
verses.textEn: When he was at the table with them, he took bread, gave thanks, broke it and began to give it to them.

verses.textZh: 他们的眼睛开了，才认出是耶稣来；他却从他们面前不见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的眼睛开了，才认出是耶稣来；他却从他们面前不见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的眼睛明亮了，这才认出他来。忽然耶稣不见了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized him, and he disappeared from their sight.
verses.textEnEsv: And their eyes were opened, and they recognized him. And he vanished from their sight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then their eyes were opened and they knew Him; and He vanished from their sight.
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly, their eyes were opened, and they recognized him. And at that moment he disappeared!
verses.textEnNasb: And then their eyes were opened and they recognized Him; and He vanished from their sight.
verses.textEn: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized him, and he disappeared from their sight.

verses.textZh: 他们彼此说："在路上他对我们说话，给我们解释圣经的时候，我们的心不是火热的吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们彼此说："在路上他对我们说话，给我们解释圣经的时候，我们的心不是火热的吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们彼此说：「在路上，他和我们说话，给我们讲解圣经的时候，我们的心岂不是火热的吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: They asked each other, "Were not our hearts burning within us while he talked with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?"
verses.textEnEsv: They said to each other, "Did not our hearts burn within us while he talked to us on the road, while he opened to us the Scriptures?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to one another, "Did not our heart burn within us while He talked with us on the road, and while He opened the Scriptures to us?"
verses.textEnNlt: They said to each other, "Didn’t our hearts burn within us as he talked with us on the road and explained the Scriptures to us?"
verses.textEnNasb: They said to one another, " Were our hearts not burning within us when He was speaking to us on the road, while He was explaining the Scriptures to us?"
verses.textEn: They asked each other, "Were not our hearts burning within us while he talked with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?"

verses.textZh: 他们就立时起来回耶路撒冷去。在那里遇见十一个使徒和跟他们聚在一起的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就立时起来回耶路撒冷去。在那里遇见十一个使徒和跟他们聚在一起的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就立时起身，回耶路撒冷去，正遇见十一个使徒和他们的同人聚集在一处，
verses.textEnNiv: They got up and returned at once to Jerusalem. There they found the Eleven and those with them, assembled together
verses.textEnEsv: And they rose that same hour and returned to Jerusalem. And they found the eleven and those who were with them gathered together,
verses.textEnNkjv: So they rose up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven and those whowere with them gathered together,
verses.textEnNlt: And within the hour they were on their way back to Jerusalem. There they found the eleven disciples and the others who had gathered with them,
verses.textEnNasb: And they got up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together and those who were with them,
verses.textEn: They got up and returned at once to Jerusalem. There they found the Eleven and those with them, assembled together

verses.textZh: 说："主果然复活了，已经向西门显现了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："主果然复活了，已经向西门显现了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「主果然复活，已经现给西门看了。」
verses.textEnNiv: and saying, "It is true! The Lord has risen and has appeared to Simon."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "The Lord has risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!"
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!"
verses.textEnNlt: who said, "The Lord has really risen! He appeared to Peter. "
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "The Lord has really risen and has appeared to Simon!"
verses.textEn: and saying, "It is true! The Lord has risen and has appeared to Simon."

verses.textZh: 两个人就把在路上的事，和擘饼的时候他们怎样认出耶稣来的事，都述说了一遍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两个人就把在路上的事，和擘饼的时候他们怎样认出耶稣来的事，都述说了一遍。
verses.textZhCuv: 两个人就把路上所遇见，和擘饼的时候怎么被他们认出来的事，都述说了一遍。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the two told what had happened on the way, and how Jesus was recognized by them when he broke the bread.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they told what had happened on the road, and how he was known to them in the breaking of the bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they told about the things thathadhappened on the road, and how He was known to them in the breaking of bread.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the two from Emmaus told their story of how Jesus had appeared to them as they were walking along the road, and how they had recognized him as he was breaking the bread.
verses.textEnNasb: They began to relate their experiences on the road, and how He was recognized by them at the breaking of the bread.
verses.textEn: Then the two told what had happened on the way, and how Jesus was recognized by them when he broke the bread.

verses.textZh: 正说这话的时候，耶稣亲自站在他们当中，说："<red>愿你们平安。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 正说这话的时候，耶稣亲自站在他们当中，说："<red>愿你们平安。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 正说这话的时候，耶稣亲自站在他们当中，说：「<red>愿你们平安！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: While they were still talking about this, Jesus himself stood among them and said to them, <red>“Peace be with you.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: As they were talking about these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, "Peace to you!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as they said these things, Jesus Himself stood in the midst of them, and said to them, "Peace to you."
verses.textEnNlt: And just as they were telling about it, Jesus himself was suddenly standing there among them. "Peace be with you," he said.
verses.textEnNasb: Now while they were telling these things, Jesus Himself suddenly stood in their midst and *said to them, "Peace be to you."
verses.textEn: While they were still talking about this, Jesus himself stood among them and said to them, <red>“Peace be with you.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们非常惊怕，以为看见了灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们非常惊怕，以为看见了灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却惊慌害怕，以为所看见的是魂。
verses.textEnNiv: They were startled and frightened, thinking they saw a ghost.
verses.textEnEsv: But they were startled and frightened and thought they saw a spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they were terrified and frightened, and supposed they had seen a spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: But the whole group was startled and frightened, thinking they were seeing a ghost!
verses.textEnNasb: But they were startled and frightened, and thought that they were looking at a spirit.
verses.textEn: They were startled and frightened, thinking they saw a ghost.

verses.textZh: 他说："<red>你们为甚么惊慌，为甚么心里疑惑呢？</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："<red>你们为甚么惊慌，为甚么心里疑惑呢？</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣说：「你们为什么愁烦？为什么心里起疑念呢？</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, <red>“Why are you troubled, and why do doubts rise in your minds?</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Why are you troubled, and why do doubts arise in your hearts?
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "Why are you troubled? And why do doubts arise in your hearts?
verses.textEnNlt: "Why are you frightened?" he asked. "Why are your hearts filled with doubt?
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to them, "Why are you frightened, and why are doubts arising in your hearts?
verses.textEn: He said to them, <red>“Why are you troubled, and why do doubts rise in your minds?</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们看我的手、我的脚，就知道我是谁。摸我看看，灵没有骨，没有肉；你们看，我是有的。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们看我的手、我的脚，就知道我是谁。摸我看看，灵没有骨，没有肉；你们看，我是有的。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们看我的手，我的脚，就知道实在是我了。摸我看看！魂无骨无肉，你们看，我是有的。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>Look at my hands and my feet. It is I myself! Touch me and see; a ghost does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: See my hands and my feet, that it is I myself. Touch me, and see. For a spirit does not have flesh and bones as you see that I have."
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold My hands and My feet, that it is I Myself. Handle Me and see, for a spirit does not have flesh and bones as you see I have."
verses.textEnNlt: Look at my hands. Look at my feet. You can see that it’s really me. Touch me and make sure that I am not a ghost, because ghosts don’t have bodies, as you see that I do."
verses.textEnNasb: See My hands and My feet, that it is I Myself; touch Me and see, because a spirit does not have flesh and bones as you plainly see that I have."
verses.textEn: <red>Look at my hands and my feet. It is I myself! Touch me and see; a ghost does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have.”</red>

verses.textZh: 说了这话，就把手和脚给他们看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说了这话，就把手和脚给他们看。
verses.textZhCuv: 说了这话，就把手和脚给他们看。
verses.textEnNiv: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and feet.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He had said this, He showed them His hands and His feet.
verses.textEnNlt: As he spoke, he showed them his hands and his feet.
verses.textEnNasb: And when He had said this, He showed them His hands and His feet.
verses.textEn: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and feet.

verses.textZh: 他们欢喜到不敢相信，并且很惊奇。耶稣说："<red>你们这里有甚么吃的没有？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们欢喜到不敢相信，并且很惊奇。耶稣说："<red>你们这里有甚么吃的没有？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们正喜得不敢信，并且希奇；耶稣就说：「<red>你们这里有什么吃的没有？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: And while they still did not believe it because of joy and amazement, he asked them, <red>“Do you have anything here to eat?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And while they still disbelieved for joy and were marveling, he said to them, "Have you anything here to eat?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But while they still did not believe for joy, and marveled, He said to them, "Have you any food here?"
verses.textEnNlt: Still they stood there in disbelief, filled with joy and wonder. Then he asked them, "Do you have anything here to eat?"
verses.textEnNasb: While they still could not believe it because of their joy and astonishment, He said to them, "Have you anything here to eat?"
verses.textEn: And while they still did not believe it because of joy and amazement, he asked them, <red>“Do you have anything here to eat?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们就给了他一片烧鱼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就给了他一片烧鱼。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们便给他一片烧鱼。
verses.textEnNiv: They gave him a piece of broiled fish,
verses.textEnEsv: They gave him a piece of broiled fish,
verses.textEnNkjv: So they gave Him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.
verses.textEnNlt: They gave him a piece of broiled fish,
verses.textEnNasb: They served Him a piece of broiled fish;
verses.textEn: They gave him a piece of broiled fish,

verses.textZh: 他接过来，在他们面前吃了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他接过来，在他们面前吃了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他接过来，在他们面前吃了。
verses.textEnNiv: and he took it and ate it in their presence.
verses.textEnEsv: and he took it and ate before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He took it and ate in their presence.
verses.textEnNlt: and he ate it as they watched.
verses.textEnNasb: and He took it and ate it in front of them.
verses.textEn: and he took it and ate it in their presence.

verses.textZh: 主对他们说："<red>这就是我从前与你们同在的时候，对你们说过的话：摩西的律法、先知书和诗篇上所记关于我的一切事，都必定应验。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 主对他们说："<red>这就是我从前与你们同在的时候，对你们说过的话：摩西的律法、先知书和诗篇上所记关于我的一切事，都必定应验。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣对他们说：「<red>这就是我从前与你们同在之时所告诉你们的话说：摩西的律法、先知的书，和诗篇上所记的，凡指着我的话都必须应验。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, <red>“This is what I told you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets and the Psalms.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to them, "These are my words that I spoke to you while I was still with you, that everything written about me in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and the Psalms must be fulfilled."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to them, "These are the words which I spoke to you while I was still with you, that all things must be fulfilled which were written in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and the Psalms concerning Me."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "When I was with you before, I told you that everything written about me in the law of Moses and the prophets and in the Psalms must be fulfilled."
verses.textEnNasb: Now He said to them, "These are My words which I spoke to you while I was still with you, that all the things that are written about Me in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and the Psalms must be fulfilled."
verses.textEn: He said to them, <red>“This is what I told you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets and the Psalms.”</red>

verses.textZh: 于是他开他们的心窍，使他们明白圣经；
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他开他们的心窍，使他们明白圣经；
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶稣开他们的心窍，使他们能明白圣经，
verses.textEnNiv: Then he opened their minds so they could understand the Scriptures.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he opened their minds to understand the Scriptures,
verses.textEnNkjv: And He opened their understanding, that they might comprehend the Scriptures.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he opened their minds to understand the Scriptures.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He opened their minds to understand the Scriptures,
verses.textEn: Then he opened their minds so they could understand the Scriptures.

verses.textZh: 又说："<red>经上这样记着：基督必须受害，第三天从死人中复活。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说："<red>经上这样记着：基督必须受害，第三天从死人中复活。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又对他们说：「照经上所写的，基督必受害，第三日从死里复活，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He told them, <red>“This is what is written: The Messiah will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and said to them, "Thus it is written, that the Christ should suffer and on the third day rise from the dead,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to them, "Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,
verses.textEnNlt: And he said, "Yes, it was written long ago that the Messiah would suffer and die and rise from the dead on the third day.
verses.textEnNasb: and He said to them, "So it is written, that the Christ would suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,
verses.textEn: He told them, <red>“This is what is written: The Messiah will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,</red>

verses.textZh: <red>人要奉他的名，传讲悔改与赦罪的道，从耶路撒冷起，直传到万国。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>人要奉他的名，传讲悔改与赦罪的道，从耶路撒冷起，直传到万国。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>并且人要奉他的名传悔改、赦罪的道，从耶路撒冷起直传到万邦。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>and repentance for the forgiveness of sins will be preached in his name to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and that repentance for the forgiveness of sins should be proclaimed in his name to all nations, beginning from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in His name to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: It was also written that this message would be proclaimed in the authority of his name to all the nations, beginning in Jerusalem: ‘There is forgiveness of sins for all who repent.’
verses.textEnNasb: and that repentance for forgiveness of sins would be proclaimed in His name to all the nations, beginning from Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: <red>and repentance for the forgiveness of sins will be preached in his name to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>你们就是这些事的见证。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>你们就是这些事的见证。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>你们就是这些事的见证。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>You are witnesses of these things.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: You are witnesses of these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you are witnesses of these things.
verses.textEnNlt: You are witnesses of all these things.
verses.textEnNasb: You are witnesses of these things.
verses.textEn: <red>You are witnesses of these things.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我要使我父的应许临到你们身上，你们当在城里等候，直到得着从上面来的能力。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我要使我父的应许临到你们身上，你们当在城里等候，直到得着从上面来的能力。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我要将我父所应许的降在你们身上，你们要在城里等候，直到你们领受从上头来的能力。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I am going to send you what my Father has promised; but stay in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, I am sending the promise of my Father upon you. But stay in the city until you are clothed with power from on high."
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I send the Promise of My Father upon you; but tarry in the city of Jerusalem until you are endued with power from on high."
verses.textEnNlt: "And now I will send the Holy Spirit, just as my Father promised. But stay here in the city until the Holy Spirit comes and fills you with power from heaven."
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, I am sending the promise of My Father upon you; but you are to stay in the city until you are clothed with power from on high."
verses.textEn: <red>I am going to send you what my Father has promised; but stay in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high.”</red>

verses.textZh: 主带他们出去，到了伯大尼附近，举手给他们祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主带他们出去，到了伯大尼附近，举手给他们祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣领他们到伯大尼的对面，就举手给他们祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: When he had led them out to the vicinity of Bethany, he lifted up his hands and blessed them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he led them out as far as Bethany, and lifting up his hands he blessed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He led them out as far as Bethany, and He lifted up His hands and blessed them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jesus led them to Bethany, and lifting his hands to heaven, he blessed them.
verses.textEnNasb: And He led them out as far as Bethany, and He lifted up His hands and blessed them.
verses.textEn: When he had led them out to the vicinity of Bethany, he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

verses.textZh: 正在祝福的时候，他就离开他们，被接到天上去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正在祝福的时候，他就离开他们，被接到天上去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 正祝福的时候，他就离开他们，被带到天上去了。
verses.textEnNiv: While he was blessing them, he left them and was taken up into heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: While he blessed them, he parted from them and was carried up into heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, while He blessed them, that He was parted from them and carried up into heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: While he was blessing them, he left them and was taken up to heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: While He was blessing them, He parted from them and was carried up into heaven.
verses.textEn: While he was blessing them, he left them and was taken up into heaven.

verses.textZh: 他们就敬拜他，欢欢喜喜地回到耶路撒冷，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就敬拜他，欢欢喜喜地回到耶路撒冷，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就拜他，大大地欢喜，回耶路撒冷去，
verses.textEnNiv: Then they worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy.
verses.textEnEsv: And they worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
verses.textEnNkjv: And they worshiped Him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
verses.textEnNlt: So they worshiped him and then returned to Jerusalem filled with great joy.
verses.textEnNasb: And they, after worshiping Him, returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
verses.textEn: Then they worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy.

verses.textZh: 常常在殿里称颂神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 常常在殿里称颂神。
verses.textZhCuv: 常在殿里称颂神。
verses.textEnNiv: And they stayed continually at the temple, praising God.
verses.textEnEsv: and were continually in the temple blessing God.
verses.textEnNkjv: and were continually in the temple praising and blessing God. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: And they spent all of their time in the Temple, praising God.
verses.textEnNasb: and were continually in the temple praising God.
verses.textEn: And they stayed continually at the temple, praising God.
